children.text: Chapter 1
buddho bhagavāñśrāvastyāṃ viharati sma jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme ||
children.translated_text: The Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>, in <s>Jetavana</s>, in <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>'s park.

children.text: asmāt parāntake vāsavagrāme balaseno nāma gṛhapatiḥ prativasati āḍhyo mahādhano mahābhogo vistīrṇaviśālaparigraho vaiśravaṇadhanapratispardhī ||
children.translated_text: Now in that frontier region, in the village of <s>Vāsavagrāma</s>, there lived a householder named <s>Balasena</s>, wealthy, possessed of great riches and great enjoyments, with broad and extensive possessions, rivaling the wealth of <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s>.

children.text: tena sadṛśāt kulāt kalatramānītam ||
children.translated_text: He took a wife from a family equal to his own.

children.text: sa tayā sārdhaṃ krīḍati ramate paricārayati ||
children.translated_text: Together with her he sported, delighted himself, and enjoyed pleasure.

children.text: so 'putraḥ putrābhinandī śivavaruṇakuberaśakrabrahmādīnāyācate ārāmadevatāṃ vanadevatāṃ śṛṅgāṭakadevatāṃ balipratigrāhikāṃ devatām ||
children.translated_text: Being sonless and longing for a son, he entreated <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Kubera</s>, <s>Śakra</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, and the others, as well as the deity of the monastery, the deity of the forest, the deity of the crossroads, and the deity who accepts offerings.

children.text: sahajāṃ sahadharmikāṃ nityānubaddhāmapi devatāmāyācate ||
children.translated_text: He also entreated the deity who was born with him, shared his dharma, and was always attached to him.

children.text: asti caiṣa loke pravādo yadāyācanahetoḥ putrā jāyante ||
children.translated_text: There is this common saying in the world, that sons are born because of entreaty.

children.text: duhitaraśceti ||
children.translated_text: And daughters too.

children.text: tacca naivam ||
children.translated_text: But that is not so.

children.text: yadyevamabhaviṣyat ekaikasya putrasahasramabhaviṣyat tadyathā rājñaścakravartinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: If it were so, each person would have a thousand sons, just like a wheel-turning king.

children.text: api tu trayāṇāṃ sthānānāṃ saṃmukhībhāvāt putrā jāyante duhitaraśca ||
children.translated_text: Rather, sons and daughters are born from the concurrence of three conditions.

children.text: katameṣāṃ trayāṇām mātāpitarau raktau bhavataḥ saṃnipatitau mātā kalyā bhavati ṛtumatī gandharvaḥ pratyupasthito bhavati ||
children.translated_text: Which three? The mother and father are passionate and have come together; the mother is healthy and in her season; and a <s>gandharva</s> is present.

children.text: eṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ sthānānāṃ saṃmukhībhāvāt putrā jāyante duhitaraśca ||
children.translated_text: From the concurrence of these three conditions sons and daughters are born.

children.text: sa caivamāyācanaparastiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: And he remained intent on such entreaty.

children.text: anyatamaśca sattvaścaramabhavikaśca hitaiṣī gṛhītamokṣamārgāntonmukho na nirvāṇe bahirmukhaḥ saṃsārādanarthikaḥ sarvabhavagativyupapattiparāṅmukho 'ntimadehadhārī anyatamāt sattvanikāyāccyutvā tasya prajāpatyāḥ kukṣimavakrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then a certain being, one in his final existence, seeking welfare, with his face turned toward the path of liberation he had taken up, not turned away from nirvāṇa, uninterested in saṃsāra, turned away from birth in every state of existence, bearing his final body, fell from a certain class of beings and entered the womb of that householder's wife.

children.text: pañcāveṇikā dharmā ekatye paṇḍitajātīye mātṛgrāme ||
children.translated_text: There are five special qualities in some women of wise nature.

children.text: katame pañca raktaṃ puruṣaṃ jānāti viraktaṃ jānāti ||
children.translated_text: Which five? She knows a man who is impassioned, and she knows one who is free from passion.

children.text: kālaṃ jānāti ṛtuṃ jānāti ||
children.translated_text: She knows the proper time; she knows her season.

children.text: garbhamavakrāntaṃ jānāti ||
children.translated_text: She knows that an embryo has entered the womb.

children.text: yasya sakāśād garbhamavakrāmati taṃ jānāti ||
children.translated_text: She knows from whose presence the embryo has entered.

children.text: dārakaṃ jānāti dārikāṃ jānāti ||
children.translated_text: She knows whether it is a boy or a girl.

children.text: saceddārako bhavati dakṣiṇaṃ kukṣiṃ niśritya tiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: If it is a boy, it stays leaning on the right side of the womb.

children.text: saceddārikā bhavati vāmaṃ kukṣiṃ niśritya tiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: If it is a girl, it stays leaning on the left side of the womb.

children.text: sā āttamanāttamanāḥ svāmina ārocayati diṣṭyā āryaputra vardhasva ||
children.translated_text: Joyful and pleased, she informed her husband, "By good fortune, noble son, rejoice.

children.text: āpannasattvāsmi saṃvṛttā ||
children.translated_text: I have become pregnant.

children.text: yathā ca me dakṣiṇaṃ kukṣiṃ niśritya tiṣṭhati niyataṃ dārako bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: And because it stays leaning on my right side, it will certainly be a boy."

children.text: so 'pi āttamanāttamanā udānam udānayati apyevāhaṃ cirakālābhilaṣitaṃ putramukhaṃ paśyeyam ||
children.translated_text: He too, joyful and pleased, uttered this exclamation: "May I indeed see the face of the son I have desired for so long.

children.text: jāto me syānnāvajātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he be born to me, and not be stillborn.

children.text: kṛtyāni me kurvīta ||
children.translated_text: May he perform my duties.

children.text: bhṛtaḥ pratibibhṛyāt ||
children.translated_text: Having been supported by me, may he support me in return.

children.text: dāyādyaṃ pratipadyeta ||
children.translated_text: May he receive the inheritance.

children.text: kulavaṃśo me cirasthitiko bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: My family line will last long.

children.text: asmākaṃ cāpyatītakālagatānām alpaṃ vā prabhūtaṃ vā dānāni dattvā puṇyāni kṛtvā dakṣiṇāmādeśayiṣyati idaṃ tayoryatratatropapannayorgacchatoranugacchatviti ||
children.translated_text: And when we too have passed away, after giving gifts, whether small or great, and making merit, he will dedicate the offering, saying, 'May this follow those two, wherever they have been reborn and wherever they are going.'"

children.text: āpannasattvāṃ ca tāṃ viditvā upariprasādatalagatāmayantritāṃ dhārayati śīte śītopakaraṇairuṣṇa uṣṇopakaraṇairvaidyaprajñaptairāhārair nātitiktair nātyamlair nātilavaṇair nātimadhurair nātikaṭukair nātikaṣāyais tiktāmlalavaṇamadhurakaṭukaṣāyavivarjitairāhāraiḥ hārārdhahāravibhūṣitagātrīm apsarasamiva nandanavanavicāriṇīṃ mañcānmañcaṃ pīṭhātpīṭham avatarantīm uparimāṃ bhūmim ||
children.translated_text: Knowing that she was pregnant, he kept her on the upper floor of the palace, unrestrained, with things suitable for cold in the cold season and things suitable for heat in the hot season, with foods prescribed by physicians, not too bitter, not too sour, not too salty, not too sweet, not too pungent, and not too astringent, with foods free from excessive bitterness, sourness, saltiness, sweetness, pungency, and astringency; her body adorned with necklaces and half-necklaces, like an apsaras wandering in <s>Nandana</s> grove, descending from couch to couch and from seat to seat on the upper floor.

children.text: na cāsyā amanojñaśabdaśravaṇam yāvadeva garbhasya paripākāya ||
children.translated_text: Nor did she hear any unpleasant sound, all for the maturation of the embryo.

children.text: sā aṣṭānāṃ vā navānāṃ vā māsānāmatyayāt prasūtā ||
children.translated_text: After eight or nine months had passed, she gave birth.

children.text: dārako jātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A boy was born.

children.text: abhirūpo darśanīyaḥ prāsādiko gauraḥ kanakavarṇaśchatrākāraśirāḥ pralambabāhurvistīrṇaviśālalalāṭaḥ saṃgatabhrūruttuṅganāso ratnapratyuptikayā karṇikayā āmuktayālaṃkṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was handsome, lovely to behold, pleasing, fair, golden in color, with a head shaped like a parasol, long arms, a broad and wide forehead, joined eyebrows, a prominent nose, and adorned with an earring set with jewels and fastened on him.

children.text: balasenena gṛhapatinā ratnaparīkṣakā āhūyoktāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The householder <s>Balasena</s> summoned gem appraisers and said:

children.text: bhavantaḥ ratnānāṃ mūlyaṃ kuruta iti ||
children.translated_text: "Sirs, determine the value of these jewels."

children.text: na śakyate ratnānāṃ mūlyaṃ kartumiti ||
children.translated_text: They said, "The value of the jewels cannot be determined."

children.text: dharmatā yasya na śakyate mūlyaṃ kartuṃ tasya koṭimūlyaṃ kriyate ||
children.translated_text: It is the rule that when something's value cannot be determined, its value is set at a crore.

children.text: te kathayanti gṛhapate asya ratnasya koṭirmūlyamiti ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Householder, this jewel has a value of a crore."

children.text: tasya jñātayaḥ saṃgamya samāgamya trīṇi saptakāni ekaviṃśatidivasāni vistareṇa jātasya jātimahaṃ kṛtvā nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpayanti kiṃ bhavatu dārakasya nāmeti ||
children.translated_text: His relatives gathered and assembled, and for three weeks, twenty-one days, they elaborately celebrated the birth of the newborn; then they settled on a name, asking, "What shall the boy's name be?"

children.text: ayaṃ dārakaḥ koṭimūlyayā ratnapratyuptikayā āmuktayā jātaḥ śravaṇeṣu ca nakṣatreṣu ||
children.translated_text: "This boy was born with an earring set with jewels worth a crore, and under the <s>Śravaṇa</s> lunar mansions.

children.text: bhavatu dārakasya śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇa iti nāma ||
children.translated_text: Therefore let the boy's name be <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>."

children.text: yasminneva divase śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo jātaḥ tasminneva divase balasenasya gṛhapaterdvau preṣyadārakau jātau ||
children.translated_text: On the very day on which <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> was born, on that same day two servant boys were born to the householder <s>Balasena</s>.

children.text: tenaikasya dāraka iti nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpitam aparasya pālaka iti ||
children.translated_text: He assigned the name <s>Dāraka</s> to one boy, and <s>Pālaka</s> to the other.

children.text: śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo 'ṣṭābhyo dhātrībhyo 'nupradatto dvābhyāmaṃsadhātrībhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ krīḍanikābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ maladhātrībhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ kṣīradhātrībhyām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> was handed over to eight nurses: two nurses for carrying him on the shoulder, two play-nurses, two nurses for cleaning him, and two milk-nurses.

children.text: so 'ṣṭābhirdhātrībhirunnīyate vardhyate kṣīreṇa dadhnā navanītena sarpiṣā sarpimaṇḍenānyaiś cottaptottaptairupakaraṇaviśeṣaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was lifted up and reared by those eight nurses, with milk, curds, fresh butter, ghee, the finest part of ghee, and other especially warm and choice provisions.

children.text: āśu vardhate hradasthamiva paṅkajam ||
children.translated_text: He grew quickly, like a lotus standing in a lake.

children.text: sa yadā mahān saṃvṛttastadā lipyām upanyastaḥ saṃkhyāyāṃ gaṇanāyāṃ mudrāyāmuddhāre nyāse nikṣepe vastuparīkṣāyāṃ ratnaparīkṣāyām ||
children.translated_text: When he had grown large, he was set to writing, to arithmetic, to calculation, to seals, to lending, to deposit, to entrusting goods, to the examination of commodities, and to the examination of jewels.

children.text: so 'ṣṭāsu parīkṣāsūdghaṭako vācakaḥ piṇḍataḥ paṭupracāraḥ saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In the eight branches of examination he became discerning, articulate, and, in sum, skilled in practical procedure.

children.text: tasya pitrā trīṇi vāsagṛhāṇi māpitāni haimantikaṃ graiṣmikaṃ vārṣikam ||
children.translated_text: His father had three dwelling houses built for him: one for winter, one for summer, and one for the rainy season.

children.text: trīṇi udyānāni māpitāni haimantikaṃ graiṣmikaṃ vārṣikam ||
children.translated_text: He had three parks built: one for winter, one for summer, and one for the rainy season.

children.text: trīṇi antaḥpurāṇi pratyupasthāpitāni jyeṣṭhakaṃ madhyamaṃ kanīyasam ||
children.translated_text: He furnished three inner apartments: the senior, the middle, and the junior.

children.text: sa upariprāsādatalagato niṣpuruṣeṇa tūryeṇa krīḍati ramate paricārayati ||
children.translated_text: Dwelling on the upper floor of the palace, he played, amused himself, and enjoyed himself with music performed without men.

children.text: balaseno gṛhapatir nityameva kṛṣikarmānte udyuktaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The householder <s>Balasena</s> was constantly occupied with the business of agriculture.

children.text: sa koṭikarṇastaṃ pitaraṃ paśyati nityaṃ kṛṣikarmānte udyuktam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Koṭikarṇa</s> saw that father of his constantly occupied with the business of agriculture.

children.text: sa kathayati tāta kasyārthe tvaṃ nityameva kṛṣikarmānte udyuktaḥ sa kathayati putra yathā tvamupariprāsādatalagato niṣpuruṣeṇa tūryeṇa krīḍasi ramasi paricārayasi yadyahamapi evameva krīḍeyaṃ rameyaṃ paricārayeyam nacirādevāsmākaṃ bhogāstanutvaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gaccheyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: He said, 'Father, for whose sake are you constantly occupied with the business of agriculture?' He said, 'Son, as you play, amuse yourself, and enjoy yourself on the upper floor of the palace with music performed without men, if I too were to play, amuse myself, and enjoy myself in just the same way, before long our possessions would go to thinness, exhaustion, and depletion.'

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati mamaivārthaṃ codanā kriyate ||
children.translated_text: He reflected, 'It is for my sake alone that this urging is being done.'

children.text: sa kathayati tāta yadyevam gacchāmi mahāsamudramavatarāmi ||
children.translated_text: He said, 'Father, if that is so, I shall go and descend to the great ocean.'

children.text: pitā kathayati putra tāvantaṃ me ratnajātamasti ||
children.translated_text: His father said, 'Son, I have so much wealth in jewels.'

children.text: yadi tvaṃ tilataṇḍulakolakulatthanyāyena ratnāni parimokṣyase tathāpi me ratnānāṃ parikṣayo na syāt ||
children.translated_text: 'Even if you were to spend jewels according to the maxim of sesame, rice, jujube, and kulattha beans, still there would be no exhaustion of my jewels.'

children.text: sa kathayati tāta anujānīhi mām paṇyamādāya mahāsamudramavatarāmīti ||
children.translated_text: He said, 'Father, give me permission; taking merchandise, I shall descend to the great ocean.'

children.text: balasenena tasyāvaśyaṃ nirbandhaṃ jñātvānujñātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Balasena</s> knew that his insistence was unavoidable, he gave him permission.

children.text: balasenena gṛhapatinā vāsavagrāmake ghaṇṭāvaghoṣaṇaṃ kṛtam yo yuṣmākamutsahate śroṇena koṭikarṇena sārthavāhena sārdham aśulkenātarapaṇyena mahāsamudramavatartum sa mahāsamudragamanīyaṃ paṇyaṃ samudānayatu ||
children.translated_text: The householder <s>Balasena</s> had a bell proclamation made in the village of <s>Vāsava</s>: 'Whoever among you is able to descend to the great ocean together with the caravan leader <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>, without tax and with untaxed merchandise, let him assemble merchandise suitable for travel to the great ocean.'

children.text: pañcabhirvaṇikśatairmahāsamudragamanīyaṃ paṇyaṃ samudānītam ||
children.translated_text: Five hundred merchants assembled merchandise suitable for travel to the great ocean.

children.text: balaseno nāma gṛhapatiḥ saṃlakṣayati kīdṛśena yānena śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo yāsyati sa saṃlakṣayati saced hastibhiḥ hastinaḥ sukumārā durbharāśca aśvā api sukumārā durbharāśca gardabhāḥ smṛtimantaḥ sukumārāśca ||
children.translated_text: The householder named <s>Balasena</s> reflected, 'By what vehicle will <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> travel?' He reflected, 'If by elephants, elephants are delicate and hard to maintain; horses too are delicate and hard to maintain; donkeys are mindful and delicate.'

children.text: gardabhayānena gacchatviti ||
children.translated_text: 'Let him go by donkey-vehicle.'

children.text: sa pitrā āhūyoktaḥ putra na tvayā sārthasya purastād gantavyam nāpi pṛṣṭhataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was summoned by his father and told, 'Son, you must not go in front of the caravan, nor behind it.

children.text: yadi balavāṃścauro bhavati sārthasya purastānnipatati ||
children.translated_text: If a bandit is strong, he attacks the front of the caravan.

children.text: durbalo bhavati pṛṣṭhato nipatati ||
children.translated_text: If he is weak, he attacks from behind.

children.text: tvayā sārthasya madhye gantavyam ||
children.translated_text: You must go in the middle of the caravan.

children.text: na ca te sārthavāhe hate sārtho vaktavyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And if the caravan leader is killed, the caravan must not be told about you.'

children.text: dāsakapālakāvapi uktau putrau yuvābhyāṃ na kenacit prakāreṇa śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo moktavya iti ||
children.translated_text: The two slave-attendants were also told, 'Sons, by no means whatsoever are you two to let <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> go.'

children.text: athāpareṇa samayena śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇaḥ kṛtakautukamaṅgalasvastyayano mātuḥ sakāśamupasaṃkramya pādayor nipatya kathayati amba gacchāmi avalokitā bhava mahāsamudramavatarāmi ||
children.translated_text: Then, at another time, <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>, after the rites of festivity, auspiciousness, and blessing had been performed, approached his mother, fell at her feet, and said, 'Mother, I am going. Be attentive to me; I am descending to the great ocean.'

children.text: sā ruditumārabdhā ||
children.translated_text: She began to weep.

children.text: sa kathayati amba kasmād rodasi ||
children.translated_text: He said, 'Mother, why are you weeping?'

children.text: mātā sāśrudurdinavadanā kathayati putra kadācidahaṃ putrakaṃ punarapi jīvantaṃ drakṣyāmīti ||
children.translated_text: His mother, her face darkened by tears, said, 'Son, will I ever again see my dear son alive?'

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati ahaṃ maṅgalaiḥ samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He reflected, 'I have set out with auspicious rites.'

children.text: iyamīdṛśamamaṅgalamabhidhatte ||
children.translated_text: 'Yet she speaks such an inauspicious thing.'

children.text: sa ruṣitaḥ kathayati amba ahaṃ kṛtakautūhalamaṅgalasvastyayano mahāsamudraṃ samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Angered, he said, 'Mother, after rites of festivity, auspiciousness, and blessing have been performed, I have set out for the great ocean.

children.text: tvaṃ cedṛśānyamaṅgalāni karoṣi ||
children.translated_text: But you are doing such inauspicious things.

children.text: apāyān kiṃ na paśyasīti ||
children.translated_text: Why do you not see the misfortunes?'

children.text: sā kathayati putra kharaṃ te vākkarma niścāritam ||
children.translated_text: She said, 'Son, a harsh deed of speech has been uttered by you.

children.text: atyayamatyayato deśaya ||
children.translated_text: Confess the transgression as a transgression.

children.text: apyevaitat karma tanutvaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gacchet ||
children.translated_text: Perhaps this karma may go to thinness, exhaustion, and depletion.'

children.text: sā tenātyayam atyayataḥ kṣamāpitā ||
children.translated_text: He asked her forgiveness for that transgression as a transgression.

children.text: atha śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇaḥ kṛtakautūhalamaṅgalasvastyayanaḥ śakaṭairbhārairmoṭaiḥ piṭakairuṣṭrairgobhirgardabhaiḥ prabhūtaṃ samudragamanīyaṃ paṇyamāropya mahāsamudraṃ samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>, after the rites of festivity, auspiciousness, and blessing had been performed, loaded abundant merchandise suitable for ocean travel onto carts, pack-loads, bundles, baskets, camels, oxen, and donkeys, and set out for the great ocean.

children.text: so 'nupūrveṇa grāmanagaranigamapallipattaneṣu cañcūryamāṇo mahāsamudrataṭamanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In due order, wandering through villages, cities, market towns, hamlets, and ports, he reached the shore of the great ocean.

children.text: nipuṇataḥ sāmudram yānapātraṃ pratipādya mahāsamudramavatīrṇo dhanahārakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After carefully procuring a sea-going vessel, the wealth-carrier descended to the great ocean.

children.text: so 'nuguṇena vāyunā ratnadvīpamanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With a favorable wind he reached <s>ratnadvīpa</s>, the jewel island.

children.text: tena tatropaparīkṣyopaparīkṣya ratnānāṃ tad vahanaṃ pūritaṃ tadyathā tilataṇḍulakolakulatthānām ||
children.translated_text: There, after examining the jewels again and again, he filled that vessel with jewels just as one might fill it with sesame, rice, jujubes, and horse-gram.

children.text: so 'nuguṇena vāyunā śroṇaḥ saṃsiddhayānapātro jambudvīpamanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, with a favorable wind and with his ship's equipment successfully prepared, <s>Śroṇa</s> reached <s>Jambudvīpa</s>.

children.text: sa sārthastasminneva samudratīre āvāsitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: That caravan encamped on that very seashore.

children.text: asau śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo 'pi sārthavāho dāsakapālakāvādāya sārthamadhyādekānte 'pakramya āyaṃ vyayaṃ ca tulayitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And that <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>, the caravan-master, took <s>Dāsaka</s> and <s>Pālaka</s>, withdrew from the midst of the caravan to a secluded place, and began to balance income and expenditure.

children.text: paścāt tenāsau dāsako 'bhihitaḥ dāsaka paśya sārthaḥ kiṃ karotīti ||
children.translated_text: Afterwards he said to that <s>Dāsaka</s>, "<s>Dāsaka</s>, go see what the caravan is doing."

children.text: sa gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He went.

children.text: yāvat paśyati sthorāṃ lardayantaṃ sārtham ||
children.translated_text: When he looked, he saw the caravan snoring heavily.

children.text: so 'pi sthorāṃ lardayitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He too began to snore heavily.

children.text: dāsakaḥ saṃlakṣayati pālakaḥ sārthavāhaṃ śabdāpayiṣyati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dāsaka</s> thought, "<s>Pālaka</s> will summon the caravan-master."

children.text: pālako 'pi saṃlakṣayati dāsakaḥ sārthavāhaḥ śabdāpayiṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pālaka</s> also thought, "<s>Dāsaka</s> will summon the caravan-master."

children.text: sa sārthaḥ sarātrimeva sthorāṃ lardayitvā samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After the caravan had spent the whole night in heavy sleep, it set out.

children.text: so 'pi gāḍhanidrāvaṣṭabdhaḥ śayitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He too lay there overcome by deep sleep.

children.text: sa sārthastāvad gato yāvatprabhātam ||
children.translated_text: The caravan had gone on until daybreak.

children.text: te kathayanti bhavantaḥ kva sārthavāhaḥ purastād gacchati ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Sirs, where is the caravan-master? Is he going in front?"

children.text: purastād gatvā pṛcchanti kva sārthavāhaḥ pṛṣṭhata āgacchati ||
children.translated_text: They went to the front and asked, "Where is the caravan-master? Is he coming behind?"

children.text: pṛṣṭhato gatvā pṛcchanti kva sārthavāhaḥ madhye gacchati ||
children.translated_text: They went to the rear and asked, "Where is the caravan-master? Is he going in the middle?"

children.text: madhye gatvā pṛcchanti ||
children.translated_text: They went to the middle and asked.

children.text: yāvat tatrāpi nāsti ||
children.translated_text: But he was not there either.

children.text: dāsakaḥ kathayati mama buddhirutpannā pālakaḥ sārthavāhaṃ śabdāpayiṣyati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dāsaka</s> said, "The thought occurred to me, '<s>Pālaka</s> will summon the caravan-master.'"

children.text: pālako 'pi kathayati mama buddhirutpannā dāsakaḥ sārthavāhaṃ śabdāpayiṣyati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pālaka</s> also said, "The thought occurred to me, '<s>Dāsaka</s> will summon the caravan-master.'"

children.text: bhavantaḥ na śobhanaṃ kṛtam yadasmābhiḥ sārthavāhaśchoritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Sirs, what we have done is not good, since the caravan-master has been left behind by us.

children.text: āgacchata nivartāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come, let us turn back."

children.text: te kathayanti bhavantaḥ yadi vayaṃ nivartiṣyāmaḥ sarva evānayena vyasanamāpatsyāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Sirs, if we turn back, every one of us will fall into this misfortune.

children.text: āgacchata kriyākāraṃ tāvat kurmaḥ tāvanna kenacicchroṇasya koṭikarṇasya mātāpitṛbhyām ārocayitavyam yāvad bhāṇḍaṃ pratiśāmitaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: Come, let us first make an agreement: no one is to report anything to the parents of <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> until the goods have been put away."

children.text: te kriyākāraṃ kṛtvā gatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having made the agreement, they went on.

children.text: śroṇasya koṭikarṇasya mātāpitṛbhyāṃ śrutam śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo 'bhyāgata iti ||
children.translated_text: The parents of <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> heard, "<s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> has returned."

children.text: te kathayanti pṛṣṭhata āgacchati ||
children.translated_text: They said, "He is coming behind."

children.text: pṛṣṭhato gatvā pṛcchataḥ kva sārthavāhaḥ purastād gacchatīti ||
children.translated_text: They went behind and asked, "Where is the caravan-master? Is he going in front?"

children.text: taistāvadākulīkṛtau yāvad bhāṇḍaṃ pratiśāmitam ||
children.translated_text: They kept the two of them confused until the goods had been put away.

children.text: paścāt te kathayanti amba vismṛto 'smābhiḥ sārthavāha iti ||
children.translated_text: Afterwards they said, "Mother, the caravan-master was forgotten by us."

children.text: tābhyāmeka āgatya kathayati ayaṃ śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo 'bhyāgata iti ||
children.translated_text: One man came to the two of them and said, "This <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> has returned."

children.text: tasya tāvabhisāraṃ dattvā pratyudgatau na paśyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: After giving him a reward for the news, the two went out to meet him, but did not see him.

children.text: apara āgatya kathayati amba diṣṭyā vardhasva ayaṃ śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo 'bhyāgata iti ||
children.translated_text: Another came and said, "Mother, rejoice by good fortune; this <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> has returned."

children.text: tasya tāvabhisāraṃ dattvā pratyudgatau na paśyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: After giving him a reward for the news, the two went out to meet him, but did not see him.

children.text: tau na kasyacit punarapi śraddadhātumārabdhau ||
children.translated_text: The two no longer began to trust anyone again.

children.text: tābhyāmudyāneṣu svakasabhādevakuleṣu chatrāṇi vyajanāni kalaśāni upānahāni cākṣarāṇi abhilikhitāni dattāni sthāpitāni yadi tāvacchroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo jīvati laghu āgamaya kṣipramāgamaya ||
children.translated_text: In parks, in their own assembly places, and in temples, they gave and set up parasols, fans, water-jars, sandals, and inscribed letters: "If <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> is alive, bring him here soon, bring him quickly.

children.text: atha cyutaḥ kālagataḥ tasyaiva gatyupapattisthānāt sthānāntaraviśeṣatāyai ||
children.translated_text: But if he has fallen and died, may this serve for the special distinction of another place from the very place of his destiny and rebirth."

children.text: tau śokena rudantāvandhībhūtau ||
children.translated_text: The two, weeping from grief, became blind.

children.text: śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇaḥ sārthavāho 'pi sūryāṃśubhiḥ spṛṣṭa ātāpitaḥ prativibuddho yāvat sārthaṃ na paśyati nānyatra gardabhayānameva ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>, the caravan-master, was touched and heated by the rays of the sun and awoke; then he saw no caravan, only the donkey-cart.

children.text: sa taṃ gardabhayānamabhiruhya samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He climbed onto that donkey-cart and set out.

children.text: rātrau ca vātena pravāyatā vālukayā mārgo vyapoḍhaḥ pithitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: During the night, as the wind blew, the road had been swept away and covered with sand.

children.text: te ca gardabhāḥ smṛtimanto gandhamāghrāyāghrāya śanairmandamandaṃ samprasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those donkeys, possessing memory, went on very slowly, smelling the scent again and again.

children.text: sārthavāhaḥ saṃlakṣayati kasmādete śanairmandamandaṃ gacchantīti kṛtvā pratodayaṣṭyā tāḍitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The caravan-master thought, "Why are these going so very slowly?" and struck them with the goad-stick.

children.text: te saṃbhrāntā ākulībhūtāḥ smṛtibhraṣṭā unmārgeṇa samprasthitāḥ yāvad anyatamāśāṭavīṃ praviṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Startled, confused, and with their memory lost, they set out on the wrong road until they entered a certain wasteland.

children.text: te tṛṣārtā vihvalavadanā jihvāṃ nirnāmayya gacchanti ||
children.translated_text: Afflicted by thirst, with distressed faces, they went along with their tongues hanging out.

children.text: tān dṛṣṭvā tasya kāruṇyamutpannam ||
children.translated_text: Seeing them, compassion arose in him.

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati yadi etān notsrakṣyāmi anayena vyasanamāpatsye ||
children.translated_text: He thought, "If I do not release them, I will fall into calamity through this.

children.text: ko 'sau nirghṛṇahṛdayastyaktaparalokaśca ya eṣāṃ pratodayaṣṭiṃ kāye nipātayiṣyati tena ta utsṛṣṭāḥ adyāgreṇa acchinnāgrāṇi tṛṇāni bhakṣayata anavamarditāni pānīyāni pibata anāvilāni caturdiśaṃ ca śītalā vāyavo vāntviti ||
children.translated_text: Who would be so hard-hearted and so heedless of the next world as to bring this goad-stick down upon their bodies?" Then he released them, saying, "From this day forward, eat grasses whose tips are uncut, drink waters that are untrampled and clear, and may cool winds blow in the four directions."

children.text: sa tānutsṛjya padbhyāṃ samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having released them, he set out on foot.

children.text: yāvat paśyati āyasaṃ nagaramuccaṃ ca pragṛhītaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: Then he saw an iron city, high and strongly fortified.

children.text: tatra dvāre puruṣastiṣṭhati kālo raudrāścaṇḍo lohitākṣa udviddhapiṇḍo lohalaguḍavyagrahastaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At its gate stood a man, black, fierce, violent, red-eyed, with swollen lumps on his body, his hand occupied with an iron club.

children.text: sa tasya sakāśamupasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He approached him.

children.text: upasaṃkramya taṃ puruṣaṃ pṛcchati asti atra bhoḥ puruṣa pānīyamiti ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, he asks that man, "Good sir, is there water here?"

children.text: sa tūṣṇīṃ vyavasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: But he remained silent.

children.text: bhūyastena pṛṣṭaḥ astyatra nagare pānīyamiti ||
children.translated_text: Again he was asked by him, "Is there water in this city?"

children.text: bhūyo 'pi sa tūṣṇīṃ vyavasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Again he remained silent.

children.text: tena sārthavāhena tatra praviśya pānīyaṃ pānīyam iti śabdo niścāritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then that caravan leader entered there and called out the words, "Water, water!"

children.text: yāvat pañcamātraiḥ pretasahasrairdagdhasthūṇāsadṛśairasthiyantravaducchritaiḥ svakeśaromapraticchannaiḥ parvatodarasaṃnibhaiḥ sūcīchidropamamukhairanuparivāritaḥ śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At once <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> was surrounded on every side by about five thousand pretas, like burnt posts, standing upright like skeleton-machines, covered with their own hair and body-hair, with bellies like mountains and mouths like needle-holes.

children.text: te kathayanti sārthavāha kāruṇikastvam ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Caravan leader, you are compassionate.

children.text: asmākaṃ tṛṣārtānāṃ pānīyamanuprayaccha ||
children.translated_text: Give water to us, who are tormented by thirst."

children.text: sa kathayati bhavantaḥ ahamapi pānīyameva mṛgayāmi ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Good sirs, I too am seeking water itself.

children.text: kuto 'ham yuṣmākaṃ pānīyamanuprayacchāmīti te kathayanti sārthavāha pretanagaramidam kuto 'tra pānīyam adyāsmābhirdvādaśabhirvarṣaistvatsakāśātpānīyaṃ pānīyamiti śabdaḥ śrutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: How can I give water to you?" They said, "Caravan leader, this is a city of pretas. How could there be water here? Today, after twelve years, we have heard from you the words 'water, water.'"

children.text: sa kathayati ke yūyaṃ bhavantaḥ kena vā karmaṇā ihopapannāḥ śroṇa duṣkuhakā jāmbūdvīpakā manuṣyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Good sirs, who are you, and by what karma have you been born here?" "<s>Śroṇa</s>, we are deceitful men from <s>Jambudvīpa</s>.

children.text: nābhiśraddadhāsyasi ||
children.translated_text: You will not believe it."

children.text: ahaṃ bhavantaḥ pratyakṣadarśī kasmānnābhiśraddadhāsye te gāthāṃ bhāṣante ||
children.translated_text: "Good sirs, I am seeing you directly. Why would I not believe it?" They recited a verse:

children.text: ākrośakā roṣakā vayaṃ matsariṇaḥ kuṭukuñcakā vayam
children.translated_text: "We were revilers, angry men; we were envious, tight-fisted men.

children.text: dānaṃ ca na dattamaṇvapi yena vayaṃ pitṛlokamāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: And we did not give even the smallest gift; because of that we have come to the world of the dead."

children.text: śroṇa gaccha puṇyamaheśākhyastvam ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Śroṇa</s>, go; you are renowned for great merit.

children.text: asti kaścit tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ pretanagaraṃ praviṣṭaḥ svastikṣemābhyāṃ nirgacchan sa samprasthito yāvat tenāsau puruṣo dṛṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Has anyone ever been seen by you who entered a city of pretas and came out safe and sound?" He set out, until he saw that man.

children.text: tenoktaḥ bhadramukha aho bata tvayā mamārocitaṃ syāt yathedaṃ pretanagaramiti nāhamatra praviṣṭaḥ syām ||
children.translated_text: He said to him, "Fine sir, alas, if only you had told me that this was a city of pretas, I would not have entered here."

children.text: sa tenoktaḥ śroṇa gaccha puṇyamaheśākhyastvam yena tvaṃ pretanagaraṃ praviśya svastikṣemābhyāṃ nirgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: The man said to him, "<s>Śroṇa</s>, go; you are renowned for great merit, since you entered a city of pretas and came out safe and sound."

children.text: sa samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He set out.

children.text: yāvadaparaṃ paśyati āyasaṃ nagaramuccaṃ ca pragṛhītaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: Then he saw another city, made of iron, lofty and strongly enclosed.

children.text: tatrāpi dvāre puruṣastiṣṭhati kālaścaṇḍo lohitākṣa udviddhapiṇḍo lohalaguḍavyagrahastaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There too at the gate stood a man, black, fierce, red-eyed, with swollen lumps, his hand occupied with an iron club.

children.text: sa tasya sakāśamupasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He approached him.

children.text: upasaṃkramyaivamāha bhoḥ puruṣa asti atra nagare pānīyam sa tūṣṇīṃ vyavasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, he said, "Good sir, is there water in this city?" He remained silent.

children.text: bhūyastena pṛṣṭaḥ bhoḥ puruṣa asti atra nagare pānīyam sa tūṣṇīṃ vyavasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Again he asked him, "Good sir, is there water in this city?" He remained silent.

children.text: tena tatra praviśya pānīyaṃ pānīyam iti śabdaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, having entered there, he made the cry, "Water, water!"

children.text: anekaiḥ pretasahasrairdagdhasthūṇākṛtibhirasthiyantravaducchritaiḥ svakeśaromapraticchannaiḥ parvatodarasaṃnibhaiḥ sūcīchidropamamukhairanuparivāritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was surrounded on every side by many thousands of pretas, shaped like burnt posts, standing upright like skeleton-machines, covered with their own hair and body-hair, with bellies like mountains and mouths like needle-holes.

children.text: śroṇa kāruṇikastvam ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Śroṇa</s>, you are compassionate.

children.text: asmākaṃ tṛṣārtānāṃ pānīyamanuprayaccha ||
children.translated_text: Give water to us, who are tormented by thirst."

children.text: sa kathayati ahamapi bhavantaḥ pānīyameva mṛgayāmi ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Good sirs, I too am searching for water itself.

children.text: kuto 'ham yuṣmākaṃ pānīyaṃ dadāmīti te kathayanti śroṇa pretanagaramidam ||
children.translated_text: How can I give you water?" They said, "<s>Śroṇa</s>, this is a city of pretas.

children.text: kuto 'tra pānīyam adyāsmābhirdvādaśabhirvarṣaistvatsakāśāt pānīyaṃ pānīyamiti śabdaḥ śrutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: How could there be water here? Today, after twelve years, we have heard from you the words 'water, water.'"

children.text: sa cāha ke yūyaṃ bhavantaḥ kena vā karmaṇā ihopapannāḥ ta ūcuḥ śroṇa duṣkuhakā jāmbudvīpakā manuṣyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: And he said, "Good sirs, who are you, and by what karma have you been born here?" They replied, "<s>Śroṇa</s>, we are deceitful men from <s>Jambudvīpa</s>.

children.text: nābhiśraddadhāsyasi ||
children.translated_text: You will not believe it."

children.text: sa cāha ahaṃ bhavantaḥ pratyakṣadarśī ||
children.translated_text: And he said, "Good sirs, I am seeing you directly.

children.text: kasmānnābhiśraddadhāsye te gāthāṃ bhāṣante ||
children.translated_text: Why would I not believe it?" They recited a verse:

children.text: ārogyamadena mattakā ye dhanabhogamadena mattakāḥ
children.translated_text: "We were intoxicated by the pride of health; we were intoxicated by the pride of wealth and enjoyments.

children.text: dānaṃ ca na dattamaṇvapi yena vayaṃ pitṛlokamāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: And we did not give even the smallest gift; because of that we have come to the world of the dead."

children.text: śroṇa gaccha puṇyakarmā tvam ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Śroṇa</s>, go; you are a man of meritorious karma.

children.text: asti kaścit tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śrutaḥ sa pretanagaraṃ praviśya vastikṣemābhyāṃ jīvannirgacchan sa samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Has anyone been seen or heard of by you who entered a city of pretas and came out alive, safe and sound?" He set out.

children.text: yāvat tenāsau puruṣo dṛṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then he saw that man.

children.text: sa tenoktaḥ bhadramukha aho bata yadi tvayā mamārocitaṃ syād yathedaṃ pretanagaramiti naivāhamatra praviṣṭaḥ syām ||
children.translated_text: He said to him, "Fine sir, alas, if only you had told me that this was a city of pretas, I certainly would not have entered here."

children.text: sa kathayati śroṇa gaccha puṇyamaheśākhyastvam ||
children.translated_text: The man said, "<s>Śroṇa</s>, go; you are renowned for great merit.

children.text: asti kaścit tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā pretanagaraṃ praviśya svastikṣemābhyāṃ jīvan nirgacchan sa samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Has anyone been seen or heard of by you who entered a city of pretas and came out alive, safe and sound?" He set out.

children.text: yāvat paśyati sūryasyāstagamanakāle vimānaṃ catasro 'psarasaḥ abhirūpāḥ prāsādikā darśanīyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, at the time of sunset, he saw a palace and four apsarases, beautiful, pleasing, and lovely to behold.

children.text: ekaḥ puruṣo 'bhirūpo darśanīyaḥ prāsādikaḥ aṅgadakuṇḍalavicitramālyābharaṇānulepanas tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ krīḍati ramate paricārayati ||
children.translated_text: One man, handsome, lovely to behold, and pleasing, adorned with armlets, earrings, variegated garlands, ornaments, and unguents, was playing, delighting, and enjoying himself together with them.

children.text: sa tairdūrata eva dṛṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was seen by them from afar.

children.text: te taṃ pratyavabhāṣitumārabdhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They began to address him.

children.text: svāgatam śroṇa māsi tṛṣito bubhukṣito vā sa saṃlakṣayati nūnaṃ devo 'yaṃ vā nāgo vā yakṣo vā bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: "Welcome, <s>Śroṇa</s>. Are you thirsty or hungry?" He thought, "Surely this must be a deva, or a nāga, or a yakṣa."

children.text: āha ca ārya tṛṣito 'smi bubhukṣito 'smi ||
children.translated_text: And he said, "Noble one, I am thirsty; I am hungry."

children.text: sa taiḥ snāpito bhojitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was bathed and fed by them.

children.text: sa tasmin vimāne tāvat sthito yāvat sūryasyābhyudgamanakālasamayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He remained in that mansion until the time of the sun's rising.

children.text: sa tenoktaḥ śroṇa avatarasva ādīnavo 'tra bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: He was told by him, "<s>Śroṇa</s>, come down; there will be danger here."

children.text: so 'vatīrya ekānte vyavasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having come down, he stood to one side.

children.text: tataḥ paścāt sūryasyābhyudgamanakālasamaye tadvimānamantarhitam ||
children.translated_text: Then afterward, at the time of the sun's rising, that mansion disappeared.

children.text: tā api apsaraso 'ntarhitāśca ||
children.translated_text: Those apsarases also disappeared.

children.text: catvāraḥ śyāmaśabalāḥ kurkurāḥ prādurbhūtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Four black-and-dappled dogs appeared.

children.text: taistaṃ puruṣam avamūrdhakaṃ pātayitvā tāvat pṛṣṭhavaṃśān utpāṭyotpāṭya bhakṣito yāvat sūryasyāstagamanakālasamayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They threw that man down head-first and, tearing out his spine again and again, devoured him until the time of the sun's setting.

children.text: tataḥ paścāt punarapi tadvimānaṃ prādurbhūtam tā apsarasaḥ prādurbhūtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then afterward that mansion appeared again, and those apsarases appeared.

children.text: sa ca puruṣastābhiḥ sārdhaṃ krīḍati ramate paricārayati ||
children.translated_text: And that man sported, delighted himself, and enjoyed himself together with them.

children.text: sa teṣāṃ sakāśamupasaṃkramya kathayati ke yūyam kena ca karmaṇā ihopapannāḥ te procuḥ śroṇa duṣkuhakā jāmbudvīpakā manuṣyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He approached them and said, "Who are you, and by what <s>karma</s> were you reborn here?" They said, "<s>Śroṇa</s>, humans of <s>Jāmbudvīpa</s> are deceitful.

children.text: nābhiśraddadhāsyasi ||
children.translated_text: You will not believe it."

children.text: sa cāha ahaṃ pratyakṣadarśī kathaṃ nābhiśraddadhāsye śroṇa ahaṃ vāsavagrāmake aurabhrika āsīt ||
children.translated_text: And he said, "I see it directly; how would I not believe it?" "<s>Śroṇa</s>, I was a sheep-butcher in the village of <s>Vāsavagrāma</s>.

children.text: urabhrān praghātya praghātya māṃsaṃ vikrīya jīvikāṃ kalpayāmi ||
children.translated_text: Killing sheep again and again, I sold the meat and made my living.

children.text: āryaśca mahākātyāyano mamānukampayā āgatya kathayati bhadramukha aniṣṭo 'sya karmaṇaḥ phalavipākaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And the noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>, coming out of compassion for me, said, 'Good sir, the fruit and maturation of this <s>karma</s> is undesirable.

children.text: virama tvamasmāt pāpakādasaddharmāt ||
children.translated_text: Desist from this evil, improper conduct.'

children.text: nāhaṃ tasya vacanena viramāmi ||
children.translated_text: I did not desist because of his words.

children.text: bhūyo bhūyaḥ sa māṃ vicchandayati bhadramukha aniṣṭo 'sya karmaṇaḥ phalavipākaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Again and again he tried to dissuade me: 'Good sir, the fruit and maturation of this <s>karma</s> is undesirable.

children.text: virama tvamasmāt pāpakādasaddharmāt ||
children.translated_text: Desist from this evil, improper conduct.'

children.text: tathāpi ahaṃ na prativiramāmi ||
children.translated_text: Even so, I did not desist.

children.text: sa māṃ pṛcchati bhadramukha kiṃ tvametānurabhrān divā praghātayasi āhosvid rātrau mayoktaḥ ārya divā praghātayāmīti ||
children.translated_text: He asked me, 'Good sir, do you kill these sheep by day, or at night?' I said, 'Noble one, I kill them by day.'

children.text: sa kathayati bhadramukha rātrau śīlasamādānaṃ kiṃ na gṛhṇāsi ||
children.translated_text: He said, 'Good sir, why do you not undertake <s>śīla</s> (moral discipline) at night?'

children.text: mayā tasyāntikād rātrau śīlasamādānaṃ gṛhītam ||
children.translated_text: From him I undertook <s>śīla</s> at night.

children.text: yattad rātrau śīlasamādānaṃ gṛhītam tasya karmaṇo vipākena rātrāvevaṃvidhaṃ divyaṃ sukhaṃ pratyanubhavāmi ||
children.translated_text: Because I undertook that <s>śīla</s> at night, by the maturation of that <s>karma</s> I experience such divine pleasure only at night.

children.text: yanmayā divā urabhrāḥ praghātitāḥ tasya karmaṇo vipākena divā evaṃvidhaṃ duḥkhaṃ pratyanubhavāmi ||
children.translated_text: Because I killed sheep by day, by the maturation of that <s>karma</s> I experience such suffering only by day.

children.text: gāthāṃ ca bhāṣate ||
children.translated_text: And he recited a verse:

children.text: divasaṃ paraprāṇapīḍako rātrau śīlaguṇaiḥ samanvitaḥ
children.translated_text: By day I harmed the lives of others; at night I was endowed with the virtues of <s>śīla</s>.

children.text: tasyaitatkarmaṇaḥ phalaṃ hyanubhavāmi kalyāṇapāpakam ||
children.translated_text: I now experience this fruit of that <s>karma</s>, both wholesome and evil.

children.text: śroṇa gamiṣyasi tvaṃ vāsavagrāmakam gamiṣyāmi ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Śroṇa</s>, will you go to <s>Vāsavagrāma</s>?" "I will go."

children.text: tatra mama putraḥ prativasati ||
children.translated_text: "My son lives there.

children.text: sa urabhrān praghātya praghātya jīvikāṃ kalpayati ||
children.translated_text: He makes his living by killing sheep again and again.

children.text: sa tvayā vaktavyaḥ dṛṣṭaste mayā pitā ||
children.translated_text: You should tell him, 'Your father was seen by me.

children.text: kathayati aniṣṭo 'sya karmaṇaḥ phalavipākaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He says: the fruit and maturation of this <s>karma</s> is undesirable.

children.text: viramāsmāt pāpakādasaddharmāt ||
children.translated_text: Desist from this evil, improper conduct.'

children.text: bhoḥ puruṣa tvamevaṃ kathayasi duṣkuhakā jāmbudvīpakā manuṣyā iti ||
children.translated_text: "Sir, you yourself say, 'Humans of <s>Jāmbudvīpa</s> are deceitful.'

children.text: nābhiśraddadhāsyati ||
children.translated_text: He will not believe it."

children.text: śroṇa yadi na śraddadhāsyati vaktavyas tava pitā kathayati asti sūnādhastāt suvarṇasya kalaśaḥ pūrayitvā sthāpitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Śroṇa</s>, if he does not believe it, he should be told, 'Your father says: beneath the slaughterhouse there is a jar filled with gold and set down.

children.text: tamuddhṛtyātmānaṃ samyaksukhena prīṇaya ||
children.translated_text: Dig it up and support yourself with proper comfort.

children.text: āryaṃ ca mahākātyāyanaṃ kālena kālaṃ piṇḍakena pratipādaya asmākaṃ ca nāmnā dakṣiṇāmādeśaya ||
children.translated_text: And from time to time provide the noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> with alms-food, and dedicate an offering in our name.

children.text: apyevaitat karma tanutvaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gacchet ||
children.translated_text: Perhaps this <s>karma</s> may come to attenuation, exhaustion, and complete ending.'"

children.text: sa samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He set out.

children.text: yāvat sūryasyābhyudgamanakālasamaye paśyati aparaṃ vimānam ||
children.translated_text: At the time of the sun's rising he saw another mansion.

children.text: tatra ekā apsarā abhirūpā darśanīyā prāsādikā ekaśca puruṣo 'bhirūpo darśanīyaḥ prāsādikaḥ aṅgadakuṇḍalavicitramālyābharaṇānulepanas tayā sārdhaṃ krīḍati ramate paricārayati ||
children.translated_text: There one apsaras, beautiful, lovely to behold, and pleasing, and one man, beautiful, lovely to behold, and pleasing, adorned with armlets, earrings, variegated garlands, ornaments, and ointments, sported, delighted himself, and enjoyed himself together with her.

children.text: sa taṃ dūrata eva dṛṣṭvā pratyavabhāṣitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeing him from far off, he began to address him.

children.text: svāgataṃ śroṇa mā tṛṣito 'si mā bubhukṣito 'si vā sa saṃlakṣayati nūnamayaṃ devo vā nāgo vā yakṣo vā bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: "Welcome, <s>Śroṇa</s>. Are you not thirsty, or hungry?" He reflected, "Surely this must be a deva, or a nāga, or a yakṣa."

children.text: sa kathayati tṛṣito 'smi bubhukṣitaśca ||
children.translated_text: He said, "I am thirsty and hungry."

children.text: sa tena snāpito bhojitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was bathed and fed by him.

children.text: sa tasmin vimāne tāvat sthito yāvat sūryasyāstaṃgamanakālasamayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He remained in that mansion until the time of the sun's setting.

children.text: sa tenoktaḥ avatarasva ādīnavo 'tra bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: He was told by him, "Come down; there will be danger here."

children.text: sa dṛṣṭādīnavo 'vatīrya ekānte 'vasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having seen the danger, he came down and stood to one side.

children.text: tataḥ paścāt sūryasyāstagamanakālasamaye tadvimānamantarhitam ||
children.translated_text: Then afterward, at the time of the sun's setting, that mansion disappeared.

children.text: sāpi apsarā antarhitā ||
children.translated_text: That apsaras also disappeared.

children.text: mahatī śatapadī prādurbhūtā ||
children.translated_text: A great centipede appeared.

children.text: tayā tasya puruṣasya kāyena kāyaṃ saptakṛtvo veṣṭayitvā tāvaduparimastiṣkaṃ bhakṣayantī sthitā yāvat sa eva sūryasyābhyudgamanakālasamayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Wrapping its body around that man's body seven times, it remained there devouring the top of his head until that very time of the sun's rising.

children.text: tataḥ paścāt punarapi tadvimānaṃ prādurbhūtam ||
children.translated_text: Then afterward that mansion appeared again.

children.text: sāpi apsarāḥ prādurbhūtā ||
children.translated_text: That apsaras also appeared.

children.text: sa ca puruṣo 'bhirūpo darśanīyaḥ prāsādikastayā sārdhaṃ krīḍati ramate paricārayati ||
children.translated_text: And that man, beautiful, lovely to behold, and pleasing, sported, delighted himself, and enjoyed himself together with her.

children.text: sa tamupasaṃkramya pṛcchati ko bhavān kena karmaṇā ihopapannaḥ sa evamāha śroṇa duṣkuhakā jāmbūdvīpakā manuṣyāḥ nābhiśraddadhāsyasi ||
children.translated_text: He approached him and asked, "Who are you, and by what karma have you been born here?" He replied, "<s>Śroṇa</s>, people from <s>Jambudvīpa</s> are very deceitful; you will not believe it."

children.text: sa kathayati ahaṃ pratyakṣadarśī kasmānnābhiśraddadhāsye sa kathayati yadi evam ahaṃ vāsavagrāmake brāhmaṇa āsīt pāradārikaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He said, "I am seeing this directly. Why would I not believe it?" He said, "If so, I was a Brahmin in <s>Vāsavagrāmaka</s>, an adulterer."

children.text: āryaśca mahākātyāyano mamānukampayā āgatya kathayati bhadramukha aniṣṭo 'sya karmaṇaḥ phalavipākaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And the noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>, out of compassion for me, came and said, "Good sir, the ripening of the result of this karma is undesirable."

children.text: virama tvamasmāt pāpakādasaddharmāt ||
children.translated_text: "Cease from this evil, unrighteous conduct."

children.text: tasya vacanādahaṃ na prativiramāmi ||
children.translated_text: Because of his words I did not desist.

children.text: bhūyo bhūyaḥ sa māṃ vicchandayati ||
children.translated_text: Again and again he urged me to turn away.

children.text: tathaivāhaṃ tasmāt pāpakādasaddharmānna prativiramāmi ||
children.translated_text: Even so, I did not desist from that evil, unrighteous conduct.

children.text: sa māṃ pṛcchati bhadramukha paradārān kiṃ tvaṃ divā gacchasi āhosvid rātrau sa mayābhihitaḥ ārya rātrau ||
children.translated_text: He asked me, "Good sir, do you go to other men's wives by day or at night?" I replied to him, "Noble one, at night."

children.text: sa kathayati bhadramukha divā kiṃ na śīlasamādānaṃ gṛhṇāsi mayā tasyāntike divā śīlasamādānaṃ gṛhītam ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Good sir, why do you not undertake the observance of <s>śīla</s> during the day?" In his presence I undertook the observance of <s>śīla</s> during the day.

children.text: yattanmayā āryasya kātyāyanasyāntikād divā śīlasamādānaṃ gṛhītam tasya karmaṇo vipākena divā evaṃvidhaṃ divyasukhaṃ pratyanubhavāmi ||
children.translated_text: Because I undertook the observance of <s>śīla</s> during the day in the presence of the noble <s>Kātyāyana</s>, by the ripening of that karma I experience such divine pleasure during the day.

children.text: yattadrātrau paradārābhigamanaṃ kṛtam tasya karmaṇo vipākena rātrāvevaṃvidhaṃ duḥkhaṃ pratyanubhavāmi ||
children.translated_text: Because I committed the approach to other men's wives at night, by the ripening of that karma I experience such suffering at night.

children.text: gāthāṃ ca bhāṣate ||
children.translated_text: And he recited a verse:

children.text: rātrau paradāramūrchito divasaṃ śīlaguṇaiḥ samanvitaḥ
children.translated_text: At night I was infatuated with other men's wives; by day I was endowed with the virtues of <s>śīla</s>.

children.text: tasyaitat karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ hyanubhavāmi kalyāṇapāpakam ||
children.translated_text: I now experience this fruit of that karma, both wholesome and evil.

children.text: śroṇa gamiṣyasi tvaṃ vāsavagrāmakam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śroṇa</s>, will you go to <s>Vāsavagrāmaka</s>?

children.text: tatra mama putro brāhmaṇaḥ pāradārikaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There my son is a Brahmin, an adulterer.

children.text: sa vaktavyo dṛṣṭaste mayā pitā ||
children.translated_text: He should be told, "Your father was seen by me."

children.text: sa kathayati aniṣṭo 'sya karmaṇaḥ phalavipākaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He says, "The ripening of the result of this karma is undesirable."

children.text: viramāsmāt pāpakādasaddharmāt ||
children.translated_text: "Desist from this evil, unrighteous conduct."

children.text: bhoḥ puruṣa tvamevaṃ kathayasi duṣkuhakā jāmbudvīpakā manuṣyā iti ||
children.translated_text: "Sir, you yourself say, 'People from <s>Jambudvīpa</s> are deceitful.'"

children.text: etanme kaḥ śraddadhāsyati śroṇa yanna śraddadhāsyati vaktavyas tava pitrā agniṣṭomasyādhastāt suvarṇakalaśaḥ pūrayitvā sthāpitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Who will believe this from me?" "<s>Śroṇa</s>, if he will not believe it, he should be told, 'A golden jar, filled full, was placed by your father beneath the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> sacrifice.'"

children.text: tamuddhṛtyātmānaṃ samyaksukhena prīṇaya ||
children.translated_text: "Dig it up and satisfy yourself with proper comfort."

children.text: āryaṃ ca mahākātyāyanaṃ kālena kālaṃ piṇḍakena pratipādaya ||
children.translated_text: "And provide the noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> from time to time with alms-food."

children.text: asmākaṃ ca nāmnā dakṣiṇāṃ deśaya ||
children.translated_text: "And dedicate the gift in our name."

children.text: apyevaitat karma tanutvaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gacchet ||
children.translated_text: "Perhaps this karma may become thin, exhausted, and ended."

children.text: sa samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He set out.

children.text: yāvat paśyati vimānam ||
children.translated_text: Then he saw a palace.

children.text: tatraikā strī abhirūpā darśanīyā prāsādikā aṅgadakuṇḍalavicitramālyābharaṇānulepanā ||
children.translated_text: There was a woman, beautiful, lovely to behold, and pleasing, adorned with armlets, earrings, varied garlands, ornaments, and unguents.

children.text: tasyāścaturṣu paryaṅkapādakeṣu catvāraḥ pretā baddhāstiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: At the four feet of her couch four pretas stood bound.

children.text: sā taṃ dūrata eva dṛṣṭvā pratyavabhāṣitumārabdhā śroṇa svāgatam ||
children.translated_text: Seeing him from afar, she began to address him: "<s>Śroṇa</s>, welcome."

children.text: mā tṛṣito 'si mā bubhukṣito 'si vā sa saṃlakṣayati nūnaṃ devīyaṃ vā nāgī vā yakṣī vā bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: "Are you thirsty? Or are you hungry?" He considered, "Surely this must be a goddess, a nāgī, or a yakṣī."

children.text: sa kathayati ārye tṛṣito 'smi bubhukṣito 'smi ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Noble lady, I am thirsty; I am hungry."

children.text: tayāsāvudvartitaḥ snāpita āhāro dattaḥ ||
children.translated_text: She rubbed him down, bathed him, and gave him food.

children.text: uktaṃ ca śroṇa yadi ete kiṃcinmṛgayanti mā dāsyasīti uktvā teṣāṃ sattvānāṃ karmasvakatāṃ pratyakṣīkartukāmā vimānaṃ praviśyāvasthitā ||
children.translated_text: And she said, "<s>Śroṇa</s>, if these ask for anything, do not give it." Having said this, wishing to make the beings' ownership of their own karma directly evident, she entered the palace and remained there.

children.text: te mṛgayitum ārabdhāḥ śroṇa kāruṇikastvam ||
children.translated_text: They began to ask: "<s>Śroṇa</s>, you are compassionate."

children.text: bubhukṣitā vayam ||
children.translated_text: "We are hungry."

children.text: asmākamanuprayaccha ||
children.translated_text: "Give something to us."

children.text: tenaikasya kṣiptam busaplāvī prādurbhūtā ||
children.translated_text: When he tossed something to one of them, chaff-water appeared.

children.text: aparasya kṣiptam ayoguḍaṃ bhakṣayitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When he tossed something to another, he began to eat an iron ball.

children.text: aparasya kṣiptam svamāṃsaṃ bhakṣayitumārabdhaḥ aparasya kṣiptam pūyaśoṇitaṃ prādurbhūtam ||
children.translated_text: When he tossed something to another, he began to eat his own flesh; when he tossed something to the other, pus and blood appeared.

children.text: sā visragandhena nirgatā ||
children.translated_text: Because of the foul smell, she came out.

children.text: śroṇa nivāritastvaṃ mayā ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Śroṇa</s>, I warned you."

children.text: kasmāt tvayaiṣāṃ dattam kiṃ mama kāruṇikayā tvam eva kāruṇikataraḥ sa kathayati bhagini tavaite ke bhavanti sā kathayati ayaṃ me svāmī ayaṃ me putraḥ iyaṃ me snuṣā iyaṃ me dāsī ||
children.translated_text: "Why did you give to them? Am I compassionate, or are you even more compassionate?" He said, "Sister, who are these to you?" She said, "This one is my husband, this one is my son, this woman is my daughter-in-law, and this woman is my maidservant."

children.text: sa āha ke yūyam kena vā karmaṇā ihopapannāḥ tayoktam śroṇa duṣkuhakā jāmbudvīpakā manuṣyā iti nābhiśraddadhāsyasi ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Who are you, and by what karma have you been born here?" She replied, "<s>Śroṇa</s>, people from <s>Jambudvīpa</s> are deceitful; you will not believe it."

children.text: ahaṃ pratyakṣadarśī kasmānnābhiśraddadhāsye sā kathayati ahaṃ vāsavagrāmake brāhmaṇī āsīt ||
children.translated_text: "I am seeing this directly. Why would I not believe it?" She said, "I was a Brahmin woman in <s>Vāsavagrāmaka</s>."

children.text: mayā nakṣatrarātryāṃ pratyupasthitāyāṃ praṇītamāhāraṃ sajjīkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: When the nakṣatra night had arrived, I prepared excellent food.

children.text: āryamahākātyāyano mamānukampayā vāsavagrāmake piṇḍāya prāvikṣat ||
children.translated_text: The noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>, out of compassion for me, entered <s>Vāsavagrāmaka</s> for alms.

children.text: sa mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kāyaprāsādikaścittaprāsādikaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I saw him, inspiring serenity in body and inspiring serenity in mind.

children.text: cittamabhiprasannaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa mayā prasādajātayā piṇḍakena pratipāditaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeing that my mind had become deeply serene, I, with faith arisen, provided him with alms-food.

children.text: tasyā mama buddhirutpannā svāminamanumodayāmi prāmodyamutpādayiṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: Then this thought arose in me: "I will have my husband rejoice in it and will produce joy in him."

children.text: sa snātvā āgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He came after bathing.

children.text: mayoktam āryaputra anumodasva mayāryo mahākātyāyanaḥ piṇḍakena pratipāditaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I said, "Noble husband, rejoice: I have provided the noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> with alms-food."

children.text: sa ruṣito yāvad brāhmaṇānāṃ na dīyate jñātīnāṃ vā jñātipūjā na kriyate tāvattvayā tasmai muṇḍakāya śramaṇakāyāgrapiṇḍakaṃ dattam so 'marṣajātaḥ kathayati kasmāt sa muṇḍakaḥ śramaṇako busaplāvīṃ na bhakṣayatīti tasya karmaṇo vipākenāyaṃ busaplāvīṃ bhakṣayati ||
children.translated_text: He became angry: "So long as food has not been given to the brahmans, or honor paid to the relatives, you have given the first morsel to that shaven-headed ascetic." Filled with resentment, he said, "Why does that shaven-headed ascetic not eat chaff-gruel?" By the maturation of that <s>karma</s>, this one eats chaff-gruel.

children.text: mama buddhirutpannā putramapi anumodayāmi prāmodyamutpādayiṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: The thought arose in me: "I will also make my son rejoice; I will produce gladness in him."

children.text: so 'pi mayoktaḥ putra anumodasva mayāryo mahākātyāyanaḥ piṇḍakena pratipāditaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I said to him too, "Son, rejoice. I have served the noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> with a morsel of alms-food."

children.text: so 'pi ruṣito yāvad brāhmaṇānāṃ na dīyate jñātīnāṃ vā jñātipūjā na kriyate tāvattvayā tasmai muṇḍakāya śramaṇakāyāgrapiṇḍaṃ dattam so 'pi amarṣajātaḥ kathayati kasmāt sa muṇḍakaḥ śramaṇako 'yoguḍaṃ na bhakṣayatīti tasya karmaṇo vipākenāyamayoguḍaṃ bhakṣayati ||
children.translated_text: He too became angry: "So long as food has not been given to the brahmans, or honor paid to the relatives, you have given the first morsel to that shaven-headed ascetic." Filled with resentment, he too said, "Why does that shaven-headed ascetic not eat an iron ball?" By the maturation of that <s>karma</s>, this one eats an iron ball.

children.text: nakṣatrarātryāṃ pratyupasthitāyāṃ mama jñātayaḥ praheṇakāni preṣayanti ||
children.translated_text: When the festival night had arrived, my relatives sent presents.

children.text: tāni ahaṃ snuṣāyāḥ samarpayāmi ||
children.translated_text: I entrusted them to my daughter-in-law.

children.text: sā praṇītāni praheṇakāni bhakṣayitvā mama lūhāni upanāmayati ||
children.translated_text: After eating the fine presents, she brought coarse ones to me.

children.text: ahaṃ teṣāṃ jñātīnāṃ saṃdiśāmi kiṃ nu yūyaṃ durbhikṣe yathā lūhāni praheṇakāni preṣayata te mama saṃdiśanti na vayaṃ lūhāni preṣayāmaḥ api tu praṇītānyeva praheṇakāni preṣayāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I sent word to those relatives: "Are you in a famine, since you send such coarse presents?" They sent word back to me: "We do not send coarse ones; rather, we send only fine presents."

children.text: mayā snuṣābhihitā vadhūke mā tvaṃ praṇītāni praheṇakāni bhakṣayitvāsmākaṃ lūhāni upanāmayasi sā kathayati kiṃ svamāṃsaṃ na bhakṣayati yā tvadīyāni praheṇakāni bhakṣayatīti iyaṃ tasya karmaṇo vipākena svamāṃsāni bhakṣayati ||
children.translated_text: I said to my daughter-in-law, "Daughter-in-law, do not eat the fine presents and bring coarse ones to us." She said, "Why does she who eats your presents not eat her own flesh?" By the maturation of that <s>karma</s>, she eats her own flesh.

children.text: nakṣatrarātryāṃ pratyupasthitāyāṃ praṇītāni praheṇakāni dattvā jñātīnāṃ preṣayāmi ||
children.translated_text: When the festival night had arrived, I sent fine presents to my relatives after handing them over.

children.text: sā dārikā tāni praṇītāni praheṇakāni mārge 'ntarbhakṣayitvā teṣāṃ lūhāni upanāmayati ||
children.translated_text: That girl ate those fine presents on the road and brought coarse ones to them.

children.text: te mama saṃdiśanti kiṃ nu tvaṃ durbhikṣe yathā lūhāni asmākaṃ praheṇakāni preṣayasi ahaṃ teṣāṃ saṃdiśāmi nāhaṃ lūhāni preṣayāmi api tu praṇītānyevāhaṃ preṣayāmīti ||
children.translated_text: They sent word to me: "Are you in a famine, since you send us coarse presents?" I sent word back to them: "I do not send coarse ones; rather, I send only fine ones."

children.text: mayā dārikābhihitā dārike mā tvaṃ praṇītāni praheṇakāni bhakṣayitvā teṣāṃ lūhāni upanāmayasi ||
children.translated_text: I said to the girl, "Girl, do not eat the fine presents and bring coarse ones to them."

children.text: sā kathayati kiṃ nu pūyaśoṇitaṃ na bhakṣayati yā tvadīyāni praheṇakāni bhakṣayatīti tasya karmaṇo vipākeneyaṃ pūyaśoṇitaṃ bhakṣayati ||
children.translated_text: She said, "Why does she who eats your presents not eat pus and blood?" By the maturation of that <s>karma</s>, this one eats pus and blood.

children.text: mama buddhirutpannā tatra pratisaṃdhiṃ gṛhṇīyām yatraitān sarvān svakaṃ svakaṃ karmaphalaṃ paribhuñjānān paśyeyamiti ||
children.translated_text: The thought arose in me: "May I take rebirth in a place where I would see all these people each enjoying the fruit of their own <s>karma</s>."

children.text: yayā mayāryamahākātyāyanaṃ piṇḍakena pratipādya praṇīte trāyastriṃśe devanikāye upapattavyam sāhaṃ mithyāpraṇidhānavaśāt pretamaharddhikā saṃvṛttā ||
children.translated_text: Although, after serving the noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> with a morsel of alms-food, I should have been reborn among the excellent <s>Trāyastriṃśa</s> gods, through the force of a wrong aspiration I became a preta of great power.

children.text: śroṇa gamiṣyasi tvaṃ vāsavagrāmakam tatra mama duhitā veśyaṃ vāhayati ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Śroṇa</s>, will you go to <s>Vāsavagrāma</s>? My daughter there practices the courtesan's trade.

children.text: sā tvayā vaktavyā dṛṣṭāste mayā pitā mātā bhrātā bhrāturjāyā dāsī ||
children.translated_text: She should be told by you: 'Your father, mother, brother, brother's wife, and female servant have been seen by me.

children.text: te kathayanti aniṣṭo 'sya karmaṇaḥ phalavipākaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: the fruit and maturation of this <s>karma</s> is undesirable.

children.text: viramāsmādasaddharmāt ||
children.translated_text: Desist from this bad <s>dharma</s> (conduct).'"

children.text: bhagini tvameva kathayasi duṣkuhakā jāmbudvīpakā manuṣyāḥ nābhiśraddadhāsyanti ||
children.translated_text: "Sister, you yourself say that the people of <s>Jāmbudvīpa</s> are deceitful; they will not believe it."

children.text: śroṇa yadi na śraddadhāsyati vaktavyā tava paurāṇe paitṛke vāsagṛhe catvāro lohasaṃghāṭāḥ suvarṇasya pūrṇāstiṣṭhanti madhye ca sauvarṇadaṇḍakamaṇḍaluḥ ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Śroṇa</s>, if she does not believe it, she should be told: 'In your old paternal dwelling-house there stand four iron chests filled with gold, and in the middle is a water-pot with a golden handle.

children.text: te kathayanti tamuddhṛtyātmānaṃ samyaksukhena prīṇaya āryaṃ ca mahākātyāyanaṃ kālena kālaṃ piṇḍakena pratipādaya asmākaṃ ca nāmnā dakṣiṇāmādeśaya ||
children.translated_text: They say: dig that up and sustain yourself with proper comfort; and from time to time serve the noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> with alms-food, and dedicate a <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (offering of merit) in our name.

children.text: apyevaitat karma tanutvaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gacchet ||
children.translated_text: Perhaps this <s>karma</s> may go to attenuation, exhaustion, and complete depletion.'"

children.text: tena tasyāḥ pratijñātam ||
children.translated_text: He promised her that.

children.text: evaṃ tasya paribhramato dvādaśa varṣā atikrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: As he wandered in this way, twelve years passed.

children.text: tayoktaḥ śroṇa gamiṣyasi tvaṃ vāsavagrāmakam bhagini gamiṣyāmi ||
children.translated_text: She said, "<s>Śroṇa</s>, will you go to <s>Vāsavagrāma</s>?" "Sister, I will go."

children.text: sa tasminneva vimāne uṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He stayed in that very mansion.

children.text: tayā teṣāmeva pretānāmājñā dattā bhavanto gacchata śroṇaṃ koṭikarṇaṃ suptameva vāsavagrāmake paitṛke udyāne sthāpayitvā āgacchata ||
children.translated_text: She gave an order to those very pretas: "Sirs, go, place <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> while he is asleep in his paternal garden at <s>Vāsavagrāma</s>, and come back."

children.text: sa tairvāsavagrāmake paitṛke udyāne sthāpitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was placed by them in the paternal garden at <s>Vāsavagrāma</s>.

children.text: sa prativibuddho yāvat paśyati ghaṇṭāchatrāṇi vyajanāni akṣarāṇi likhitāni yadi tāvacchroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo jīvati laghvāgamanāya kṣipramāgamanāya cyutaḥ kālagato gatyupapattisthānāt sthānāntaraviśeṣatāyai ||
children.translated_text: When he awoke, he saw bells, parasols, fans, and written letters: "If <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> is still alive, may he come back soon and return quickly; if he has died and passed away, may he pass from the place of rebirth in one destiny to the distinction of another place."

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati yadi ahaṃ mātāpitṛbhyāṃ mṛta eva gṛhītaḥ kasmādbhūyo 'haṃ gṛhaṃ praviśāmi gacchāmi āryamahākātyāyanasyāntikāt pravrajāmīti ||
children.translated_text: He reflected, "If I have been regarded by my parents as dead, why should I enter the house again? I will go to the noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> and go forth."

children.text: atha śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo yenāyuṣmān mahākātyāyanastenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> approached the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>.

children.text: adrākṣīdāyuṣmān mahākātyāyanaḥ śroṇaṃ koṭikarṇaṃ dūrādeva ||
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> saw <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> from afar.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā ca punaḥ śroṇaṃ koṭikarṇamidamavocat ehi śroṇa svāgataṃ te ||
children.translated_text: And when he had seen <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>, he said this: "Come, <s>Śroṇa</s>; welcome to you.

children.text: dṛṣṭaste śroṇa ayaṃ lokaḥ paraśca lokaḥ sa kathayati dṛṣṭo bhadanta mahākātyāyana ||
children.translated_text: Have you seen this world and the other world, <s>Śroṇa</s>?" He said, "I have seen them, venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>."

children.text: labheyāhaṃ bhadanta mahākātyāyana svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajyām upasampadaṃ bhikṣubhāvam ||
children.translated_text: "May I obtain, venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>, <s>pravrajyā</s> (going forth), <s>upasaṃpad</s> (full ordination), and the state of a <s>bhikṣu</s> in the well-proclaimed <s>dharmavinaya</s> (teaching and discipline).

children.text: careyamahaṃ bhavato 'ntike brahmacaryam ||
children.translated_text: I would practice <s>brahmacarya</s> (the holy life) in your presence."

children.text: sa āryeṇoktaḥ śroṇa tāṃ tāvat pūrvikāṃ pratijñāṃ paripūraya ||
children.translated_text: The noble one said to him, "<s>Śroṇa</s>, first fulfill that earlier promise.

children.text: yathāgṛhītān saṃdeśān samarpayeti ||
children.translated_text: Deliver the messages just as you received them."

children.text: sa tasyaurabhrikasya sakāśamupasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He approached that sheep-butcher.

children.text: viramāsmādasaddharmāt ||
children.translated_text: "Desist from this improper conduct.

children.text: bhoḥ puruṣa adya mama piturdvādaśavarṣāṇi kālagatasya ||
children.translated_text: Sir, today it is twelve years since my father passed away.

children.text: asti kaścid dṛṣṭaḥ paralokāt punarāgacchan bhadramukha eṣo 'hamāgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Has anyone been seen returning from the next world? Good sir, I myself have come back."

children.text: nāsau śraddadhāti ||
children.translated_text: He did not believe it.

children.text: bhadramukha yadi na śraddadhāsi sa tava pitā kathayati asti sūnādhastāt suvarṇasya kalaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Good sir, if you do not believe it, your father says: beneath the slaughterhouse there is a jar of gold.

children.text: pūrṇastiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: It is standing there full.

children.text: tamuddhṛtyātmānaṃ samyaksukhena prīṇaya ||
children.translated_text: Dig it up and nourish yourself with proper comfort.

children.text: āryaṃ ca mahākātyāyanaṃ kālena kālaṃ piṇḍakena pratipādaya asmākaṃ ca nāmnā dakṣiṇāmādeśaya ||
children.translated_text: And from time to time provide the noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> with alms-food, and dedicate a <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (religious offering) in our name.

children.text: apyevaitat karma tanutvaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gacchet ||
children.translated_text: Perhaps this <s>karma</s> may come to attenuation, exhaustion, and complete ending."

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati na kadācidevaṃ mayā śrutapūrvam ||
children.translated_text: He reflected, "Never before have I heard such a thing.

children.text: paśyāmi saced bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyati sarvametat satyam ||
children.translated_text: I will see: if it is true, all this will be true."

children.text: tena gatvā khanitam ||
children.translated_text: He went and dug.

children.text: yāvat tat sarvaṃ tat tathaiva tenābhiśraddadhātam ||
children.translated_text: When it was all exactly so, he believed it.

children.text: tataḥ paścāt sa pāradārikasya sakāśamupasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then afterward he approached the adulterer.

children.text: upasaṃkramya kathayati bhadramukha dṛṣṭaste mayā pitā ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, he said, "Good sir, I have seen your father.

children.text: sa kathayati aniṣṭo 'sya karmaṇaḥ phalavipākaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He says: the fruit and maturation of this <s>karma</s> is undesirable.

children.text: viramāsmāt pāpakādasaddharmāt ||
children.translated_text: Desist from this evil, improper conduct."

children.text: sa kathayati bhoḥ puruṣa adya mama piturdvādaśa varṣāṇi kālaṃ gatasya ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Sir, today it is twelve years since my father passed away.

children.text: asti kaścit tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ paralokaṃ gatvā punarāgacchan bhadramukha eṣo 'hamāgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Have you seen anyone who went to the next world and returned?" "Good sir, I myself have come back."

children.text: nāsau śraddadhāti ||
children.translated_text: He did not believe it.

children.text: sa cāha bhadramukha sacennābhiśraddadhāsi tava pitrā agniṣṭomasyādhastāt suvarṇasya kalaśaḥ pūrayitvā sthāpitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And he said, "Good sir, if you do not believe it, a jar filled with gold has been set down by your father beneath the Agniṣṭoma place.

children.text: sa kathayati tamuddhṛtyātmānaṃ samyaksukhena prīṇaya āryaṃ ca mahākātyāyanaṃ kālena kālaṃ piṇḍakena pratipādaya asmākaṃ ca nāmnā dakṣiṇāmādeśaya ||
children.translated_text: He says: dig it up and nourish yourself with proper comfort; and from time to time provide the noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> with alms-food, and dedicate a <s>dakṣiṇā</s> in our name.

children.text: apyevaitat karma tanutvaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gacchet ||
children.translated_text: Perhaps this <s>karma</s> may come to attenuation, exhaustion, and complete ending."

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati na kadācidetanmayā śrutapūrvam ||
children.translated_text: He reflected, "Never before have I heard this.

children.text: paśyāmi saced bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyati sarvametat satyam ||
children.translated_text: I will see: if it is true, all this will be true."

children.text: tena gatvā khanitam ||
children.translated_text: He went and dug.

children.text: yāvat tatsarvaṃ tattathaiva tenābhiśraddadhātam ||
children.translated_text: When it was all exactly so, he believed it.

children.text: sa tasyā veśyāyāḥ sakāśamupasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He approached that courtesan.

children.text: upasaṃkramya kathayati bhagini dṛṣṭāste mayā mātā pitā bhrātā bhrāturjāyā dāsī ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, he said, "Sister, I have seen your mother, father, brother, brother's wife, and maidservant.

children.text: te kathayanti aniṣṭo 'sya karmaṇaḥ phalavipākaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: the fruit and maturation of this <s>karma</s> is undesirable.

children.text: viramāsmāt pāpakādasaddharmāt ||
children.translated_text: Desist from this evil, improper conduct."

children.text: sā kathayati bhoḥ puruṣa mama mātāpitrordvādaśa varṣāṇi kālagatayoḥ ||
children.translated_text: She said, "Sir, it is twelve years since my mother and father passed away.

children.text: asti kaścit tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ paralokaṃ gatvā punarāgacchan sa kathayati eṣo 'hamāgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Have you seen anyone who went to the next world and returned?" He said, "I myself have come back."

children.text: sā na śraddadhāti ||
children.translated_text: She did not believe it.

children.text: sa kathayati bhagini sacennābhiśraddadhāsi tava paurāṇe paitṛke vāsagṛhe catasro lohasaṃghāṭāḥ suvarṇapūrṇāstiṣṭhanti madhye ca sauvarṇadaṇḍakamaṇḍaluḥ ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Sister, if you do not believe it, in your old paternal dwelling there are four iron chests standing full of gold, and in the middle there is a golden-handled water pot.

children.text: te kathayanti tamuddhṛtyātmānaṃ samyaksukhena prīṇaya āryaṃ ca mahākātyāyanaṃ kālena kālaṃ piṇḍakena pratipādaya asmākaṃ ca nāmnā dakṣiṇāmādeśaya ||
children.translated_text: They say: dig it up and nourish yourself with proper comfort; and from time to time provide the noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> with alms-food, and dedicate a <s>dakṣiṇā</s> in our name.

children.text: apyevaitat karma tanutvaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gacchet ||
children.translated_text: Perhaps this <s>karma</s> may come to attenuation, exhaustion, and complete ending."

children.text: sā saṃlakṣayati na kadācinmayā śrutapūrvam ||
children.translated_text: She reflected, "Never before have I heard this.

children.text: paśyāmi saced bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyati sarvametat satyam ||
children.translated_text: I will see: if it is true, all this will be true."

children.text: tayā gatvā khanitam ||
children.translated_text: She went and dug.

children.text: yāvat tat sarvaṃ tattathaiva tayābhiśraddadhātam ||
children.translated_text: When it was all exactly so, she believed it.

children.text: śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇaḥ saṃlakṣayati sarvo 'yaṃ lokaḥ suvarṇasya śraddadhāti na tu kaścinmama śraddhayā gacchatīti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> reflected, "This whole world believes because of gold, but no one goes by faith in me."

children.text: tena vaipuṣpitam ||
children.translated_text: Then he showed his teeth.

children.text: śiśutve suvarṇena daśanā baddhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: In childhood his teeth had been bound with gold.

children.text: tayāsau pratyabhijñātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By that she recognized him.

children.text: syādāryaḥ śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇa eva te bhaginījanaḥ saṃjānate ||
children.translated_text: "Could the noble one be <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> himself?" His sisters recognized him.

children.text: tayā gatvā tasya mātāpitṛbhyāmārocitam ||
children.translated_text: She went and reported it to his mother and father.

children.text: amba tāta koṭikarṇo 'bhyāgata iti ||
children.translated_text: "Mother, father, <s>Koṭikarṇa</s> has arrived."

children.text: anekaisteṣāmārocitam ||
children.translated_text: They were informed by many people.

children.text: te na kasyacit śraddhayā gacchanti ||
children.translated_text: They did not go by anyone's testimony.

children.text: te kathayanti putri tvamapyasmākamutprāsayasi ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Daughter, you too are mocking us."
