children.text: yāvadasau svayameva gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: At last he himself went.

children.text: tena dvārakoṣṭhake sthitvotkāśanaśabdaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Standing in the gateway, he made the sound of clearing his throat.

children.text: hiraṇyasvaro 'sau mahātmā ||
children.translated_text: That great-souled one had a golden voice.

children.text: tasya śabdena sarvaṃ gṛhamāpūritam ||
children.translated_text: By his sound the whole house was filled.

children.text: sa taiḥ svareṇa pratyabhijñātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was recognized by them from his voice.

children.text: te kaṇṭhe pariṣvajya ruditumārabdhau ||
children.translated_text: They embraced him around the neck and began to weep.

children.text: teṣāṃ bāṣpeṇa paṭalāni sphuṭitāni ||
children.translated_text: By their tears the films over their eyes burst.

children.text: draṣṭumārabdhau ||
children.translated_text: They began to see.

children.text: sa kathayati amba tāta anujānīdhvam ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Mother, father, give me permission.

children.text: pravrajiṣyāmi samyageva śraddhayā agārādanagārikām ||
children.translated_text: I will go forth from home into homelessness, with true faith."

children.text: tau kathayataḥ putra āvāṃ tvadīyena śokena rudantāvandhībhūtau ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Son, we became blind while weeping from grief for you.

children.text: idānīṃ tvāmevāgamya cakṣuḥ pratilabdham ||
children.translated_text: Now, through meeting you, we have regained our sight.

children.text: yāvadāvāṃ jīvāmaḥ tāvanna pravrajitavyam ||
children.translated_text: As long as we live, you must not go forth.

children.text: yadā kālaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ tadā pravrajiṣyasi ||
children.translated_text: When we die, then you may go forth."

children.text: tenāyuṣmato mahākātyāyanasyāntikāddharmaṃ śrutvā srotāpattiphalaṃ sākṣātkṛtam mātāpitarau ca śaraṇagamanaśikṣāpadeṣu pratiṣṭhāpitau ||
children.translated_text: Having heard the <s>dharma</s> from the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>, he directly realized the fruit of stream-entry, and he established his mother and father in taking refuge and in the training precepts.

children.text: āgamacatuṣṭayamadhītam sakṛdāgāmiphalaṃ sākṣātkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: He studied the four Āgamas and directly realized the fruit of once-returning.

children.text: mātāpitarau satyeṣu pratiṣṭhāpitau ||
children.translated_text: He established his mother and father in the truths.

children.text: apareṇa samayena tasya mātāpitarau kālagatau ||
children.translated_text: At another time his mother and father passed away.

children.text: sa taṃ dhanajātaṃ dīnānāthakṛpaṇebhyo dattvā daridrānadaridrān kṛtvā yenāyuṣmān mahākātyāyanastenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After giving that wealth to the poor, the helpless, and the destitute, making the poor no longer poor, he approached the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>.

children.text: upasaṃkramyāyuṣmato mahākātyāyanasya pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte 'sthāt ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, he bowed with his head at the feet of the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> and stood to one side.

children.text: ekānte sthitaḥ śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇa āyuṣmantaṃ mahākātyāyanamidamavocat labheyāhamāryamahākātyāyana svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajyām yāvaccareyāhaṃ bhagavato 'ntike brahmacaryam ||
children.translated_text: Standing to one side, <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> said this to the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>: "Noble <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>, may I obtain going forth in the well-proclaimed <s>dharma-vinaya</s>, so that I may practice celibate conduct in the presence of the Blessed One?"

children.text: sa āyuṣmatā mahākātyāyanena pravrajitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was given going forth by the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>.

children.text: tena pravrajya mātṛkādhītā anāgāmiphalaṃ sākṣātkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: After going forth, he studied the <s>mātṛkā</s> and directly realized the fruit of non-returning.

children.text: asmāt parāntakeṣu janapadeṣvalpabhikṣukam ||
children.translated_text: In the frontier districts there were few monks.

children.text: kṛcchreṇa deśavargo gaṇaḥ paripūryate ||
children.translated_text: The local monastic group was completed only with difficulty.

children.text: sa traimāsīṃ śrāmaṇero dhāritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was kept as a novice for three months.

children.text: dharmatā khalu yathā buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ śrāvakāṇāṃ dvau saṃnipātau bhavataḥ ||
children.translated_text: It is indeed the regular practice that there are two assemblies of the disciples of the blessed Buddhas.

children.text: yaccāṣāḍhyāṃ varṣopanāyikāyām yacca kārtikyāṃ pūrṇamāsyām ||
children.translated_text: One is at the beginning of the rains in Āṣāḍha, and the other is on the full moon of Kārttika.

children.text: tatra ye āṣāḍhyāṃ varṣopanāyikāyāṃ saṃnipatanti te tāṃstānuddeśayogamanasikārānudgṛhya paryavāpya tāsu grāmanagaranigamarāṣṭrarājadhānīṣu varṣāmupagacchanti ||
children.translated_text: Those who assemble at the beginning of the rains in Āṣāḍha learn and master those particular recitations, practices, and contemplations, and then enter the rains-retreat in those various villages, towns, market-towns, districts, and royal capitals.

children.text: ye kārtikyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ saṃnipatanti te yathādhigatamārocayanti uttare ca paripṛcchanti sūtrasya vinayasya mātṛkāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those who assemble on the full moon of Kārttika report what they have attained and ask further questions about the <s>sūtra</s>, the <s>vinaya</s>, and the <s>mātṛkā</s>.

children.text: evameva mahāśrāvakāṇāmapi ||
children.translated_text: So it is also for the great disciples.

children.text: atha ye āyuṣmato mahākātyāyanasya sārdhaṃvihāryantevāsikā bhikṣavas tāṃstānuddeśayogamanasikāraviśeṣān gṛhya paryavāpya tāsu tāsu grāmanagaranigamarāṣṭrarājadhānīṣu varṣāmupagatāḥ te trayāṇāṃ vārṣikāṇāṃ māsānāmatyayāt kṛtacīvarā niṣṭhitacīvarāḥ samādāya pātracīvaram yenāyuṣmān mahākātyāyanastenopasaṃkrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the monks who were fellow residents and pupils of the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>, having learned and mastered those particular recitations, practices, and contemplations, had entered the rains-retreat in those various villages, towns, market-towns, districts, and royal capitals. When the three months of the rains had passed, with their robes made and their robes finished, they took their bowl and robe and approached the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>.

children.text: upasaṃkramyāyuṣmato mahākātyāyanasya pādau śirasā vanditvaikānte niṣaṇṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, they bowed with their heads at the feet of the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s> and sat to one side.

children.text: ekānte niṣadya yathādhigatamārocayanti uttare ca paripṛcchanti ||
children.translated_text: Sitting to one side, they reported what they had attained and asked further questions.

children.text: deśavargo gaṇaḥ paripūrṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The local group was complete.

children.text: sa tenopasaṃpāditaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was given full ordination by him.

children.text: tena tṛtīyapiṭakamadhītam ||
children.translated_text: He studied the third Piṭaka.

children.text: sarvakleśaprahāṇādarhattvaṃ sākṣātkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Through the abandonment of all defilements he directly realized arhatship.

children.text: arhan saṃvṛttas traidhātukavītarāgo yāvad abhivādyaśca saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He became an arhat, free from passion for the three realms, and, to the same extent, became worthy of homage.

children.text: athāyuṣmato mahākātyāyanasya sārdhaṃvihāryantevāsikā āyuṣmantaṃ mahākātyāyanam yāvattāvat paryupāsyāyuṣmantaṃ mahākātyāyanamidamavocan dṛṣṭo 'smābhirupādhyāyaḥ paryupāsitaśca ||
children.translated_text: Then the fellow residents and pupils of the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>, after attending for a time upon the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>, said this to him: "We have seen the preceptor and attended upon him.

children.text: gacchāmo vayam bhagavantaṃ paryupāsiṣyāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Let us go; we will attend upon the Blessed One."

children.text: sa cāha vatsā evaṃ kurudhvam ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Children, do so.

children.text: draṣṭavyā eva paryupāsitavyā eva hi tathāgatā arhantaḥ samyaksambuddhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: For the <s>Tathāgatas</s>, arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas are indeed to be seen and indeed to be attended upon."

children.text: tena khalu punaḥ samayena śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇastasyāmeva parṣadi saṃniṣaṇṇo 'bhūt saṃnipatitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now at that time the venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> was seated, gathered in that very assembly.

children.text: athāyuṣmāñ śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇa utthāyāsanād ekāṃsamuttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yenāyuṣmān mahākātyāyanastenāñjaliṃ kṛtvā praṇamyāyuṣmantaṃ mahākātyāyanamidamavocat dṛṣṭo mayopādhyāyānubhāvena sa bhagavān dharmakāyena no tu rūpakāyena ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> rose from his seat, arranged his upper robe over one shoulder, placed his right knee on the ground, bowed with joined palms toward the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>, and said this to him: "Through the power of my preceptor I have seen that Blessed One by the <s>dharmakāya</s>, but not by the <s>rūpakāya</s>.

children.text: gacchāmi upādhyāya rūpakāyenāpi taṃ bhagavantaṃ drakṣyāmi ||
children.translated_text: I will go, preceptor; I will see that Blessed One also by the <s>rūpakāya</s>."

children.text: sa āha evaṃ vatsa kuruṣva ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Do so, child.

children.text: durlabhadarśanā hi vatsa tathāgatā arhantaḥ samyaksambuddhās tadyathā audumbarapuṣpam ||
children.translated_text: For the <s>Tathāgatas</s>, arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas, child, are hard to see, like the flower of the udumbara.

children.text: asmākaṃ ca vacanena bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vandasva alpābādhatāṃ ca yāvat sukhasparśavihāratāṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: And on our behalf bow with your head at the feet of the Blessed One, and ask whether he has little illness, up to whether he dwells with pleasant bodily ease.

children.text: pañca praśnāṃśca pṛccha asmāt parāntakeṣu bhadanta janapadeṣu alpabhikṣukam ||
children.translated_text: And ask five questions: 'Venerable sir, in these frontier districts there are few monks.

children.text: kṛcchreṇa daśavargagaṇaḥ paripūryate ||
children.translated_text: Only with difficulty is a monastic group of ten completed.

children.text: tatrāsmābhiḥ kathaṃ pratipattavyam kharā bhūmī gokaṇṭakā dhānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: How should we proceed there? The ground is rough, with cow-thorns and hard grains.

children.text: asmākamaparāntakeṣu janapadeṣu idamevaṃrūpamāstaraṇaṃ pratyāstaraṇaṃ tadyathā avicarma gocarma chāgacarma ||
children.translated_text: In our western districts there is just this sort of covering and under-covering, namely sheep-skin, cowhide, and goat-skin.

children.text: tadanyeṣu janapadeṣu idamevaṃrūpamāstaraṇaṃ pratyāstaraṇaṃ tadyathā erako merako jandurako mandurakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In other districts there is this sort of covering and under-covering, namely eraka, meraka, janduraka, and manduraka.

children.text: evamevāsmāt parāntakeṣu janapadeṣvidamevaṃrūpamāstaraṇaṃ pratyāstaraṇaṃ tadyathā avicarma pūrvavat ||
children.translated_text: In just the same way, in these frontier districts there is this sort of covering and under-covering, namely sheep-skin and so on as before.

children.text: udakastabdhikā manuṣyāḥ snātopavicārāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The people are constrained by water and are accustomed to bathing.

children.text: bhikṣurbhikṣoścīvarakāni preṣayati itaścyutāni tatrāsaṃprāptāni kasyaitāni naiḥsargikāni ||
children.translated_text: A monk sends another monk's robe-cloths; when they have departed from here but have not arrived there, to whom are they forfeitable?

children.text: adhivāsayati āyuṣmāñchroṇaḥ koṭikarṇa āyuṣmato mahākātyāyanasya tūṣṇībhāvena ||
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> accepted, by his silence, the request of the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>.

children.text: athāyuṣmāñchroṇaḥ koṭikarṇas tasyā eva rātreratyayāt pūrvāhṇe nivāsya pātracīvaramādāya vāsavagrāmakaṃ piṇḍāya prāvikṣat ||
children.translated_text: Then, when that very night had passed, in the morning the venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> dressed, took his bowl and robe, and entered <s>Vāsavagrāmaka</s> for alms.

children.text: yāvadanupūrveṇa śrāvastīmanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Eventually, in due course, he reached <s>Śrāvastī</s>.

children.text: athāyuṣmāñchroṇaḥ koṭikarṇaḥ pātracīvaraṃ pratisamayya pādau prakṣālya yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> put away his bowl and robe, washed his feet, and approached the Blessed One.

children.text: upasaṃkramyaikānte niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, he sat down to one side.

children.text: tatra bhagavānāyuṣmantamānandamāmantrayate sma gaccha ānanda tathāgatasya śroṇasya ca koṭikarṇasyaikavihāre mañcaṃ prajñāpaya ||
children.translated_text: There the Blessed One addressed the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: "Go, <s>Ānanda</s>, prepare a couch in one dwelling for the <s>Tathāgata</s> and for <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>."

children.text: evaṃ bhadanteti āyuṣmānānandastathāgatasya śroṇasya ca koṭikarṇasya yāvat prajñāpya yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Yes, venerable sir," said the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>; having prepared it for the <s>Tathāgata</s> and for <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>, he approached the Blessed One.

children.text: upasaṃkramya bhagavantamidamavocat prajñapto bhadanta tathāgatasya śroṇasya koṭikarṇasya vihāras tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ yāvadvihāraṃ praviśya niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, he said this to the Blessed One: "Venerable sir, the lodging has been prepared for the <s>Tathāgata</s> and for <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>." He went there, entered the lodging, and sat down.

children.text: yāvat paśyati smṛtiṃ pratimukhamupasthāpya ||
children.translated_text: Then he remained, having set mindfulness directly before him.

children.text: athāyuṣmānapi śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo bahirvihārasya pādau prakṣālya vihāraṃ praviśya niṣaṇṇaḥ paryaṅkamābhujya yāvat pratimukhaṃ smṛtimupasthāpya ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> also washed his feet outside the dwelling, entered the dwelling, sat down cross-legged, and set mindfulness directly before him.

children.text: tāṃ khalu rātriṃ bhagavān āyuṣmāṃśca śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇa āryeṇa tūṣṇībhāvenādhivāsitavān ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One and the venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> passed that night in noble silence.

children.text: atha bhagavān rātryāḥ pratyūṣasamaye āyuṣmantaṃ śroṇaṃ koṭikarṇamāmantrayate sma pratibhātu te śroṇa dharmo yo mayā svayamabhijñāyābhisaṃbudhyākhyātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, at dawn, the Blessed One addressed the venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>: "Let the Dharma come to you, <s>Śroṇa</s>, which I myself directly knew, fully awakened to, and taught."

children.text: athāyuṣmāñ śroṇo bhagavatā kṛtāvakāśaḥ asmāt parāntikayā guptikayā udānāt pārāyaṇāt satyadṛṣṭaḥ śailagāthā munigāthā arthavargīyāṇi ca sūtrāṇi vistareṇa svareṇa svādhyāyaṃ karoti ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śroṇa</s>, given leave by the Blessed One, recited at length and in a clear voice from this frontier Guptikā, from the <s>Udāna</s>, from the <s>Parāyaṇa</s>, the <s>Satyadṛṣṭa</s>, the <s>Śailagāthā</s>, the <s>Munigāthā</s>, and the sūtras belonging to the <s>Arthavarga</s>.

children.text: atha bhagavāñchroṇasya koṭikarṇasya kathāparyavasānaṃ viditvā āyuṣmantaṃ śroṇaṃ koṭikarṇamidamavocat sādhu sādhu śroṇa madhuraste dharmo bhāṣitaḥ praṇītaśca yo mayā svayamabhijñāyābhisaṃbudhyākhyātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, knowing that <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>'s discourse had ended, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>: "Good, good, <s>Śroṇa</s>. Sweet and excellent is the Dharma spoken by you, the one that I myself directly knew, fully awakened to, and taught."

children.text: athāyuṣmataḥ śroṇasya koṭikarṇasyaitadabhavat ayaṃ me kālo bhagavata upādhyāyasya vacasārocayitumiti viditvotthāyāsanād yāvad bhagavantaṃ praṇamyedamavocat asmāt parāntakeṣu janapadeṣu vāsavagrāmake bhadantamahākātyāyanaḥ prativasati yo me upādhyāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then this occurred to the venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>: "This is the time for me to report my preceptor's words to the Blessed One." Knowing this, he rose from his seat, bowed to the Blessed One, and said this: "Venerable sir, in the frontier districts, in <s>Vāsavagrāmaka</s>, the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>, who is my preceptor, resides.

children.text: sa bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vandate alpābādhatāṃ ca pṛcchati yāvat sparśavihāratāṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: He bows with his head at the Blessed One's feet and asks whether you have little illness, and likewise whether you are dwelling comfortably.

children.text: pañca ca praśnān pṛcchati vistareṇoccārayitavyāni ||
children.translated_text: And he asks five questions, which are to be stated in full."

children.text: atha bhagavāñchroṇaṃ koṭikarṇamidamavocat akālaṃ te śroṇa praśnavyākaraṇāya ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One said this to <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>: "<s>Śroṇa</s>, this is not the time for answering questions.

children.text: saṃghamelakas tatra kālo bhaviṣyati praśnasya vyākaraṇāya ||
children.translated_text: When there is a meeting of the Saṃgha, that will be the time for answering the question."

children.text: atha bhagavān kālyamevotthāya purastādbhikṣusaṃghasya prajñapta evāsane niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One rose early, and sat down on the seat that had been prepared before the Saṃgha of monks.

children.text: athāyuṣmāñchroṇaḥ koṭikarṇo yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvaikānte 'sthāt ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s> approached the Blessed One, bowed with his head at the Blessed One's feet, and stood to one side.

children.text: ekāntasthito bhagavantamidamavocat asmāt parāntakeṣu janapadeṣu vāsavagrāmake bhadantamahākātyāyanaḥ prativasati yo me upādhyāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Standing to one side, he said this to the Blessed One: "Venerable sir, in the frontier districts, in <s>Vāsavagrāmaka</s>, the venerable <s>Mahākātyāyana</s>, who is my preceptor, resides.

children.text: sa bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vandate alpābādhatāṃ ca pṛcchati yāvat sparśavihāratāṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: He bows with his head at the Blessed One's feet and asks whether you have little illness, and likewise whether you are dwelling comfortably.

children.text: pañca ca praśnāni vistareṇoccārayitavyāni yathāpūrvamuktāni yāvat kasya naiḥsargikāni ||
children.translated_text: And the five questions are to be stated in full, as they were spoken before, down to: to whom are they forfeitable?"

children.text: bhagavānāha tasmādanujānāmi ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: "Therefore I permit it.

children.text: pratyantimeṣu janapadeṣu vinayadharapañcamenopasampadā sadā snātaḥ ekapalāśike upānahe dhārayitavye na dvipuṭāṃ na tripuṭām ||
children.translated_text: In frontier districts, higher ordination may be performed with a fifth member who is a holder of the Vinaya; regular bathing is allowed; single-soled sandals may be worn, but not double-soled or triple-soled ones.

children.text: sā cet kṣayadharmiṇī bhavati tāṃ tyaktvā punar navā grahītavyā ||
children.translated_text: If such a sandal is liable to wear out, then after discarding it another new one may be taken.

children.text: bhikṣurbhikṣoścīvarakāni preṣayati itaścyutāni tatrāsamprāptāni na kasyacinnaiḥsargikāṇi ||
children.translated_text: When a monk sends another monk's robe-cloths, and they have departed from here but have not arrived there, they are not forfeitable to anyone."

children.text: āyuṣmān upālī buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ pṛcchati yaduktaṃ bhadanta bhagavatā pratyantimeṣu janapadeṣu vinayadharapañcamenopasampadaṃ tatra katamo 'ntaḥ katamaḥ pratyantaḥ pūrveṇopāli puṇḍavardhanaṃ nāma nagaram tasya pūrveṇa puṇḍakakṣo nāma parvataḥ tataḥ pareṇa pratyantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Upāli</s> asked the <s>Buddha</s>, the Blessed One: "Venerable sir, as it was said by the Blessed One that in the border districts <s>upasampadā</s> (ordination) may be given with a <s>vinayadhara</s> as the fifth member, there what is the interior and what is the border?" "To the east, <s>Upāli</s>, there is a city named <s>Puṇḍavardhana</s>; east of it is a mountain named <s>Puṇḍakakṣa</s>. Beyond that is the border."

children.text: dakṣiṇena śarāvatī nāma nagarī tasyāḥ pareṇa sarāvatī nāma nadī so 'ntaḥ tataḥ pareṇa pratyantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "To the south there is a city named <s>Śarāvatī</s>; beyond it is a river named <s>Sarāvatī</s>. That is the interior; beyond that is the border."

children.text: paścimena sthūṇopasthūṇakau brāhmaṇagrāmakau so 'ntaḥ tataḥ pareṇa pratyantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "To the west are the two brahmin villages <s>Sthūṇa</s> and <s>Upasthūṇa</s>. That is the interior; beyond that is the border."

children.text: uttareṇa uśīragiriḥ so 'ntaḥ tataḥ pareṇa pratyantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "To the north is <s>Uśīragiri</s>. That is the interior; beyond that is the border."

children.text: kiṃ bhadanta āyuṣmatā śroṇena koṭikarṇena karma kṛtamiti vistaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Venerable sir, what <s>karma</s> (deed) was done by the venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>?" This is to be told at length.

children.text: bhagavānāha bhūtapūrvam yāvat kāśyapo nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksambuddho bhagavāñ śāstā loka utpannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: "In the past, up to the time when a <s>Tathāgata</s>, an arhat, a perfectly awakened Blessed One named <s>Kāśyapa</s>, a teacher, arose in the world."

children.text: tena khalu samayena vārāṇasyāṃ dvau jāyāpatikau ||
children.translated_text: At that time in <s>Vārāṇasī</s> there was a married couple.

children.text: tābhyāṃ kāśyapasya samyaksambuddhasyāntike śaraṇagamanaśikṣāpadāni udgṛhītāni ||
children.translated_text: They received the going for refuge and the precepts in the presence of <s>Kāśyapa</s>, the perfectly awakened one.

children.text: yadā kāśyapaḥ samyaksambuddhaḥ sakalaṃ buddhakāryaṃ kṛtvā nirupadhiśeṣe nirvāṇadhātau parinirvṛtaḥ tasya rājñā kṛkinā catūratnamayaṃ caityaṃ kāritaṃ samantādyojanamuccatvena ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Kāśyapa</s>, the perfectly awakened one, had performed the whole work of a Buddha and had passed completely into the <s>nirvāṇa</s> element without remainder, King <s>Kṛkin</s> had a caitya made for him, composed of four kinds of precious substances, a yojana all around and in height.

children.text: tena tatra khaṇḍasphuṭapratisaṃskaraṇāya ye pūrvanagaradvāre karapratyāyā uttiṣṭhante te tasmin stūpe 'nupradattāḥ ||
children.translated_text: And the tax revenues that arose at the eastern city gate were assigned to that stūpa for the repair of breaks and cracks.

children.text: yadā kṛkī rājā kālagataḥ tasya putraḥ sujāto nāmnā sa rājye pratiṣṭhāpitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When King <s>Kṛkin</s> died, his son, named <s>Sujāta</s>, was established in the kingdom.

children.text: tasyāmātyaiḥ stokāḥ karapratyāyā upanāmitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: His ministers brought him only small tax revenues.

children.text: so 'mātyānāmantrayate kiṃkāraṇamasmākaṃ bhavadbhiḥ stokakarapratyāyā upanāmitāḥ kimasmākaṃ vijite karapratyāyā nottiṣṭhante te kathayanti deva kutaḥ karapratyāyā prajñāpitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He addressed the ministers: "For what reason have you brought us only small tax revenues? Do tax revenues not arise in our dominion?" They said, "Your Majesty, where have the tax revenues been assigned?"

children.text: yadi devo 'nujānīyāt te vayaṃ tān karapratyāyān samucchindāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "If Your Majesty permits, we will abolish those tax revenues."

children.text: sa kathayati bhavantaḥ yanmama pitrā kṛtam devakṛtaṃ na tu brahmakṛtaṃ tat ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Good sirs, what was done by my father was done by a god, but not by Brahmā."

children.text: te saṃlakṣayanti yadi devo 'nujānīte vayaṃ tathā kariṣyāmo yathā svayameva te karapratyāyā notthāsyanti ||
children.translated_text: They considered, "If His Majesty permits, we shall act in such a way that those tax revenues will no longer arise by themselves."

children.text: taiḥ sa dvāre baddhvā sthāpitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They blocked that gate and left it closed.

children.text: na bhūyaḥ karapratyāyā uttiṣṭhante ||
children.translated_text: No more tax revenues arose.

children.text: tasmin stūpe caṭitakāni prādurbhūtāni ||
children.translated_text: Cracks appeared in that stūpa.

children.text: tau jāyāpatī vṛddhībhūtau tatraiva stūpe parikarma kurvāṇau tiṣṭhataḥ ||
children.translated_text: That elderly married couple remained there at that very stūpa, performing service.

children.text: uttarāpathāt sārthavāhaḥ paṇyamādāya vārāṇasīmanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A caravan leader from the northern region arrived at <s>Vārāṇasī</s>, bringing merchandise.

children.text: tenāsau dṛṣṭaḥ stūpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He saw that stūpa.

children.text: caṭitasphuṭitakaḥ prādurbhūtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: It had become cracked and split.

children.text: sa dṛṣṭvā pṛcchati amba tāta kasyaiṣa stūpa iti ||
children.translated_text: Having seen it, he asked, "Mother, father, whose stūpa is this?"

children.text: tau kathayataḥ kāśyapasya samyaksambuddhasya ||
children.translated_text: They said, "It is that of <s>Kāśyapa</s>, the perfectly awakened one."

children.text: kena kāritaḥ kṛkinā rājñā ||
children.translated_text: "By whom was it made?" "By King <s>Kṛkin</s>."

children.text: na tena rājñāsmin stūpe khaṇḍasphuṭapratisaṃskārakaraṇāya kiṃcit prajñaptaṃ tau kathayataḥ prajñaptam ||
children.translated_text: "Was nothing assigned by that king for the repair of breaks and cracks in this stūpa?" They said, "It was assigned."

children.text: ye pūrvanagaradvāre karapratyāyāste 'smin stūpe khaṇḍasphuṭapratisaṃskaraṇāya niryātitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "The tax revenues at the eastern city gate were handed over for the repair of breaks and cracks in this stūpa."

children.text: kṛkī rājā kālagataḥ ||
children.translated_text: "King <s>Kṛkin</s> died."

children.text: tasya putraḥ sujāto nāma sa rājye pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "His son, named <s>Sujāta</s>, was established in the kingdom."

children.text: tena te karapratyāyāḥ samucchinnāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "He abolished those tax revenues."

children.text: tenāsmin stūpe caṭitasphuṭitakāni prādurbhūtāni ||
children.translated_text: "Because of that, cracks and splits have appeared in this stūpa."

children.text: tasya ratnakarṇikā karṇe āmuktikā ||
children.translated_text: He had a jeweled earring fastened on his ear.

children.text: tena sā ratnakarṇikāvatārya tayordattā ||
children.translated_text: He took off that jeweled earring and gave it to the two of them.

children.text: amba tāta anayā karṇikayāsmin stūpe khaṇḍasphuṭapratisaṃskāraṃ kurutamiti ||
children.translated_text: "Mother, father, with this earring make repairs to the breaks and cracks in this stūpa."

children.text: yāvadahaṃ paṇyaṃ visarjayitvā āgacchāmi ||
children.translated_text: "I will come back after I have disposed of my merchandise."

children.text: tataḥ paścād bhūyo 'pi dāsyāmi ||
children.translated_text: "After that I will give again."

children.text: taistāṃ vikrīya tasmin stūpe khaṇḍasphuṭitapratisaṃskāraḥ kṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They sold it and made the repair of the breaks and cracks in that stūpa.

children.text: aparamutsarpitam ||
children.translated_text: A surplus remained.

children.text: athāpareṇa samayena sārthavāhaḥ paṇyaṃ visarjayitvā āgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, at another time, the caravan leader came back after disposing of his merchandise.

children.text: tena sa dṛṣṭaḥ stūpo 'secanakadarśanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He saw that stūpa, lovely to behold.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā ca bhūyasyā mātrayābhiprasannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And, seeing it, he became deeply and abundantly serene in faith.

children.text: sa prasādajātaḥ pṛcchati amba tāta yuṣmābhiḥ kiṃciduddhārīkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Filled with faith, he asked, "Mother, father, have you kept anything back?"

children.text: tau kathayataḥ putra nāsmābhiḥ kiṃciduddhārīkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Son, we have kept nothing back."

children.text: kiṃtvaparamutsarpitaṃ tiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: "But a surplus remains."

children.text: tena prasādajātena yattatrāvaśiṣṭam aparaṃ ca dattvā mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā praṇidhānaṃ ca kṛtam anenāhaṃ kuśalamūlenāḍhye mahādhane mahābhoge kule jāyeyam ||
children.translated_text: Then, filled with faith, he gave what was left there and still more, performed a great act of worship, and made the aspiration: "By this root of merit may I be born in a family that is wealthy, rich in great possessions, and rich in great enjoyments."

children.text: evaṃvidhānāṃ ca dharmāṇāṃ lābhī syām ||
children.translated_text: "May I obtain dharmas of such a kind."

children.text: evaṃvidhameva śāstāramārāgayeyaṃ mā virāgayeyamiti ||
children.translated_text: "May I please just such a teacher and not displease him."

children.text: kiṃ manyadhve bhikṣavo yo 'sau sārthavāhaḥ eṣa evāsau śroṇaḥ koṭikarṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "What do you think, monks? That caravan leader at that time is this very <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>."

children.text: yadanena kāśyapasya samyaksambuddhasya stūpe kārāṃ kṛtvā praṇidhānaṃ kṛtam tasya karmaṇo vipākenāḍhye mahādhane mahābhoge kule jātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Because he did service at the stūpa of <s>Kāśyapa</s>, the perfectly awakened one, and made an aspiration, by the ripening of that <s>karma</s> he was born in a family that was wealthy, rich in great possessions, and rich in great enjoyments."

children.text: mama śāsane pravrajya sarvakleśaprahāṇādarhattvaṃ sākṣātkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: After going forth in my teaching, he realized arhatship through the abandonment of all defilements.

children.text: ahamanena kāśyapena samyaksambuddhena sārdhaṃ samajavaḥ samabalaḥ samadhuraḥ samasāmānyaprāptaḥ śāstā ārāgito na virāgitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By me, together with this <s>Kāśyapa</s>, the perfectly awakened one, the teacher equal in origin, equal in strength, equal in burden, and having attained equal common standing, was pleased and not displeased.

children.text: iti bhikṣava ekāntakṛṣṇānāmekāntakṛṣṇo vipākaḥ ekāntaśuklānāṃ dharmāṇāmekāntaśuklo vipākaḥ vyatimiśrāṇāṃ vyatimiśraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thus, monks, for actions that are wholly dark there is a wholly dark result; for wholly bright dharmas there is a wholly bright result; for those that are mixed, a mixed result.

children.text: tasmāttarhi bhikṣava ekāntakṛṣṇāni karmāṇyapāsya vyatimiśrāṇi ca ekāntaśukleṣveva karmasvābhogaḥ karaṇīyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, monks, having cast aside wholly dark actions and also mixed ones, attention should be devoted only to wholly bright actions.

children.text: ityevaṃ vo bhikṣavaḥ śikṣitavyam ||
children.translated_text: In just this way, monks, you should train yourselves.

children.text: bhikṣava ūcuḥ kiṃ bhadanta āyuṣmatā śroṇena koṭikarṇena karma kṛtam yasya karmaṇo vipākena dṛṣṭa eva dharme apāyā dṛṣṭā bhagavānāha yadanena māturantike kharavākkarma niścāritam tasya karmaṇo vipākena dṛṣṭa eva dharme apāyā dṛṣṭā iti ||
children.translated_text: The monks said, "Venerable sir, what karma was done by the venerable <s>Śroṇa Koṭikarṇa</s>, by the ripening of which bad destinies were seen in this very life?" The Blessed One said, "Because he uttered an act of harsh speech toward his mother, by the ripening of that karma bad destinies were seen in this very life."

children.text: idamavocadbhagavān ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said this.

children.text: āttamanasaste bhikṣavo bhagavato bhāṣitamabhyanandan ||
children.translated_text: Those monks, delighted in mind, rejoiced in what the Blessed One had said.

children.text: Chapter 2
bhagavāñśrāvastyāṃ viharati sma jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>, in <s>Jeta Grove</s>, in the park of <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>.

children.text: tena khalu samayena sūrpārake nagare bhavo nāma gṛhapatiḥ prativasati āḍhyo mahādhano mahābhogo vistīrṇaviśālaparigraho vaiśravaṇadhanasamudito vaiśravaṇadhanapratispardhī ||
children.translated_text: At that time, in the city of <s>Sūrpāraka</s>, there lived a householder named <s>Bhava</s>, wealthy, possessed of great riches and great enjoyments, with extensive and broad possessions, endowed with the wealth of <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s> and rivaling the wealth of <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s>.

children.text: tena sadṛśāt kulāt kalatramānītam ||
children.translated_text: A wife was brought for him from a family of equal standing.

children.text: sa tayā sārdhaṃ krīḍati ramate paricārayati ||
children.translated_text: He sported, delighted, and amused himself together with her.

children.text: tasya krīḍato ramamāṇasya paricārayataḥ kālāntareṇa patnī āpannasattvā saṃvṛttā ||
children.translated_text: As he sported, delighted, and amused himself, after some time his wife became pregnant.

children.text: sā aṣṭānāṃ navānāṃ vā māsānāmatyayāt prasūtā ||
children.translated_text: After eight or nine months had passed, she gave birth.

children.text: dārako jātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A boy was born.

children.text: tasya trīṇi saptakāni ekaviṃśatidivasāni vistareṇa jātasya jātamahaṃ kṛtvā nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpyate kiṃ bhavatu dārakasya nāmeti ||
children.translated_text: When three weeks, twenty-one days, had passed after his birth, and the birth festival had been performed in full, a name was to be assigned: "What shall the boy's name be?"

children.text: jñātaya ūcuḥ ayaṃ dārako bhavasya gṛhapateḥ putraḥ tasmādbhavatu bhavila iti nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpitam ||
children.translated_text: The relatives said, "This boy is the son of <s>Bhava</s> the householder; therefore let his name be <s>Bhavila</s>." So that name was assigned.

children.text: bhūyo 'pyasya krīḍato ramamāṇasya paricārayataḥ putro jātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Again, as he sported, delighted, and amused himself, another son was born to him.

children.text: tasya bhavatrāta iti nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpitam ||
children.translated_text: The name <s>Bhavatrāta</s> was assigned to him.

children.text: punarapyasya putro jātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Again another son was born to him.

children.text: tasya bhavanandīti nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpitam ||
children.translated_text: The name <s>Bhavanandin</s> was assigned to him.

children.text: yāvadapareṇa samayena bhavo gṛhapatir glānaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, after some time, <s>Bhava</s> the householder became ill.

children.text: so 'tyarthaṃ paruṣavacanasamudācārī yataḥ patnyā putraiścāpyupekṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He behaved with extremely harsh speech, so that he was neglected even by his wife and sons.

children.text: tasya preṣyadārikā ||
children.translated_text: He had a servant girl.

children.text: sā saṃlakṣayati mama svāminā anekairupāyaśatairbhogāḥ samudānītāḥ ||
children.translated_text: She thought, "My master has gathered his wealth by hundreds of various means.

children.text: sa idānīṃ glānaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now he has become ill.

children.text: sa eṣa patnyā putraiścāpyupekṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This man is neglected even by his wife and sons.

children.text: na mama pratirūpaṃ syād yadahaṃ svāminamadhyupekṣeyamiti ||
children.translated_text: It would not be proper for me to neglect my master."

children.text: sā vaidyasakāśaṃ gatvā kathayati ārya jānīṣe tvaṃ bhavaṃ gṛhapatim jāne kiṃ tasya tasyaivaṃvidhaṃ glānyaṃ samupajātam ||
children.translated_text: She went to a physician and said, "Noble sir, do you know <s>Bhava</s> the householder?" "I know him." "What has happened to him, that such an illness has arisen?

children.text: sa patnyā putraiścāpyupekṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He is neglected even by his wife and sons.

children.text: tasya bhaiṣajyam vyapadiśeti ||
children.translated_text: Prescribe medicine for him."

children.text: sa kathayati dārike tvameva kathayasi sa patnyā putraiścāpyupekṣita iti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Girl, you yourself say that he is neglected even by his wife and sons.

children.text: atha kastasyopasthānaṃ karoti sā kathayati ahamasyopasthānaṃ karomi ||
children.translated_text: Then who is attending on him?" She said, "I am attending on him.

children.text: kiṃtvalpamūlyāni bhaiṣajyāni vyapadiśeti ||
children.translated_text: But prescribe medicines of little cost."

children.text: tena vyapadiṣṭam idaṃ tasya bhaiṣajyamiti ||
children.translated_text: He prescribed: "This is his medicine."

children.text: tatastayā kiṃcit svabhaktāttasmādeva gṛhādapahṛtyopasthānaṃ kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Then, taking a little from her own food, and from that very house, she performed the attendance on him.

children.text: sa svasthībhūtaḥ saṃlakṣayati ahaṃ patnyā putraiścādhyupekṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When he had recovered, he thought, "I was neglected even by my wife and sons.

children.text: yadahaṃ jīvitaḥ tadasyā dārikāyāḥ prabhāvāt ||
children.translated_text: That I am alive is due to the power of this girl.

children.text: tadasyāḥ pratyupakāraḥ kartavya iti ||
children.translated_text: Therefore I must make a return for her."

children.text: sā tenoktā dārike ahaṃ patnyā putraiścāpyupekṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He said to her, "Girl, I was neglected even by my wife and sons.

children.text: yat kiṃcidahaṃ jīvitaḥ sarvaṃ tava prabhāvāt ||
children.translated_text: Whatever life I have, all of it is due to your power.

children.text: ahaṃ te varamanuprayacchāmīti ||
children.translated_text: I grant you a boon."

children.text: sā kathayati svāmin yadi me parituṣṭo 'si bhavatu me tvayā sārdhaṃ samāgama iti ||
children.translated_text: She said, "Master, if you are pleased with me, let there be union for me with you."

children.text: sa kathayati kiṃ te mayā sārdhaṃ samāgamena pañca kārṣāpaṇaśatānyanuprayacchāmi adāsīṃ cotsṛjāmīti sā kathayati āryaputra dūramapi paramapi gatvā dāsyevāham yadi tu āryaputreṇa sārdhaṃ samāgamo bhavati evamadāsī bhavāmīti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "What need have you of union with me? I will give you five hundred <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s> and release you from slavery." She said, "Noble son, even if I go far away, even to the furthest place, I am still only a slave; but if there is union with the noble son, then in this way I shall become no slave."

children.text: tenāvaśyaṃ nirbandhaṃ jñātvā abhihitā yadā saṃvṛttā ṛtumatī tadā mamārocayiṣyasīti ||
children.translated_text: Knowing that her insistence was unavoidable, he said, "When you have become menstruating, then inform me."

children.text: sā apareṇa samayena kalyā saṃvṛttā ṛtumatī ||
children.translated_text: After some time she became ready, being in her fertile period.

children.text: tayā tasyārocitam ||
children.translated_text: She informed him of it.

children.text: tato bhavena gṛhapatinā tayā sārdhaṃ paricāritam ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Bhava</s> the householder had intercourse with her.

children.text: sā āpannasattvā saṃvṛttā ||
children.translated_text: She became pregnant.

children.text: yameva divasamāpannasattvā saṃvṛttā tameva divasamupādāya bhavasya gṛhapateḥ sarvārthāḥ sarvakarmāntāśca paripūrṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: From the very day on which she became pregnant, all the affairs and all the business undertakings of <s>Bhava</s> the householder were fulfilled.

children.text: sā tvaṣṭānāṃ vā navānāṃ māsānāmatyayāt prasūtā ||
children.translated_text: And she, after eight or nine months had passed, gave birth.

children.text: dārako jāto 'bhirūpo darśanīyaḥ prāsādiko gauraḥ kanakavarṇaśchatrākāraśīrṣaḥ pralambabāhurvistīrṇalalāṭaḥ saṃgatabhrūstuṅganāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A boy was born: handsome, lovely to see, pleasing, fair, golden-colored, with a head shaped like a parasol, long-armed, broad-browed, with joined eyebrows and a high nose.

children.text: yasminneva divase dārako jātaḥ tasminneva divase bhavasya gṛhapaterbhūyasyā mātrayā sarvārthāḥ sarvakarmāntāḥ paripūrṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: On the very day on which the boy was born, on that same day all the affairs and all the business undertakings of the householder <s>Bhava</s> were fulfilled in very great measure.

children.text: tasya jñātayaḥ saṃgamya samāgamya trīṇi saptakānyekaviṃśatidivasāni vistareṇa jātasya jātamahaṃ kṛtvā pūrvavat yāvatpūrṇeti nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpitam ||
children.translated_text: His kinsmen assembled and came together; for three weeks, twenty-one days, they held the birth celebration for the newborn in full detail, as before, and the name <s>Pūrṇa</s> was assigned to him.

children.text: pūrṇo dārako 'ṣṭābhyo dhātrībhyo dvābhyāmaṃsadhātrībhyāṃ datto vistareṇa yāvadāśu vardhate hradasthamiva paṅkajam ||
children.translated_text: The boy <s>Pūrṇa</s> was entrusted to eight nurses, including two nurses who carried him on the shoulder; as described in full before, he quickly grew like a lotus in a lake.

children.text: yadā mahān saṃvṛttaḥ tadā lipyāmupanyastaḥ saṃkhyāyāṃ gaṇanāyāṃ mudrāyāmuddhāre nyāse nikṣepe vastuparīkṣāyāṃ ratnaparīkṣāyāṃ hastiparīkṣāyāmaśvaparīkṣāyāṃ kumāraparīkṣāyāṃ kumārikāparīkṣāyām ||
children.translated_text: When he had grown up, he was set to writing, arithmetic, calculation, seals, withdrawals, deposits, pledges, testing of goods, testing of jewels, testing of elephants, testing of horses, testing of boys, and testing of girls.

children.text: aṣṭāsu parīkṣāsūdghaṭako vācakaḥ paṇḍitaḥ paṭupracāraḥ saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In the eight examinations he became proficient, articulate, learned, and quick in practice.

children.text: tato bhavena gṛhapatinā bhavilādīnāṃ putrāṇām yathānupūrvyā niveśāḥ kṛtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the householder <s>Bhava</s> arranged household establishments for his sons, beginning with <s>Bhavila</s>, in due order.

children.text: te patnībhiḥ sārdhamatīva saṃraktā nivṛttā maṇḍanaparamā vyavasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Together with their wives, they became exceedingly attached, withdrawn from work, and devoted chiefly to adornment.

children.text: tato bhavo gṛhapatiḥ kare kapolaṃ dattvā cintāparo vyavasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the householder <s>Bhava</s> placed his hand on his cheek and remained absorbed in thought.

children.text: sa putrairdṛṣṭaḥ pṛṣṭaśca tāta kasmāttvaṃ kare kapolaṃ dattvā cintāparo vyavasthita iti ||
children.translated_text: His sons saw him and asked, "Father, why are you sitting with your hand on your cheek, absorbed in thought?"

children.text: sa kathayati putrakāḥ na tāvanmayā niveśaḥ kṛto yāvatsuvarṇalakṣaḥ samudānīta iti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Sons, I did not make a household establishment until I had gathered a lakh of gold.

children.text: te yūyaṃ nirastavyāpārāḥ patnīṣvatyarthaṃ saṃraktā maṇḍanaparamā vyavasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: But you have abandoned business, are excessively attached to your wives, and remain devoted chiefly to adornment.

children.text: mamātyayāt gṛhaṃ śocanīyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: After I am gone, the household will become pitiable.

children.text: kathaṃ na cintāparo bhaviṣyāmīti bhavilena ratnakarṇikā pinaddhā ||
children.translated_text: How, then, could I not be absorbed in thought?" <s>Bhavila</s> had fastened on a jeweled ear-ornament.

children.text: sa tāmavatārya dārukarṇikāṃ pinahya pratijñāmārūḍhaḥ na tāvat ratnakarṇikāṃ pinahyāmi yāvat suvarṇalakṣaḥ samupārjita iti ||
children.translated_text: He took it off, put on a wooden ear-ornament, and undertook a vow: "I will not wear a jeweled ear-ornament until a lakh of gold has been earned."

children.text: apareṇa stavakarṇikā ||
children.translated_text: Another took a straw ear-ornament.

children.text: apareṇa trapukarṇikā ||
children.translated_text: Another took a tin ear-ornament.

children.text: teṣām yāstāḥ saṃjñā bhavilo bhavatrāto bhavanandīti tā antarhitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Their names, <s>Bhavila</s>, <s>Bhavatrāta</s>, and <s>Bhavanandī</s>, disappeared.

children.text: dārukarṇī stavakarṇī trapukarṇīti prādurbhūtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The names <s>Dārukarṇī</s>, <s>Stavakarṇī</s>, and <s>Trapukarṇī</s> appeared.

children.text: te paṇyamādāya mahāsamudraṃ samprasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They took merchandise and set out for the great ocean.

children.text: pūrṇaḥ kathayati tāta ahamapi mahāsamudraṃ gacchāmīti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūrṇa</s> said, "Father, I too will go to the great ocean."

children.text: sa kathayati putra bālastvam ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Son, you are a child.

children.text: atraiva tiṣṭha āvāryāṃ vyāpāraṃ kuru ||
children.translated_text: Stay right here and conduct trade in the shop."

children.text: sa tatraivāvasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He remained right there.

children.text: te 'pi saṃsiddhayānapātrā āgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They too returned with their ships successful.

children.text: mārgaśramaṃ prativinodya kathayanti tāta kalyatāmasmadīyaṃ paṇyamiti ||
children.translated_text: After relieving the weariness of the road, they said, "Father, let our merchandise be reckoned."

children.text: tena kalitam ekaikasya suvarṇalakṣāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ ||
children.translated_text: It was reckoned by him, and for each of them a lakh of gold came about.

children.text: pūrṇenāpi tatraiva dharmeṇa nyāyena vyavahāritāḥ sātirekāḥ suvarṇalakṣāḥ samudānītāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūrṇa</s> also, right there, conducted business according to <s>dharma</s> and justice, and gathered more than a lakh of gold.

children.text: pūrṇo 'pi pituḥ pādayor nipatya kathayati tāta mamāpi kalyatāmāvārīsamutthitaṃ dravyamiti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūrṇa</s> too fell at his father's feet and said, "Father, let the wealth arisen from my shop be reckoned as well."

children.text: sa kathayati putra tvamatraivāvasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Son, you stayed right here.

children.text: kiṃ tava kalyate sa kathayati tāta kalyatām ||
children.translated_text: What of yours is to be reckoned?" He said, "Father, let it be reckoned.

children.text: tathāpi jñātaṃ bhaviṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: Even so, it will be known."

children.text: kalitam yāvannyāyopārjitasya suvarṇasya mūlyaṃ varjayitvā sātiriktā lakṣāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ ||
children.translated_text: It was reckoned: after setting aside the value of the lawfully acquired gold, there were lakhs in surplus.

children.text: bhavo gṛhapatiḥ prītisaumanasyajātaḥ saṃlakṣayati puṇyamaheśākhyo 'yaṃ sattvo yenehaiva sthiteneyatsuvarṇaṃ samupārjitamiti ||
children.translated_text: The householder <s>Bhava</s>, filled with joy and gladness, reflected, "This being is great in merit and influence, since he has earned so much gold while staying right here."

children.text: yāvadapareṇa samayena bhavo gṛhapatirglānaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, at another time, the householder <s>Bhava</s> became ill.

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati mamātyayādete bhedaṃ gamiṣyanti ||
children.translated_text: He reflected, "After I am gone, these sons will become divided.

children.text: upāyasaṃvidhānaṃ kartavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: A skillful arrangement must be made."

children.text: tena te 'bhihitāḥ putrakāḥ kāṣṭhāni samudānayateti ||
children.translated_text: He said to them, "Sons, collect pieces of wood."

children.text: taiḥ kāṣṭhāni samudānītāni ||
children.translated_text: They collected the pieces of wood.

children.text: sa kathayati agniṃ prajvālayateti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Kindle a fire."

children.text: tairagniḥ prajvālitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They kindled the fire.

children.text: bhavo gṛhapatiḥ kathayati ekaikamalātamapanayateti ||
children.translated_text: The householder <s>Bhava</s> said, "Remove one firebrand each."

children.text: tairapanītam ||
children.translated_text: They removed them.

children.text: so 'gnir nirvāṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: That fire went out.

children.text: sa kathayati putrakāḥ dṛṣṭo vaḥ tāta dṛṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Sons, have you seen?" "Father, we have seen."

children.text: sa gāthāṃ bhāṣate ||
children.translated_text: He spoke a verse:

children.text: jvalanti sahitāṅgārā bhrātaraḥ sahitāstathā
children.translated_text: Coals blaze when they are together; brothers likewise when united.

children.text: pravibhaktā niśāmyanti yathāṅgārastathā narāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When divided, they grow cold, just as coals do; so too do men.

children.text: putrakāḥ na yuṣmābhirmamātyayāt strīṇāṃ śrotavyam ||
children.translated_text: Sons, after I am gone, you must not listen to women.

children.text: kuṭumbaṃ bhidyate strībhir vāgbhirbhidyanti kātarāḥ
children.translated_text: A household is split by women; timid men are split by words.

children.text: durnyasto bhidyate mantraḥ prītirbhidyate lobhataḥ
children.translated_text: Counsel badly entrusted is split; affection is split through greed.

children.text: iti ||
children.translated_text: Thus.

children.text: te niṣkrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They went out.

children.text: bhavilastatraivāvasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bhavila</s> remained there.

children.text: sa tenoktaḥ putra na kadācit tvayā pūrṇo moktavyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was told by him, "Son, <s>Pūrṇa</s> must never be let go by you.

children.text: puṇyamaheśākhyo 'yaṃ sattvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This being is great in merit and influence."

children.text: ityuktvā ||
children.translated_text: Having said this,

children.text: sarve kṣayāntā nicayāḥ patanāntāḥ samucchrayāḥ
children.translated_text: All accumulations end in destruction; all elevations end in falling.

children.text: saṃyogā viprayogāntā maraṇāntaṃ ca jīvitam ||
children.translated_text: All unions end in separation, and life ends in death.

children.text: iti kāladharmeṇa saṃyuktaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thus he met the condition of time.

children.text: tair nīlapītalohitāvadātairvastraiḥ śibikāmalaṃkṛtya mahatā saṃskāreṇa śmaśānaṃ nītvā dhmāpitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They decorated the bier with blue, yellow, red, and white cloths, took him to the cremation ground with great ceremony, and had him cremated.

children.text: tataste śokavinodanaṃ kṛtvā kathayanti yadā asmākaṃ pitā jīvati tadā tadadhīnāḥ prāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, having dispelled their grief, they said, "When our father was alive, our lives depended on him.

children.text: yadidānīṃ nirastavyāpārāstiṣṭhāmaḥ gṛhamavasādaṃ gamiṣyati ||
children.translated_text: If we now remain without business, the household will fall into decline.

children.text: na śobhanaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: It will not be good.

children.text: yannu vayaṃ paṇyamādāya deśāntaraṃ gacchāma iti ||
children.translated_text: What if we take merchandise and go to another country?"

children.text: pūrṇaḥ kathayati yadyevamahamapi gacchāmīti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūrṇa</s> said, "If that is so, I too will go."

children.text: te kathayanti tvamatraivāvāryāṃ vyāpāraṃ kuru vayameva gacchāma iti ||
children.translated_text: They said, "You stay right here and conduct the business in the shop; we alone will go."

children.text: te paṇyamādāya deśāntaraṃ gatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Taking merchandise, they went to another country.

children.text: pūrṇo nyastasarvakāryastatraivāvasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūrṇa</s>, with all duties entrusted to him, remained there itself.

children.text: dharmatā khalu īśvaragṛheṣu divasaparivyayo dīyate ||
children.translated_text: It is the custom that in the houses of the wealthy, daily expense-money is given.

children.text: tāsteṣāṃ patnyo dārikāḥ parivyayanimittaṃ preṣayanti ||
children.translated_text: Their wives sent the maidservants for the daily expenses.

children.text: pūrṇo 'pi dhanibhiḥ śreṣṭhibhiḥ sārthavāhairanyaiścājīvibhiḥ parivṛto 'vatiṣṭhate ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūrṇa</s> too remained surrounded by rich men, merchants, caravan-leaders, and other people pursuing a livelihood.

children.text: tāstvavakāśaṃ na labhante ||
children.translated_text: But the women found no opportunity.

children.text: yadā te upasthāya prakrāntā bhavanti tadā tāsāṃ divasaparivyayaṃ dadāti ||
children.translated_text: When those men had attended on him and gone away, then he would give the daily expenses to them.

children.text: tā dārikāściracirādāgacchantītyupālabhyante ||
children.translated_text: The maidservants were scolded: "You come only after a very long time."

children.text: tā evamarthaṃ vistareṇārocayanti ||
children.translated_text: They reported the matter in detail.

children.text: tāḥ kathayanti evaṃ hi teṣāṃ bhavati yeṣāṃ dāsīputrāḥ kuleṣvaiśvaryaṃ vaśe vartayantīti ||
children.translated_text: The wives said, "Indeed this is what happens among those whose slave-woman's sons bring authority in families under their control."

children.text: bhavilapatnyā dārikā abhihitā tvayā kālaṃ jñātvā gantavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: The maidservant was told by <s>Bhavila</s>'s wife, "You should go after recognizing the right time."

children.text: sā kālaṃ jñātvā gacchati śīghraṃ labhate ||
children.translated_text: She went after recognizing the right time and received it quickly.

children.text: anyāścirayanti ||
children.translated_text: The others delayed.

children.text: tābhiḥ sā pṛṣṭā tayā samākhyātam ||
children.translated_text: She was questioned by them, and she explained it.

children.text: tā api tayā sārdhaṃ gantumārabdhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They too began to go together with her.

children.text: tā api śīghraṃ pratilabhante ||
children.translated_text: They too received it quickly.

children.text: tāḥ svāminībhiruktāḥ kimatra kāraṇamidānīṃ śīghramāgacchatheti ||
children.translated_text: They were asked by their mistresses, "What is the reason here that you now come quickly?"

children.text: tāḥ kathayanti ārogyaṃ jyeṣṭhabhavikāyā bhavatu ||
children.translated_text: They said, "May the elder <s>Bhavikā</s> be well.

children.text: yadā tasyā dārikā gatā bhavati tadā labhyate ||
children.translated_text: When her maidservant has gone, then it is obtained.

children.text: vayaṃ tayā sārdhaṃ gacchāma iti ||
children.translated_text: We go together with her."

children.text: tāḥ saṃjātāmarṣāḥ kathayanti evaṃ hi teṣāṃ bhavati yeṣāṃ dāsīputrāḥ kuleṣvaiśvaryaṃ vaśe vartayantīti ||
children.translated_text: Becoming resentful, they said, "Indeed this is what happens among those whose slave-woman's sons bring authority in families under their control."

children.text: yāvadapareṇa samayena bhavilo bhavatrāto bhavanandī ca sahitāḥ samagrāḥ saṃmodamānā mahāsamudrāt saṃsiddhayānapātrā āgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, at another time, <s>Bhavila</s>, <s>Bhavatrāta</s>, and <s>Bhavanandin</s> arrived from the great ocean, their ship having completed its voyage, united, harmonious, and rejoicing together.

children.text: bhavilena patnī pṛṣṭā bhadre śobhanaṃ pūrṇena pratipālitā tvamiti sā kathayati yathā bhrātrā putreṇa veti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bhavila</s> asked his wife, "Dear, were you well looked after by <s>Pūrṇa</s>?" She said, "As by a brother or a son."

children.text: te anye 'pi svāmibhyāṃ pṛṣṭe kathayataḥ evaṃ hi teṣāṃ bhavati yeṣāṃ dāsīputrāḥ kuleṣvaiśvaryaṃ vaśe vartayantīti ||
children.translated_text: But the other two wives, when asked by their husbands, said, "Indeed this is what happens among those whose slave-woman's sons bring authority in families under their control."

children.text: tau saṃlakṣayataḥ suhṛdbhedakāḥ striyo bhavantīti ||
children.translated_text: The two men understood, "Women are dividers of friends."

children.text: yāvadapareṇa samayena kāśikavastrāvārī udghāṭitā ||
children.translated_text: Then, at another time, the storeroom of <s>Kāśī</s> cloths was opened.

children.text: tatsamanantaraṃ bhavilasya putro gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Immediately after that, <s>Bhavila</s>'s son went.

children.text: sa pūrṇena kāśikavastrayugenācchāditaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was covered by <s>Pūrṇa</s> with a pair of <s>Kāśī</s> cloths.

children.text: anyābhyāṃ dṛṣṭvā svaputrāḥ preṣitā yāvat kāśikavastrāvārī ghaṭṭitā phuṭṭakavastrāvārī udghāṭitā ||
children.translated_text: Seeing this, the other two sent their own sons, but by then the storeroom of <s>Kāśī</s> cloths had been closed and the storeroom of coarse cloths had been opened.

children.text: te ca daivayogāt samprāptāḥ ||
children.translated_text: And by chance they arrived then.

children.text: te pūrṇena phuṭṭakairvastrairācchāditāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They were covered by <s>Pūrṇa</s> with coarse cloths.

children.text: te dṛṣṭvā svāminoḥ kathayataḥ dṛṣṭam yuvābhyāmapareṣāṃ kāśikavastrāṇi dīyante pareṣāṃ phuṭṭakānīti ||
children.translated_text: Seeing this, the two wives said to their husbands, "Did you two see? To some, <s>Kāśī</s> cloths are given; to others, coarse cloths."

children.text: tābhyāmanusaṃjñaptirdattā ||
children.translated_text: The two men gave them a conciliatory explanation.

children.text: kimetadeva bhaviṣyati nūnaṃ kāśikavastrāvārī ghaṭṭitā phuṭṭakavastrāvārī udghāṭiteti ||
children.translated_text: "What else could this be? Surely the storeroom of <s>Kāśī</s> cloths had been closed and the storeroom of coarse cloths opened."

children.text: yāvadapareṇa samayena śarkarāvārī udghaṭitā ||
children.translated_text: Then, at another time, the sugar-candy storeroom was opened.

children.text: bhavilasya ca putro gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: And <s>Bhavila</s>'s son went.

children.text: tena śarkarākhodako labdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He received a lump of sugar-candy.

children.text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā anyābhyāṃ svaputrāḥ preṣitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeing him, the other two sent their own sons.

children.text: te daivayogād guḍāvāryāmudghāṭitāyāṃ gatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: By chance they went when the jaggery storeroom had been opened.

children.text: tairguḍo labdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They received jaggery.

children.text: tābhistaṃ dṛṣṭvā svāminau tathā tathā bhagnau yathā gṛhavibhāgaṃ kartumārabdhau ||
children.translated_text: Seeing that, the wives wore down their two husbands in such a way that they began to divide the household.

children.text: tau parasparaṃ saṃjalpaṃ kurutaḥ sarvathā vinaṣṭā vayam gṛhaṃ bhājayāmeti ||
children.translated_text: The two men held counsel with each other: "We are altogether ruined. Let us divide the household."

children.text: ekaḥ kathayati jyeṣṭhataraṃ śabdayāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: One said, "Let us call the eldest."

children.text: ekaḥ kathayati vicārayāmastāvat kathaṃ bhājayāmeti ||
children.translated_text: The other said, "Let us first consider how we should divide it."

children.text: tau svabuddhyā vicārayataḥ ||
children.translated_text: The two considered according to their own judgment.

children.text: ekasya gṛhagataṃ kṣetragataṃ ca ekasyāvārīgataṃ deśāntaragataṃ ca ekasya pūrṇakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "For one there is what belongs to the house and the fields; for one, what belongs to the storerooms and to foreign trade; for one, <s>Pūrṇaka</s>.

children.text: yadi jyeṣṭhataro gṛhagataṃ kṣetragataṃ ca grahīṣyati śaknumo vayamāvārīgatena deśāntaragatena cātmānaṃ saṃdhārayitum ||
children.translated_text: If the eldest takes what belongs to the house and the fields, we can maintain ourselves with what belongs to the storerooms and to foreign trade.

children.text: athāvārīgataṃ deśāntaragataṃ ca grahīṣyati tathāpi vayaṃ śaknumo gṛhagatena kṣetragatena cātmānaṃ saṃdhārayitum pūrṇakasya ca maryādābandhaṃ kartumiti ||
children.translated_text: But if he takes what belongs to the storerooms and to foreign trade, then even so we can maintain ourselves with what belongs to the house and the fields, and we can set bounds on <s>Pūrṇaka</s>."

children.text: tāvevaṃ saṃjalpaṃ kṛtvā bhavilasya sakāśaṃ gatau ||
children.translated_text: Having spoken together in this way, the two went to <s>Bhavila</s>.

children.text: bhrātaḥ vinaṣṭā vayaṃ bhājayāmo gṛhamiti ||
children.translated_text: "Brother, we are ruined. Let us divide the household."

children.text: sa kathayati suparīkṣitaṃ kartavyam gṛhabhedikāḥ striyo bhavantīti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "This should be very carefully examined. Women are splitters of households."

children.text: tau kathayataḥ pratyakṣīkṛtamasmābhiḥ bhājayāmeti ||
children.translated_text: The two said, "We have seen it directly. Let us divide it."

children.text: sa kathayati yadevam āhūyantāṃ kulānīti ||
children.translated_text: He says, "If that is so, let the families be summoned."

children.text: tau kathayataḥ pūrvamevāsmābhirbhājitam ||
children.translated_text: The two say, "It has already been divided by us before now."

children.text: ekasya gṛhagataṃ kṣetragataṃ ca ekasyāvārīgataṃ deśāntaragataṃ ca ekasya pūrṇakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For one there is what belongs to the house and fields, for one what belongs to the ship and to foreign lands, and for one there is <s>Pūrṇaka</s>.

children.text: sa kathayati pūrṇasya pratyaṃśaṃ nānuprayacchatha tau kathayataḥ dāsīputraḥ saḥ ||
children.translated_text: He says, "Do you not give <s>Pūrṇa</s> his share?" The two say, "He is the son of a slave woman."

children.text: kastasya pratyaṃśaṃ dadyāt api tu sa evāsmābhirbhājitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Who would give him a share? But he himself has been assigned by us."

children.text: yadi tavābhipretaṃ tameva gṛhāṇeti ||
children.translated_text: "If you wish, take him alone."

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati ahaṃ pitrā abhihitaḥ sarvasvamapi te parityajya pūrṇo grahītavya iti ||
children.translated_text: He reflects, "I was told by my father: 'Even if you abandon all my property, <s>Pūrṇa</s> must be taken.'"

children.text: gṛhṇāmi pūrṇamiti viditvā kathayati evaṃ bhavatu mama pūrṇaka iti ||
children.translated_text: Knowing, "I will take <s>Pūrṇa</s>," he says, "So be it. <s>Pūrṇaka</s> is mine."

children.text: yasya gṛhagataṃ kṣetragataṃ ca sa tvaramāṇo gṛhaṃ gatvā kathayati jyeṣṭhabhavike nirgaccha ||
children.translated_text: The one whose share was the house and fields went quickly to the house and said, "Wife of the elder <s>Bhavila</s>, come out."

children.text: sā nirgatā ||
children.translated_text: She came out.

children.text: mā bhūyaḥ pravekṣyasi ||
children.translated_text: "You shall not enter again."

children.text: kasyārthāya asmābhirbhājitaṃ gṛham ||
children.translated_text: "For what purpose was the house divided by us?"

children.text: yasyāvārīgataṃ deśāntaragataṃ ca so 'pi tvaramāṇa āvārīṃ gatvā kathayati pūrṇaka avatareti ||
children.translated_text: The one whose share was the ship and the foreign possessions also went quickly to the ship and said, "<s>Pūrṇaka</s>, get down."

children.text: so 'vatīrṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He got down.

children.text: mā bhūyo 'bhirokṣyasi ||
children.translated_text: "You shall not climb aboard again."

children.text: kiṃ kāraṇam asmābhirbhājitam ||
children.translated_text: "Why was it divided by us?"

children.text: yāvat bhavilapatnī pūrṇakena sārdhaṃ jñātigṛhaṃ samprasthitā ||
children.translated_text: At length <s>Bhavila</s>'s wife set out for the house of her relatives together with <s>Pūrṇaka</s>.

children.text: dārakā bubhukṣitā roditumārabdhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The children, hungry, began to cry.

children.text: sā kathayati pūrṇa dārakāṇāṃ pūrvabhakṣikāmanuprayaccheti ||
children.translated_text: She says, "<s>Pūrṇa</s>, give the children some food to eat first."

children.text: sa kathayati kārṣāpaṇaṃ prayaccha ||
children.translated_text: He says, "Give me a <s>kārṣāpaṇa</s>."

children.text: sā kathayati tvayā iyatībhiḥ suvarṇalakṣābhirvyavahṛtam dārakāṇāṃ pūrvabhikṣikāpi nāsti pūrṇaḥ kathayati kimahaṃ jāne yuṣmākaṃ gṛhe īdṛśīyamavasthā bhaviṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: She says, "You have traded with so many hundreds of thousands of gold coins, yet there is not even a first morsel for the children?" <s>Pūrṇa</s> says, "How could I know that such a condition would come about in your house?"

children.text: yadi mayā jñātamabhaviṣyat mayā anekāḥ suvarṇalakṣāḥ saṃhāritā abhaviṣyan ||
children.translated_text: "If I had known, I would have collected many hundreds of thousands of gold coins."

children.text: dharmataiṣā striya ārakūṭakārṣāpaṇān vastrānte badhnanti ||
children.translated_text: It is the way of women to tie base-metal <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s> in the hem of their garment.

children.text: tayārakūṭamāṣako dattaḥ pūrvabhakṣikāmānayeti ||
children.translated_text: She gave him a base-metal <s>māṣaka</s>, saying, "Bring some food to eat first."

children.text: sa tamādāya vīthīṃ samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Taking it, he set out for the street.

children.text: anyatamaśca puruṣaḥ samudravelāpreritānāṃ kāṣṭhānāṃ bhāramādāya śītenābhidruto vepamāna āgacchati ||
children.translated_text: And a certain man came along, trembling and overcome by cold, carrying a load of wood driven in by the tide of the sea.

children.text: sa tena dṛṣṭaḥ pṛṣṭaśca bhoḥ puruṣa kasmādevaṃ vepase sa kathayati ahamapi na jāne ||
children.translated_text: He saw him and asked, "Sir, why are you trembling like this?" He says, "I do not know either."

children.text: mayā cāyaṃ bhāraka utkṣipto bhavati mama cedṛśī samavasthā ||
children.translated_text: "When this little load was lifted by me, such a condition came upon me."

children.text: sa dāruparīkṣāyāṃ kṛtāvī ||
children.translated_text: He was skilled in examining wood.

children.text: sa tat kāṣṭhaṃ nirīkṣitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He began to inspect that wood.

children.text: paśyati tatra gośīrṣacandanam ||
children.translated_text: He saw gośīrṣa sandalwood there.

children.text: sa tenābhihitaḥ bho puruṣa kiyatā mūlyena dīyate pañcabhiḥ kārṣāpaṇaśataiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He said to him, "Sir, for what price is it given?" "For five hundred <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>."

children.text: tena taṃ kāṣṭhabhāraṃ gṛhītvā tadgośīrṣacandanamapanīya vīthīṃ gatvā karapattrikayā catasraḥ khaṇḍikāḥ kṛtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He took that load of wood, removed the gośīrṣa sandalwood, went to the street, and with a hand-saw made four pieces.

children.text: taccūrṇakasyārthaṃ kārṣāpaṇasahasreṇa vikrītaṃ vartate ||
children.translated_text: For the sake of its powder, it was sold for a thousand <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>.

children.text: tatastasya puruṣasya pañcakārṣāpaṇaśatāni dattāni ||
children.translated_text: Then five hundred <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s> were given to that man.

children.text: uktaṃ ca enaṃ kāṣṭhabhārakamamuṣmin gṛhe bhavilapatnī tiṣṭhati tatra naya vaktavyā pūrṇena preṣiteti ||
children.translated_text: And it was said to him, "Take this load of wood to the house where <s>Bhavila</s>'s wife is staying. There she should be told, 'It has been sent by <s>Pūrṇa</s>.'"

children.text: tenāsau nīto yathāvṛttaṃ cārocitam ||
children.translated_text: He took it there and reported what had happened.

children.text: sā urasi prahāraṃ dattvā kathayati yadyasāvarthātparibhraṣṭaḥ kiṃ prajñayāpi paribhraṣṭaḥ pakvamānayeti pācanaṃ preṣitam ||
children.translated_text: She struck her breast and said, "If that man has fallen away from wealth, has he also fallen away from wisdom? Bring cooked food." The cooking vessel was sent.

children.text: tadeva nāsti yat paktavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: "There is nothing here to be cooked."

children.text: pūrṇena śeṣakatipayakārṣāpaṇair dāsadāsīgomahiṣīvastrāṇi jīvitopakaraṇāni pakvamādāyāgatya dampatyor upanāmitavān ||
children.translated_text: With the few remaining <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>, <s>Pūrṇa</s> bought male and female slaves, cows, buffalo cows, garments, necessities for living, and cooked food; he came back and presented them to the couple.

children.text: tena kuṭumbaṃ saṃtoṣitam ||
children.translated_text: By him the household was satisfied.

children.text: atrāntare saurpārakīyo rājā dāhajvareṇa viklavībhūtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Meanwhile the king of <s>Sūrpāraka</s> was afflicted and made helpless by a burning fever.

children.text: tasya vaidyairgośīrṣacandanamupadiṣṭam ||
children.translated_text: Gośīrṣa sandalwood was prescribed for him by the physicians.

children.text: tato 'mātyā gośīrṣacandanaṃ samanveṣayitum ārabdhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the ministers began to search for gośīrṣa sandalwood.

children.text: tairvīthyāṃ pāramparyeṇa śrutam ||
children.translated_text: Through rumor passed along in the street, they heard of it.

children.text: te pūrṇasya sakāśaṃ gatvā kathayanti tavāsti gośīrṣacandanam sa āha asti ||
children.translated_text: They went to <s>Pūrṇa</s> and said, "Do you have gośīrṣa sandalwood?" He said, "I have."

children.text: te ūcuḥ kiyatā mūlyena dīyate sa āha kārṣāpaṇasahasreṇa ||
children.translated_text: They said, "At what price is it given?" He said, "For a thousand <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>."

children.text: taiḥ kārṣāpaṇasahasreṇa gṛhītvā rājñaḥ pralepo dattaḥ svasthībhūtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They bought it for a thousand <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s> and gave the king an ointment; he became well.

children.text: rājā saṃlakṣayati kīdṛśo 'sau rājā yasya gṛhe gośīrṣacandanaṃ nāsti ||
children.translated_text: The king reflected, "What kind of king is he in whose house there is no gośīrṣa sandalwood?"

children.text: rājā pṛcchati kuta etat deva pūrṇāt ||
children.translated_text: The king asks, "Where is this from?" "Sire, from <s>Pūrṇa</s>."

children.text: āhūyatāṃ pūrṇakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Let <s>Pūrṇaka</s> be summoned."

children.text: sa dūtena gatvā uktaḥ pūrṇa devastvāṃ śabdāpayatīti ||
children.translated_text: A messenger went and said to him, "<s>Pūrṇa</s>, His Majesty calls you."

children.text: sa vicārayitum ārabdhaḥ kimarthaṃ māṃ rājā śabdāpayati sa saṃlakṣayati gośīrṣacandanenāsau rājā svasthībhūtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He began to consider, "For what purpose does the king call me?" He reflected, "This king has become well through the gośīrṣa sandalwood."

children.text: tadarthaṃ māṃ śabdayati ||
children.translated_text: "He calls me for that reason."

children.text: sarvathā gośīrṣacandanamādāya gantavyam ||
children.translated_text: "In every way I must go, taking the gośīrṣa sandalwood."

children.text: sa gośīrṣacandanasya tisro gaṇḍikā vastreṇa pidhāyaikaṃ pāṇinā gṛhītvā rājñaḥ sakāśaṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He covered the three lumps of gośīrṣa sandalwood with a cloth, took the bundle in his hand, and went into the presence of the king.

children.text: rājñā pṛṣṭaḥ pūrṇa asti kiṃcid gośīrṣacandanam ||
children.translated_text: The king asked, "<s>Pūrṇa</s>, is there any gośīrṣa sandalwood?"

children.text: sa kathayati deva idamasti ||
children.translated_text: He says, "Sire, this much is here."

children.text: kimasya mūlyam deva suvarṇalakṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "What is its price?" "Sire, a hundred thousand gold coins."

children.text: aparamasti deva asti ||
children.translated_text: "Is there more?" "Sire, there is."

children.text: tena tāstisro gaṇḍikā darśitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then he showed those three lumps.

children.text: rājñāmātyānām ājñā dattā pūrṇasya catasraḥ suvarṇalakṣāḥ prayacchateti ||
children.translated_text: An order was given by the king to the ministers: "Give <s>Pūrṇa</s> four lakhs of suvarṇas."

children.text: pūrṇaḥ kathayati deva tisro dīyantām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūrṇa</s> said, "Your Majesty, let three be given."

children.text: ekagaṇḍikā devasya prābhṛtamiti ||
children.translated_text: "One gaṇḍikā is a presentation for Your Majesty."

children.text: tatastasya tisro dattāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then three were given to him.

children.text: rājā kathayati pūrṇa parituṣṭo 'ham ||
children.translated_text: The king said, "<s>Pūrṇa</s>, I am pleased."

children.text: vada kiṃ te varamanuprayacchāmīti ||
children.translated_text: "Say what boon I should grant you."

children.text: pūrṇaḥ kathayati yadi me devaḥ parituṣṭo devasya vijite 'paribhūto vaseyamiti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūrṇa</s> said, "If Your Majesty is pleased with me, may I live unoppressed in Your Majesty's realm."

children.text: rājñā amātyānāmājñā dattā bhavantaḥ adyāgreṇa kumārāṇāmājñā deyā na tvevaṃ pūrṇasyeti ||
children.translated_text: The king gave an order to the ministers: "Sirs, from this day forward orders may be given to the princes, but not in this way to <s>Pūrṇa</s>."

children.text: yāvanmahāsamudrāt pañcamātrāṇi vaṇikśatāni saṃsiddhayānapātrāṇi sūrpārakaṃ nagaramanuprāptāni ||
children.translated_text: Then, from the great ocean, about five hundred merchants with their ships made ready arrived at the city of <s>Sūrpāraka</s>.

children.text: vaṇiggrāmeṇa kriyākāraḥ kṛtaḥ na kenacidasmākaṃ samastānāṃ nirgatyaikākinā vaṇijāṃ sakāśamupasaṃkramitavyam ||
children.translated_text: The merchants' guild made an agreement: "No one among us is to go out separately and approach the merchants on his own."

children.text: gaṇa eva sambhūya bhāṇḍaṃ grahīṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: "The guild alone, having assembled together, will take the merchandise."

children.text: apare kathayanti pūrṇamapi śabdāpayāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Some said, "Let us summon <s>Pūrṇa</s> too."

children.text: anye kathayanti kiṃ tasya kṛpaṇasyāsti yaḥ śabdāyata iti ||
children.translated_text: Others said, "What does that pauper have, that he should be summoned?"

children.text: tena khalu samayena pūrṇo bahirnirgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: At that time <s>Pūrṇa</s> had gone outside.

children.text: tena śrutaṃ mahāsamudrāt pañca vaṇikchatāni saṃsiddhayānapātrāṇi sūrpārakaṃ nagaramanuprāptānīti ||
children.translated_text: He heard that five hundred merchants with their ships made ready had arrived from the great ocean at the city of <s>Sūrpāraka</s>.

children.text: so 'praviśyaiva nagaraṃ teṣāṃ sakāśamupasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Without even entering the city, he approached them.

children.text: pṛcchati bhavantaḥ kimidaṃ dravyamiti te kathayanti idaṃ cedaṃ ceti ||
children.translated_text: He asked, "Sirs, what is this merchandise?" They said, "It is this and this."

children.text: kiṃ mūlyam te kathayanti sārthavāha dūramapi paramapi gatvā tvameva praṣṭavyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "What is the price?" They said, "Caravan-leader, even if we had gone far, even very far, you yourself would have to be asked."

children.text: yadyapyevaṃ tathāpi ucyatāṃ mūlyam ||
children.translated_text: "Even so, state the price."

children.text: tairaṣṭādaśa suvarṇalakṣā mūlyamupadiṣṭam ||
children.translated_text: They named a price of eighteen lakhs of suvarṇas.

children.text: sa kathayati bhavantastisro lakṣā avadraṃgaṃ gṛhṇīta mamaitat ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Sirs, take three lakhs as a deposit; this is mine."

children.text: paṇyamavaśiṣṭaṃ dāsyāmi ||
children.translated_text: "I will pay the remaining price for the merchandise."

children.text: tathā bhavatu ||
children.translated_text: "So be it."

children.text: tena tisro lakṣā ānāyya dattāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He brought three lakhs and gave them.

children.text: svamudrālakṣitaṃ ca kṛtvā prakrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After marking it with his own seal, he departed.

children.text: tato vaṇiggrāmeṇāvacarakāḥ puruṣāḥ preṣitāḥ paśyata kiṃ dravyamiti ||
children.translated_text: Then the merchants' guild sent out scouts, saying, "See what the merchandise is."

children.text: tairgatvā pṛṣṭāḥ kiṃ dravyam idaṃ cedaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: They went and asked, "What is the merchandise?" "It is this and this."

children.text: asmākamapi pūrṇāni kośakoṣṭhāgārāṇi tiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: "Our treasuries and storehouses also stand full."

children.text: pūrṇāni vā bhavantu mā vā ||
children.translated_text: "Whether they are full or not,

children.text: api vikrītam ||
children.translated_text: has it been sold?"

children.text: kasyāntike pūrṇasya ||
children.translated_text: "To whom?" "To <s>Pūrṇa</s>."

children.text: prabhūtamāsādayiṣyatha pūrṇasyāntikād vikrīya ||
children.translated_text: "Will you realize a great deal by selling it to <s>Pūrṇa</s>?"

children.text: te kathayanti yattenāvadraṅge dattaṃ tad yūyaṃ mūlye 'pi na dāsyatha ||
children.translated_text: They said, "What he gave as a deposit, you would not give even as the price."

children.text: kiṃ tenāvadraṅge dattam tisraḥ suvarṇalakṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "What did he give as a deposit?" "Three lakhs of suvarṇas."

children.text: sumuṣitāstena bhrātaraḥ kṛtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Brothers, they have been thoroughly cheated by him."

children.text: tairāgatya vaṇiggrāmasyārocitam ||
children.translated_text: They returned and reported this to the merchants' guild.

children.text: tatpaṇyaṃ vikrītam ||
children.translated_text: "That merchandise has been sold."

children.text: kasyāntike pūrṇasya ||
children.translated_text: "To whom?" "To <s>Pūrṇa</s>."

children.text: prabhūtamāsādayiṣyanti pūrṇasyāntike vikrīya ||
children.translated_text: "They will obtain a great deal by selling it to <s>Pūrṇa</s>."

children.text: yat tenāvadraṅge dattaṃ tadyūyaṃ mūlye 'pi na dāsyatha ||
children.translated_text: "What he gave as a deposit, you would not give even as the price."

children.text: kiṃ tenāvadraṅge dattam tisraḥ suvarṇalakṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "What did he give as a deposit?" "Three lakhs of suvarṇas."

children.text: sumuṣitāstena te bhrātaraḥ kṛtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "He has thoroughly cheated those brothers."

children.text: sa tairāhūyoktaḥ pūrṇa vaṇiggrāmeṇa kriyākāraḥ kṛtaḥ na kenacidekākinā grahītavyam ||
children.translated_text: He was summoned by them and told, "<s>Pūrṇa</s>, the merchants' guild made an agreement that no one should buy on his own."

children.text: vaṇiggrāma eva grahīṣyatītyeva ||
children.translated_text: "The merchants' guild itself was to buy it."

children.text: kasmātte gṛhītam sa kathayati bhavantaḥ yadā yuṣmābhiḥ kriyākāraḥ kṛtastadā kimahaṃ na śabdito mama bhrātā vā yuṣmābhireva kriyākāraḥ kṛto yūyameva pālayata ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Sirs, when you made the agreement, was I summoned by you, or my brother? You yourselves made the agreement; you yourselves keep it."

children.text: tato vaṇiggrāmeṇa saṃjātāmarṣeṇa ṣaṣṭeḥ kārṣāpaṇānāmarthāyātape dhāritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the merchants' guild, anger having arisen in them, held him in the sun over a matter of sixty kārṣāpaṇas.
