children.text: rājñaḥ pauruṣeyairdṛṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was seen by the king's officers.

children.text: tai rājñe ārocitam ||
children.translated_text: They reported it to the king.

children.text: rājā kathayati bhavantaḥ śabdayataitān ||
children.translated_text: The king said, "Sirs, summon them."

children.text: taiḥ śabditāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They were summoned.

children.text: kathayati rājā bhavantaḥ kasyārthe yuṣmābhiḥ pūrṇa ātape vidhāritas te kathayanti deva vaṇiggrāmeṇa kriyākāraḥ kṛto na kenacidekākinā paṇyaṃ grahītavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: The king said, "Sirs, for what reason have you kept <s>Pūrṇa</s> in the sun?" They said, "Your Majesty, the merchants' guild made an agreement that no one should buy merchandise on his own."

children.text: tadanenaikākinā gṛhītam ||
children.translated_text: "But this man bought it on his own."

children.text: pūrṇaḥ kathayati deva samanuyujyantām yadaibhiḥ kriyākāraḥ kṛtastadā kimahamebhiḥ śabdito mama bhrātā vā te kathayanti deva neti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūrṇa</s> said, "Your Majesty, let them be questioned: when these men made the agreement, was I summoned by them, or my brother?" They said, "Your Majesty, no."

children.text: rājā kathayati bhavantaḥ śobhanaṃ pūrṇaḥ kathayati sa tairvrīḍitairmuktaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The king said, "Sirs, <s>Pūrṇa</s> speaks rightly." Embarrassed, they released him.

children.text: yāvadapareṇa samayena rājñastena dravyeṇa prayojanamutpannam ||
children.translated_text: Then at another time the king had need of that merchandise.

children.text: tena vaṇiggrāma āhūyoktaḥ bhavantaḥ mamāmukena dravyeṇa prayojanam ||
children.translated_text: He summoned the merchants' guild and said, "Sirs, I have need of such-and-such merchandise."

children.text: anuprayacchateti ||
children.translated_text: "Provide it."

children.text: te kathayanti deva pūrṇasyāsti ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Your Majesty, <s>Pūrṇa</s> has it."

children.text: rājā kathayati bhavantaḥ nāhaṃ tasyājñāṃ dadāmi ||
children.translated_text: The king said, "Sirs, I do not give orders to him."

children.text: yūyameva tasyāntikāt krītvānuprayacchata ||
children.translated_text: "You yourselves buy it from him and provide it."

children.text: taiḥ pūrṇasya dūtaḥ preṣitaḥ vaṇiggrāmaḥ śabdayatīti ||
children.translated_text: They sent a messenger to <s>Pūrṇa</s>, saying, "The merchants' guild summons you."

children.text: sa kathayati nāhamāgacchāmi ||
children.translated_text: He said, "I am not coming."

children.text: te vaṇiggrāmāḥ sarva eva sambhūya tasya niveśanaṃ gatvā dvāri sthitvā tairdūtaḥ preṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: All those members of the merchants' guild gathered together, went to his residence, stood at the door, and sent a messenger.

children.text: pūrṇa nirgaccha vaṇiggrāmo dvāri tiṣṭhatīti ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Pūrṇa</s>, come out; the merchants' guild is standing at the door."

children.text: sa sāhaṃkāraḥ kāmakāramadattvā nirgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He came out proudly, without doing as they wished.

children.text: vaṇiggrāmaḥ kathayati sārthavāha yathākrītakaṃ paṇyamanuprayaccha ||
children.translated_text: The merchants' community says, "Caravan leader, hand over the merchandise according to the price at which it was bought."

children.text: sa kathayati ativāṇijako 'ham yadi yathākrītaṃ paṇyamanuprayacchāmīti ||
children.translated_text: He says, "I would be too much of a trader if I handed over the merchandise just at the price at which it was bought."

children.text: te kathayanti sārthavāha dviguṇamūlyena dattam ||
children.translated_text: They say, "Caravan leader, it has been given at double the price."

children.text: pañcadaśa lakṣāṇi teṣāṃ vaṇijāṃ dattamavaśiṣṭaṃ svagṛhaṃ praveśitam ||
children.translated_text: Fifteen lakhs were given to those merchants, and the remainder was brought into his own house.

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati kiṃ śakyamavaśyāyabindunā kumbhaṃ pūrayitum mahāsamudramavatarāmīti ||
children.translated_text: He reflects, "Can a pot be filled by a drop of dew? I shall go down into the great ocean."

children.text: tena sūrpārake nagare ghaṇṭāvaghoṣaṇaṃ kāritam śṛṇvantu bhavantaḥ saurpārakīyā vaṇijaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then in the city of <s>Sūrpāraka</s> he had a bell proclamation made: "Let the merchants of <s>Sūrpāraka</s> hear, good sirs.

children.text: pūrṇaḥ sārthavāho mahāsamudramavatarati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūrṇa</s> the caravan leader is going down into the great ocean.

children.text: yo yuṣmākamutsahate pūrṇena sārthavāhena sārdham aśulkenāgulmenātarapaṇyena mahāsamudramavatartuṃ sa mahāsamudragamanīyaṃ paṇyaṃ samudānayatviti ||
children.translated_text: Whoever among you is able to go down into the great ocean together with <s>Pūrṇa</s> the caravan leader, free of toll, free of customs-post tax, and with untaxed merchandise, let him assemble merchandise suitable for travel on the great ocean."

children.text: pañcamātrairvaṇikśatairmahāsamudragamanīyaṃ paṇyaṃ samudānītam ||
children.translated_text: Merchandise suitable for travel on the great ocean was assembled by five hundred merchants.

children.text: tataḥ pūrṇaḥ sārthavāhaḥ kṛtakutūhalamaṅgalasvastyayanaḥ pañcavaṇikśataparivāro mahāsamudramavatīrṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Pūrṇa</s> the caravan leader, after celebrations, auspicious rites, and blessings had been performed, went down into the great ocean surrounded by five hundred merchants.

children.text: sa saṃsiddhayānapātraśca pratyāgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: And he returned with his vessel successful.

children.text: evam yāvat ṣaṭkṛtvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In this way, up to six times.

children.text: sāmantakena śabdo viśrutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The report became famous throughout the neighboring region.

children.text: pūrṇaḥ ṣaṭkṛtvo mahāsamudramavatīrṇaḥ saṃsiddhayānapātraśca pratyāgata iti ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Pūrṇa</s> has gone down into the great ocean six times and has returned with his vessel successful."

children.text: śrāvasteyā vaṇijaḥ paṇyamādāya sūrpārakaṃ nagaraṃ gatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Merchants from <s>Śrāvastī</s>, taking merchandise, went to the city of <s>Sūrpāraka</s>.

children.text: te mārgaśramaṃ prativinodya yena pūrṇaḥ sārthavāhastenopasaṃkrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: After dispelling the weariness of the road, they approached the place where <s>Pūrṇa</s> the caravan leader was.

children.text: upasaṃkramya kathayanti sārthavāha mahāsamudramavatarāmeti ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, they said, "Caravan leader, let us go down into the great ocean."

children.text: sa kathayati bhavantaḥ asti kaścidyuṣmābhirdṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā ṣaṭkṛtvo mahāsamudrāt saṃsiddhayānapātrāgataḥ saptamaṃ vāramavataran te kathayanti pūrṇa vayaṃ tvāmuddiśya dūrādāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He says, "Good sirs, has anyone been seen or heard of by you who went down into the great ocean six times, came back with his vessel successful, and then went down a seventh time?" They say, "<s>Pūrṇa</s>, we have come from afar with you in mind.

children.text: yadi nāvatarasi tvameva pramāṇamiti ||
children.translated_text: If you do not go down, you alone are the authority."

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati kiṃ cāpyahaṃ dhanenānarthī tathāpyeṣām arthāyāvatarāmīti ||
children.translated_text: He reflects, "Although I have no need of wealth, still I shall go down for their sake."

children.text: sa taiḥ sārdhaṃ mahāsamudraṃ samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He set out with them for the great ocean.

children.text: te rātryāḥ pratyūṣasamaye udānāt pārāyaṇāt satyadṛśaḥ sthaviragāthāḥ śailagāthā munigāthā arthavargīyāṇi ca sūtrāṇi vistareṇa svareṇa svādhyāyaṃ kurvanti ||
children.translated_text: At the daybreak time of night, they recited in full voice from the <s>Udāna</s>, the <s>Pārāyaṇa</s>, the verses of <s>Satyadṛśa</s> the elder, the <s>Śaila</s> verses, the <s>Muni</s> verses, and the sūtras belonging to the <s>Arthavarga</s>.

children.text: tena te śrutāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He heard them.

children.text: sa kathayati bhavantaḥ śobhanāni gītāni gāyatha ||
children.translated_text: He says, "Good sirs, you are singing beautiful songs."

children.text: te kathayanti sārthavāha naitāni gītāni kiṃtu khalvetadbuddhavacanam ||
children.translated_text: They say, "Caravan leader, these are not songs; rather, this is the word of the Buddha."

children.text: sa buddha ityaśrutapūrvaṃ śabdaṃ śrutvā sarvaromakūpāni āhṛṣṭāni ||
children.translated_text: Hearing the word "Buddha," which he had never heard before, all the pores of his body thrilled.

children.text: sa ādarajātaḥ pṛcchati bhavantaḥ ko 'yaṃ buddhanāmeti ||
children.translated_text: Filled with reverence, he asks, "Good sirs, who is this one named Buddha?"

children.text: te kathayanti asti śramaṇo gautamaḥ śākyaputraḥ śākyakulātkeśaśmaśrūṇyavatārya kāṣāyāṇi vastrāṇi ācchādya samyageva śraddhayā agārādanagārikāṃ pravrajitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say, "There is the ascetic <s>Gautama</s>, son of the <s>Śākyas</s>; from the <s>Śākya</s> clan he cut off his hair and beard, put on saffron robes, and with right faith went forth from the household into homelessness.

children.text: so 'nuttarāṃ samyaksambodhimabhisaṃbuddhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He has awakened to unsurpassed complete and perfect awakening.

children.text: sa eṣa sārthavāha buddho nāma ||
children.translated_text: This one, caravan leader, is called the Buddha."

children.text: kutra bhavantaḥ sa bhagavānetarhi viharati sārthavāha śrāvastyāṃ jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme ||
children.translated_text: "Good sirs, where is that Blessed One dwelling now?" "Caravan leader, in <s>Śrāvastī</s>, in <s>Jetavana</s>, in the park of <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>."

children.text: sa taṃ hṛdi kṛtvā taiḥ sārdhaṃ mahāsamudramavatīrṇaḥ saṃsiddhayānapātraśca pratyāgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Holding him in his heart, he went down into the great ocean with them and returned with his vessel successful.

children.text: bhrātāsya bhavilaḥ saṃlakṣayati parikhinno 'yaṃ mahāsamudragamanena niveśo 'sya kartavya iti ||
children.translated_text: His brother <s>Bhavila</s> reflects, "He is worn out by travel on the great ocean; a household must be arranged for him."

children.text: sa tenoktaḥ bhrātaḥ kathaya katarasya dhaninaḥ sārthavāhasya vā tavārthāya duhitaraṃ prārthayāmīti ||
children.translated_text: He said to him, "Brother, tell me: for your sake, the daughter of which wealthy man or caravan leader shall I ask for in marriage?"

children.text: sa kathayati nāhaṃ kāmairarthī ||
children.translated_text: He says, "I have no need of sensual pleasures.

children.text: yadyanujānāsi pravrajāmīti ||
children.translated_text: If you permit it, I shall go forth."

children.text: sa kathayati yadāsmākaṃ gṛhe vārtā nāsti tadā na pravrajitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He says, "When there was no prosperity in our house, then you did not go forth.

children.text: idānīṃ kāmārthaṃ pravrajasi ||
children.translated_text: Now you are going forth for the sake of desire."

children.text: pūrṇaḥ kathayati bhrātaḥ tadānīṃ na śobhate idānīṃ tu yuktam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūrṇa</s> says, "Brother, at that time it was not fitting; but now it is proper."

children.text: sa tenāvaśyaṃ nirbandhaṃ jñātvānujñātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Knowing his insistence to be unavoidable, he was granted permission by him.

children.text: sa kathayati bhrātaḥ mahāsamudro bahvādīnavo 'lpāsvādaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He says, "Brother, the great ocean has many dangers and little enjoyment.

children.text: bahavo 'vataranti alpā vyuttiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: Many go down into it; few come out.

children.text: sarvathā na tvayā mahāsamudramavatartavyam ||
children.translated_text: By all means, you must not go down into the great ocean.

children.text: nyāyopārjitaṃ te prabhūtaṃ dhanamasti eṣāṃ tu tava bhrātṝṇām anyāyopārjitam ||
children.translated_text: You have abundant wealth acquired by right means; but the wealth of these brothers of yours has been acquired by wrong means.

children.text: yadyete kathayanti ekadhye vasāmeti na vastavyam ||
children.translated_text: If they say, 'Let us live together in one place,' you must not live with them."

children.text: ityuktvopasthāyakamādāya śrāvastīṃ samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having said this, he took an attendant and set out for <s>Śrāvastī</s>.

children.text: anupūrveṇa śrāvastīmanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In due course he reached <s>Śrāvastī</s>.

children.text: śrāvastyāmudyāne sthitena anāthapiṇḍadasya gṛhapaterdūto 'nupreṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: While staying in a park at <s>Śrāvastī</s>, he sent a messenger to the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>.

children.text: tena gatvā anāthapiṇḍadasya gṛhapaterārocitam gṛhapate pūrṇaḥ sārthavāha udyāne tiṣṭhati gṛhapatiṃ draṣṭukāma iti ||
children.translated_text: The messenger went and reported to the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>, "Householder, <s>Pūrṇa</s> the caravan leader is staying in the park and wishes to see the householder."

children.text: anāthapiṇḍado gṛhapatiḥ saṃlakṣayati nūnaṃ jalayānena khinna idānīṃ sthalayānenāgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: The householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> reflects, "Surely, tired by travel on water, he has now come by land vehicle."

children.text: tataḥ pṛcchati bhoḥ puruṣa kiyatprabhūtaṃ paṇyamānītam ||
children.translated_text: Then he asks, "Man, how much merchandise has been brought?"

children.text: sa kathayati kuto 'sya paṇyam upasthāyakadvitīyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He says, "Where is his merchandise, when he has only an attendant as his companion?"

children.text: sa cāhaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: "It is he himself, and I."

children.text: anāthapiṇḍadaḥ saṃlakṣayati na mama pratirūpam yadahaṃ pradhānapuruṣamasatkāreṇa praveśayeyamiti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> thinks, "It would not be fitting for me to bring such an eminent man in without honor."

children.text: sa tena mahatā satkāreṇa praveśita udvartitaḥ snāpito bhojitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: So he was brought in with great honor, anointed, bathed, and fed.

children.text: svairālāpeṇāvasthitayoranāthapiṇḍadaḥ pṛcchati sārthavāha kimāgamanaprayojanam apūrveṇa gṛhapate icchāmi svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajyāmupasampadaṃ bhikṣubhāvamiti ||
children.translated_text: When they were sitting at ease in private conversation, <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> asked, "Caravan leader, what is the purpose of your coming?" "Householder, it is something unprecedented: I wish for going forth, ordination, and the state of a monk in the well-proclaimed <s>dharmavinaya</s> (teaching and discipline)."

children.text: tato 'nāthapiṇḍado gṛhapatiḥ pūrvaṃ kāyamabhyunnamayya dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ prasāryodānamudānayati ||
children.translated_text: Then the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> raised his body forward, stretched out his right arm, and uttered an inspired utterance:

children.text: aho buddhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Ah, the Buddha!

children.text: aho dharmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Ah, the dharma!

children.text: aho saṃghasya svākhyātatā ||
children.translated_text: Ah, how well proclaimed is the <s>saṃgha</s>!

children.text: yatredānīmīdṛśāḥ pradhānapuruṣā vistīrṇasvajanabandhuvargamapahāya sphītāni ca kośakoṣṭhāgārāṇi ākāṅkṣanti svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajyāmupasampadaṃ bhikṣubhāvamiti ||
children.translated_text: For now even eminent men such as this, leaving behind an extensive circle of kinsmen and relatives and abundant treasuries and granaries, long for going forth, ordination, and the state of a monk in the well-proclaimed <s>dharmavinaya</s>."

children.text: tato 'nāthapiṇḍado gṛhapatiḥ pūrṇaṃ sārthavāhamādāya yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>, taking <s>Pūrṇa</s> the caravan leader with him, approached the place where the Blessed One was.

children.text: tena khalu samayena bhagavānanekaśatāyā bhikṣupariṣadaḥ purastānniṣaṇṇo dharmaṃ deśayati ||
children.translated_text: At that time the Blessed One was seated before an assembly of many hundreds of monks, teaching the dharma.

children.text: adrākṣīd bhagavānanāthapiṇḍadaṃ gṛhapatiṃ saprābhṛtamāgacchantam ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One saw the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> coming with a gift.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā ca punarbhikṣūnāmantrayate sma eṣa bhikṣavo 'nāthapiṇḍado gṛhapatiḥ saprābhṛta āgacchati ||
children.translated_text: Having seen him, he addressed the monks: "Monks, this householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> is coming with a gift.

children.text: nāsti tathāgatasyaivaṃvidhaḥ prābhṛto yathā vaineyaprābhṛta iti ||
children.translated_text: For the <s>Tathāgata</s> there is no gift of this kind like the gift of a person to be trained."

children.text: tato 'nāthapiṇḍado gṛhapatirbhagavataḥ pādābhivandanaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇena sārthavāhena sārdhamekānte niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>, having bowed at the Blessed One's feet, sat down to one side together with <s>Pūrṇa</s> the caravan leader.

children.text: ekāntaniṣaṇṇo 'nāthapiṇḍado gṛhapatirbhagavantamidamavocat ayaṃ bhadanta pūrṇaḥ sārthavāha ākāṅkṣati svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajyāmupasampadaṃ bhikṣubhāvam ||
children.translated_text: Sitting to one side, the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Venerable sir, this <s>Pūrṇa</s> the caravan leader longs for going forth, ordination, and the state of a monk in the well-proclaimed <s>dharmavinaya</s>.

children.text: taṃ bhagavān pravrājayatu upasaṃpādayed anukampāmupādāyeti ||
children.translated_text: Let the Blessed One make him go forth and ordain him, out of compassion."

children.text: adhivāsayati bhagavānanāthapiṇḍadasya gṛhapatestūṣṇībhāvena ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One consented to the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> by silence.

children.text: tato bhagavān pūrṇaṃ sārthavāhamāmantrayate ehi bhikṣo cara brahmacaryamiti ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One addressed <s>Pūrṇa</s> the caravan leader: "Come, monk; practice the holy life."

children.text: sa bhagavato vācāvasāne muṇḍaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ saṃghāṭiprāvṛtaḥ pātrakarakavyagrahastaḥ saptāhāvaropitakeśaśmaśrur varṣaśatopasaṃpannasya bhikṣorīryāpathenāvasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At the conclusion of the Blessed One's words he became shaven-headed, clothed in the <s>saṃghāṭī</s> robe, his hands occupied with bowl and water-pot, his hair and beard as if removed seven days before, standing with the bearing of a monk ordained for a hundred years.

children.text: ehīti coktaḥ sa tathāgatena muṇḍaśca saṃghāṭiparītadehaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And when the <s>Tathāgata</s> had said to him, "Come," he was shaven, his body wrapped in the <s>saṃghāṭī</s> robe.

children.text: sadyaḥ praśāntendriya eva tasthau evaṃ sthito buddhamanorathena ||
children.translated_text: At once he stood with his faculties calmed, established in this way by the Buddha's intention.

children.text: athāpareṇa samayenāyuṣmān pūrṇo yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then at another time the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> approached the place where the Blessed One was.

children.text: upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvaikānte 'sthāt ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, he bowed his head at the Blessed One's feet and stood to one side.

children.text: ekānte sthita āyuṣmān pūrṇo bhagavantamidamavocat sādhu me bhagavāṃstathā saṃkṣiptena dharmaṃ deśayatu yathāhaṃ bhagavato 'ntikāt saṃkṣiptena dharmaṃ śrutvaiko vyapakṛṣṭo 'pramatta ātāpī prahitātmā vihareyam ||
children.translated_text: Standing to one side, the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Good, Blessed One, please teach me the dharma in brief, so that, after hearing the dharma in brief in the Blessed One's presence, I may dwell alone, withdrawn, heedful, ardent, and resolute."

children.text: yadarthaṃ kulaputrāḥ keśaśmaśrūṇi avatārya kāṣāyāṇi vastrāṇi ācchādya samyageva śraddhayā agārādanagārikāṃ pravrajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacaryaparyavasānaṃ dṛṣṭadharme svayamabhijñāya sākṣātkṛtvopasaṃpadya pravrajayeyam kṣīṇā me jātir uṣitaṃ brahmacaryaṃ kṛtaṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparamasmādbhavaṃ prajānāmīti ||
children.translated_text: "That purpose for which sons of good family cut off their hair and beard, put on saffron robes, and with true faith rightly go forth from the household into homelessness: having directly known, realized, attained, and entered in this very life that unsurpassed culmination of the holy life, may I declare, 'Birth is exhausted for me; the holy life has been lived; what had to be done has been done; I know no further existence after this.'"

children.text: evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ pūrṇamidamavocat sādhu pūrṇa sādhu khalu tvaṃ pūrṇa yastvamevaṃ vadasi sādhu me bhagavāṃstathā saṃkṣiptena dharmaṃ deśayatu pūrvavadyāvannāparamasmād bhavaṃ prajānāmīti ||
children.translated_text: When this was said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>: "Good, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, good indeed, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, that you speak thus: 'Good, Blessed One, please teach me the dharma in brief,' and so on as before, up to, 'I know no further existence after this.'

children.text: tena hi pūrṇa śṛṇu sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca manasi kuru bhāṣiṣye ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, listen, and attend carefully and well; I shall speak."

children.text: santi pūrṇa cakṣurvijñeyāni rūpāṇīṣṭakāni kāntāni priyāṇi manaāpāni kāmopasaṃhitāni rañjanīyāni ||
children.translated_text: "There are, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, forms cognizable by the eye that are desired, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, attractive, connected with sensual pleasure, and enticing.

children.text: tāni cedbhikṣurdṛṣṭvābhinandati abhivadatyadhyavasyati adhyavasāya tiṣṭhati tāni abhinandato 'bhivadato 'dhyavasyato 'dhyavasāya tiṣṭhata ānandī bhavati ||
children.translated_text: If, having seen them, a monk delights in them, welcomes them, settles upon them, and remains fixed upon them, then for one who delights in them, welcomes them, settles upon them, and remains fixed upon them, there is delight.

children.text: ānandyā nandīsaumanasyaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: From delight there comes delighted gladness.

children.text: nandīsaumanasye sati sarāgo bhavati ||
children.translated_text: When delighted gladness is present, he is possessed of passion.

children.text: nandīsarāge sati nandīsarāgasaṃyojanaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: When delight and passion are present, there is the fetter of delight and passion.

children.text: nandīsarāgasaṃyojanasaṃyuktaḥ pūrṇa bhikṣurārānnirvāṇasyocyate ||
children.translated_text: A monk joined to the fetter of delight and passion, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, is said to be far from <s>nirvāṇa</s>.

children.text: santi pūrṇa śrotravijñeyāḥ śabdāḥ ghrāṇavijñeyā gandhāḥ jihvāvijñeyā rasāḥ kāyavijñeyāni spraṣṭavyāni manovijñeyā dharmā iṣṭāḥ kāntāḥ priyā manaāpāḥ kāmopasaṃhitā rañjanīyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: There are, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, sounds cognizable by the ear, odors cognizable by the nose, tastes cognizable by the tongue, tangibles cognizable by the body, and mental objects cognizable by the mind that are desired, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, attractive, connected with sensual pleasure, and enticing.

children.text: tāṃśca bhikṣurdṛṣṭvā pūrvavad yāvadārānnirvāṇasyeti ucyate ||
children.translated_text: And if, having perceived them, a monk acts as before, up to, he is said to be far from <s>nirvāṇa</s>.

children.text: santi tu pūrṇa cakṣurvijñeyāni rūpāṇi iṣṭāni kāntāni priyāṇi manaāpāni pūrvavad yāvat śuklapakṣeṇāntike nirvāṇasyeti ucyate ||
children.translated_text: But there are, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, forms knowable by eye-consciousness that are wished for, desired, dear, agreeable; as before, up to: one is said to be near nirvāṇa by the bright side.

children.text: anena tvaṃ pūrṇa mayā saṃkṣiptenāvavādena coditaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By this brief instruction, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, you have been exhorted by me.

children.text: kutrecchasi vastuṃ kutrecchasi vāsaṃ kalpayitum anenāhaṃ bhadanta bhagavatā saṃkṣiptenāvavādena codita icchāmi śroṇāparāntakeṣu janapadeṣu vastuṃ śroṇāparāntakeṣu janapadeṣu vāsaṃ kalpayitum ||
children.translated_text: "Where do you wish to dwell? Where do you wish to establish a residence?" He said, "Venerable sir, I have been exhorted by the Blessed One with this brief instruction. I wish to dwell in the districts of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s>; in the districts of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> I wish to establish a residence."

children.text: caṇḍāḥ pūrṇa śroṇāparāntikā manuṣyā rabhasāḥ karkaśā ākrośakā roṣakāḥ paribhāṣakāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Pūrṇa</s>, the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> are fierce, violent, harsh, abusive, angry, and insulting.

children.text: sacet tvāṃ pūrṇa śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ saṃmukhaṃ pāpikayā asatyayā paruṣayā vācā ākrokṣyanti roṣayiṣyanti paribhāṣiṣyante tasya te kathaṃ bhaviṣyati sacenmāṃ bhadanta śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ saṃmukhaṃ pāpikayā asatyayā paruṣayā vācā ākrokṣyanti roṣayiṣyanti paribhāṣiṣyante tasya mamaivaṃ bhaviṣyati bhadrakā bata śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ snigdhakā bata śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ ye māṃ saṃmukhaṃ pāpikayā asatyayā paruṣayā vācā ākrośanti roṣayanti paribhāṣante ||
children.translated_text: If, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> abuse you to your face with wicked, false, harsh speech, anger you, and insult you, how will it be for you?" "Venerable sir, if the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> abuse me to my face with wicked, false, harsh speech, anger me, and insult me, it will occur to me thus: 'Good indeed are the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s>; affectionate indeed are the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s>, since they abuse me, anger me, and insult me to my face with wicked, false, harsh speech.

children.text: no tu pāṇinā vā loṣṭena vā praharantīti ||
children.translated_text: But they do not strike me with a hand or with a clod.'"

children.text: caṇḍāḥ pūrṇa śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ pūrvavat yāvat paribhāṣakāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Pūrṇa</s>, the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> are fierce, as before, up to: insulting.

children.text: sacet tvāṃ pūrṇa śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ pāṇinā vā loṣṭena vā prahariṣyanti tasya te kathaṃ bhaviṣyati sacenmāṃ bhadanta śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ pāṇinā vā loṣṭena vā prahariṣyanti tasya mamaivaṃ bhaviṣyati bhadrakā bata śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ snehakā bata śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ ye māṃ pāṇinā vā loṣṭena vā praharanti no tu daṇḍena vā śastreṇa vā praharantīti ||
children.translated_text: If, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> strike you with a hand or with a clod, how will it be for you?" "Venerable sir, if the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> strike me with a hand or with a clod, it will occur to me thus: 'Good indeed are the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s>; affectionate indeed are the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s>, since they strike me with a hand or with a clod. But they do not strike me with a stick or with a weapon.'"

children.text: caṇḍāḥ pūrṇa śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ pūrvavad yāvat paribhāṣakāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Pūrṇa</s>, the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> are fierce, as before, up to: insulting.

children.text: sacet tvāṃ pūrṇa śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyā daṇḍena vā śastreṇa vā prahariṣyanti tasya te kathaṃ bhaviṣyati sacenmāṃ bhadanta śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyā daṇḍena vā śastreṇa vā prahariṣyanti tasya mamaivaṃ bhaviṣyati bhadrakā bata śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ snehakā bata śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ ye māṃ daṇḍena vā śastreṇa vā praharanti no tu sarveṇa sarvaṃ jīvitād vyaparopayanti ||
children.translated_text: If, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> strike you with a stick or with a weapon, how will it be for you?" "Venerable sir, if the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> strike me with a stick or with a weapon, it will occur to me thus: 'Good indeed are the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s>; affectionate indeed are the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s>, since they strike me with a stick or with a weapon. But they do not deprive me of life altogether.'"

children.text: caṇḍāḥ pūrṇa śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyā yāvat paribhāṣakāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Pūrṇa</s>, the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> are fierce, up to: insulting.

children.text: sacet tvāṃ pūrṇa śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ sarveṇa sarvaṃ jīvitād vyaparopayiṣyanti tasya te kathaṃ bhaviṣyati sacenmāṃ bhadanta śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ sarveṇa sarvaṃ jīvitād vyaparopayiṣyanti tasya me evaṃ bhaviṣyati santi bhagavataḥ śrāvakā ye anena pūtikāyenārdīyamānā jehrīyante vijugupsamānāḥ śastramapi ādhārayanti viṣamapi bhikṣayanti rajjvā baddhā api mriyante prapātādapi prapatantyapi ||
children.translated_text: If, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> altogether deprive you of life, how will it be for you?" "Venerable sir, if the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> altogether deprive me of life, it will occur to me thus: 'There are disciples of the Blessed One who, tormented by this foul body, ashamed of it and disgusted with it, even take up a weapon, even ask for poison, even die by a rope, and even fall from a precipice.

children.text: bhadrakā bata śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyakāḥ snehakā bata śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyāḥ ye māmasmāt pūtikalevarādalpakṛcchreṇa parimocayantīti ||
children.translated_text: Good indeed are the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s>; affectionate indeed are the people of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s>, since with little hardship they release me from this putrid corpse.'"

children.text: sādhu sādhu pūrṇa śakyastvaṃ pūrṇa anena kṣāntisaurabhyena samanvāgataḥ śroṇāparāntakeṣu janapadeṣu vastuṃ śroṇāparāntakeṣu vāsaṃ kalpayitum ||
children.translated_text: "Good, good, <s>Pūrṇa</s>. <s>Pūrṇa</s>, endowed with this fragrance of patience, you are able to dwell in the districts of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> and to establish a residence in <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s>.

children.text: gaccha tvaṃ pūrṇa mukto mocaya tīrṇastāraya āśvasta āśvāsaya parinirvṛtaḥ parinirvāpayeti ||
children.translated_text: Go, <s>Pūrṇa</s>: freed, free others; crossed over, make others cross; comforted, comfort others; having attained final nirvāṇa, bring others to final nirvāṇa."

children.text: athāyuṣmān pūrṇo bhagavato bhāṣitamabhinandyānumodya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavato 'ntikāt prakrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>, rejoicing in and approving the Blessed One's speech, bowed with his head at the Blessed One's feet and departed from the Blessed One's presence.

children.text: athāyuṣmān pūrṇastasyā eva rātreratyayāt pūrvāhṇe nivāsya pātracīvaramādāya śrāvastīṃ piṇḍāya prāvikṣat ||
children.translated_text: Then, when that very night had passed, in the forenoon the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> dressed, took his bowl and robe, and entered <s>Śrāvastī</s> for alms.

children.text: śrāvastīṃ piṇḍāya caritvā kṛtabhaktakṛtyaḥ paścādbhaktapiṇḍapātraḥ pratikrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having walked for alms in <s>Śrāvastī</s>, having completed the business of the meal, after the meal he returned with his alms-bowl.

children.text: yathāparibhuktaśayanāsanaṃ pratisamayya samādāya pātracīvaram yena śroṇāparāntakā janapadāstena cārikāṃ carañ śroṇāparāntakāñ janapadānanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He put away and arranged the bedding and seat he had used, took his bowl and robe, and, traveling on tour toward the districts of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s>, arrived in the districts of <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s>.

children.text: athāyuṣmān pūrṇaḥ pūrvāhṇe nivāsya pātracīvaramādāya śroṇāparāntakaṃ piṇḍāya prāvikṣat ||
children.translated_text: Then in the forenoon the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> dressed, took his bowl and robe, and entered <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> for alms.

children.text: anyatamaśca lubdhako dhanuṣpāṇirmṛgayāṃ nirgacchati ||
children.translated_text: And a certain hunter, bow in hand, was going out to hunt.

children.text: tena dṛṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was seen by him.

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati amaṅgalo 'yaṃ muṇḍakaḥ śramaṇako mayā dṛṣṭa iti viditvā ā karṇād dhanuḥ pūrayitvā yenāyuṣmān pūrṇastena pradhāvitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He thought, "This shaven-headed little ascetic whom I have seen is inauspicious." Having decided this, he drew his bow up to his ear and ran toward the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>.

children.text: sa āyuṣmatā pūrṇena dṛṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was seen by the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā cottarāsaṅgaṃ vivartya kathayati bhadramukha asya duṣpūrasyārthe praviśāmi atra prahareti ||
children.translated_text: And seeing him, he turned aside his upper robe and said, "Good sir, for the sake of this hard-to-fill one I enter here; strike!"

children.text: gāthāṃ ca bhāṣate ||
children.translated_text: And he recites a verse:

children.text: yasyārthe gahane caranti vihagā gacchanti bandhaṃ mṛgāḥ saṃgrāme śaraśaktitomaradharā naśyantyajasraṃ narāḥ
children.translated_text: "For its sake birds wander in thickets, deer go into captivity, and men bearing arrows, spears, and lances perish constantly in battle;

children.text: dīnā durdinacāriṇaśca kṛpaṇā matsyā grasantyāyasam asyārthe udarasya pāpakalile dūrādihābhyāgataḥ iti ||
children.translated_text: wretched, poor fish moving in bad weather swallow iron. For the sake of this belly, foul with evil, I have come here from afar."

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati ayaṃ pravrajita īdṛśena kṣāntisaurabhyena samanvāgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He reflects, "This renunciant is endowed with such a fragrance of patience.

children.text: kimasya praharāmīti matvā abhiprasannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Why should I strike him?" Thinking this, he became deeply pleased.

children.text: tato 'syāyuṣmatā pūrṇena dharmo deśitaḥ śaraṇagamanaśikṣāpadeśeṣu ca pratiṣṭhāpitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Dharma was taught to him by the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>, and he was established in going for refuge and in the training precepts.

children.text: anyāni ca pañcopāsakaśatāni kṛtāni pañcopāsikāśatāni ||
children.translated_text: And another five hundred male lay followers and five hundred female lay followers were made.

children.text: pañcavihāraśatāni kāritāni anekāni ca mañcapīṭhavṛṣikoccakabimbopadhānacaturasrakaśatāni anupradāpitāni ||
children.translated_text: Five hundred monasteries were caused to be built, and many hundreds of beds, seats, mats, cushions, pillows, and square covers were provided.

children.text: tasyaiva ca trimāsasyātyayāt tisro vidyāḥ kāyena sākṣātkṛtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: And at the passing of those very three months, the three knowledges were realized directly by him.

children.text: arhan saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He became an arhat.

children.text: traidhātukavītarāgo yāvat sendropendrāṇāṃ devānāṃ pūjyo mānyo 'bhivādyaśca saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Free from passion for the three realms, he became worthy of worship, honor, and salutation by the gods, including <s>Indra</s> and <s>Upendra</s>.

children.text: yāvadapareṇa samayena dārukarṇibhrātrorbhogāstanutvaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then at another time the wealth of <s>Dārukarṇī</s> and his brother became diminished, exhausted, and used up.

children.text: tau kathayataḥ gato 'sau asmākaṃ gṛhāt kālakarṇiprakhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They said, "That one, resembling ill fortune, has gone from our house.

children.text: āgaccha ekadhye prativasāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come, let us live together in one place."

children.text: sa kathayati kataro 'sau kālakarṇiprakhyaḥ tau kathayataḥ pūrṇakaśrīḥ ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Who is that one resembling ill fortune?" They said, "<s>Pūrṇakaśrī</s>."

children.text: sā mama gṛhānniṣkrāntā ||
children.translated_text: "She has gone out from my house.

children.text: nāsau kālakarṇiprakhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: She is not one resembling ill fortune."

children.text: tau kathayataḥ śrīrvā bhavatu kālakarṇī vā āgaccha ekadhye prativasāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Whether she is fortune or ill fortune, come, let us live together in one place."

children.text: sa kathayati yuvayoranyāyopārjitaṃ dhanam mama nyāyopārjitam ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Your wealth was acquired unjustly; mine was acquired justly.

children.text: nāham yuvābhyāṃ sārdhamekadhye vāsaṃ kalpayāmīti ||
children.translated_text: I will not arrange to live together in one place with you two."

children.text: tau kathayataḥ tena dāsīputreṇa mahāsamudramavatīryāvatīrya bhogāḥ samudānītā yena tvaṃ bhuñjāno vikatthase ||
children.translated_text: They said, "By that slave-woman's son, after he went down again and again into the great ocean, wealth was gathered, because of which you boast while enjoying it.

children.text: kutastava sāmarthyaṃ mahāsamudramavatartumiti ||
children.translated_text: How could you have the ability to go down into the great ocean?"

children.text: sa tābhyāṃ mānaṃ grāhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They caused him to take pride.

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati ahamapi mahāsamudramavatarāmi ||
children.translated_text: He reflects, "I too will go down into the great ocean."

children.text: pūrvavat yāvanmahāsamudramavatīrṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As before, up to the point that he went down into the great ocean.

children.text: yāvattadvahanaṃ vāyunā gośīrṣacandanavanam anupreritam ||
children.translated_text: Then that vessel was driven by the wind to the gośīrṣa sandalwood forest.

children.text: karṇadhāraḥ kathayati bhavantaḥ yattat śrūyate gośīrṣacandanavanamiti idaṃ tat ||
children.translated_text: The helmsman said, "Good sirs, that which is heard of as the gośīrṣa sandalwood forest: this is it.

children.text: gṛhṇantu atra yatsāramiti ||
children.translated_text: Take here whatever is heartwood."

children.text: tena khalu samayena gośīrṣacandanavanaṃ maheśvarasya yakṣasya parigraho 'bhūt ||
children.translated_text: Now at that time the gośīrṣa sandalwood forest was the possession of the yakṣa <s>Maheśvara</s>.

children.text: sa ca yakṣāṇām yakṣasamitiṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: And he had gone to a gathering of yakṣas.

children.text: tato gośīrṣacandanavane pañcamātrāṇi kuṭhāraśatāni voḍhumārabdhāni ||
children.translated_text: Then in the gośīrṣa sandalwood forest some five hundred axes began to be plied.

children.text: adrākṣīdapriyākhyo yo yakṣo gośīrṣacandanavane pañcamātrāṇi kuṭhāraśatāni vahataḥ ||
children.translated_text: A yakṣa named <s>Apriya</s> saw some five hundred axes being plied in the gośīrṣa sandalwood forest.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā ca yena maheśvaro yakṣaḥ tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having seen this, he approached the place where the yakṣa <s>Maheśvara</s> was.

children.text: upasaṃkramya maheśvaram yakṣamidamavocat yat khalu grāmaṇīrjānīyā gośīrṣacandanavane pañcamātrāṇi kuṭhāraśatāni vahanti ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, he said this to the yakṣa <s>Maheśvara</s>: "Let the chief know that some five hundred axes are being plied in the gośīrṣa sandalwood forest.

children.text: yatte kṛtyaṃ vā karaṇīyaṃ vā tatkuruṣveti ||
children.translated_text: Whatever is your business or duty, do that."

children.text: atha maheśvaro yakṣo yakṣāṇāṃ samitimasamitiṃ kṛtvā saṃjātāmarṣo mahāntaṃ kālikāvātabhayaṃ saṃjanya yena gośīrṣacandanavanaṃ tena samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the yakṣa <s>Maheśvara</s>, breaking up the assembly of yakṣas and filled with anger, produced a great danger of a black storm-wind and set out toward the gośīrṣa sandalwood forest.

children.text: karṇadhāreṇārocitam śṛṇvantu bhavanto jāmbudvīpakā vaṇijaḥ yattat śrūyate mahākālikāvātabhayamiti idaṃ tat ||
children.translated_text: The helmsman announced, "Listen, merchants of <s>Jambudvīpa</s>: that which is heard of as the danger of a great black storm-wind, this is it.

children.text: kiṃ manyadhvamiti tataste vaṇijo bhītāstrastāḥ saṃvignā āhṛṣṭaromakūpā devatāyācanaṃ kartumārabdhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: What do you think?" Then those merchants, frightened, terrified, distressed, with the pores of their bodies bristling, began to make supplication to the deities.

children.text: śivavaruṇakuberaśakrabrahmādyāsuramanujoragayakṣadānavendrāḥ vyasanamatibhayaṃ vayaṃ prapannā vigatabhayā hi bhavantu no 'dya nāthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "O <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Kubera</s>, <s>Śakra</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, and foremost ones among asuras, men, serpents, yakṣas, and dānavas, we have fallen into a disaster of excessive fear; let our protectors today make us free from fear.

children.text: kecinnamasyanti śacīpatiṃ narā brahmāṇamanye hariśaṃkarāvapi ||
children.translated_text: Some men bow to the lord of <s>Śacī</s>, others to <s>Brahmā</s>, and also to <s>Hari</s> and <s>Śaṃkara</s>.

children.text: bhūmyāśritān vṛkṣavanāśritāṃśca trāṇārthino vātapiśācadasthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeking protection, they appeal to those abiding on the earth and those abiding in trees and forests, while afflicted by demons of the wind."

children.text: dārukarṇī alpotsukastiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dārukarṇī</s> stood with little concern.

children.text: vaṇijaḥ kathayanti sārthavāha vayaṃ kṛcchrasaṃkaṭasambādhaprāptāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The merchants said, "Caravan leader, we have fallen into a difficult, narrow, and oppressive strait.

children.text: kimarthamalpotsukastiṣṭhasīti sa kathayati bhavantaḥ ahaṃ bhrātrā abhihitaḥ mahāsamudro 'lpāsvādo bahvādīnavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Why do you stand with little concern?" He said, "Good sirs, I was told by my brother, 'The great ocean has little enjoyment and many dangers.

children.text: tṛṣṇāndhā bahavo 'vataranti svalpā vyutthāsyanti ||
children.translated_text: Many, blinded by craving, go down into it; few will come back up.

children.text: na tvayā kenacit prakāreṇa mahāsamudramavatartavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: By no means are you to go down into the great ocean.'

children.text: so 'haṃ tasya vacanamavacanaṃ kṛtvā mahāsamudramavatīrṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: But I, making his words as if they were not words, went down into the great ocean.

children.text: kimidānīṃ karomi kastava bhrātā pūrṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: What shall I do now?" "Who is your brother?" "<s>Pūrṇa</s>."

children.text: vaṇijaḥ kathayanti bhavantaḥ sa evāryapūrṇaḥ puṇyamaheśākhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The merchants said, "Good sirs, that very one is the noble <s>Pūrṇa</s>, renowned for great merit.

children.text: tameva śaraṇaṃ prapadyāma iti ||
children.translated_text: Let us go to him alone for refuge."

children.text: tairekasvareṇa sarvairevaṃ nādo muktaḥ namastasmai āryāya pūrṇāya namo namastasmai āryāya pūrṇāyeti ||
children.translated_text: With one voice all of them uttered this cry: "Homage to that noble <s>Pūrṇa</s>, homage, homage to that noble <s>Pūrṇa</s>."

children.text: atha yā devatā āyuṣmatī pūrṇe 'bhiprasannā sā yenāyuṣmān pūrṇastenopasaṃkrāntā ||
children.translated_text: Then the deity who was well disposed toward the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> approached the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>.

children.text: upasaṃkramya āyuṣmantaṃ pūrṇamidamavocat ārya bhrātā te kṛcchrasaṃkaṭasambādhaprāptaḥ samanvāhareti ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, she said this to the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>: "Noble one, your brother has fallen into a difficult, narrow, and perilous strait. Attend to him."

children.text: tena samanvāhṛtam ||
children.translated_text: He attended to him.

children.text: tata āyuṣmān pūrṇastadrūpaṃ samādhiṃ samāpanno yathā samāhite citte śroṇāparāntake 'ntarhito mahāsamudre vahanasīmāyāṃ paryaṅkaṃ baddhvā avasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> entered such a samādhi that, while his mind was concentrated, he disappeared from <s>Śroṇāparāntaka</s> and appeared seated cross-legged at the boundary of the ship in the great ocean.

children.text: tato 'sau kālikāvātaḥ sumerupratyāhata iva pratinivṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then that black storm-wind turned back, as if struck by <s>Sumeru</s>.

children.text: atha maheśvaro yakṣaḥ saṃlakṣayati pūrvam yat kiṃcidvahanaṃ kālikāvātena spṛśyate tattūlapicuvat kṣipyate viśīryate ca ||
children.translated_text: Then the yakṣa <s>Maheśvara</s> considered: "Formerly, whatever ship was touched by the black storm-wind was tossed about like a tuft of cotton and shattered.

children.text: idānīṃ ko yogo yena kālikāvātaḥ sumerupratyāhata iva pratinivṛttaḥ sa itaścāmutaśca pratyavekṣitumārabdho yāvat paśyati āyuṣmantaṃ pūrṇaṃ vahanasīmāyāṃ paryaṅkaṃ baddhvāvasthitam ||
children.translated_text: Now what cause is there that the black storm-wind has turned back as if struck by <s>Sumeru</s>?" He began to look here and there, until he saw the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> seated cross-legged at the boundary of the ship.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā ca punaḥ kathayati ārya pūrṇa kiṃ viheṭhayasīti āyuṣmān pūrṇaḥ kathayati jarādharmo 'ham ||
children.translated_text: Seeing him, he then said, "Noble <s>Pūrṇa</s>, why are you troubling me?" The venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> said, "I am subject to old age.

children.text: kiṃ māmeva viheṭhayasi yadi mayedṛśā guṇagaṇā nādhigatāḥ syurbhrātā me tvayā nāmāvaśeṣaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt ||
children.translated_text: Why do you trouble me alone? If such a collection of qualities had not been attained by me, my brother would have been left by you with only his name remaining."

children.text: maheśvaro yakṣaḥ kathayati ārya idaṃ gośīrṣacandanavanaṃ rājñaścakravartino 'rthāya dhāryate ||
children.translated_text: The yakṣa <s>Maheśvara</s> said, "Noble one, this forest of gośīrṣa-sandalwood is being kept for the sake of the wheel-turning king.

children.text: kiṃ manyase grāmaṇīḥ kiṃ varaṃ rājā cakravartī uta tathāgato 'rhan samyaksambuddhaḥ kim ārya bhagavāṃlloka utpannaḥ utpannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: What do you think, guild-chief? Which is better, a wheel-turning king or a <s>Tathāgata</s>, an arhat, a perfectly awakened Buddha?" "Noble one, has the Blessed One arisen in the world?" "He has arisen."

children.text: yadi evam yadaparipūrṇaṃ tatparipūryatām ||
children.translated_text: "If so, let what is incomplete be completed."

children.text: tataste vaṇijo gatapratyāgataprāṇā āyuṣmati pūrṇe cittamabhiprasādya tadvahanaṃ gośīrṣacandanasya pūrayitvā samprasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then those merchants, whose lives had gone and come back, became deeply confident in the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>, filled that ship with gośīrṣa-sandalwood, and set out.

children.text: anupūrveṇa sūrpārakaṃ nagaramanuprāptāḥ ||
children.translated_text: In due course they reached the city of <s>Sūrpāraka</s>.

children.text: tata āyuṣmān pūrṇo bhrātuḥ kathayati yasya nāmnā vahanaṃ saṃsiddhayānapātramāgacchati tattasya gamyaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> said to his brother, "The one in whose name the ship arrives as a successful vessel is the one to whom its cargo belongs.

children.text: tvameṣāṃ vaṇijāṃ ratnasaṃvibhāgaṃ kuru ||
children.translated_text: You distribute the jewels among these merchants.

children.text: ahamanena gośīrṣacandanena bhagavato 'rthāya candanamālaṃ prāsādaṃ kārayāmīti ||
children.translated_text: With this gośīrṣa-sandalwood I shall have a sandalwood pavilion made for the Blessed One."

children.text: tena teṣāṃ vaṇijāṃ ratnaiḥ saṃvibhāgaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He made a distribution of jewels among those merchants.

children.text: tata āyuṣmān pūrṇo gośīrṣacandanena prāsādaṃ māpayitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> began to have a pavilion built with the gośīrṣa-sandalwood.

children.text: tena śilpānāhūyoktāḥ bhavantaḥ kiṃ divase divase pañca kārṣāpaṇaśatāni gṛhṇīdhvamāhosvit gośīrṣacandanacūrṇasya biḍālapadam te kathayanti ārya gośīrṣacandanacūrṇasya biḍālapadam ||
children.translated_text: He summoned the craftsmen and said, "Good sirs, will you take five hundred kārṣāpaṇas each day, or a cat's-foot measure of gośīrṣa-sandalwood powder?" They said, "Noble one, a cat's-foot measure of gośīrṣa-sandalwood powder."

children.text: yāvat alpīyasā kālena candanamālaḥ prāsādaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In a very short time the sandalwood pavilion was completed.

children.text: rājā kathayati bhavantaḥ śobhanaṃ prāsādam ||
children.translated_text: The king said, "Good sirs, the pavilion is splendid."

children.text: sarvajātakṛtaniṣṭhataḥ saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: It turned out to have been completed with every kind of workmanship.

children.text: yattatra saṃkalikā cūrṇaṃ cāvaśiṣṭam tat piṣṭvā tatraiva pralepo dattaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whatever chips and powder remained there were ground up, and a plaster coating was applied there with that very material.

children.text: te ca bhrātaraḥ parasparaṃ sarve kṣamitā uktāśca buddhapramukhaṃ bhikṣusaṃghamupanimantrya bhojayata ||
children.translated_text: All those brothers mutually asked forgiveness of one another and were told, "Invite the community of monks headed by the Buddha and feed them."

children.text: ārya kutra bhagavān śrāvastyām ||
children.translated_text: "Noble one, where is the Blessed One?" "In <s>Śrāvastī</s>."

children.text: kiyaddūramitaḥ śrāvastī sātirekam yojanaśatam ||
children.translated_text: "How far from here is <s>Śrāvastī</s>?" "More than one hundred yojanas."

children.text: rājānaṃ tāvadavalokayāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Let us first consult the king."

children.text: evaṃ kuruta ||
children.translated_text: "Do so."

children.text: te rājñaḥ sakāśamupasaṃkrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They approached the king.

children.text: upasaṃkramya śirasā praṇāmaṃ kṛtvā kathayanti deva icchāmo vayaṃ buddhapramukhaṃ bhikṣusaṃghamupanimantrya bhojayitum ||
children.translated_text: Having approached and bowed with their heads, they said, "Your Majesty, we wish to invite the community of monks headed by the Buddha and feed them.

children.text: devo 'smākaṃ sāhāyyaṃ kalpayatu ||
children.translated_text: May Your Majesty provide assistance for us."

children.text: rājā kathayati tataḥ śobhanam ||
children.translated_text: The king said, "That is excellent.

children.text: tathā bhavatu ||
children.translated_text: So be it.

children.text: kalpayāmi ||
children.translated_text: I shall arrange it."

children.text: tata āyuṣmān pūrṇaḥ śaraṇapṛṣṭhamabhiruhya jetavanābhimukhaṃ sthitvā ubhe jānumaṇḍale pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya puṣpāṇi kṣiptvā dhūpaṃ saṃcārya ārāmikena ca sauvarṇabhṛṅgāraṃ grāhayitvā ārādhituṃ pravṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> climbed onto the roof of the refuge, stood facing <s>Jetavana</s>, set both knees on the ground, threw flowers, wafted incense, had the park attendant take a golden water-vessel, and began to invite him:

children.text: viśuddhaśīla suviśuddhabuddhe bhaktābhisāre satatārthadarśin
children.translated_text: "Pure in virtue, of perfectly pure awakening, one who attends on devotion, always seeing what is beneficial,

children.text: anāthabhūtān prasamīkṣya sādho kṛtvā kṛpāmāgamanaṃ kuruṣva
children.translated_text: look upon those who are helpless, good sir, show compassion, and come.

children.text: iti ||
children.translated_text: Thus.

children.text: tatastāni puṣpāṇi buddhānāṃ buddhānubhāvena devatānāṃ ca devatānubhāvenopari puṣpamaṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā jetavane gatvā sthitāni dhūpo 'bhrakūṭavadudakaṃ vaidūryaśalākāvat ||
children.translated_text: Then those flowers, by the power of the Buddhas and by the power of the deities, formed a canopy of flowers above and went and stood in <s>Jetavana</s>; the incense was like a mass of cloud, and the water like rods of beryl.

children.text: āyuṣmānānando nimittakuśalaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Ānanda</s> was skilled in signs.

children.text: sa kṛtakarapuṭo bhagavantaṃ papraccha kuto bhagavan nimantraṇamāgatam sūrpārakāt ānanda nagarāt ||
children.translated_text: With joined palms he asked the Blessed One, "From where, Blessed One, has the invitation come?" "From <s>Sūrpāraka</s>, <s>Ānanda</s>, from the city."

children.text: kiyaddūre bhadanta sūrpārakaṃ nagaram sātirekam ānanda yojanaśatam ||
children.translated_text: "How far away, venerable sir, is the city of <s>Sūrpāraka</s>?" "More than one hundred yojanas, <s>Ānanda</s>."

children.text: gacchāmaḥ ānanda bhikṣūnārocaya yo yuṣmākamutsahate śvaḥ sūrpārakaṃ nagaraṃ gatvā bhoktum sa śalākāṃ gṛhṇātu iti ||
children.translated_text: "Let us go, <s>Ānanda</s>. Inform the monks: whoever among you is able to go tomorrow to the city of <s>Sūrpāraka</s> and eat there should take a ticket."

children.text: evaṃ bhadanteti āyuṣmānānando bhagavataḥ pratiśrutya śalākāṃ gṛhītvā bhagavataḥ purastāt sthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "So be it, venerable sir," the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> replied to the Blessed One; taking the allotment-stick, he stood before the Blessed One.

children.text: bhagavatā śalākā gṛhītā sthavirasthaviraiśca bhikṣubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The allotment-stick was taken by the Blessed One and by the elder monks.

children.text: tena khalu samayenāyuṣmān pūrṇaḥ kuṇḍopadhānīyakaḥ sthaviraḥ prajñāvimuktas tasyāmeva pariṣadi saṃniṣaṇṇo 'bhūt ||
children.translated_text: At that time the venerable elder <s>Pūrṇa</s> <s>Kuṇḍopadhānīyaka</s>, liberated by wisdom, was seated in that very assembly.

children.text: saṃnipatitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He had come together with them.

children.text: so 'pi śalākāṃ gṛhītumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He too began to take the allotment-stick.

children.text: tamāyuṣmānānando gāthayā pratyabhāṣata ||
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Ānanda</s> addressed him in a verse:

children.text: naitadbhoktavyamāyuṣman kośalādhipatergṛhe
children.translated_text: "This is not to be eaten, venerable sir, in the house of the lord of <s>Kośala</s>,

children.text: agāre vā sujātasya mṛgārabhavane 'thavā ||
children.translated_text: nor in the mansion of <s>Sujāta</s>, nor in the residence of <s>Mṛgāra</s>.

children.text: sādhikam yojanaśataṃ sūrpārakamitaḥ puram ||
children.translated_text: The city of <s>Sūrpāraka</s> is more than a hundred yojanas from here.

children.text: ṛddhibhiryatra gantavyaṃ tūṣṇīṃ tvaṃ bhava pūrṇaka
children.translated_text: One must go there by <s>ṛddhi</s> (miraculous power); be silent, <s>Pūrṇaka</s>."

children.text: iti ||
children.translated_text: Thus.

children.text: sa prajñāvimuktaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was liberated by wisdom.

children.text: tena ṛddhir notpāditā ||
children.translated_text: Therefore he had not produced <s>ṛddhi</s>.

children.text: tasyaitadabhavat yena mayā sakalaṃ kleśagaṇaṃ vāntaṃ charditaṃ tyaktaṃ pratiniḥsṛṣṭam so 'haṃ tīrthikasādhāraṇāyām ṛddhyāṃ viṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He thought, "Since I have vomited out, spewed forth, abandoned, and cast away the whole mass of defilements, am I to be discouraged over <s>ṛddhi</s>, which is common even to the sectarians?"

children.text: tena vīryamāsthāya ṛddhimutpādya yāvadāyuṣmānānandas tṛtīyasthavirasya śalākāṃ na dadāti tāvat tena gajabhujasadṛśaṃ bāhumabhiprasārya śalākā gṛhītā ||
children.translated_text: So, applying energy, he produced <s>ṛddhi</s>; and before the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> could give the allotment-stick to the third elder, he stretched out an arm like an elephant's trunk and took the allotment-stick.

children.text: tato gāthāṃ bhāṣate ||
children.translated_text: Then he spoke a verse:

children.text: vapuṣmattayā śrutena vā na balātkāraguṇaiśca gautama
children.translated_text: "Not by beauty of body, nor by learning, nor by forceful qualities, <s>Gautama</s>,

children.text: prabalairapi vāṅmanorathaiḥ ṣaḍabhijñatvamihādhigamyate ||
children.translated_text: nor even by powerful aspirations of speech and mind is the state of possessing the six higher knowledges attained here.

children.text: śamaśīlavipaśyanābalairvividhairdhyānabalaiḥ parīkṣitāḥ
children.translated_text: Tested by the strengths of tranquillity, moral discipline, insight, and the various strengths of meditation,

children.text: jarayā hi nipīḍitayauvanāḥ ṣaḍabhijñā hi bhavanti madvidhāḥ
children.translated_text: those like me, whose youth is oppressed by old age, indeed possess the <s>ṣaḍabhijñā</s> (six higher knowledges)."

children.text: iti ||
children.translated_text: Thus.

children.text: tatra bhagavān bhikṣūnāmantrayate sma eṣo 'gro me bhikṣavo bhikṣūṇāṃ mama śrāvakāṇāṃ caityaśalākāgrahaṇe ||
children.translated_text: There the Blessed One addressed the monks: "Monks, among my disciple monks, this one is foremost in taking the caitya allotment-stick,

children.text: tatprathamataḥ śalākāṃ gṛhṇatām yaduta pūrṇaḥ kuṇḍopadhānīyakaḥ sthaviraḥ ||
children.translated_text: namely, the elder <s>Pūrṇa</s> <s>Kuṇḍopadhānīyaka</s>, among those who take the allotment-stick first."

children.text: tatra bhagavānāyuṣmantamānandamāmantrayate gaccha ānanda bhikṣūṇāmārocaya ||
children.translated_text: There the Blessed One addressed the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: "Go, <s>Ānanda</s>, and announce this to the monks.

children.text: kiṃ cāpi uktaṃ mayā praticchannakalyāṇairvo bhikṣavo vihartavyaṃ vivṛtapāpairiti api tu tīrthikāvastabdhaṃ tannagaram ||
children.translated_text: Although I have said, 'Monks, you should live with your good qualities concealed and your faults exposed,' nevertheless that city is propped up by sectarians.

children.text: yo vo yasyā ṛddherlābhī tena tayā tatra sūrpārakaṃ nagaraṃ gatvā bhoktavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: Whoever among you has obtained whatever <s>ṛddhi</s>, by that very power he should go there to the city of <s>Sūrpāraka</s> and eat."

children.text: evaṃ bhadanteti āyuṣmānānando bhagavataḥ pratiśrutya bhikṣūṇāmārocayati āyuṣmantaḥ bhagavānevamāha kiṃ cāpi uktaṃ mayā praticchannakalyāṇairvo bhikṣavo vihartavyamiti pūrvavat yāvat gatvā bhoktavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: "So be it, venerable sir," the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> replied to the Blessed One, and announced to the monks, "Venerable ones, the Blessed One says this: 'Although I have said, Monks, you should live with your good qualities concealed,' as before, up to, 'you should go and eat.'"

children.text: tataḥ sūrpārakarājñā sūrpārakanagaramapagatapāṣāṇaśarkarakaṭhallaṃ vyavasthāpitaṃ candanavāripariṣiktaṃ nānāvidhasurabhidhūpaghaṭikāsamalaṃkṛtam āmuktapaṭṭadāmakalāpaṃ nānāpuṣpābhikīrṇaṃ ramaṇīyam ||
children.translated_text: Then the king of <s>Sūrpāraka</s> had the city of <s>Sūrpāraka</s> made free of stones, gravel, and potsherds, sprinkled with sandalwood water, adorned with vessels of many kinds of fragrant incense, hung with garlands and festoons of cloth, strewn with many flowers, and delightful.

children.text: sūrpārakasya nagarasyāṣṭādaśa dvārāṇi ||
children.translated_text: The city of <s>Sūrpāraka</s> had eighteen gates.

children.text: tasyāpi rājñaḥ saptadaśa putrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: That king also had seventeen sons.

children.text: pratyekamekaikasmin dvāre paramayā vibhūtyā rājaputrā vyavasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: At each single gate the princes stood arranged with the highest splendor.

children.text: mūladvāre ca mahatā rājānubhāvena sūrpārakādhipatī rājā āyuṣmān pūrṇo dārukarṇī stavakarṇī trapukarṇī ca vyavasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: At the main gate, with great royal majesty, stood the king, lord of <s>Sūrpāraka</s>, together with the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>, <s>Dārukarṇī</s>, <s>Stavakarṇī</s>, and <s>Trapukarṇī</s>.

children.text: yāvat patracārikā ṛddhyā haritacārikā bhājanacārikāścāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the leaf-carriers came by <s>ṛddhi</s>, and the green-carriers and vessel-carriers came as well.

children.text: tān dṛṣṭvā rājā kathayati bhadanta pūrṇa kiṃ bhagavānāgataḥ āyuṣmān pūrṇaḥ kathayati mahārāja patracārikā haritacārikā bhājanacārikāścaite na tāvat bhagavān ||
children.translated_text: Seeing them, the king said, "Venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>, has the Blessed One come?" The venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> said, "Great king, these are the leaf-carriers, green-carriers, and vessel-carriers; the Blessed One has not yet come."

children.text: yāvat sthavirasthavirā bhikṣavo 'nekavidhābhirdhyānasamāpattibhiḥ samprāptāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the elder monks arrived by many kinds of meditative attainments.

children.text: punarapi pṛcchati bhadanta pūrṇa kiṃ bhagavānāgataḥ āyuṣmān pūrṇaḥ kathayati mahārāja na bhagavān api tu khalu sthavirasthavirā eva te bhikṣava iti ||
children.translated_text: Again he asked, "Venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>, has the Blessed One come?" The venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s> said, "Great king, it is not the Blessed One; rather, these are just the elder monks."

children.text: athānyatamopāsakastasyāṃ velāyāṃ gāthāṃ bhāṣate ||
children.translated_text: Then a certain lay follower at that time spoke a verse:

children.text: siṃhavyāghragajāśvanāgavṛṣabhānāśritya kecit śubhān kecidratnavimānaparvatatarūṃścitrān rathāṃścojjvalān
children.translated_text: "Some, relying on splendid lions, tigers, elephants, horses, nāgas, and bulls; some on jeweled palaces, mountains, trees of many colors, and shining chariots;

children.text: anye toyadharā ivāmbaratale vidyullatālaṃkṛtā ṛddhyā devapurīmiva pramuditā gantuṃ samabhyudyatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: others, like rain clouds in the sky adorned with flashes of lightning, joyfully set out by <s>ṛddhi</s> to go as though to a city of the gods.

children.text: gāṃ bhittvā hyutpatantyeke patantyanye nabhastalāt
children.translated_text: Some burst through the earth and fly upward; others descend from the sky.

children.text: āsane nirmitāścaike paśya ṛddhimatāṃ balam
children.translated_text: Some are fashioned upon seats. Behold the power of those who possess <s>ṛddhi</s>."

children.text: iti ||
children.translated_text: Thus.

children.text: tato bhagavān bahirvihārasya pādau prakṣālya vihāraṃ praviśya ṛjuṃ kāyaṃ praṇidhāya pratimukhaṃ smṛtimupasthāpya prajñapta evāsane niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One washed his feet outside the monastery, entered the monastery, set his body upright, established mindfulness before him, and sat down on the prepared seat.

children.text: yāvad bhagavatā gandhakuṭyāṃ sābhisaṃskāraṃ pādo nyastaḥ ṣaḍvikāraḥ pṛthivīkampo jātaḥ iyaṃ mahāpṛthivī calati saṃcalati saṃpracalati vyadhati pravyadhati saṃpravyadhati ||
children.translated_text: When the Blessed One set his foot, deliberately, in the fragrant chamber, there arose an earthquake with six transformations: this great earth shook, shook all over, shook violently, trembled, trembled all over, and trembled violently.

children.text: pūrvadigbhāga unnamati paścimo 'vanamati ||
children.translated_text: The eastern quarter rose up and the western sank down.

children.text: paścima unnamati pūrvo 'vanamati ||
children.translated_text: The western rose up and the eastern sank down.

children.text: dakṣiṇa unnamati uttaro 'vanamati ||
children.translated_text: The southern rose up and the northern sank down.

children.text: uttara unnamati dakṣiṇo 'vanamati ||
children.translated_text: The northern quarter rose up and the southern sank down.

children.text: anta unnamati madhyo 'vanamati ||
children.translated_text: The edge rose up and the middle sank down.

children.text: madhya unnamati anto 'vanamati ||
children.translated_text: The middle rose up and the edge sank down.

children.text: rājā āyuṣmantaṃ pūrṇaṃ pṛcchati ārya pūrṇa kimetat sa kathayati mahārāja bhagavatā gandhakuṭyāṃ sābhisaṃskāraḥ pādo nyastaḥ tena ṣaḍvikāraḥ pṛthivīkampo jātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The king asked the venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>, "Noble <s>Pūrṇa</s>, what is this?" He said, "Great king, the Blessed One has deliberately set his foot down in the fragrant chamber; because of that, an earthquake with six transformations has occurred."

children.text: tato bhagavatā kanakamarīcivarṇaprabhā utsṛṣṭā yayā jambudvīpo vilīnakanakāvabhāsaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One emitted a radiance the color of golden rays, by which <s>Jambudvīpa</s> became filled with the appearance of molten gold.

children.text: punarapi rājā vismayotphullalocanaḥ pṛcchati ārya pūrṇa idaṃ kim sa kathayati mahārāja bhagavatā kanakamarīcivarṇaprabhā utsṛṣṭeti ||
children.translated_text: Again the king, his eyes opened wide with wonder, asked, "Noble <s>Pūrṇa</s>, what is this?" He said, "Great king, the Blessed One has emitted a radiance the color of golden rays."

children.text: tato bhagavān dānto dāntaparivāraḥ śāntaḥ śāntaparivāraḥ pañcabhirarhacchataiḥ sārdhaṃ sūrpārakābhimukhaḥ samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, tamed and with a retinue of the tamed, peaceful and with a retinue of the peaceful, set out toward <s>Sūrpāraka</s> together with five hundred arhats.

children.text: atha yā jetavananivāsinī devatā sā bakulaśākhāṃ gṛhītvā bhagavataśchāyāṃ kurvantī pṛṣṭhataḥ samprasthitā ||
children.translated_text: Then the deity who lived in <s>Jetavana</s> took a bakula branch and, making shade for the Blessed One, set out behind him.

children.text: tasyā bhagavatā āśayaṃ dhātuṃ prakṛtiṃ ca jñātvā tādṛśī caturāryasatyasamprativedhakī dharmadeśanā kṛtā yāṃ śrutvā tayā devatayā viṃśatiśikharasamudgataṃ satkāyadṛṣṭiśailaṃ jñānavajreṇa bhittvā srotaāpattiphalaṃ sākṣātkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Knowing her intention, disposition, and nature, the Blessed One gave such a teaching of the Dharma as leads to penetration of the four noble truths; having heard it, that deity split the mountain of <s>satkāyadṛṣṭi</s> (identity-view), risen with twenty peaks, with the diamond of knowledge, and realized the fruit of <s>srotaāpatti</s> (stream-entry).

children.text: yāvadanyatamasmin pradeśe pañcamātrāṇi ghariṇīśatāni prativasanti ||
children.translated_text: Then, in a certain place, about five hundred household women were living.

children.text: adrākṣustā buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ dvātriṃśatā mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam aśītyānuvyañjanairvirājitagātraṃ vyāmaprabhālaṃkṛtaṃ sūryasahasrātirekaprabhaṃ jaṅgamamiva ratnaparvataṃ samantato bhadrakam ||
children.translated_text: They saw the Buddha, the Blessed One, adorned with the thirty-two marks of a great man, his limbs resplendent with the eighty minor marks, adorned with a fathom-wide halo, brighter than a thousand suns, like a moving mountain of jewels, lovely on every side.

children.text: sahadarśanācca tāsāṃ bhagavati mahāprasāda utpannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And immediately on seeing him, great faith in the Blessed One arose in them.

children.text: dharmataiṣā na tathā dvādaśavarṣābhyastaḥ śamathaścittasya kalyatāṃ janayati aputrasya ca putralābho daridrasya vā nidhidarśanaṃ rājyābhinandino vā rājyābhiṣeko yathopacitakuśalamūlahetukasya sattvasya tatprathamato buddhadarśanam ||
children.translated_text: For this is the nature of things: neither calm cultivated for twelve years produces such readiness of mind, nor the gaining of a son by the childless, nor the sight of treasure by the poor, nor the royal consecration of one who longs for kingship, as does the first sight of a Buddha for a being whose roots of merit have been accumulated.

children.text: tato bhagavāṃstāsāṃ vinayakālamavekṣya purastād bhikṣusaṃghasya prajñapta evāsane niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, seeing that it was the time to discipline them, sat down on the seat prepared before the community of monks.

children.text: tā api bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvaikānte niṣaṇṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They too bowed with their heads at the Blessed One's feet and sat to one side.

children.text: tato bhagavatā tāsāmāśayānuśayaṃ dhātuṃ prakṛtiṃ ca jñātvā yāvat srotaāpattiphalaṃ sākṣātkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, knowing their intentions, underlying tendencies, dispositions, and natures, taught them until they realized the fruit of <s>srotaāpatti</s> (stream-entry).

children.text: tā dṛṣṭasatyās trirudānamudānayanti idamasmākaṃ bhadanta na mātrā kṛtaṃ na pitrā kṛtaṃ na rājñā neṣṭasvajanabandhuvargeṇa na devatābhir na pūrvapretair na śramaṇabrāhmaṇairyad bhagavatāsmākaṃ tatkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Having seen the truth, they uttered this exclamation three times: "Venerable sir, this was not done for us by our mother, nor by our father, nor by the king, nor by our dear kinsmen and relatives, nor by deities, nor by departed ancestors, nor by ascetics and brahmins; what the Blessed One has done for us is this:

children.text: ucchoṣitā rudhirāśrusamudrāḥ laṅghitā asthiparvatāḥ pihitānyapāyadvārāṇi pratiṣṭhāpitā vayaṃ devamanuṣyeṣu atikrāntātikrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: oceans of blood and tears have been dried up, mountains of bones have been crossed over, the doors to the bad destinies have been closed, we have been established among gods and humans, and we have passed beyond again and again.

children.text: etā vayaṃ bhagavataṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchāmo dharmaṃ ca bhikṣusaṃghaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: We now go for refuge to the Blessed One, to the Dharma, and to the community of monks.

children.text: upāsikāścāsmān bhagavān dhārayatu ||
children.translated_text: May the Blessed One regard us as <s>upāsikās</s> (laywomen)."

children.text: tata utthāyāsanāt yena bhagavāṃstenāñjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantamidamavocan aho bata bhagavānasmākaṃ kiṃcidatra prayacchet yatra vayaṃ kārāṃ kariṣyāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, rising from their seats, they bowed with joined palms toward the Blessed One and said this to him: "Ah, may the Blessed One give us something here, over which we may perform worship."

children.text: tato bhagavatā ṛddhyā keśanakhamutsṛṣṭam ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, by <s>ṛddhi</s> (miraculous power), released hair and nails.

children.text: tābhirbhagavataḥ keśanakhastūpaḥ pratiṣṭhāpitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They established a <s>stūpa</s> for the Blessed One's hair and nails.

children.text: tatastayā jetavananivāsinyā tasmin stūpe yaṣṭyāṃ sā bakulaśākhāropitā ||
children.translated_text: Then that <s>Jetavana</s>-dwelling deity set the bakula branch upon the staff of that <s>stūpa</s>.

children.text: bhagavāṃścoktaḥ bhagavan ahamasmin stūpe kārāṃ kurvantī tiṣṭhāmīti ||
children.translated_text: And she said to the Blessed One, "Blessed One, I will remain at this <s>stūpa</s>, performing worship."

children.text: sā tatraiva āsthitā ||
children.translated_text: She stayed right there.

children.text: tatra kecit ghariṇīstūpa iti saṃjānate kecit bakulamedhīti yamadyāpi caityavandakā bhikṣavo vandante ||
children.translated_text: There some know it as the <s>Ghariṇīstūpa</s>, and others as the <s>Bakulamedhī</s>, which monks who venerate <s>caityas</s> still worship even today.

children.text: tato bhagavān samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One set out.

children.text: yāvadanyasminnāśramapade pañca ṛṣiśatāni prativasanti ||
children.translated_text: Then, in another hermitage, five hundred ṛṣis were living.

children.text: tatteṣāmāśramapadaṃ puṣpaphalasalilasampannam ||
children.translated_text: Their hermitage was furnished with flowers, fruit, and water.

children.text: te tena madena mattā na kiṃcinmanyante ||
children.translated_text: Intoxicated with pride in that, they thought little of anything.

children.text: tato bhagavāṃsteṣāṃ vinayakālamavekṣya tadāśramapadamupasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, seeing that it was the time to discipline them, approached that hermitage.

children.text: upasaṃkramya tasmādāśramapadāt puṣpaphalamṛddhyā śāmitam salilaṃ śoṣitam haritaśāḍvalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sthaṇḍilāni pātitāni ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, by his <s>ṛddhi</s> (miraculous power) he made the flowers and fruit of that hermitage fade, dried up the water, turned the green turf black, and cast down the altar-grounds.

children.text: tataste ṛṣayaḥ kare kapolaṃ dattvā cintāparā vyavasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then those ṛṣis, putting hand to cheek, remained absorbed in thought.

children.text: tato bhagavatā abhihitāḥ maharṣayaḥ kimarthaṃ cintāparāstiṣṭhateti ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One said to them, "Great sages, why do you stand absorbed in thought?"

children.text: te kathayanti bhagavaṃstvaṃ dvipādakaṃ puṇyakṣetramiha praviṣṭo 'smākaṃ cedṛśī samavasthā ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Blessed One, you, the field of merit among two-footed beings, have entered here, and yet such a condition has befallen us."

children.text: bhagavānāha kim te kathayanti bhagavan puṣpaphalasalilasampannam āśramapadaṃ vinaṣṭam yathāpaurāṇaṃ bhavatu ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, "What is it?" They said, "Blessed One, our hermitage, furnished with flowers, fruit, and water, has perished. Let it be as it was before."

children.text: bhavatu ityāha bhagavān ||
children.translated_text: "Let it be," the Blessed One said.

children.text: tato bhagavatā ṛddhiḥ prasrabdhā yathāpaurāṇaṃ saṃvṛttam ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One withdrew the miraculous power, and it became as it had been before.

children.text: tataste paraṃ vismayamupagatā bhagavati cittam abhiprasādayāmāsuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, thereafter, they attained supreme wonder and made their minds serene with faith toward the Blessed One.

children.text: tato bhagavatā teṣāmāśayānuśayaṃ dhātuṃ prakṛtiṃ ca jñātvā tādṛśī caturāryasatyasamprativedhikī dharmadeśanā kṛtā yāṃ śrutvā taiḥ pañcabhirṛṣiśatairanāgāmiphalaṃ sākṣātkṛtam ṛddhiścābhinirhṛtā ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, knowing their dispositions, latent tendencies, elements, and natures, gave such a Dharma teaching that brought realization of the four noble truths that, after hearing it, those five hundred sages directly realized the fruit of non-returning and manifested <s>ṛddhi</s> (miraculous power).

children.text: tato yena bhagavāṃstenāñjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantamidamavocan labhema vayaṃ bhadanta svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajyāmupasampadaṃ bhikṣubhāvam ||
children.translated_text: Then they bowed with joined palms toward the Blessed One and said this to him: "May we obtain, venerable sir, going forth, ordination, and the state of monks in the well-proclaimed Dharma and discipline.

children.text: carema vayaṃ bhagavato 'ntike brahmacaryam ||
children.translated_text: May we practice the holy life in the presence of the Blessed One."

children.text: tataste bhagavatā ehibhikṣukayā ābhāṣitāḥ eta bhikṣavaścarata brahmacaryamiti ||
children.translated_text: Then they were addressed by the Blessed One with the ehi-bhikṣu formula: "Come, monks; practice the holy life."

children.text: bhagavato vācāvasāne muṇḍāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ saṃghāṭiprāvṛtāḥ pātrakaravyagrahastāḥ saptāhāvaropitakeśaśmaśravo varṣaśatopasaṃpannasya bhikṣorīryāpathena avasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: At the end of the Blessed One's words they became shaven-headed, clothed in saṃghāṭī robes, with bowls in hand, their hair and beards as though cut seven days before, and they stood in the deportment of monks ordained for a hundred years.

children.text: ehīti coktā hi tathāgatena muṇḍāśca saṃghāṭiparītadehāḥ sadyaḥ praśāntendriyā eva tasthurevaṃ sthitā buddhamanorathena ||
children.translated_text: For when the Tathāgata had said, "Come," they immediately stood shaven-headed, their bodies wrapped in saṃghāṭī robes, their faculties calmed, standing thus according to the Buddha's intention.

children.text: tairyujyamānairghaṭamānair vyāyacchamānairidameva pañcagaṇḍakaṃ pūrvavat yāvadabhivādyāśca saṃvṛttāḥ ||
children.translated_text: As they applied themselves, exerted themselves, and strove, this same fivefold section occurred as before, up to the point that they became worthy of reverence.

children.text: yasteṣām ṛṣiravavādakaḥ sa kathayati bhagavan mayā anena veṣeṇa mahājanakāyo vipralabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The sage who had been their instructor said, "Blessed One, by this garb I have deceived a great mass of people.

children.text: tam yāvadabhiprasādayāmi paścāt pravrajiṣyāmīti ||
children.translated_text: Let me first inspire them with faith as far as possible; afterward I shall go forth."

children.text: tato bhagavān pañcabhirṛṣiśataiḥ pūrvakaiśca pañcabhirbhikṣuśatair ardhacandrākāropagūḍhastat eva ṛddhyā upari vihāyasā prakrānto 'nupūrveṇa musalakaṃ parvatamanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, encircled in a crescent shape by the five hundred sages and by the earlier five hundred monks, departed from that very place through the upper air by <s>ṛddhi</s> (miraculous power), and in due course arrived at Mount <s>Musalaka</s>.

children.text: tena khalu samayena musalake parvate vakkalī nāma ṛṣiḥ prativasati ||
children.translated_text: At that time a sage named <s>Vakkalī</s> was living on Mount <s>Musalaka</s>.

children.text: adrākṣīt sa ṛṣirbhagavantaṃ dūrādeva dvātriṃśatā mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇaiḥ samalaṃkṛtaṃ pūrvavat yāvat samantato bhadrakam ||
children.translated_text: That sage saw the Blessed One from afar, adorned with the thirty-two marks of a great man, as before, up to being auspicious on every side.

children.text: sahadarśanāccānena bhagavato 'ntike cittamabhiprasāditam ||
children.translated_text: As soon as he saw him, he made his mind serene with faith in the presence of the Blessed One.

children.text: sa prasādajātaścintayati yannvahaṃ parvatādavatīrya bhagavantaṃ darśanāyopasaṃkramiṣyāmi ||
children.translated_text: Filled with faith, he thought, "What if I descend from the mountain and approach the Blessed One for the sake of seeing him?

children.text: bhagavān vaineyāpekṣayā atikramiṣyati ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One, out of regard for those to be trained, will pass by.

children.text: yannvahamātmānaṃ parvatānmuñceyamiti ||
children.translated_text: What if I throw myself down from the mountain?"

children.text: tena parvatādātmā muktaḥ ||
children.translated_text: So he cast himself down from the mountain.

children.text: asaṃmoṣadharmāṇo buddhā bhagavantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Buddhas, Blessed Ones, are not subject to forgetfulness.

children.text: bhagavatā ṛddhyā pratīṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One caught him by <s>ṛddhi</s> (miraculous power).

children.text: tato 'sya bhagavatā āśayānuśayaṃ dhātuṃ prakṛtiṃ ca jñātvā tādṛśī dharmadeśanā kṛtā yāṃ śrutvā vakkalinā anāgāmiphalaṃ sākṣātkṛtam ṛddhiścābhinirhṛtā ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, knowing his disposition, latent tendencies, element, and nature, gave such a Dharma teaching that, after hearing it, <s>Vakkalī</s> directly realized the fruit of non-returning and manifested <s>ṛddhi</s> (miraculous power).

children.text: tato bhagavantamidamavocat labheyāhaṃ bhadanta svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajyāmupasampadaṃ bhikṣubhāvaṃ pūrvavat yāvat bhagavatā ehibhikṣukayā pravrājito yāvadevaṃ sthito buddhamanorathena ||
children.translated_text: Then he said this to the Blessed One: "May I obtain, venerable sir, going forth, ordination, and the state of a monk in the well-proclaimed Dharma and discipline," as before, up to the Blessed One ordained him with the ehi-bhikṣu formula, and he stood thus according to the Buddha's intention.

children.text: tatra bhagavān bhikṣūnāmantrayate sma eṣo 'gro me bhikṣavo bhikṣūṇāṃ mama śraddhādhimuktānām yaduta vakkalī bhikṣuriti ||
