children.text: sa caivaṃ cintayati ||
children.translated_text: And he thought in this way.

children.text: anāthapiṇḍadena gṛhapatinā śrutam yathā śiśumāragirau bodho gṛhapatistasya duhitā evaṃ rūpayauvanasamuditā sā nānādeśanivāsināṃ rājāmātyagṛhapatidhanināṃ śreṣṭhisārthavāhaputrāṇāmarthāya prārthyata iti ||
children.translated_text: The householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> heard that in <s>Śiśumāragiri</s> there was the householder <s>Bodha</s>, and that his daughter, endowed with such beauty and youth, was being sought for the sons of kings, ministers, householders, wealthy men, merchants, and caravan-leaders living in various regions.

children.text: śrutvā ca punarasyaitadabhavat ahamapi tāvat tāṃ putrasyārthāya prārthayāmi ||
children.translated_text: When he heard it, this occurred to him: 'I too, then, shall seek her for my son.'

children.text: kadācid bodho gṛhapatirdadyāditi viditvā tasyā yācanakāḥ preṣitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thinking, 'Perhaps the householder <s>Bodha</s> will give her,' he sent suitors for her.

children.text: bodhena gṛhapatinā anāthapiṇḍadasya gṛhapateḥ samudācāradhanasampadaṃ ca vicārya dattā ||
children.translated_text: After the householder <s>Bodha</s> had considered the conduct and wealth of the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>, he gave her.

children.text: anāthapiṇḍadena gṛhapatinā mahatā śrīsamudayena putrasya pariṇītā ||
children.translated_text: The householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> married her to his son with a great display of prosperity.

children.text: yāvat punarapi bodhasya gṛhapateḥ patnyā sārdhaṃ krīḍato ramamāṇasya paricārayataḥ patnī āpannasattvā saṃvṛttā ||
children.translated_text: Then, once again, as the householder <s>Bodha</s> played, took pleasure, and enjoyed himself with his wife, his wife became pregnant.

children.text: yameva divasamāpannasattvā saṃvṛttā tameva divasaṃ bodhasya gṛhapateranekānyanarthaśatāni prādurbhūtāni ||
children.translated_text: On the very day she became pregnant, many hundreds of misfortunes appeared for the householder <s>Bodha</s>.

children.text: tena naimittikā āhūya pṛṣṭāḥ bhavantaḥ paśyata kasya prabhāvānmamānarthaśatāni prādurbhūtāni ||
children.translated_text: He summoned omen-interpreters and asked them, 'Gentlemen, look and see through whose influence these hundreds of misfortunes of mine have appeared.'

children.text: naimittikā vicāryaikamatenāhur gṛhapate ya eṣa tava patnyāḥ kukṣimavakrāntaḥ asyaiṣa prabhāvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The omen-interpreters examined the matter and said with one voice, 'Householder, the one who has entered your wife's womb: this is his influence.'

children.text: tadasya parityāgaḥ kriyatām ||
children.translated_text: 'Therefore he should be abandoned.'

children.text: iti śrutvā bodho gṛhapatiḥ paraṃ viṣādamāpannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Hearing this, the householder <s>Bodha</s> fell into deepest despair.

children.text: kathayati bhavantaḥ svāgataṃ na parityakṣyāmīti ||
children.translated_text: He said, 'Gentlemen, I will not abandon one who has come as a welcome arrival.'

children.text: naimittāḥ svastītyuktvā prakrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The omen-interpreters said, 'May it be well,' and departed.

children.text: atha bodho gṛhapatirviyogasaṃjanitadaurmanasyo 'pi lokāpavādabhayādabhyupekṣyāvasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the householder <s>Bodha</s>, though distressed by sorrow born from separation, remained as he was, disregarding it because he feared public blame.

children.text: yathā yathāsau garbho vṛddhiṃ gacchati tathā tathā bodhasya gṛhapateruttarottarātiśayenānarthaśatānyutpadyante ||
children.translated_text: The more that fetus grew, the more, in ever-increasing measure, hundreds of misfortunes arose for the householder <s>Bodha</s>.

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati ka etāni śṛṇoti udyānaṃ gatvā tiṣṭhāmīti viditvā tena pauruṣeyā uktāḥ yadi me kaścinmahānanartha utpadyate sa śrāvayitavyo nānya ityuktvā udyānaṃ gatvā avasthito yāvadasyāsau patnī prasūtā ||
children.translated_text: He considered, 'Who can bear hearing these things? I shall go and stay in the park.' Having decided this, he said to his servants, 'If some great misfortune occurs to me, that is to be reported, and nothing else.' Having said this, he went to the park and stayed there until his wife gave birth.

children.text: dārako jātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A boy was born.

children.text: anyatamaḥ puruṣastvaritaṃ tvaritaṃ bodhasya gṛhapateḥ sakāśaṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: A certain man went very quickly to the householder <s>Bodha</s>.

children.text: tenāsau dūrata eva dṛṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bodha</s> saw him from afar.

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati yathāyaṃ tvaritatvaritamāgacchati nūnaṃ mahānanarthaḥ prādurbhūtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He considered, 'Since this man is coming very quickly, surely a great misfortune has appeared.'

children.text: iti viditvā sasambhramaḥ pṛcchati bhoḥ puruṣa kiṃ tvaritatvaritamāgacchasīti sa kathayati gṛhapate diṣṭyā vardhase putraste jāta iti ||
children.translated_text: Knowing this, he asks in agitation, "Sir, why are you coming in such a hurry?" He says, "Householder, good fortune to you: a son has been born to you."

children.text: sa kathayati bhoḥ puruṣa yadyapi me putro 'narthaśatānyutpādya jātaḥ tathāpi svāgatamasyeti ||
children.translated_text: He says, "Sir, although my son has been born after producing hundreds of misfortunes for me, still he is welcome."

children.text: tadanantarameva dvitīyapuruṣastathaiva tvaritatvaritamaśruparyākulekṣaṇo bodhasya gṛhapateḥ sakāśaṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Immediately after that, a second man, likewise hurrying and with eyes filled with tears, went to <s>Bodha</s> the householder.

children.text: so 'pi tenānarthatayā sasambhrameṇa pṛṣṭaḥ bhoḥ puruṣa kiṃ tvaritatvaritamāgacchasīti sa bāṣpoparudhyamānagadgadakaṇṭhaḥ karuṇādīnavilambitākṣaraṃ kathayati gṛhapate gṛhe 'gnirutthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He too was anxiously questioned by him about the calamity: "Sir, why are you coming in such a hurry?" With his throat choked by tears and stammering, with pitiable, feeble, delayed syllables, he says, "Householder, a fire has broken out in the house."

children.text: sarvaṃ svāpateyaṃ dagdhamiti ||
children.translated_text: "All the property has been burned."

children.text: sa muhurmuhuranarthaśravaṇadṛḍhīkṛtacittasaṃtatiḥ kathayati bhoḥ puruṣa prāptavyametat ||
children.translated_text: His stream of thought made firm by hearing calamity again and again, he says, "Sir, this was bound to happen."

children.text: alaṃ viṣādena tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭheti ||
children.translated_text: "Enough with grief. Be silent."

children.text: atha tasya jñātayo lokadharmānuvṛttyā avajñāpūrvakena nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpayitumārabdhāḥ kiṃ bhavatu dārakasya nāmeti ||
children.translated_text: Then his relatives, following worldly custom but with contempt, began to decide on a name: "What should the boy's name be?"

children.text: tatraike kathayanti yatkulasadṛśaṃ tatkriyatāmiti ||
children.translated_text: Some among them say, "Let it be one that suits the family."

children.text: apare kathayanti yena bodhasya gṛhapateḥ kukṣigatenaivānekadhanasamuditaṃ gṛhaṃ nidhanamupanītam tasya kīdṛśaṃ kulasadṛśaṃ nāma vyavasthāpyate api tu ayaṃ pitrā jātamātraḥ svāgatavādena samudācaritaḥ tasmādasya svāgata iti nāma bhavatu iti ||
children.translated_text: Others say, "For one by whom, while still in the womb, the house of <s>Bodha</s> the householder, full of abundant wealth, was brought to ruin, what sort of family-appropriate name is to be assigned? Rather, the moment he was born he was addressed by his father with words of welcome; therefore let his name be <s>Svāgata</s>."

children.text: tasya svāgata iti nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpitam ||
children.translated_text: The name <s>Svāgata</s> was assigned to him.

children.text: yathā yathā svāgato vṛddhimupayāti tathā tathā bodhasya gṛhapater dhanadhānyahiraṇyasuvarṇadāsīdāsakarmakarapauruṣeyās tanutvaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gacchanti ||
children.translated_text: As <s>Svāgata</s> grew more and more, so the wealth, grain, silver, gold, female and male slaves, laborers, and hired men of <s>Bodha</s> the householder became diminished, exhausted, and depleted.

children.text: yāvadapareṇa samayena bodho gṛhapatiḥ kālagataḥ ||
children.translated_text: After some time, <s>Bodha</s> the householder died.

children.text: sāpyasya patnī kālagatā ||
children.translated_text: His wife also died.

children.text: tadgṛhaṃ pratisaṃskṛtaṃ punaragninā dagdham ||
children.translated_text: That house, though repaired, was burned again by fire.

children.text: ye 'pyasya pauruṣeyāḥ paṇyamādāya deśāntaragatā mahāsamudram yāvattīrṇāḥ tataḥ keṣāṃcidyānapātraṃ vipannam keṣāṃcit paṇyamapaṇyījātam kecit tatraivānayena vyasanamāpannāḥ keṣāṃcit kāntāramadhyagatānāṃ caurairdravyamapahṛtam keṣāṃcinnagarasamīpamanuprāptānāṃ śaulkikaśaulkikairdravyaṃ vicārayadbhiḥ sāro gṛhītaḥ keṣāṃcit pattanamanuprāptānāṃ rājñā viniyuktairdoṣamutpādya sarvasvamapahṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Those hired men of his who had taken merchandise and gone to another country, even crossing the great ocean, met with disasters: some had their ships wrecked; for some the merchandise became unsellable; some there fell into ruin through misfortune; from some, while they were in the middle of the wilderness, robbers stole their goods; from some, when they had reached the vicinity of a city, customs officers, inspecting the goods, took the valuable portion; and from some, when they had reached a port, royal officials fabricated a fault and took everything they owned.

children.text: kecidbodhasya gṛhapateḥ prāṇaviyogaṃ śrutvā tatraiva avasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Some, having heard of the death of <s>Bodha</s> the householder, remained right there.

children.text: jñātīnāmapi kecit kālagatāḥ kecinniṣpalāyitāḥ kecit tatraivāvasthitāḥ svāgatasya vācamapi na prayacchanti ||
children.translated_text: Among his relatives too, some died, some fled, and some stayed right there; they do not even offer <s>Svāgata</s> a word.

children.text: dāsīdāsakarmakarapauruṣeyā api kecit kālagatāḥ kecinniṣpalāyitāḥ kecidanyāśrayeṇa tatraivāvasthitāḥ santaḥ svāgatasya nāmāpi na gṛhṇanti ||
children.translated_text: Among the female and male slaves, laborers, and hired men too, some died, some fled, and some remained there under another's protection; they do not even take <s>Svāgata</s>'s name.

children.text: kiṃtu bodhasyaikā purāṇavṛddhā dāsī kṛtajñatayā svāgatasyopasthānaṃ kurvantī tiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: But one old former maidservant of <s>Bodha</s>, out of gratitude, remained, attending on <s>Svāgata</s>.

children.text: tayā sa lipyakṣarācāryasyākṣarāṇi śikṣayitumupanyastaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By her he was placed with a teacher of writing and letters to learn the alphabet.

children.text: sā saṃlakṣayati bodhasya gṛhapatergṛhamanekadhanasamuditaṃ vistīrṇasvajanabandhuvargaṃ prabhūtadāsīdāsakarmakarapauruṣeyam paryādānaṃ gatam ||
children.translated_text: She reflected, "The house of <s>Bodha</s> the householder, full of abundant wealth, with a wide circle of kinsmen and relatives and many female and male slaves, laborers, and hired men, has gone to depletion."

children.text: svāgato 'haṃ cāvasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Only <s>Svāgata</s> and I are left."

children.text: tajjijñāsayāmi tāvat kasyāpuṇyenāyamupaplavaḥ kiṃ svāgatasya āhosvinmameti ||
children.translated_text: "Let me find out, then: through whose demerit has this calamity come about, <s>Svāgata</s>'s or mine?"

children.text: tayā svāgatasya nāmnā sthālyāṃ taṇḍulān prakṣipya bhaktārtham yojitā vinaṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: She put rice grains into a pot in <s>Svāgata</s>'s name and set them to cook for a meal, but they were spoiled.

children.text: tata ātmano nāmnā tathaiva yojitāḥ śobhanaṃ bhaktaṃ sampannam ||
children.translated_text: Then she set them up in the same way in her own name, and a good meal was produced.

children.text: sā saṃlakṣayati asau mandabhāgyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: She reflected, "He is ill-fated."

children.text: etamāgamya bodhasya gṛhapatergṛhamanekadhanasamuditaṃ vistīrṇasvajanabandhuvargaṃ prabhūtadāsīdāsakarmakarapauruṣeyaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gatam ||
children.translated_text: "Because of him, the house of <s>Bodha</s> the householder, full of abundant wealth, with a wide circle of kinsmen and relatives and many female and male slaves, laborers, and hired men, has gone to exhaustion and depletion."

children.text: ahaṃ punar na yāsyāmīti ||
children.translated_text: "But I will not go that way."

children.text: kutaḥ sthāsyāmīti atra prāptakālaṃ sarvathā yāvat prāṇaviyogo na bhavati tāvanniṣpalāyeyam ||
children.translated_text: "For where would I stay? The time has come; by all means, before death comes to me, I should run away."

children.text: iti viditvā yattatra kiṃcit sāramasti tamādāya niṣpalāyitā ||
children.translated_text: Having understood this, she took whatever valuables were there and fled.

children.text: tasmiñ śūnye gṛhe śvānaḥ praviśya kalahaṃ kartumārabdhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Dogs entered that empty house and began to fight.

children.text: yāvadanyatamo dhūrtapuruṣastena pradeśenātikrāmati ||
children.translated_text: Then a certain rogue was passing by that place.

children.text: sa śvānakalahaṃ śrutvā saṃlakṣayati bodhasya gṛhapatergṛhe śvānaḥ kaliṃ kurvanti ||
children.translated_text: Hearing the dogs' fight, he reflected, "Dogs are quarreling in the house of <s>Bodha</s> the householder."

children.text: kiṃ tadanyaṃ bhavet paśyāmi tāvaditi ||
children.translated_text: "What else might be there? Let me see."

children.text: sa tatra praviṣṭo yāvat paśyati śūnyam ||
children.translated_text: He entered there, and then saw that it was empty.

children.text: so 'pi tasmādyat kiṃciccheṣāvaśeṣamasti tamādāya prakrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He too took from there whatever slight remnant was left and departed.

children.text: tataḥ svāgato bhojanavelāṃ jñātvā lekhaśālāyāḥ svagṛhamāgato bhoktumiti yāvat paśyati śūnyam ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Svāgata</s>, knowing it was mealtime, came from the writing school to his own house to eat; when he looked, he saw that it was empty.

children.text: sa bhoktukāmāvarjitasaṃtatiḥ kṣudhāsaṃjanitadaurmanasyaḥ śabdāpayitumārabdhaḥ amba ambeti ||
children.translated_text: His whole being overcome by the desire to eat, and dejected from the hunger that had arisen, he began to call out, "Mother, mother!"

children.text: na kaścidvacanaṃ dadāti ||
children.translated_text: No one gave any answer.

children.text: sa tadgṛhamitaścāmutaśca vyavalokya nairāśyamāpanno niṣkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He looked around that house this way and that, and, having fallen into despair, went out.

children.text: tasya gṛhasya nātidūre 'nyagṛham ||
children.translated_text: Not far from that house was another house.

children.text: tasmin svāgatasya jñātayastiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: In it lived relatives of <s>Svāgata</s>.

children.text: sa teṣāṃ sakāśaṃ gato yāvattatra kaliḥ prādurbhūtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He went into their presence, but then a quarrel broke out there.

children.text: te kalahaṃ kṛtvā vyupaśāntāḥ parasparaṃ kathayanti bhavantaḥ pūrvamasmākamanyonyaṃ dṛṣṭvā sneho bhavati idānīṃ tu dveṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After quarreling and then calming down, they said to one another, "Sirs, formerly when we saw one another there was affection among us; now there is hatred.

children.text: paśyadhvaṃ kaścidanya āgataḥ syāditi ||
children.translated_text: Look and see whether someone else has come in."

children.text: te samanveṣitumārabdhā yāvat paśyanti svāgatam ||
children.translated_text: They began to search, and then they saw <s>Svāgata</s>.

children.text: tatraike kathayanti bhavantaḥ svāgataḥ praviṣṭa iti ||
children.translated_text: Some there said, "Sirs, <s>Svāgata</s> has entered."

children.text: apare kathayanti nāyaṃ svāgatāḥ kiṃtu durāgataḥ imamāgamyāsmākaṃ kaliḥ prādurbhūta iti ||
children.translated_text: Others said, "This is not <s>Svāgata</s>, but <s>Durāgata</s>; because of his coming, a quarrel has arisen among us."

children.text: sa tairgrīvāyāṃ gṛhītvā niṣkāsito 'nyatra gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: They seized him by the neck and threw him out, and he went elsewhere.

children.text: tasmādapi niṣkāsito yāvat kroḍamallānāṃ madhye praviṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Driven out from there as well, he went on until he entered among the <s>kroḍamallaka</s> alms-seekers.

children.text: te yatra yatra bhaikṣārthikāḥ praviśanti tatra nirbhartsyante niṣkāsyante ca ||
children.translated_text: Wherever those who sought alms entered, there they were abused and driven out.

children.text: te nairāśyamāpannā riktahastakā riktamallakāḥ śūnyadevakulamaṇḍapavṛkṣamūlānyāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having fallen into despair, with empty hands and empty bowls, they came to empty shrines, pavilions, and the roots of trees.

children.text: te 'nyonyaṃ pṛcchanti bhavantaḥ vayaṃ pūrve yatra yatra gacchāmastataḥ pūrṇahastāḥ pūrṇamallakā āgacchāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They asked one another, "Sirs, formerly, wherever we went, we came back from there with full hands and full bowls.

children.text: idānīṃ ko yogo yena vayaṃ riktahastakā riktamallakā nairāśyamāpannā ihāgatā iti tatraike kathayanti nūnaṃ ko 'pi mandabhāgyo 'smākaṃ madhye praviṣṭo yena vayaṃ riktahastā riktamallakā ihāgatā iti ||
children.translated_text: What connection is there now, by which we have come here with empty hands and empty bowls, fallen into despair?" Some there said, "Surely some ill-fated person has entered among us, because of whom we have come here with empty hands and empty bowls."

children.text: apare kathayanti gatametat ||
children.translated_text: Others said, "Let that be.

children.text: dvidhā bhūtvā praviśāma iti ||
children.translated_text: Let us split into two groups and enter."

children.text: te parasmin divase dvidhā praviṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: On the next day they entered in two groups.

children.text: tatra yeṣāṃ madhye svāgataste tathaiva nirbhartsitā niṣkāsitāśca nairāśyamāpannā riktahastā riktamallāśca yathānilayamāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those among whom <s>Svāgata</s> was present were abused and driven out in just the same way, and, having fallen into despair, returned to their lodging with empty hands and empty bowls.

children.text: te tvanye pūrṇahastāḥ pūrṇamallakā āgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: But the others came back with full hands and full bowls.

children.text: ye te riktahastakā riktapātrā āgatāste bhūyo dvidhā bhūtvā praviṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those who had come back with empty hands and empty bowls again divided into two and entered.

children.text: tatra teṣāmapi yeṣāṃ madhye svāgataste tathaiva riktahastā riktamallakāścāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Among them too, those in whose group <s>Svāgata</s> was present came back in the same way with empty hands and empty bowls.

children.text: te bhūyo dvidhā bhūtā evam yāvat svāgatakroḍamallakau praviṣṭau riktahastau riktamallakau āgatau ||
children.translated_text: They again divided into two; thus it went on until <s>Svāgata</s> and one <s>kroḍamallaka</s> entered and came back with empty hands and empty bowls.

children.text: te tvanye pūrṇahastāḥ pūrṇamallakā āgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: But the others came back with full hands and full bowls.

children.text: tataste kroḍamallakāḥ sarve sambhūya saṃkalpaṃ kartumārabdhāḥ bhavantaḥ ayaṃ mandabhāgyo 'smākaṃ madhye praviṣṭo yena vayaṃ riktahastā riktamallakāścāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then all those <s>kroḍamallakas</s> gathered together and began to make a decision: "Sirs, this ill-fated man has entered among us, because of whom we have come back with empty hands and empty bowls.

children.text: niṣkāsayāma enamiti ||
children.translated_text: Let us drive him out."

children.text: sa taiḥ prabhūtān prahārān dattvā śirasi ca mallakaṃ bhaṅktvā niṣkāsitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They gave him many blows, broke a bowl on his head, and drove him out.

children.text: atrāntare yāvacchrāvasteyo vaṇijo bodhasya gṛhapatervayasyaḥ paṇyamādāya śiśumāragirimanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Meanwhile, a merchant from <s>Śrāvastī</s>, a friend of the householder <s>Bodha</s>, arrived at <s>Śiśumāragiri</s> with merchandise.

children.text: tena svāgato mallakena hastagatena pīṭhīṃ gato mukhabimbakena pratyabhijñāta uktaśca putra tvaṃ bodhagṛhapateḥ putra iti sa kathayati tāta ahaṃ tasya putro durāgata iti ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Svāgata</s>, with a bowl in his hand, came to the counter, the merchant recognized him by the likeness of his face and said, "Son, are you the son of the householder <s>Bodha</s>?" He said, "Father, I am his son, <s>Durāgata</s>."

children.text: sa muhūrtaṃ tūṣṇīṃ sthitvā aśruparyākulekṣaṇaḥ kathayati putra tau tava mātāpitarau kālagatau te jñātayaḥ sa āha teṣāmapi kecit kālagatāḥ kecidihaiva tiṣṭhanto vācamapi na prayacchanti ||
children.translated_text: He remained silent for a moment, his eyes filled with tears, and said, "Son, have those parents of yours passed away? And your relatives?" He replied, "Some of them too have died, and some who remain right here do not even speak to me.

children.text: te dāsīdāsakarmakarapauruṣeyāḥ teṣāmapi kecit kālagatāḥ kecinniṣpalāyitāḥ kecidihaivānyānāśrityāvasthitā vācamapi na prayacchanti ||
children.translated_text: And the female slaves, male slaves, hired workers, and servants? Of them too, some have died, some have run away, and some remain right here dependent on others and do not even speak to me.

children.text: yadavaśiṣṭaṃ dhanaṃ tadapi kiṃcidagninā dagdham ||
children.translated_text: Whatever wealth was left, some of that too was burned by fire.

children.text: ye vaṇikpauruṣeyāḥ paṇyaṃ gṛhītvā dhanārthino deśāntaraṃ mahāsamudraṃ cāvatīrṇāḥ tatrāpi keṣāṃcit paṇyamapaṇyībhūtam kecit tatraivānayena vyasanamāpannāḥ keṣāṃcit kāntāramadhyagatānāṃ taskarairdravyamapahṛtaṃ keṣāṃcinnagarasamīpamanuprāptānāṃ śaulkikaśaulkikairdravyaṃ vicārayadbhiḥ sāro gṛhītaḥ keṣāṃcit pattanamanuprāptānāṃ rājño viniyuktairdoṣamutpādya sarvasvamapahṛtam ||
children.translated_text: As for the merchants' servants who took merchandise and, seeking wealth, went to other countries and crossed the great ocean: for some their merchandise became unsaleable; some met disaster by misfortune right there; for some, while they were in the middle of the wilderness, bandits stole their goods; for some, when they had come near a city, customs officers, examining their property, took the best of it; for some, when they had reached a port, officials appointed by the king fabricated a fault and seized everything.

children.text: kecit tasya prāṇaviyogaṃ śrutvā tatraivāvasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Some, having heard of his loss of life, remained right there."

children.text: sa dīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca niśvasya kathayati putra śrāvastīṃ kiṃ na gacchasi tāta kiṃ tatragatasya bhaviṣyati putra tatrānāthapiṇḍado gṛhapatiḥ tasya putreṇa tava bhaginī pariṇītā ||
children.translated_text: He sighed long and hotly and said, "Son, why do you not go to <s>Śrāvastī</s>?" "Father, what will happen for one who has gone there?" "Son, there is the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> there; your sister has been married to his son.

children.text: sā tava yogodvahanaṃ kariṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: She will provide for your support."

children.text: sa kathayati tāta yadyevaṃ gacchāmīti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Father, if that is so, I will go."

children.text: tena tasya dvau kārṣāpaṇau dattau uktaśca putra ābhyāṃ tāvadātmānaṃ saṃdhāraya yāvadahaṃ paṇyaṃ visarjayāmi ||
children.translated_text: The merchant gave him two <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s> and said, "Son, support yourself with these for now, until I sell my merchandise."

children.text: mayā sārdhaṃ gamiṣyasi ||
children.translated_text: You will go together with me.

children.text: tena tau kārṣāpaṇau khustavastrānte baddhvā sthāpitau karmavipākena vismṛtau ||
children.translated_text: Then, tying those two <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s> in the edge of his garment, he put them away; through the ripening of karma he forgot them.

children.text: tathaivāsau kutaścit kiṃcidārāgayati kiṃcinnārāgayati ||
children.translated_text: In just that way, from somewhere he obtains a little, and a little he does not obtain.

children.text: kṣudhayā pīḍyamāno 'vasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Tormented by hunger, he remained there.

children.text: yāvadasau vaṇik paṇyaṃ visarjayitvā pratipaṇyamādāya svāgataṃ vismṛtya samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After that merchant had sold his merchandise and taken goods in exchange, he forgot <s>Svāgata</s> and set out.

children.text: svāgato 'pi tena sārdhaṃ samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Svāgata</s> too set out with him.

children.text: yāvat te sārthakāḥ kaliṃ kartumārabdhāḥ balīvardā yoddhumārabdhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the caravan men began to quarrel, and the oxen began to fight.

children.text: sārthikāḥ kathayanti bhavantaḥ pratyavekṣata sārtham ||
children.translated_text: The caravan men said, "Sirs, inspect the caravan.

children.text: mā asau durāgato 'trāgataḥ syāditi ||
children.translated_text: Let that ill-come man not have come here."

children.text: taiḥ pratyavekṣamāṇairasau dṛṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When they inspected, they saw him.

children.text: te taṃ khaṭucapeṭādibhis tāḍayitvā ardhacandrākāreṇa grīvāyāṃ gṛhītvā niṣkāsitumārabdhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They beat him with blows of fists, slaps, and the like, seized him by the neck in a crescent-shaped grip, and began to drive him out.

children.text: sa niṣkāsitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was driven out.

children.text: niṣkramyamāṇo vikroṣṭumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As he was being driven out, he began to cry out.

children.text: sārthavāhastaṃ kolāhalaśabdaṃ śrutvā nirīkṣitumārabdhaḥ yāvat paśyati taṃ niṣkāsyamānam ||
children.translated_text: The caravan leader heard that sound of commotion and began to look; then he saw him being driven out.

children.text: sa kathayati bhavantaḥ mā enaṃ niṣkāsayata mamaiṣa vayasyaputro bhavatīti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Sirs, do not drive him out. He is the son of my friend."

children.text: te kathayanti sārthavāha yamāgamya bodhasya gṛhapateranekadhanasamuditaṃ sasuhṛtsambandhibāndhavaṃ gṛhaṃ vinaṣṭam kathaṃ tena sārdhaṃ gacchāmaḥ sarvathā tvaṃ sārthasya svāmī ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Caravan leader, through whose arrival the house of the householder <s>Bodha</s> of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s>, rich with much wealth and with friends, relations, and kinsmen, was destroyed, how can we travel with him? In every respect, you are the master of the caravan.

children.text: yadyeṣa gacchati vayaṃ na gacchāma iti ||
children.translated_text: If he goes, we do not go."

children.text: sārthavāhastaṃ kathayati putra mahājanavirodho 'tra bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The caravan leader said to him, "Son, there is opposition from the great crowd here.

children.text: sārthakāḥ kṣubhitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The caravan men are agitated.

children.text: tvaṃ paścādvāsodghātikayā gaccha ahaṃ tavārthe āhāraṃ sthāpayāmīti ||
children.translated_text: You go behind by the rear trail; I will set aside food for you."

children.text: sa mātāpitṛviyogapratispardhinā pūrvakarmāparādhaprabhāveṇa duḥkhadaurmanasyena saṃtāpitamanāḥ sāśrukaṇṭhastūṣṇīmavasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: His mind was scorched by grief and dejection, rivaling separation from his parents, through the force of the fault of former karma; with his throat full of tears, he remained silent.

children.text: sārthaḥ samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The caravan set out.

children.text: so 'pi vāsodghātikayā gantumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He too began to go by the rear trail.

children.text: sa sārthavāhastasyāhāraṃ patrapuṭake baddhvā kiṃcidbhūmau pāṃśunā praticchādya sthāpayati kiṃcidvṛkṣaśākhāpatrairavacchādya ||
children.translated_text: That caravan leader tied food for him in a packet of leaves and set some of it on the ground, covered with dust, and some covered with leaves on branches of trees.

children.text: tatra yaṃ bhūmau sthāpayati sa śṛgālairanyaiścatuṣpadairbhakṣyate ||
children.translated_text: There, what he set on the ground was eaten by jackals and other quadrupeds.

children.text: yaṃ vṛkṣaśākhāsu sa pakṣibhiḥ śākhāmṛgaiśca bhakṣyate ||
children.translated_text: What he placed among the tree-branches was eaten by birds and monkeys.

children.text: tataḥ kiṃcidārāgayati kiṃcinnārāgayati ||
children.translated_text: Thereafter he obtains a little, and a little he does not obtain.

children.text: asthānamanavakāśo yaccaramabhavikaḥ sattvo 'samprāpte viśeṣādhigame so 'ntarā kālaṃ kuryāt ||
children.translated_text: It is impossible, there is no occasion, that a being in his final existence should die in the meantime before attaining the special realization.

children.text: sa kṛcchreṇa śrāvastīmanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With difficulty he reached <s>Śrāvastī</s>.

children.text: bahiḥ śrāvastyāmudapānopakaṇṭhake viśrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Outside <s>Śrāvastī</s>, he rested near a well.

children.text: yāvat tasya bhaginyāḥ santikā preṣyadārikā udakārthinī kumbhamādāya gatā ||
children.translated_text: Then a servant girl from his sister's presence went, taking a water jar, in order to get water.

children.text: sa tayā mukhabimbakena pratyabhijñātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: She recognized him by the likeness of his face.

children.text: sā ciraṃ nirīkṣya hīnadīnavadanā kathayati dāraka tvaṃ bodhasya gṛhapateḥ śuśumāragirīyakasya putra iti sa kathayati evaṃ māṃ bhaginījanaḥ saṃjānīta iti ||
children.translated_text: After looking at him for a long time, with a low and wretched face she said, "Boy, are you the son of the householder <s>Bodha</s> of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s>?" He said, "So the people of my sister's household know me."

children.text: sā aśruparyākulekṣaṇā bāṣpoparudhyamānakaṇṭhā urasi prahāraṃ dattvā karuṇādīnavilambitākṣaraṃ praṣṭumārabdhā ||
children.translated_text: With her eyes filled with tears and her throat choked by sobbing, she struck her breast and began to ask in syllables drawn out with compassion and distress:

children.text: tau tava mātāpitarau kālagatau kālagatau ||
children.translated_text: "Those parents of yours have passed away, have they passed away?"

children.text: te jñātayaḥ sa kathayati teṣāmapi kecit kālagatāḥ kecinniṣpalāyitāḥ kecit tatraiva tiṣṭhanto vācamapi na prayacchanti ||
children.translated_text: "And your relatives?" He said, "Of them too, some have passed away, some have fled, and some, remaining right there, do not even speak to me.

children.text: te dāsīdāsakarmakarapauruṣeyās teṣāmapi kecit kālagatāḥ kecinniṣpalāyitāḥ kecit tatraivānyānāśrityāvasthitā vācamapi na prayacchanti ||
children.translated_text: "And the female slaves, male slaves, laborers, and servants?" "Of them too, some have passed away, some have fled, and some, staying right there dependent on others, do not even speak to me.

children.text: yadapi dhanajātaṃ tadapi kiṃcidagninā dagdham kiṃcidanyapauruṣeyā gṛhītvā dhanārthino deśāntaraṃ mahāsamudraṃ cāvatīrṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whatever wealth there was, some was burned by fire, and some other persons took it and, seeking wealth, went to another country and embarked on the great ocean.

children.text: tatrāpi keṣāṃcidyānapātraṃ vipannam keṣāṃcit paṇyamapaṇyībhūtam kecit tatraivānayena vyasanamāpannāḥ keṣāṃcit kāntāramadhyagatānāṃ taskarairdravyamapahṛtam keṣāṃcinnagarasamīpamanuprāptānāṃ śaulkikaśaulkikairdravyaṃ vicārayadbhiḥ sāro gṛhītaḥ keṣāṃcit pattanamanuprāptānāṃ rājaniyuktairdoṣamutpādya sarvasvamapahṛtam kecittasya prāṇaviyogaṃ śrutvā tatraivāvasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: There too, some people's vessels came to ruin, some people's merchandise became unsalable, some there met with disaster through misfortune, some who had gone into the middle of a wilderness had their property stolen by bandits, some who had reached the vicinity of a city had the best part taken by customs officers who were inspecting goods for duty, some who reached a port had all their property taken by royal appointees after a charge was raised, and some, hearing of his death, remained there.

children.text: sā dīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca niśvasya kathayati ihaiva tiṣṭha yāvatte bhaginyāḥ kathayāmīti ||
children.translated_text: She sighed long and hot and said, "Stay right here until I tell your sister."

children.text: tayā gatvā tasyāḥ pracchannaṃ kathitam ||
children.translated_text: She went and told her secretly.

children.text: kīdṛśena paṇyeneti sā kathayati kuto 'sya paṇyam daṇḍamasya haste mallakaśceti ||
children.translated_text: "With what sort of merchandise?" She said, "Where would he have merchandise? He has a staff in his hand and a small bowl."

children.text: tayā tasyārthaṃ mahārhāṇi vastrāṇi dattāni ||
children.translated_text: She gave costly garments for his sake.

children.text: kārṣāpaṇāṃśca dattvā uktā ca sa vaktavyo yadi te bhāgineyo vā bhāgineyikā vā upasaṃkrāmati tasyaiva kārṣāpaṇān dadyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: After giving <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>, she also said, "He should be told: If your nephew or niece comes to you, you should give the <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s> to that very one,

children.text: mā jñātīnāṃ pratarkyo bhaviṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: so that he will not become an object of suspicion among the relatives."

children.text: sā vastrāṇyādāya kārṣāpaṇāṃśca tasya sakāśaṃ gatā kathayati imāni te vastrāṇi kārṣāpaṇāśca bhaginyā preṣitāni kathayati ca yadi te bhāgineyo vā bhāgineyikā vā upasaṃkrāmati tasyaitatkārṣāpaṇān dadyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: She took the clothes and the <s>kārṣāpaṇa</s> coins and went to him. She said, "These clothes and <s>kārṣāpaṇa</s> coins have been sent to you by your sister. And she says, 'If your nephew or niece comes to you, give these <s>kārṣāpaṇa</s> coins to that child.'"

children.text: mā jñātīnāṃ pratarkyo bhaviṣyasi ||
children.translated_text: "Do not become an object of suspicion among the relatives."

children.text: sa kathayati śobhanameva bhavati ||
children.translated_text: He said, "That is fine."

children.text: ityuktvā tūṣṇīmavasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having said this, he remained silent.

children.text: dārikā prakrāntā ||
children.translated_text: The girl departed.

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati anāthapiṇḍado gṛhapatirvistīrṇasvajanaparivāraḥ ||
children.translated_text: He reflected, "The householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> has a broad circle of kinsmen and attendants."

children.text: asmākamapi pitā vistīrṇaparivāraḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Our father too had a broad circle of attendants."

children.text: teṣāmekaikaśo vārtāṃ pratyavekṣate ||
children.translated_text: "He looks into the affairs of each one of them individually."

children.text: bhaginyā ciramālāpo bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: "There will be a long conversation with my sister."

children.text: sa ca mārgapariśramakhinnena kṣudhārtena na śakyate kartum ||
children.translated_text: "And, worn out by the fatigue of the road and hungry, I cannot do that."

children.text: purobhakṣikāṃ tāvat karomi ||
children.translated_text: "First I will eat something before the meal."

children.text: tṛptaḥ sukhālāpam udyānaṃ gatvā śayitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Satisfied, he went for pleasant conversation to the park and lay down.

children.text: ācaritaṃ śrāvastyāmudyānamoṣakāḥ puruṣāḥ pratidinam anvāhiṇḍyante ||
children.translated_text: It was the custom in <s>Śrāvastī</s> that men who robbed parks wandered about every day.

children.text: te yadi suptaṃ puruṣaṃ paśyanti pādena ghaṭṭayanti ||
children.translated_text: If they saw a man asleep, they nudged him with the foot.

children.text: sa yadi prativibudhyate tamevaṃ vadanti bhoḥ puruṣa na tvayā śrutam yathā śrāvastyāmudyānamoṣakāḥ puruṣāḥ pratidinamanvāhiṇḍyante te yadi suptaṃ puruṣaṃ paśyanti vadanti uttiṣṭha gaccheti ||
children.translated_text: If he woke up, they would say this to him: "Sir, have you not heard that in <s>Śrāvastī</s> men who rob parks wander about every day? If they see a man asleep, they say, 'Get up, go away.'"

children.text: yadi na prativibudhyate muṣitvā gacchanti ||
children.translated_text: If he did not wake up, they robbed him and went away.

children.text: taiḥ pādena ghaṭṭito na prativibudhyate ||
children.translated_text: Nudged by them with the foot, he did not wake up.

children.text: muṣitvā prakrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They robbed him and departed.

children.text: sa vigatamadyamadaḥ pratibuddho yāvat paśyati tānyevānantakāni prāvṛtyāvasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the intoxication of liquor had left him, he woke up; and when he looked, he saw that he remained wearing only those same undergarments.

children.text: tato 'sya bhaginī saṃlakṣayati aticirayatyasau ||
children.translated_text: Then his sister reflected, "He is taking too long."

children.text: nūnamatra kāraṇena bhavitavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: "There must surely be some reason here."

children.text: tasyāsau dārikā punaḥ preṣitā dārike gaccha cirayatyasau paśya kimarthaṃ nāgacchatīti ||
children.translated_text: That girl of hers was sent again: "Girl, go. He is delaying; see why he has not come."

children.text: sā gatā yāvat paśyati muṣitakaṃ tenaiva veṣeṇāvasthitam ||
children.translated_text: She went, and when she looked, she saw him robbed and remaining in just that same dress.

children.text: sā tvaritatvaritaṃ gatā tasyāḥ kathayati ārye muṣitastenaiva veṣeṇa tiṣṭhatīti ||
children.translated_text: She went back very quickly and told her, "Noble lady, he has been robbed and is standing there in just that same dress."

children.text: sā saṃlakṣayati yamāgamya bodhasya gṛhapateranekadhanasamuditaṃ sasuhṛtsambandhibāndhavaṃ gṛhaṃ vinaṣṭam yadi tamiha praveśayāmi sthānametadvidyate yanmayāpi śvaśuragṛhamanayena vyasanamāpatsyate ||
children.translated_text: She reflected, "Because of the one by whose arrival the house of the householder <s>Bodha</s>, full of abundant wealth and with friends, relations, and kinsmen, was ruined, if I let him enter here, it is possible that through misfortune I too may bring disaster upon my husband's household."

children.text: nāsāviha praveśayitavyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "He must not be let in here."

children.text: iti viditvā tayāpyupekṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having understood this, she too disregarded him.

children.text: tasyāpi pūrvakarmāparādhādvismṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Because of the fault of his former karma, this too was forgotten by him.

children.text: sa kroḍamallakānāṃ madhye praviṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He entered among the <s>kroḍamallakas</s>, beggars carrying bowls.

children.text: te yatra yatra bhaikṣārthinaḥ praviśanti tatra tatra nirbhartsyante ca niṣkāsyante ca ||
children.translated_text: Wherever they entered in search of alms, there they were rebuked and driven out.

children.text: nairāśyamāpannā riktahastā riktamallakāḥ śūnyadevakulamaṇḍapavṛkṣamūlānyāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having fallen into despair, empty-handed and with empty bowls, they came to empty temples, halls, and tree-roots.

children.text: te 'nyonyaṃ pṛcchanti bhavantaḥ vayaṃ pūrvam yatra yatra gacchāmastataḥ pūrṇahastāḥ pūrṇamallakā gacchāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They asked one another, "Gentlemen, formerly, wherever we went, from there we came away with full hands and full bowls."

children.text: idānīṃ ko yogo yena vayaṃ riktahastā riktamallakā nairāśyamāpannā ihāgatā iti tatraike kathayanti nūnaṃ ko 'pi mandabhāgyo 'smākaṃ madhye praviṣṭo yena vayaṃ riktahastā riktamallakā ihāgatā iti ||
children.translated_text: "Now what is the cause by which we have come here empty-handed, with empty bowls, and fallen into despair?" Some among them said, "Surely some ill-fated person has entered among us, because of whom we have come here empty-handed and with empty bowls."

children.text: apare kathayanti dvidhā bhūtvā praviśāma iti ||
children.translated_text: Others said, "Let us enter after dividing into two groups."

children.text: te 'parasmin divase dvidhā bhūtvā praviṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: On the next day they entered after dividing into two groups.

children.text: tatra yeṣāṃ madhye svāgataḥ te tathaiva nirbhartsitā niṣkāsitāśca nairāśyamāpannā riktahastā riktamallakāścāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: There, the group among whom <s>Svāgata</s> was present were rebuked in the same way and driven out, and they came back fallen into despair, empty-handed and with empty bowls.

children.text: te tvanye pūrṇahastāḥ pūrṇamallakā āgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: But the others came back with full hands and full bowls.

children.text: ye riktahastā riktamallakā āgatāḥ te bhūyo dvidhā bhūtvā praviṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those who had come back empty-handed and with empty bowls entered again after dividing into two groups.

children.text: teṣāmapi yeṣāṃ madhye svāgataḥ te tathaiva riktahastā riktamallakāścāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Among them too, the group in which <s>Svāgata</s> was present likewise came back empty-handed and with empty bowls.

children.text: te bhūyo dvidhā bhūtā evam yāvat svāgato 'nyaśca kroḍamallakaḥ praviṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They again divided into two groups; in this way it continued until <s>Svāgata</s> and one other <s>kroḍamallaka</s> entered together.

children.text: tau riktahastau riktamallakau āgatau te tvanye pūrṇahastāḥ pūrṇamallakā āgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those two came back empty-handed and with empty bowls, while the others came back with full hands and full bowls.

children.text: te kroḍamallakāḥ sarve sambhūya saṃjalpaṃ kartumārabdhāḥ bhavantaḥ ayaṃ mandabhāgyasattvo 'smākaṃ madhye praviṣṭo yena vayaṃ riktahastā riktamallakāścāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: All those <s>kroḍamallakas</s> assembled and began to discuss: "Gentlemen, this ill-fated being has entered among us, because of whom we have come back empty-handed and with empty bowls."

children.text: niṣkāsayāma enamiti ||
children.translated_text: "Let us expel him."

children.text: sa taiḥ prabhūtān prahārān dattvā śirasi ca mallakaṃ bhaṅktvā niṣkāsitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After giving him many blows and breaking a bowl on his head, they expelled him.

children.text: atrāntare 'nāthapiṇḍadena gṛhapatinā buddhapramukho bhikṣusaṃgho 'ntargṛhe bhaktenopanimantritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Meanwhile the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> had invited the community of monks headed by the Buddha to a meal inside his house.

children.text: tena dauvārikāṇāmājñā dattā na tāvat kasyacit kroḍamallakasya praveśo dātavyo yāvadbuddhapramukhena bhikṣusaṃghena bhuktam ||
children.translated_text: He gave an order to the doorkeepers: "No <s>kroḍamallaka</s> at all is to be allowed entry until the community of monks headed by the Buddha has eaten."

children.text: paścāt tān bhojayiṣyāmīti ||
children.translated_text: "Afterwards I will feed them."

children.text: kroḍamallakā ye tasya gṛhaṃ pratiśaraṇabhūtāste sarve saṃnipatitāḥ praveṣṭumārabdhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>kroḍamallakas</s> for whom his house was a refuge all assembled and began to enter.

children.text: dauvārikeṇa virodhitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They were stopped by the doorkeeper.

children.text: kathayanti bhoḥ puruṣa asmākameva nāmnā ayaṃ gṛhapatiḥ prajñāyate anāthapiṇḍado gṛhapatiriti ||
children.translated_text: They say, "Sir, this householder is known by our very name, as the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>."

children.text: tat kimidamiti kṛtvā asmān vidhārayasīti sa kathayati gṛhapatinā ājñā dattā na tāvat kasyacit kroḍamallakasya praveśo dātavyo yāvadbuddhapramukhena bhikṣusaṃghena bhuktam ||
children.translated_text: "So why, then, are you holding us back?" He says, "The householder has given an order: no kroḍamallaka is to be allowed entry until the community of monks headed by the Buddha has eaten."

children.text: paścāt tān bhojayiṣyāmīti ||
children.translated_text: "Afterwards I shall feed them."

children.text: te kathayanti bhavantaḥ na kadācidvayaṃ vidhāryamāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say, "Sirs, we have never been held back before."

children.text: taṃ paśyata mā atrāryā durāgata āgato bhavediti ||
children.translated_text: "Look for him, lest, noble sirs, an ill-arrived man has come here."

children.text: te samanveṣitumārabdhā yāvat paśyantyekasmin pradeśe nilīyāvasthitam ||
children.translated_text: They began to search, until they saw him standing hidden in one place.

children.text: tatastaiḥ kolāhalaśabdaḥ kṛtaḥ ayaṃ bhavantaḥ sa durāgato nilīnastiṣṭhatīti ||
children.translated_text: Then they made a tumultuous noise: "Sirs, this ill-arrived fellow is standing hidden here."

children.text: sa taiḥ prabhūtān prahārān dattvā niṣkāsitastīvreṇa ca paryavasthānena śirasi mallakena prahāro dattaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After giving him many blows, they threw him out, and in fierce rage a blow was struck on his head with a vessel.

children.text: tasya śiro bhagnam ||
children.translated_text: His head was broken.

children.text: sa nivartya vipralapitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He turned back and began to babble.

children.text: tatastairhastapādeṣu gṛhītvā saṃkārakūṭe kṣiptaḥ durāgata atra tiṣṭheti ||
children.translated_text: Then, taking him by the hands and feet, they threw him onto a rubbish heap: "Ill-arrived one, stay here."

children.text: sa rudhireṇa pragharatā tasmin saṃkārakūṭe 'vasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With blood streaming, he remained on that rubbish heap.

children.text: yāvadbhagavān pūrvāhṇe nivāsya pātracīvaramādāya bhikṣugaṇaparivṛto bhikṣusaṃghapuraskṛto yenānāthapiṇḍadasya gṛhapater niveśanaṃ tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, having dressed in the forenoon and taken his bowl and robe, surrounded by a group of monks and preceded by the community of monks, went to the dwelling of the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>.

children.text: adrākṣīdbhagavān svāgataṃ paruṣarūkṣāṅgulidīrghakeśaṃ rajasāvacūrṇitagātraṃ kṛśamalpasthānaṃ malinajīrṇavāsonivasitaṃ śirasā bhagnena rudhireṇa pragharatā anyaiśca vraṇaiścākīrṇaiḥ makṣikābhirupadrutaiḥ saṃkārakūṭe nipatitam ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One saw <s>Svāgata</s> fallen on the rubbish heap: harsh and rough, with long nails and hair, his limbs covered with dust, emaciated and reduced, wearing dirty worn-out clothes, his head broken and streaming with blood, covered with other wounds, and harassed by flies.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā ca punarbhikṣūnāmantrayate sma tṛpyata bhikṣavaḥ sarvabhavopapattibhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having seen him, he addressed the monks: "Monks, have enough of all rebirths in existence."

children.text: tṛpyata sarvabhavopapattyupakaraṇebhyaḥ yatra nāma caramabhavikasya sattvasyeyamavasthā ||
children.translated_text: "Have enough of all the conditions for rebirth in existence, where such is the state of a being in his final existence."

children.text: tatra bhagavāṃs taṃ svāgatamāmantrayate ākāṅkṣase vatsa pātraśeṣam bhagavan ||
children.translated_text: There the Blessed One addressed <s>Svāgata</s>: "Child, do you want the bowl-remnant?" "Lord."

children.text: tatra bhagavānāyuṣmantamānandamāmantrayate svāgatasya te ānanda pātraśeṣaḥ sthāpayitavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: There the Blessed One addressed the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: "<s>Ānanda</s>, the bowl-remnant is to be set aside by you for <s>Svāgata</s>."

children.text: evaṃ bhadantetyāyuṣmānānando bhagavataḥ pratyaśrauṣīt ||
children.translated_text: "So be it, venerable sir," the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> replied to the Blessed One.

children.text: atha bhagavān yenānāthapiṇḍadasya gṛhapaterbhaktābhisārastenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One went to the meal offering at the dwelling of the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>.

children.text: upasaṃkramya purastādbhikṣusaṃghasya prajñapta evāsane niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having gone there, he sat down on the prepared seat in front of the community of monks.

children.text: anāthapiṇḍado gṛhapatiḥ sukhopaniṣaṇṇaṃ buddhapramukhaṃ bhikṣusaṃghaṃ viditvā praṇītena khādanīyabhojanīyena svahastena saṃtarpya saṃpravārya bhagavantaṃ bhuktavantaṃ viditvā dhautahastamapanītapātraṃ nīcataramāsanaṃ gṛhītvā bhagavataḥ purastānniṣaṇṇo dharmaśravaṇāya ||
children.translated_text: Knowing that the community of monks headed by the Buddha was comfortably seated, the householder <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s> satisfied and served them with excellent hard and soft foods with his own hand; then, knowing that the Blessed One had eaten, that his hands were washed and his bowl removed, he took a lower seat and sat before the Blessed One to hear the Dharma.

children.text: āyuṣmata ānandasya tatpātraśeṣaṃ svāgatāya vismṛtam ||
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Ānanda</s> forgot that bowl-remnant for <s>Svāgata</s>.

children.text: asaṃmoṣadharmāṇo buddhā bhagavantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Buddhas, Blessed Ones, are by nature free from forgetfulness.

children.text: bhagavatā utthāpitam ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One lifted it up.

children.text: āyuṣmānānando bhagavataḥ pātraṃ gṛhītumārabdho yāvat paśyati tatra pātraśeṣaṃ na saṃsthāpitam ||
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Ānanda</s> began to take the Blessed One's bowl, until he saw that the bowl-remnant had not been set aside there.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā ca smṛtirutpannā ||
children.translated_text: Having seen it, his memory arose.

children.text: sa dharmatattvo vacasā atha roditumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, as the fact of the matter came to him, he began to weep.

children.text: bhagavānāha kasmāt tvamānanda rodiṣīti ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, "Why are you weeping, <s>Ānanda</s>?"

children.text: sa kathayati na mayā bhadanta bhagavataḥ kadācidājñā pratyūḍhapūrveti ||
children.translated_text: He says, "Venerable sir, never before have I failed to carry out the Blessed One's command."

children.text: kiṃ kṛtam svāgatasya pātraśeṣaṃ na sthāpitamiti ||
children.translated_text: "What has been done? The bowl-remnant for <s>Svāgata</s> was not set aside."

children.text: bhagavānāha na tvayā ānanda mamājñā pratismṛtā api tu svāgatasyaiva tāni karmāṇi labdhasambhārāṇi pariṇatapratyayānyoghavatpratyupasthitānyavaśyabhāvīni yena tava vismṛtam ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, "<s>Ānanda</s>, it was not that you forgot my command; rather, those very deeds of <s>Svāgata</s>, having acquired their accumulations, with their conditions matured, were present like a flood and were inevitable, so that you forgot."

children.text: alaṃ viṣādena ||
children.translated_text: "Enough with grief."

children.text: gaccha taṃ śabdāpayeti ||
children.translated_text: "Go and call him."

children.text: sa gatvā śabdāpayitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He went and began to call out.

children.text: anekaiḥ prativacanaṃ dattam ||
children.translated_text: Replies were given by many.

children.text: svāgatasya tadapi vismṛtam yadbhagavatā pratijñātam tava pātraśeṣaṃ sthāpayiṣyāmīti ||
children.translated_text: Even this had been forgotten by <s>Svāgata</s>: that the Blessed One had promised, "I shall set aside the bowl-remnant for you."

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati ko 'pyayaṃ puṇyakarmā bhagavatā trailokyaguruṇā samanvāhṛtaḥ śabdata iti ||
children.translated_text: He considered, "Some man of meritorious karma, attended to by the Blessed One, the teacher of the three worlds, is being called."

children.text: āyuṣmatā ānandena gatvā bhagavata ārocitam ||
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Ānanda</s> went and reported to the Blessed One.

children.text: bhagavan svāgata ityuktvā anekaiḥ prativacanaṃ dattam ||
children.translated_text: "Lord, when '<s>Svāgata</s>' was said, replies were given by many."

children.text: na jāne kaṃ śabdāpayāmīti ||
children.translated_text: "I do not know whom I should call."

children.text: bhagavānāha gaccha ānanda gatvā kathaya yo bodhasya gṛhapateḥ śuśumāragirīyasya putraḥ svāgataḥ sa āgacchatu iti ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, "Go, <s>Ānanda</s>, and say: 'Let <s>Svāgata</s>, son of the householder <s>Bodha</s> of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s>, come.'"

children.text: āyuṣmatā ānandena gatvoccaiḥ śabdairuktaḥ yo bodhasya gṛhapateḥ śuśumāragirīyakasya putraḥ svāgataḥ sa āgacchatu iti ||
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Ānanda</s> went and said in a loud voice, "Let <s>Svāgata</s>, son of the householder <s>Bodha</s> of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s>, come."

children.text: tena pitur nāmaśravaṇādātmano nāma smṛtam ||
children.translated_text: On hearing his father's name, he remembered his own name.

children.text: sa śanairdaṇḍaviṣṭambhanayogādutthāya gāthāṃ bhāṣate
children.translated_text: Slowly, using a staff for support, he stood up and spoke a verse:

children.text: bhraṣṭaḥ svāgataśabdo 'yaṃ kutaḥ punarihāgataḥ
children.translated_text: "This word '<s>Svāgata</s>' had fallen away; whence has it come here again?"

children.text: nūnamaśreyaso nāśaḥ śreyasaśca samudbhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Surely misfortune is being destroyed, and good fortune is arising."

children.text: teṣāṃ sarvajña nātho 'si ye hi tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
children.translated_text: For those who have gone to you for refuge, O omniscient one, you are their lord.

children.text: teṣāṃ svāgatamāryāṇām ye ca te śāsane ratāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those noble ones who delight in your teaching are truly welcome.

children.text: ahaṃ tu bhāgyarahitaḥ sarvabandhuvivarjitaḥ
children.translated_text: But I am bereft of fortune, deprived of every kinsman,

children.text: śocyaḥ kaṣṭāṃ daśāṃ prāptaḥ śokaśalyasamarpitaḥ
children.translated_text: pitiable, fallen into a wretched condition, pierced by the dart of grief.

children.text: iti ||
children.translated_text: Thus.

children.text: athāyuṣmānānandastamādāya yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then venerable <s>Ānanda</s> took him and approached the Blessed One.

children.text: upasaṃkramya bhagavantamidamavocat ayaṃ bhadanta svāgata iti ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, he said this to the Blessed One: "Venerable sir, this is <s>Svāgata</s>."

children.text: sa bhagavatā kṣudhāsaṃjanitadaurmanasyaḥ samāśvāsitaḥ uktaśca putra imaṃ pātraśeṣaṃ paribhuṅkṣveti ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One comforted him, despondent because of the hunger that had arisen, and said, "Son, eat this remnant from the bowl."

children.text: sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃlakṣayati yadyapyahaṃ bhagavatā trailokyaguruṇā daivāt samanvāhṛtaḥ tadapi stokaḥ pātraśeṣaḥ sthāpitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeing it, he thought, "Although by good fortune I have been attended to by the Blessed One, the teacher of the three worlds, still only a small remnant from the bowl has been set aside.

children.text: kimatra bhokṣya iti ||
children.translated_text: What is there here to eat?"

children.text: bhagavāṃstasya cetasā cittamājñāya kathayati vatsa yadi tvaṃ sumerumātraiḥ piṇḍaiḥ samudrasadṛśena kukṣiṇā paribhokṣyase tathāpyavyayaṃ tanna parikṣayaṃ gamiṣyati yāvattṛptaḥ paribhuṅkṣva yathāsukhamiti ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One, knowing his thought with his own mind, said, "Child, even if you were to eat morsels as large as <s>Sumeru</s> with a belly like the ocean, still this would be inexhaustible; it will not be depleted. Eat as you please until you are satisfied."

children.text: tena tāvad bhuktam yāvat tṛpta iti ||
children.translated_text: He ate until he was satisfied.

children.text: tatsaṃtarpitendriyo bhagavato mukhaṃ vyavalokayitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With his senses refreshed by that, he began to look at the Blessed One's face.

children.text: bhagavānāha vatsa svāgata tṛpto 'si tṛpto 'smi bhagavan ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, "Child <s>Svāgata</s>, are you satisfied?" "I am satisfied, Blessed One."

children.text: vatsa yadyevamapaścimaṃ kavalaṃ gṛhāṇa antardhāsyatyeṣa pātra iti ||
children.translated_text: "Child, if so, take the final mouthful. This bowl will disappear."

children.text: tenāpaścimakavalo gṛhītaḥ so 'ntarhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He took the final mouthful, and it disappeared.

children.text: bhagavān dakṣiṇādeśanāṃ kṛtvā prakrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One gave the teaching after the gift and departed.

children.text: caramabhavikaḥ sa sattvo bhagavantaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ samanubaddhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: That being, one in his final existence, followed behind the Blessed One step after step.

children.text: yāvadbhagavān vihāraṃ gatvā purastādbhikṣusaṃghasya prajñapta evāsane niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At last the Blessed One went to the monastery and sat down on the seat prepared in front of the community of monks.

children.text: so 'pi bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He too bowed with his head at the Blessed One's feet and sat to one side.

children.text: bhagavān saṃlakṣayati puṣpāṇāmenaṃ preṣayāmi karmāpanayo 'sya kartavya iti viditvā svāgatamāmantrayate vatsa svāgata santi te kārṣāpaṇāḥ na santi bhagavan ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One thought, "I shall send him for flowers; the removal of his karma must be done." Knowing this, he addressed <s>Svāgata</s>: "Child <s>Svāgata</s>, do you have any <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s> (coins)?" "I do not, Blessed One."

children.text: vatsa svāgata vastrāntaṃ nirīkṣasva ||
children.translated_text: "Child <s>Svāgata</s>, look at the edge of your garment."

children.text: vastrāntaṃ nirīkṣitumārabdho yāvat paśyati dvau kārṣāpaṇau ||
children.translated_text: He began to look at the edge of his garment, and then he saw two <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>.

children.text: sa kathayati bhagavan dvau kārṣāpaṇau ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Blessed One, two <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>."

children.text: vatsa gaccha gaṇḍakasyārāmikasya sakāśānnīlotpalāni gṛhītvā āgaccheti ||
children.translated_text: "Child, go to <s>Gaṇḍaka</s> the park attendant, get blue lotuses from him, and come back."

children.text: svāgatastasya sakāśaṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Svāgata</s> went to him.

children.text: sa taṃ dūrādeva dṛṣṭvā paryavasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeing him from afar, he became disturbed.

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati āgato 'yaṃ durāgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He thought, "This ill-arrived man has come.

children.text: niyataṃ mamānartho bhavati ||
children.translated_text: Surely some misfortune will befall me."

children.text: iti viditvā saparuṣaṃ kathayati durāgata kimarthaṃ ihāgacchasīti ||
children.translated_text: Knowing this, he spoke harshly: "Ill-arrived one, why have you come here?"

children.text: sa gāthāṃ bhāṣate
children.translated_text: He spoke a verse:

children.text: nīlotpalairasti kāryaṃ me tathānyair nāpi paṅkajaiḥ
children.translated_text: "My business is with blue lotuses, and not with any other lotuses.

children.text: munīndrasya tu dūto 'haṃ sarvajñasya yaśasvinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: But I am the messenger of the lord of sages, the glorious omniscient one."

children.text: ityuktvā pratinivartitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having said this, he began to turn back.

children.text: so 'pi gāthāṃ bhāṣate
children.translated_text: He too spoke a verse:

children.text: ehyehi yadi dūto 'si tasya śāntātmano muneḥ
children.translated_text: "Come, come, if you are the messenger of that sage whose self is peaceful.

children.text: pūjyaḥ sa naradevānāṃ pūjyaḥ pūjyatamairapi ||
children.translated_text: He is worshipful to men and gods, worshipful even to the most worshipful."

children.text: ityuktvā sa kathayati buddhadūtastvam buddhadūtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having said this, he asked, "Are you the Buddha's messenger?" "I am the Buddha's messenger."

children.text: kimarthamāgataḥ puṣpārtham ||
children.translated_text: "For what purpose have you come?" "For flowers."

children.text: yadi buddhadūtastvam gṛhāṇa yathepsitam ||
children.translated_text: "If you are the Buddha's messenger, take as much as you wish."

children.text: nīlotpalānāṃ bhāramādāya bhagavataḥ sakāśamāgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Taking a load of blue lotuses, he came to the Blessed One.

children.text: bhagavānāha vatsa bhikṣūṇāṃ cāraya ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, "Child, distribute them among the monks."

children.text: sa bhikṣūṇāṃ cārayitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He began to distribute them among the monks.

children.text: bhikṣavo na pratigṛhṇanti ||
children.translated_text: The monks did not accept them.

children.text: bhagavānāha gṛhṇīdhvaṃ bhikṣavaḥ sarvasaugandham ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, "Monks, accept them, all of them fragrant.

children.text: cakṣurbhyāṃ karmāpanayo 'sya kartavya iti ||
children.translated_text: The removal of his karma must be done through his eyes."

children.text: bhikṣubhirgṛhītāni ||
children.translated_text: The monks accepted them.

children.text: gṛhītvā puṣpitāni ||
children.translated_text: Once they had been accepted, they blossomed.

children.text: tenāpūrvaṃ nīlakṛtsnamutpāditaṃ pūrvam ||
children.translated_text: Through them he first produced an unprecedented blue <s>kṛtsna</s> (totality meditation).

children.text: sa vṛddhānte sthitvā tāni puṣpāṇi dṛṣṭvā sutarāṃ nirīkṣitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Standing at the end of the elders' row and seeing those flowers, he began to look at them all the more intently.

children.text: tasya tannīlakṛtsnam āmukhībhūtam ||
children.translated_text: That blue <s>kṛtsna</s> became present before him.

children.text: tatastaṃ bhagavānāha vatsa kiṃ na pravrajasīti sa kathayati pravrajāmi bhagavanniti ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One said to him, "Child, why do you not go forth?" He said, "I will go forth, Blessed One."

children.text: bhagavatā pravrajita upasaṃpādito manasikāraśca dattaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One gave him the going-forth, conferred full ordination, and gave him an object of contemplation.

children.text: tena yujyamānena ghaṭamānena vyāyacchamānena idameva pañcagaṇḍakaṃ saṃsāracakraṃ calācalaṃ viditvā sarvasaṃskāragatīḥ śatanapatanavikiraṇavidhvaṃsanadharmatayā parāhatya sarvakleśaprahāṇādarhattvaṃ sākṣātkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: As he applied himself, exerted himself, and strove, he understood this very wheel of <s>saṃsāra</s>, with its five knots, as wavering and unstable; having overcome all destinies of conditioned things as being by nature subject to hundreds of falls, collapses, scatterings, and destructions, through the abandoning of all defilements he directly realized arhatship.

children.text: arhan saṃvṛttastraidhātukavītarāgaḥ samaloṣṭakāñcana ākāśapāṇitalasamacitto vāsīcandanakalpo vidyāvidāritāṇḍakośo vidyābhijñāpratisaṃvitprāpto bhavalābhalobhasatkāraparāṅmukhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He became an arhat, free from passion for the three realms, regarding clods and gold alike, with a mind equal toward the sky and the palm of his hand, like sandalwood toward the axe, the eggshell split open by knowledge, possessing knowledge, higher knowledges, and analytical discriminations, and turned away from existence, gain, greed, and honor.

children.text: sendropendrāṇāṃ pūjyo mānyo 'bhivādyaśca saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He became worthy of worship, honor, and salutation by those with <s>Indra</s> and <s>Upendra</s> at their head.

children.text: so 'rhattvaṃ prāpto vimuktisukhapratisaṃvedī tasyāṃ velāyāṃ gāthāṃ bhāṣate
children.translated_text: Having attained arhatship and experiencing the happiness of liberation, at that time he spoke a verse:

children.text: upāyapāśairvīreṇa baddhvāhaṃ tattvadarśinā
children.translated_text: "I was bound by the snares of skillful means by the hero who sees reality,

children.text: kāruṇyāduddhṛto duḥkhājjīrṇaḥ paṅkādiva dvipaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and out of compassion I was lifted up from suffering, like an aged elephant from the mud.

children.text: svāgato 'hamabhūvaṃ prāktataḥ paścāddurāgataḥ
children.translated_text: I was formerly <s>Svāgata</s>; after that, later, <s>Durāgata</s>

children.text: āgato 'smi purā nātha śrutvā vākyaṃ tavottamam ||
children.translated_text: I came long ago, lord, after hearing your excellent word.

children.text: sāmprataṃ svāgato vyaktam saṃvṛtto na durāgataḥ
children.translated_text: Now I have clearly become welcome, and not ill-come.

children.text: sāmprataṃ kāñcanaṃ dehaṃ dhārayāmi nirāśravam ||
children.translated_text: Now I bear a golden body, free from the outflows.

children.text: ratnāni pratilebhe hi svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca kāṅkṣatām
children.translated_text: Indeed, for those who desire jewels, heaven, and liberation,

children.text: śreṣṭhā kalyāṇamitrāṇāṃ sadā sevā hitaiṣiṇām ||
children.translated_text: constant service to good friends who seek one's welfare is best.

children.text: iti ||
children.translated_text: Thus.

children.text: yadā āyuṣmān svāgataḥ svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajitaḥ tadā sāmantakena śabdo visṛtaḥ śramaṇena gautamenāsau durāgataḥ kroḍamallakaḥ pravrajitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the venerable <s>Svāgata</s> had gone forth in the well-proclaimed <s>dharma-vinaya</s> (teaching and discipline), a report spread in the neighborhood: "That ill-come <s>Kroḍamallaka</s> has been ordained by the ascetic <s>Gautama</s>."

children.text: tīrthyaiḥ śrutam ||
children.translated_text: The non-Buddhist ascetics heard it.

children.text: te 'vadhyāyanti kṣipanti vivādayanti śramaṇo bhavanto gautama evamāha sāmantaprāsādikaṃ me śāsanamiti ||
children.translated_text: They disparaged him, reviled him, and argued, saying, "Sirs, the ascetic <s>Gautama</s> says this: 'My teaching is pleasing in every respect.'

children.text: atra kiṃ sāmantaprāsādikamityasya yatredānīṃ durāgataprabhṛtayo 'pi kroḍamallakāḥ pravrajantīti atrāntare nāsti kiṃcidbuddhānāṃ bhagavatāmajñātamadṛṣṭamaviditamavijñātam ||
children.translated_text: What in this is pleasing in every respect, when now even ill-come <s>Kroḍamallakas</s> beginning with <s>Durāgata</s> go forth in it?" At that moment there is nothing unknown, unseen, unrecognized, or unrealized by the blessed Buddhas.

children.text: bhagavān saṃlakṣayati sumeruprakhyo mahāśrāvake mahājanakāyaḥ prasādaṃ pravedayate ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One reflected, "The great mass of people will arouse faith toward the great disciple, who is like <s>Sumeru</s>.

children.text: tadguṇodbhāvanamasya kartavyam kutra kartavyam yatraiva patitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: His qualities must be brought to light. Where should that be done? Precisely where he fell."

children.text: iti jñātvā ānandamāmantrayate sma gaccha ānanda bhikṣūṇāmārocaya tathāgato bhikṣavo bhargeṣu janapadeṣu cārikāṃ cariṣyati ||
children.translated_text: Knowing this, he addressed <s>Ānanda</s>: "Go, <s>Ānanda</s>, announce to the monks: 'Monks, the <s>Tathāgata</s> will wander on tour through the <s>Bharga</s> districts.

children.text: yo yuṣmākamutsahate tathāgatena sārdhaṃ bhargeṣu cārikāṃ cartum sa cīvarakāṇi gṛhṇātu iti ||
children.translated_text: Whoever among you is able to go wandering with the <s>Tathāgata</s> through the <s>Bhargas</s>, let him take his robes.'"

children.text: evaṃ bhadantetyāyuṣmānānando bhagavataḥ pratiśrutya bhikṣūṇāmārocayati bhagavānāyuṣmanto bhargeṣu janapadeṣu cārikāṃ cariṣyati ||
children.translated_text: "Yes, venerable sir," the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> replied to the Blessed One, and he announced to the monks: "Venerable ones, the Blessed One will wander on tour through the <s>Bharga</s> districts.

children.text: yo yuṣmākamutsahate bhagavatā sārdhaṃ bhargeṣu janapadeṣu cārikāṃ caritum sa cīvarakāṇi gṛhṇātu iti ||
children.translated_text: Whoever among you is able to go wandering with the Blessed One through the <s>Bharga</s> districts, let him take his robes."

children.text: atha bhagavān dānto dāntaparivāraḥ śāntaḥ śāntaparivāro mukto muktaparivāra āśvasta āśvastaparivāro vinīto vinītaparivāro 'rhannarhatparivāro vītarāgo vītarāgaparivāraḥ prāsādikaḥ prāsādikaparivāro vṛṣabha iva gogaṇaparivṛto gaja iva kalabhaparivṛtaḥ siṃha iva daṃṣṭrigaṇaparivṛto haṃsarāja iva haṃsagaṇaparivṛtaḥ suparṇīva pakṣigaṇaparivṛto vipra iva śiṣyagaṇaparivṛtaḥ suvaidya ivāturagaṇaparivṛtaḥ śūra iva yodhagaṇaparivṛto deśika ivādhvagagaṇaparivṛtaḥ sārthavāha iva vaṇiggaṇaparivṛtaḥ śreṣṭhīva pauragaṇaparivṛtaḥ koṭṭarāja iva mantrigaṇaparivṛtaścakravartīva putrasahasraparivṛtaścandra iva nakṣatragaṇaparivṛtaḥ sūrya iva raśmisahasraparivṛto dhṛtarāṣṭra iva gandharvagaṇaparivṛto virūḍhaka iva kumbhāṇḍagaṇaparivṛto virūpākṣa iva nāgagaṇaparivṛto dhanada iva yakṣagaṇaparivṛto vemacitrīvāsuragaṇaparivṛtaḥ śakra iva tridaśagaṇaparivṛto brahmeva brahmakāyikagaṇaparivṛtaḥ stimita iva jalanidhiḥ sajala iva jaladharo vimada iva gajapatiḥ sudāntendriyair asaṃkṣobhiteryāpathapracāro dvātriṃśatā mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇaiḥ samalaṃkṛto 'śītyānuvyañjanairvirājitagātro vyāmaprabhālaṃkṛtamūrtiḥ sūryasahasrātirekaprabho jaṅgama iva ratnaparvataḥ samantato bhadrako daśabhirbalaiścaturbhir vaiśāradyaistribhirāveṇikaiḥ smṛtyupasthānairmahākaruṇayā ca samanvāgata ājñātakauṇḍinyabāṣpamahānāmāniruddhaśāriputramaudgalyāyanakāśyapānandaraivataprabhṛtibhir mahāśrāvakaiḥ parivṛto 'nyena ca mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena yena śuśumāragiristenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One, tamed and surrounded by the tamed, peaceful and surrounded by the peaceful, liberated and surrounded by the liberated, comforted and surrounded by the comforted, disciplined and surrounded by the disciplined, an arhat surrounded by arhats, free from passion and surrounded by those free from passion, gracious and surrounded by the gracious, like a bull surrounded by a herd of cattle, like an elephant surrounded by young elephants, like a lion surrounded by fanged beasts, like a king of swans surrounded by a flock of swans, like <s>Suparṇī</s> surrounded by birds, like a brahmin surrounded by pupils, like a good physician surrounded by the sick, like a hero surrounded by warriors, like a guide surrounded by travelers, like a caravan leader surrounded by merchants, like a guild-master surrounded by townsmen, like a king in a fortress surrounded by ministers, like a wheel-turning king surrounded by a thousand sons, like the moon surrounded by constellations, like the sun surrounded by a thousand rays, like <s>Dhṛtarāṣṭra</s> surrounded by gandharvas, like <s>Virūḍhaka</s> surrounded by kumbhāṇḍas, like <s>Virūpākṣa</s> surrounded by nāgas, like <s>Dhanada</s> surrounded by yakṣas, like <s>Vemacitrin</s> surrounded by asuras, like <s>Śakra</s> surrounded by the Thirty-three, and like <s>Brahmā</s> surrounded by the hosts belonging to <s>Brahmā</s>; like a still ocean, like a rain-filled cloud, like a lordly elephant without rut, his conduct in bodily bearing unshaken, his senses well tamed, adorned with the thirty-two marks of a great man, his body radiant with the eighty minor marks, his form adorned with an arm-span halo, with a brilliance surpassing a thousand suns, like a moving mountain of jewels, auspicious on every side, endowed with the ten powers, the four fearlessnesses, the three special foundations of mindfulness, and great compassion, surrounded by great disciples beginning with <s>Ājñātakauṇḍinya</s>, <s>Bāṣpa</s>, <s>Mahānāma</s>, <s>Aniruddha</s>, <s>Śāriputra</s>, <s>Maudgalyāyana</s>, <s>Kāśyapa</s>, <s>Ānanda</s>, and <s>Raivata</s>, and by another great community of monks, approached the place where <s>Śuśumāragiri</s> was.

children.text: anupūrveṇa cārikāṃ carañ śuśumāragirimanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Traveling on tour by stages, he arrived at <s>Śuśumāragiri</s>.

children.text: śuśumāragirau viharati bhiṣaṇikāvane mṛgadāve ||
children.translated_text: He stayed at <s>Śuśumāragiri</s>, in the <s>Bhiṣaṇikā</s> grove, in the deer park.

children.text: aśrauṣuḥ śuśumāragirīyakā brāhmaṇagṛhapatayo bhagavān bhargeṣu janapadeṣu cārikāṃ carañ śuśumāragirimanuprāptaḥ śuśumāragirau viharati bhiṣaṇikāvane mṛgadāva iti ||
children.translated_text: The brahmins and householders of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s> heard: "The Blessed One, wandering on tour through the <s>Bharga</s> districts, has arrived at <s>Śuśumāragiri</s>; he is staying at <s>Śuśumāragiri</s>, in the <s>Bhiṣaṇikā</s> grove, in the deer park."

children.text: śrutvā ca punaḥ saṃghāt saṃghaṃ pūgātpūgaṃ saṃgamya śuśumāragirer niṣkramya yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having heard this, they gathered from assembly to assembly and from guild to guild, went out from <s>Śuśumāragiri</s>, and approached the Blessed One.

children.text: upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte niṣaṇṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: After approaching, they bowed with their heads at the Blessed One's feet and sat down to one side.

children.text: śuśumāragirīyakān brāhmaṇagṛhapatīn dharmyayā kathayā saṃdarśayati samādāpayati samuttejayati saṃpraharṣayati ||
children.translated_text: He instructed the brahmins and householders of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s> with a discourse on Dharma, caused them to undertake it, stirred them up, and gladdened them.

children.text: anekaparyāyeṇa dharmyayā kathayā saṃdarśya samādāpya samuttejya saṃpraharṣya tūṣṇīm ||
children.translated_text: Having in many ways instructed them with a discourse on Dharma, caused them to undertake it, stirred them up, and gladdened them, he became silent.

children.text: atha śuśumāragirīyakā brāhmaṇagṛhapataya utthāyāsanād ekāṃsamuttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā yena bhagavāṃstenāñjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantamidamavocan adhivāsayatvasmākaṃ bhagavāñ śvo 'ntargṛhe bhaktena sārdhaṃ bhikṣusaṃghena ||
children.translated_text: Then the brahmin householders of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s> rose from their seats, arranged their upper garments over one shoulder, and, bowing with joined palms toward the Blessed One, said this to him: "May the Blessed One consent to take tomorrow's meal inside our houses, together with the community of monks."

children.text: adhivāsayati bhagavāñ śuśumāragirīyakānāṃ brāhmaṇagṛhapatīnāṃ tūṣṇībhāvena ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One consented to the invitation of the brahmin householders of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s> by remaining silent.

children.text: atha śuśumāragirīyakā brāhmaṇagṛhapatayo bhagavatas tūṣṇībhāvenādhivāsanāṃ viditvā bhagavato bhāṣitamabhinandyānumodya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavato 'ntikāt prakrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the brahmin householders of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s>, knowing that the Blessed One had consented by silence, rejoiced in and approved the Blessed One's words, bowed with their heads at the Blessed One's feet, and departed from his presence.

children.text: atha śuśumāragirīyakā brāhmaṇagṛhapatayastāmeva rātriṃ śuci praṇītaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ samudānīya kālyamevotthāyāsanakāni prajñapya udakamaṇīn pratiṣṭhāpya bhagavato dūtena kālamārocayanti samayo bhadanta sajjaṃ bhaktam yasyedānīṃ bhagavān kālaṃ manyata iti ||
children.translated_text: Then, during that very night, the brahmin householders of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s> prepared pure and excellent hard and soft food; rising early, they arranged seats, set out water jars, and informed the Blessed One of the time by messenger: "It is time, venerable sir; the meal is ready. Let the Blessed One now consider the proper time."

children.text: atha bhagavān pūrvāhṇe nivāsya pātracīvaramādāya bhikṣugaṇaparivṛto bhikṣusaṃghapuraskṛto yena śuśumāragirīyakānāṃ brāhmaṇagṛhapatīnāṃ bhaktābhisārastenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then in the forenoon the Blessed One dressed, took his bowl and robe, and, surrounded by a group of monks and preceded by the community of monks, went to the meal offering of the brahmin householders of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s>.

children.text: upasaṃkramya prajñapta evāsane niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having arrived, he sat down on the seat that had been prepared.

children.text: śuśumāragirīyakā brāhmaṇagṛhapatayaḥ sukhopaniṣaṇṇaṃ buddhapramukhaṃ bhikṣusaṃghaṃ viditvā śucinā praṇītena khādanīyabhojanīyena svahastena saṃtarpayanti saṃpravārayanti ||
children.translated_text: When the brahmin householders of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s> knew that the community of monks headed by the Buddha was comfortably seated, they satisfied and served them with pure and excellent hard and soft food with their own hands.

children.text: anekaparyāyeṇa śucinā praṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena svahastaṃ saṃtarpya saṃpravārya bhagavantaṃ bhuktavantaṃ viditvā dhautahastamapanītapātraṃ nīcataramāsanaṃ gṛhītvā bhagavataḥ purastānniṣaṇṇā dharmaśravaṇāya ||
children.translated_text: After, in many ways, satisfying and serving them with pure and excellent hard and soft food with their own hands, and knowing that the Blessed One had eaten, washed his hands, and put away his bowl, they took lower seats and sat down before the Blessed One to hear the Dharma.

children.text: atha bhagavāñ śuśumāragirīyakān brāhmaṇagṛhapatīn dharmyayā kathayā saṃdarśayati samādāpayati samuttejayati saṃpraharṣayati ||
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One instructed, exhorted, inspired, and delighted the brahmin householders of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s> with a discourse on Dharma.

children.text: anekaparyāyeṇa dharmyayā kathayā saṃdarśya samādāpya samuttejya saṃpraharṣya tūṣṇīm ||
children.translated_text: Having, in many ways, instructed, exhorted, inspired, and delighted them with a discourse on Dharma, he became silent.

children.text: atha śuśumāragirīyakā brāhmaṇagṛhapatayo bhagavantamidamavocat bhagavatā bhadanta nānādeśeṣu nānādhiṣṭhāneṣu te te duṣṭanāgā duṣṭayakṣāśca vinītāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the brahmin householders of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Venerable sir, the Blessed One has subdued various wicked nāgas and wicked yakṣas in various countries and various places.

children.text: ayaṃ bhadanta aśvatīrthiko nāgo 'smākamavairāṇāṃ vairī asapatnānāṃ sapatno 'drugdhānāṃ drugdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Venerable sir, this nāga <s>Aśvatīrthika</s> is an enemy to us who have no enmity, an adversary to us who have no adversary, and hostile to us who have done no harm.

children.text: nityamasmākaṃ jātāni jātāni śasyāni vināśayati strīpuruṣadārakadārikāgomahiṣān ajaiḍakāṃśca ||
children.translated_text: Again and again he destroys our crops as soon as they arise, and also women, men, boys, girls, cows, buffaloes, goats, and sheep.

children.text: aho bata bhagavāṃstaṃ vinayedanukampāmupādāyeti ||
children.translated_text: Ah, if only the Blessed One, out of compassion, would subdue him."

children.text: adhivāsayati bhagavāñ śuśumāragirīyakānāṃ brāhmaṇagṛhapatīnām ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One consented to the request of the brahmin householders of <s>Śuśumāragiri</s>.

children.text: tūṣṇībhāvenādhivāsayati ||
children.translated_text: He consented by remaining silent.

children.text: atha bhagavāñ śuśumāragirīyakānāṃ brāhmaṇagṛhapatīnāṃ tūṣṇībhāvenādhivāsya utthāyāsanāt prakrāntaḥ ||
