wheel-turning monarch surrounded by a thousand sons, like the moon surrounded by constellations, like the sun surrounded by a thousand rays, like <s>Dhṛtarāṣṭra</s> surrounded by <s>gandharvas</s>, like <s>Virūḍhaka</s> surrounded by <s>kumbhāṇḍas</s>, like <s>Dhanada</s> surrounded by <s>yakṣas</s>, like <s>Vemacitrin</s> surrounded by <s>asuras</s>, like <s>Śakra</s> surrounded by the thirty gods, like <s>Brahmā</s> surrounded by the Brahmā-bodied gods, still like the ocean, like a rain-cloud full of water, like an elephant lord without rut, with well-tamed senses, with his deportment unagitated, adorned with the thirty-two marks of a great man, his body shining with the eighty secondary marks, his form adorned by a fathom-wide radiance, with a brilliance surpassing a thousand suns, like a moving mountain of jewels, auspicious on every side, endowed with the ten powers, the four fearlessnesses, the three special applications of mindfulness, and great compassion, surrounded by great disciples such as <s>Ājñātakauṇḍinya</s>, <s>Aśvajit</s>, <s>Bāṣpa</s>, <s>Mahānāma</s>, <s>Bhadrika</s>, <s>Śāriputra</s>, <s>Maudgalyāyana</s>, <s>Kāśyapa</s>, <s>Yaśas</s>, and <s>Pūrṇa</s>, and by another great community of monks and many hundreds of thousands of living beings, set out for <s>Śītavana</s>, the great cemetery.

children.text: aṣṭādaśānuśaṃsā buddhacārikāyāmityanekāni devatāśatasahasrāṇi bhagavataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nubaddhāni ||
children.translated_text: Thinking, "There are eighteen advantages in a Buddha's walk," many hundreds of thousands of deities followed close behind the Blessed One.

children.text: śītavanānuguṇāśca vāyavo vāyitumārabdhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: And winds suited to <s>Śītavana</s> began to blow.

children.text: rājagṛhāt dvau bāladārakau brāhmaṇadārakaḥ kṣatriyadārakaśca bahir nirgatya krīḍataḥ ||
children.translated_text: From <s>Rājagṛha</s> two young boys, a Brahmin boy and a <s>kṣatriya</s> boy, went outside and played.

children.text: tayoḥ kṣatriyadārako 'vagāḍhaśrāddho brāhmaṇadārako na tathā ||
children.translated_text: Of the two, the <s>kṣatriya</s> boy had deep faith; the Brahmin boy was not so.

children.text: sa brāhmaṇadārakaḥ kṣatriyadārakasya kathayati vayasya bhagavatā subhadrasya gṛhapateḥ patnī vyākṛtā putraṃ janayiṣyati kulamuddyotayiṣyati divyamānuṣīṃ śriyaṃ pratyanubhaviṣyati mama śāsane pravrajya sarvakleśaprahāṇādarhattvaṃ sākṣātkariṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: That Brahmin boy said to the <s>kṣatriya</s> boy, "Friend, the Blessed One predicted of the wife of the householder <s>Subhadra</s>: 'She will give birth to a son; he will illuminate the family; he will experience divine and human splendor; and, after going forth in my teaching, through the abandonment of all defilements, he will realize <s>arhatship</s>.'

children.text: sā ca mṛtā kālagatā śītavanaṃ śmaśānaṃ nirhṛtā mā haiva bhagavatā bhāṣitaṃ vitathaṃ syāditi ||
children.translated_text: But she has died, passed away, and been carried out to <s>Śītavana</s>, the cemetery. May what the Blessed One said not prove false!"

children.text: sa kṣatriyadārako gāthāṃ bhāṣate ||
children.translated_text: The <s>kṣatriya</s> boy spoke a verse:

children.text: sacandratāraṃ prapatedihāmbaraṃ mahī saśailā savanā nabho vrajet
children.translated_text: "The sky here, together with moon and stars, might fall; the earth, with its mountains and forests, might go to heaven;

children.text: mahodadhīnāmudakaṃ kṣayaṃ vrajenmaharṣayaḥ syur na mṛṣābhidhāyinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the water of the great oceans might come to an end, but great seers would not be speakers of falsehood."

children.text: sa ca brāhmaṇadārakaḥ kathayati vayasya yadyevaṃ gacchāmaḥ śītavanaṃ mahāśmaśānaṃ paśyāmaḥ vayasya gacchāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the Brahmin boy said, "Friend, if that is so, let us go to <s>Śītavana</s>, the great cemetery, and see. Friend, let us go."

children.text: tau samprasthitau ||
children.translated_text: The two set out.

children.text: bhagavāṃśca rājagṛhānnirgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: And the Blessed One went out from <s>Rājagṛha</s>.

children.text: adrākṣīt sa kṣatriyadārako bhagavantaṃ dūrādeva ||
children.translated_text: The <s>kṣatriya</s> boy saw the Blessed One from far away.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā ca punargāthāṃ bhāṣate ||
children.translated_text: And, seeing him, he again spoke a verse:

children.text: anuddhato vigatakutūhalo muniryathā vrajatyeṣa janaughasaṃvṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: "Unhaughty, free from restless curiosity, see how this sage proceeds, surrounded by crowds of people.

children.text: niḥsaṃśayaṃ paragaṇavādimardano nadasyate mṛgapatinādamuttamam ||
children.translated_text: Without doubt, the crusher of rival teachers' assemblies will roar the supreme lion's roar.

children.text: yathā hyamī śītavanonmukhotsukāḥ pravānti vātā himapaṅkaśītalāḥ
children.translated_text: For since these winds, eager and turned toward <s>Śītavana</s>, are blowing, cold with frost and damp earth,

children.text: prayānti nūnaṃ bahavo divaukaso nirīkṣituṃ śākyamunervikurvitam ||
children.translated_text: surely many gods are going forth to behold the miraculous display of <s>Śākyamuni</s>."

children.text: rājñā bimbisāreṇa śrutaṃ bhagavatā subhadrasya gṛhapateḥ patnī vyākṛtā putraṃ janayiṣyati kulamuddyotayiṣyati divyamānuṣīṃ śriyaṃ pratyanubhaviṣyati mama śāsane pravrajya sarvakleśaprahāṇādarhattvaṃ sākṣātkariṣyati ||
children.translated_text: King <s>Bimbisāra</s> heard that the Blessed One had predicted of the wife of the householder <s>Subhadra</s>: "She will give birth to a son; he will illuminate the family, experience divine and human splendor, go forth under my teaching, and, through the abandonment of all defilements, directly realize arhatship."

children.text: sā ca mṛtā kālagatā śītavanaṃ śmaśānamabhinirhṛtā ||
children.translated_text: And she had died, passed away, and been carried out to the <s>Śītavana</s> charnel ground.

children.text: bhagavāṃśca saśrāvakasaṃghaḥ śītavanaṃ samprasthita iti ||
children.translated_text: And the Blessed One, together with the community of disciples, had set out for <s>Śītavana</s>.

children.text: śrutvā ca punarasyaitadabhavan na bhagavān nirarthakaṃ śītavanaṃ gacchati ||
children.translated_text: Hearing this, this occurred to him: "The Blessed One does not go to <s>Śītavana</s> without purpose.

children.text: nūnaṃ bhagavān subhadrasya gṛhapateḥ patnīmāgamya mahadvineyakāryaṃ kartukāmo bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: Surely the Blessed One, on account of the wife of the householder <s>Subhadra</s>, wishes to perform a great task of training those to be guided.

children.text: paśyāmīti ||
children.translated_text: I shall see."

children.text: so 'pyantaḥpurakumārāmātyapaurajānapadaparivṛto rājagṛhānnirgantumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He too, surrounded by the women of the inner apartments, princes, ministers, townspeople, and country folk, began to go out from <s>Rājagṛha</s>.

children.text: adrākṣīt sa kṣatriyakumārako rājānaṃ māgadhaśreṇyaṃ bimbisāraṃ dūrādeva ||
children.translated_text: That kṣatriya prince saw from afar King <s>Bimbisāra</s>, the <s>Māgadha Śreṇya</s>.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā ca punargāthāṃ bhāṣate ||
children.translated_text: And, seeing him, he spoke a verse:

children.text: yathā hi śreṇyo magadhādhipo hyayaṃ viniryayau rājagṛhāt sabāndhavaḥ
children.translated_text: "For just as this <s>Śreṇya</s>, lord of <s>Magadha</s>, has gone out from <s>Rājagṛha</s> with his kinsmen,

children.text: pravartate me hṛdi niścitā matir mahājanasyābhyudayo bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: a firm thought arises in my heart: there will be an exaltation of the great multitude."

children.text: janakāyena bhagavantaṃ dṛṣṭvā vivaramanupradattam ||
children.translated_text: When the crowd saw the Blessed One, an opening was made for him.

children.text: bhagavān smitonmukho mahājanamadhyaṃ praviṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One, with a smiling face, entered into the midst of the great crowd.

children.text: nirgranthā bhagavantaṃ smitonmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃlakṣayanti yathā śramaṇo gautamaḥ smitonmukho mahājanamadhyaṃ praviṣṭaḥ nūnamayaṃ bodhisattvo na kālagataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeing the Blessed One with a smiling face entering the midst of the great crowd, the <s>nirgranthas</s> reflected, "Since the ascetic <s>Gautama</s> has entered the midst of the great crowd with a smiling face, surely this bodhisattva has not died."

children.text: taiḥ subhadro gṛhapatirukto gṛhapate nanvayaṃ sattvo mandabhāgyo na kālagata iti ||
children.translated_text: They said to the householder <s>Subhadra</s>, "Householder, surely this being is unfortunate and has not died."

children.text: sa kathayati ārya yadyevaṃ kathamatra pratipattavyamiti te kathayanti gṛhapate vayaṃ śamāttaśikṣās tvameva jñāsyasīti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Āryas, if this is so, how should one proceed here?" They said, "Householder, we are renunciants trained in calm; you yourself will know."

children.text: sa tāṃ patnīṃ citāyāmāropya dhmāpayitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He placed that wife upon the pyre and began to have it kindled.

children.text: tasyāḥ sarvaḥ kāyo dagdhaḥ sthāpayitvā kukṣisāmantakam ||
children.translated_text: Her whole body was burned, except for the region around the belly.

children.text: tathāsau kukṣiḥ sphuṭitaḥ padmaṃ prādurbhūtam ||
children.translated_text: Then that belly split open, and a lotus appeared.

children.text: tasya coparipadmakarṇikāyāṃ kumāro niṣaṇṇo 'bhirūpo darśanīyaḥ prāsādikaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And above it, on the lotus pericarp, a boy was seated, handsome, lovely to see, and pleasing.

children.text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā anekāni prāṇiśatasahasrāṇi paraṃ vismayamupagatāni ||
children.translated_text: Seeing him, many hundreds of thousands of living beings were filled with supreme wonder.

children.text: nirgranthā nipātamadamānā na ca prabhāvāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>nirgranthas</s> were cast down in pride and became powerless.

children.text: tatra bhagavān subhadraṃ gṛhapatimāmantrayate gṛhapate gṛhāṇa kumāram ||
children.translated_text: There the Blessed One addressed the householder <s>Subhadra</s>: "Householder, take the boy."

children.text: sa nirgranthānāṃ mukhamavalokitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He began to look toward the faces of the <s>nirgranthas</s>.

children.text: te kathayanti gṛhapate yadi prajvalitāmetāṃ citāṃ pravekṣyasi sarveṇa sarvaṃ na bhaviṣyasīti ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Householder, if you enter this blazing pyre, you will be entirely no more."

children.text: sa na pratigṛhṇāti ||
children.translated_text: He did not accept him.

children.text: tatra bhagavāñ jīvakaṃ kumārabhūtamāmantrayate gṛhāṇa jīvaka kumārakamiti ||
children.translated_text: There the Blessed One addressed <s>Jīvaka Kumārabhūta</s>: "<s>Jīvaka</s>, take the boy."

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati asthānamanavakāśo bhagavān māmasthāne niyokṣyati ||
children.translated_text: He reflected, "It is impossible, there is no occasion, that the Blessed One would appoint me to an improper place.

children.text: gṛhṇāmīti ||
children.translated_text: I shall take him."

children.text: tena nirviśaṅkena citāṃ vigāhya gṛhītaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Without hesitation he plunged into the pyre and took him.

children.text: vigāhatastasya jinājñayā citāṃ pratigṛhṇataścāgnigataṃ kumārakam
children.translated_text: As he plunged into the pyre at the command of the Jina and took up the boy who was in the fire,

children.text: jinaprabhāvānmahato hutāśanaḥ kṣaṇena jāto himapaṅkaśītalaḥ ||
children.translated_text: through the power of the Jina the great blaze became in a moment cool as icy mud.

children.text: tato jīvakaṃ kumārabhūtamidamavocaj jīvaka māsi kṣata upahato veti sa kathayati rājakule 'haṃ bhadanta jāto rājakule vṛddhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then he said this to <s>Jīvaka Kumārabhūta</s>: "<s>Jīvaka</s>, were you wounded or injured?" He said, "Venerable sir, I was born in the royal household and raised in the royal household.

children.text: nābhijānāmi gośīrṣacandanasyāpīdṛśaṃ śaityam yadbhagavatā adhiṣṭhitāyāścitāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: I do not know even gośīrṣa sandalwood to have such coolness as the pyre consecrated by the Blessed One."

children.text: tatra bhagavān subhadraṃ gṛhapatimāmantrayate gṛhāṇedānīṃ gṛhapate kumāramiti ||
children.translated_text: There the Blessed One addressed the householder <s>Subhadra</s>: "Householder, now take the boy."

children.text: sa mithyādarśanavihataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was stricken by false view.

children.text: tathāpi na sampratipadyate ||
children.translated_text: Even so, he did not consent.

children.text: nirgranthānāmeva mukhaṃ vyavalokayati ||
children.translated_text: He kept looking toward the faces of the <s>nirgranthas</s>.

children.text: te kathayanti gṛhapate ayaṃ sattvo 'tīva mandabhāgyo yo hi nāma sarvabhakṣeṇāpyagninā na dagdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Householder, this being is extremely unfortunate, since he was not burned even by fire, which consumes everything.

children.text: kiṃ bahunā yadyevaṃ gṛhaṃ praveśayasi nīyatām ||
children.translated_text: In short, if you bring him into the house, have him taken away.

children.text: te gṛhamutsādayad bhaviṣyasi tvaṃ ca prāṇairviyujyasa iti ||
children.translated_text: He will bring ruin to the house, and you too will be parted from your life."

children.text: nāsti ātmasamaṃ premeti ||
children.translated_text: "There is no love equal to love of oneself."

children.text: tenāsau na pratigṛhītaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For that reason he was not accepted by him.

children.text: tatra bhagavān rājānaṃ bimbisāramāmantrayate gṛhāṇa mahārāja kumāramiti ||
children.translated_text: There the Blessed One addressed King <s>Bimbisāra</s>: "Great king, take the boy."

children.text: tena sasambhrameṇa hastau prasārya gṛhītaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With agitation he stretched out his hands and took him.

children.text: tataḥ samantato nirīkṣya kathayati bhagavan kiṃ bhavatu asya dārakasya nāmeti bhagavān āha mahārāja yasmādayaṃ dārako jyotirmadhyāllabdhastasmādbhavati dārakasya jyotiṣka iti nāmeti ||
children.translated_text: Then, looking all around, he said, "Blessed One, what shall this boy's name be?" The Blessed One said, "Great king, since this boy was obtained from the midst of a flame, therefore the boy's name shall be <s>Jyotiṣka</s>."

children.text: tasya jyotiṣka iti nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpitam ||
children.translated_text: His name was established as <s>Jyotiṣka</s>.

children.text: tato bhagavatā tasya janakāyasyāśayānuśayaṃ dhātuṃ prakṛtiṃ ca jñātvā tādṛśī dharmadeśanā kṛtā yāṃ śrutvā bahubhiḥ sattvaśatairmahān viśeṣo 'dhigataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, knowing the dispositions, latent tendencies, elements, and nature of that crowd, the Blessed One gave such a teaching of <s>dharma</s> that, on hearing it, many hundreds of beings attained a great distinction.

children.text: kaiścicchrotāpattiphalaṃ sākṣātkṛtam kaiścit sakṛdāgāmiphalaṃ kaiścidanāgāmiphalaṃ kaiścit sarvakleśaprahāṇādarhattvaṃ sākṣātkṛtaṃ kaiścidūṣmagatāni kuśalamūlānyutpāditāni kaiścinmūrdhānaḥ kaiścit mṛdumadhyāḥ kṣāntayaḥ kaiścicchrāvakabodhau cittānyutpāditāni kaiścit pratyekabodhau kaiścidanuttarāyāṃ samyaksambodhau kaiściccharaṇagamanāni kaiścicchikṣāpadāni ||
children.translated_text: Some directly realized the fruit of stream-entry; some the fruit of once-returning; some the fruit of non-returning; some, through the abandonment of all defilements, directly realized arhatship. Some produced the roots of good called 'heat'; some the 'summits'; some the mild and middling acceptances. Some produced thoughts directed toward the awakening of a disciple, some toward solitary awakening, and some toward unsurpassed complete awakening. Some undertook going for refuge, and some undertook the training precepts.

children.text: yadbhūyasā sā parṣadbuddhanimnā dharmapravaṇā saṃghaprāgbhārā vyavasthitā ||
children.translated_text: For the most part that assembly became inclined toward the Buddha, bent toward the Dharma, and leaning toward the Saṃgha.

children.text: jyotiṣko dārako rājñā bimbisāreṇa aṣṭābhyo dhātrībhyo 'nupradatto dvābhyām aṃsadhātrībhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ kṣīradhātrībhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ maladhātrībhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ krīḍanikābhyāṃ dhātrībhyām ||
children.translated_text: The boy <s>Jyotiṣka</s> was entrusted by King <s>Bimbisāra</s> to eight nurses: two carrying-nurses, two milk-nurses, two nurses for cleaning him, and two nurses for play.

children.text: so 'ṣṭābhirdhātrībhir unnīyate vardhate kṣīreṇa dadhnā navanītena sarpiṣā sarpimaṇḍena anyaiścottaptottaptairupakaraṇaviśeṣaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was brought up and grew under those eight nurses, with milk, curds, fresh butter, ghee, clarified butter, and other specially prepared, very warm requisites.

children.text: āśu vardhate hradasthamiva paṅkajam ||
children.translated_text: He grew quickly, like a lotus standing in a pond.

children.text: tasya mātulaḥ paṇyamādāya deśāntaraṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: His maternal uncle had taken merchandise and gone to another country.

children.text: tena śrutaṃ yathā mama bhaginī sattvavatī saṃvṛttā ||
children.translated_text: He heard, 'My sister has become pregnant.'

children.text: sā bhagavatā vyākṛtā putraṃ janayiṣyati kulamuddyotayiṣyati divyamānuṣīṃ śriyaṃ pratyanubhaviṣyati mama śāsane pravrajya sarvakleśaprahāṇādarhattvaṃ sākṣātkariṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: She had been predicted by the Blessed One: 'She will give birth to a son; he will illuminate the family, experience divine and human splendor, go forth in my teaching, and, through the abandonment of all defilements, directly realize arhatship.'

children.text: sa paṇyaṃ visarjayitvā pratipaṇyamādāya rājagṛhamāgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: After selling his merchandise and taking return goods, he came to <s>Rājagṛha</s>.

children.text: tena śrutaṃ yathā sā asmākaṃ bhaginī kālagateti ||
children.translated_text: There he heard, 'That sister of ours has died.'

children.text: śrutvā ca punaḥ saṃlakṣayati bhagavatā asau vyākṛtā putraṃ janayiṣyati kulamuddyotayiṣyati divyāṃ mānuṣīṃ śriyaṃ pratyanubhaviṣyati mama śāsane pravrajya sarvakleśaprahāṇādarhattvaṃ sākṣātkariṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: And, hearing this, he reflected, 'She was predicted by the Blessed One: "She will give birth to a son; he will illuminate the family, experience divine and human splendor, go forth in my teaching, and, through the abandonment of all defilements, directly realize arhatship."'

children.text: mā haiva tadbhagavato bhāṣitaṃ vitathaṃ syāt ||
children.translated_text: 'Surely the Blessed One's utterance cannot be false.'

children.text: tena tiraḥprātiveśyāḥ pṛṣṭāḥ śrutaṃ mayā asmākaṃ bhaginī sattvavatī saṃvṛttā ||
children.translated_text: He questioned the neighbors around them: 'I heard that our sister had become pregnant.

children.text: sā bhagavatā vyākṛtā putraṃ janayiṣyati kulamuddyotayiṣyati divyamānuṣīṃ śriyaṃ pratyanubhaviṣyati mama śāsane pravrajya sarvakleśaprahāṇādarhattvaṃ sākṣātkariṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: She had been predicted by the Blessed One: "She will give birth to a son; he will illuminate the family, experience divine and human splendor, go forth in my teaching, and, through the abandonment of all defilements, directly realize arhatship."

children.text: śrutvā vayaṃ parituṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When we heard this, we were delighted.

children.text: sā ca śrūyate mṛtā kālagateti ||
children.translated_text: But she is now heard to be dead and gone.

children.text: mā haiva bhagavato bhāṣitaṃ vitathaṃ syāditi ||
children.translated_text: Surely the Blessed One's utterance cannot be false.'

children.text: te gāthāṃ bhāṣante ||
children.translated_text: They spoke a verse:

children.text: sacandratāraṃ prapatedihāmbaraṃ mahī saśailā savanā nabho vrajet
children.translated_text: 'The sky here, with moon and stars, may fall; the earth, with its mountains and forests, may go up to the sky;

children.text: mahodadhīnāmudakaṃ kṣayaṃ vrajenmaharṣayaḥ syur na mṛṣābhidhāyinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the water of the great oceans may come to destruction, but great seers are not speakers of falsehood.'

children.text: na bhagavato bhāṣitaṃ vitatham ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One's utterance is not false.

children.text: kathaṃ bhagavato bhāṣitaṃ vitathaṃ bhaviṣyati kiṃtu tena svāmināpi asau tathā tathā upakrāntā yathā kālagatā ||
children.translated_text: How could the Blessed One's utterance be false? Rather, that master treated her in such and such a way that she died.

children.text: sa dārako maharddhiko mahānubhāvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: That boy is possessed of great miraculous power and great majesty.

children.text: agninā na dagdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was not burned by the fire.

children.text: adyāpi rājakule saṃvardhata iti ||
children.translated_text: Even now he is being raised in the royal household.

children.text: sa subhadrasya gṛhapateḥ sakāśaṃ gatvā kathayati na yuktaṃ gṛhapate tvayā kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: He went to the householder <s>Subhadra</s> and said, 'Householder, what you did was not proper.

children.text: kiṃ kṛtaṃ asmākaṃ sattvavatī bhaginī tvayā nirgranthavigrāhitena tathā tathā upakrāntā yathā kālagatā ||
children.translated_text: What have you done? Misled by the <s>nirgranthas</s>, you treated our pregnant sister in such and such a way that she died.

children.text: sa dārako maharddhiko mahānubhāvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: That boy is possessed of great miraculous power and great majesty.

children.text: agnināpi na dagdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was not burned even by fire.

children.text: adyāpi rājakule saṃvardhate ||
children.translated_text: Even now he is being raised in the royal household.

children.text: tadgatametat ||
children.translated_text: That is how the matter stands.

children.text: yadi tāvatkumāramānayasi ityevaṃ kuśalam ||
children.translated_text: If you bring the prince here, then that is well.

children.text: no cedvayaṃ tvāṃ jñātimadhyādutkṣipāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: But if not, we will cast you out from among the kinsmen.

children.text: salokānām saṃkāraṃ pātayāmaḥ rathyāvīthīcatvaraśṛṅgāṭakeṣu cāvaraṇaṃ niścārayāmo 'smākaṃ bhaginī subhadreṇa gṛhapatinā praghātitā ||
children.translated_text: We will disgrace you before the people, and in the roads, streets, squares, and crossroads we will have an announcement made: "Our sister was killed by the householder <s>Subhadra</s>."

children.text: strīghātako 'yam ||
children.translated_text: "This man is a killer of a woman.

children.text: na kenacidābhāṣitavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: He is not to be spoken to by anyone."

children.text: rājakule ca te 'narthaṃ kārayāma iti ||
children.translated_text: And we will bring misfortune upon you in the royal household.'

children.text: sa śrutvā vyathitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Hearing this, he was shaken.

children.text: yathaiṣa paribhāṣate nūnamevaṃ karomīti viditvā rājñaḥ pādayor nipatya kathayati deva mama jñātaya evaṃ paribhāṣante yadi tāvat kumāramānayasītyevaṃ kuśalaṃ no cedānayasi vayaṃ tvāṃ jñātimadhyādutkṣipāmaḥ saṃkāraṃ pātayāmo rathyāvīthīcatvaraśṛṅgāṭakeṣu cāvaraṇaṃ niścārayāmo 'smākaṃ bhaginī subhadreṇa gṛhapatinā praghātitā ||
children.translated_text: Perceiving, 'As he threatens, so indeed he will act,' he fell at the king's feet and said, 'Your Majesty, my kinsmen threaten me in this way: "If you bring the prince here, then that is well; but if you do not bring him, we will cast you out from among the kinsmen. We will disgrace you, and in the roads, streets, squares, and crossroads we will have an announcement made: 'Our sister was killed by the householder <s>Subhadra</s>.'

children.text: strīghātako 'yam ||
children.translated_text: "This man is a killer of a woman.

children.text: na kenacidābhāṣitavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: He is not to be spoken to by anyone."

children.text: rājakule ca te 'narthaṃ kārayāma iti ||
children.translated_text: And we will bring misfortune upon you in the royal household."

children.text: tadarhasi jyotiṣkaṃ kumāraṃ dātumiti ||
children.translated_text: Therefore you ought to give me Prince <s>Jyotiṣka</s>.'

children.text: rājā kathayati gṛhapate na mayā tvatsakāśāt jyotiṣkaḥ kumāro gṛhītaḥ kiṃtu bhagavatā mama nyastaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The king said, 'Householder, Prince <s>Jyotiṣka</s> was not taken by me from you; rather, he was placed with me by the Blessed One.

children.text: yadi tvaṃ kumāreṇārthī bhagavatsakāśaṃ gaccheti ||
children.translated_text: If you have need of the prince, go to the Blessed One.'

children.text: sa bhagavatsakāśaṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He went to the Blessed One.

children.text: pādayor nipatya kathayati bhagavan mama jñātaya evaṃ paribhāṣante yadi tāvat kumāramānayasītyevaṃ kuśalam ||
children.translated_text: Falling at his feet, he says, "Blessed One, my relatives reproach me in this way: 'If you bring the boy, then it is well.

children.text: no cedānayasi vayaṃ tvāṃ jñātimadhyādutkṣipāmaḥ saṃkāraṃ pātayāmaḥ rathyāvīthīcatvaraśṛṅgāṭakeṣu cāvaraṇaṃ niścārayāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: But if you do not bring him, we will cast you out from the midst of the kin, we will throw refuse on you, and in roads, streets, squares, and crossroads we will issue a public exclusion.

children.text: asmākaṃ bhaginī subhadreṇa gṛhapatinā praghātitā ||
children.translated_text: Our sister was killed by the householder <s>Subhadra</s>.

children.text: strīghātako 'yam ||
children.translated_text: This man is a killer of women.

children.text: na kenacidābhāṣitavya iti ||
children.translated_text: No one is to speak with him.'

children.text: rājakule cānarthaṃ kārayāma iti ||
children.translated_text: And they say, 'We will have harm done to you at the royal court.'

children.text: tadarhasi jyotiṣkaṃ kumāraṃ dāpayitumiti ||
children.translated_text: Therefore you ought to have the boy <s>Jyotiṣka</s> handed over."

children.text: bhagavān saṃlakṣayati yadi subhadro jyotiṣkaṃ kumāraṃ na labhate sthānametadvidyate yaduṣṇaṃ rudhiraṃ chardayitvā kālaṃ kariṣyati ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One considers, "If <s>Subhadra</s> does not obtain the boy <s>Jyotiṣka</s>, it is possible that he will vomit hot blood and die."

children.text: iti viditvā āyuṣmantamānandamāmantrayate gaccha ānanda rājānaṃ bimbisāraṃ madvacanenārogyaya evaṃ ca vada anuprayaccha mahārāja subhadrasya gṛhapaterjyotiṣkaṃ kumāram ||
children.translated_text: Knowing this, he addressed venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: "Go, <s>Ānanda</s>, greet King <s>Bimbisāra</s> in my name and say this: 'Great king, hand over the boy <s>Jyotiṣka</s> to the householder <s>Subhadra</s>.

children.text: yadi subhadro gṛhapatirjyotiṣkaṃ kumāraṃ na labhate sthānametadvidyate yaduṣṇaṃ śoṇitaṃ chardayitvā kālaṃ kariṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: If the householder <s>Subhadra</s> does not obtain the boy <s>Jyotiṣka</s>, it is possible that he will vomit hot blood and die.'"

children.text: evaṃ bhadantetyāyuṣmānānando bhagavataḥ pratiśrutya yena rājā bimbisārastenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "So be it, venerable sir," venerable <s>Ānanda</s> replied to the Blessed One, and he went to King <s>Bimbisāra</s>.

children.text: upasaṃkramya rājānaṃ bimbisārametadavocad bhagavāṃste mahārāja ārogyayati kathayati ca anuprayaccha mahārāja subhadrasya gṛhapaterjyotiṣkaṃ kumāram ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, he said this to King <s>Bimbisāra</s>: "The Blessed One greets you, great king, and says: 'Great king, hand over the boy <s>Jyotiṣka</s> to the householder <s>Subhadra</s>.

children.text: yadi subhadro gṛhapatirjyotiṣkaṃ kumāraṃ na labhate sthānametadvidyate yat subhadro gṛhapatiruṣṇaṃ śoṇitaṃ chardayitvā kālaṃ kariṣyati ||
children.translated_text: If the householder <s>Subhadra</s> does not obtain the boy <s>Jyotiṣka</s>, it is possible that the householder <s>Subhadra</s> will vomit hot blood and die.'"

children.text: rājā kathayati vande bhadantānanda buddhaṃ bhagavantam ||
children.translated_text: The king says, "Venerable <s>Ānanda</s>, I bow to the Buddha, the Blessed One.

children.text: yathā bhagavānājñāpayati tathā kariṣye ||
children.translated_text: As the Blessed One commands, so I shall do.

children.text: ārogyamityuktā āyuṣmānānandaḥ prakrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Say that I am well." Having been told this, venerable <s>Ānanda</s> departed.

children.text: rājā bimbisāraḥ kathayati gṛhapate mayā ayaṃ kumāraḥ saṃvardhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: King <s>Bimbisāra</s> says, "Householder, this boy has been brought up by me.

children.text: priyaśca me manāpaśca ||
children.translated_text: He is dear and pleasing to me.

children.text: samayato 'haṃ muñcāmi yadi māṃ divase divase triṣkālaṃ darśanāyopasaṃkrāmatīti ||
children.translated_text: I release him on condition that he come to see me three times every day."

children.text: sa kathayati deva upasaṃkramiṣyati ||
children.translated_text: He says, "Your Majesty, he will come.

children.text: ko 'nya upasaṃkramitavya iti sa rājñā sarvālaṃkāravibhūṣitaṃ kṛtvā hastiskandha āropya visarjitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whom else should he approach?" Then the king adorned him with every ornament, mounted him on the back of an elephant, and sent him away.

children.text: ācaritametallokasya na tāvat putrasya nāma prajñāyate yāvat pitā jīvati ||
children.translated_text: This is the custom of the world: a son's name is not known so long as his father is alive.

children.text: yāvadapareṇa samayena subhadro gṛhapatiḥ kālagataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, at another time, the householder <s>Subhadra</s> died.

children.text: jyotiṣkaḥ kumāraḥ svagṛhe pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The boy <s>Jyotiṣka</s> was established in his own house.

children.text: sa buddhe 'bhiprasanno dharme saṃghe 'bhiprasannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He had serene faith in the Buddha, serene faith in the Dharma, and serene faith in the Saṅgha.

children.text: buddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gato dharmaṃ saṃghaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He had gone to the Buddha for refuge, and had gone to the Dharma and the Saṅgha for refuge.

children.text: tena yasmin pradeśe tena subhadreṇa patnī āghātitā tasmin pradeśe vihāraṃ kārayitvā sarvopakaraṇasampūrṇaś cāturdiśāryabhikṣusaṃghāya niryātitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In the place where the wife had been killed by that <s>Subhadra</s>, he had a monastery built and, complete with every requisite, handed it over to the noble community of monks of the four quarters.

children.text: tathā sthavirairapi sūtrānta upanibaddhaṃ bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati mṛditakukṣike dāva iti ||
children.translated_text: So too the elders recorded it in the sūtra: "The Blessed One was dwelling at <s>Rājagṛha</s>, at <s>Mṛditakukṣika</s>, in the wood."

children.text: subhadrasya gṛhapateḥ pauruṣeyā ye paṇyamādāya deśāntaraṃ gatās taiḥ śrutaṃ subhadro gṛhapatiḥ kālagataḥ ||
children.translated_text: The men of the householder <s>Subhadra</s> who had gone to another country with merchandise heard, "The householder <s>Subhadra</s> has died.

children.text: jyotiṣkaḥ kumāraḥ svagṛhe pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The boy <s>Jyotiṣka</s> has been established in his own house.

children.text: sa buddhe 'bhiprasanno dharme saṃghe 'bhiprasanno buddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gato dharmaṃ saṃghaṃ śaraṇaṃ gata iti ||
children.translated_text: He has serene faith in the Buddha, serene faith in the Dharma and the Saṅgha, and he has gone to the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Saṅgha for refuge."

children.text: teṣāṃ ca gośīrṣacandanamayaṃ pātraṃ sampannam ||
children.translated_text: And they had acquired a bowl made of gośīrṣa sandalwood.

children.text: taistadratnānāṃ pūrayitvā jyotiṣkasya gṛhapateḥ prābhṛtamanupreṣitam ||
children.translated_text: They filled it with jewels and sent it as a gift to the householder <s>Jyotiṣka</s>.

children.text: tena taddīrghe stambhe āropya sthāpitam ||
children.translated_text: He had it raised up on a tall pillar and set there.

children.text: ghaṇṭāvaghoṣaṇaṃ kāritaṃ nedaṃ kenacit viṣṭayā vā śiṭayā vā karkaṭakena vā gṛhītavyam ||
children.translated_text: He had a bell proclamation made: "This is not to be taken by anyone with a ladder, a pole, or a hook.

children.text: ya etacchramaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā maharddhiko vā mahānubhāva ṛddhyā gṛhṇāti tasyedam yathāsukhamiti ||
children.translated_text: Whatever ascetic or brahmin, mighty in miraculous power and great in majesty, takes it by miraculous power, it is his to enjoy as he wishes."

children.text: tīrthyāḥ kalyamevotthāya tīrthyasparśanaṃ gacchanti ||
children.translated_text: The non-Buddhist ascetics, rising very early, go to the bathing place of the ascetics.

children.text: taistad dṛṣṭam ||
children.translated_text: They saw it.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā ca punarjyotiṣkasya gṛhapateḥ kathayanti gṛhapate kimetaditi tena teṣāṃ vistareṇārocitam ||
children.translated_text: Having seen it, they then said to the householder <s>Jyotiṣka</s>, "Householder, what is this?" He explained it to them in detail.

children.text: te kathayanti gṛhapate tvaṃ śramaṇaśākyaputreṣvabhiprasannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say, "Householder, you have serene faith in the ascetics who are sons of the <s>Śākya</s>.

children.text: te evaṃ grahīṣyantītyuktvā prakrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They will be the ones to take it." Having said this, they departed.

children.text: yāvat sthavirasthavirā bhikṣavo rājagṛhaṃ piṇḍāya praviṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the elder monks entered <s>Rājagṛha</s> for alms.

children.text: tairdṛṣṭvā tairapi jyotiṣko gṛhapatiḥ pṛṣṭaḥ kimetaditi tena tathaiva vistareṇa samākhyātam ||
children.translated_text: Having seen it, they too asked the householder <s>Jyotiṣka</s>, "What is this?" He recounted it to them in the same way, in detail.

children.text: te kathayanti gṛhapate kiṃ pātramātrasyārthāyātmānaṃ saṃprakāśayāma uktaṃ bhagavatā pracchannakalyāṇairvo bhikṣavo vihartavyaṃ dhūtapāpair ityuktvā prakrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say, "Householder, shall we display ourselves for the sake of a mere bowl? The Blessed One has said, 'Monks, you should live with your good concealed and your evils shaken off.'" Having said this, they departed.

children.text: yāvadāyuṣmān daśabalaḥ kāśyapastamanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then venerable <s>Daśabala Kāśyapa</s> arrived there.

children.text: sa pṛcchati gṛhapate kimetaditi tena yathāvṛttamārocitam ||
children.translated_text: He asks, "Householder, what is this?" He told him what had happened.

children.text: āyuṣmān daśabalakāśyapaḥ saṃlakṣayati yena mayā anādikālopacitaṃ kleśagaṇaṃ vāntaṃ tyaktaṃ charditaṃ pratinisṛṣṭaṃ taṃ māṃ gṛhapatistīrthikasādhāraṇayā ṛddhyā āhvayati ||
children.translated_text: Venerable <s>Daśabalakāśyapa</s> reflected, "I have vomited up, cast away, disgorged, and released the mass of defilements accumulated from beginningless time; yet this householder summons me by miraculous power common to the <s>tīrthikas</s>."

children.text: tadasya manorathaṃ pūrayāmīti ||
children.translated_text: "So I will fulfill his wish."

children.text: tena gajabhujasadṛśaṃ bāhumabhiprasārya tatpātraṃ gṛhītam ||
children.translated_text: Then he stretched out an arm like an elephant's trunk and took that bowl.

children.text: sa tadgṛhītvā vihāraṃ gato bhikṣubhirucyate sthavira kutastava gośīrṣacandanamayaṃ pātramiti tena yathāvṛttamārocitam ||
children.translated_text: Having taken it, he went to the monastery. The monks said to him, "Elder, where did you get a bowl made of <s>gośīrṣa</s> sandalwood?" He reported what had happened.

children.text: bhikṣavaḥ kathayanti sthavira kalpate tava pātramātrasyārthāya ṛddhiṃ vidarśayitumiti kathayati āyuṣmantaḥ kalpatu vā mā vā ||
children.translated_text: The monks said, "Elder, is it allowable for you to display miraculous power for the sake of a mere bowl?" He said, "Venerables, whether it is allowable or not,

children.text: kṛtamidānīm ||
children.translated_text: it has now been done.

children.text: kiṃ kriyatāmiti etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti ||
children.translated_text: What is to be done?" The monks reported this matter to the Blessed One.

children.text: bhagavānāha na bhikṣuṇā āgārikasya purastāt ṛddhirvidarśayitavyā ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, "A monk must not display miraculous power in front of a householder.

children.text: darśayati sātisāro bhavati ||
children.translated_text: If he displays it, there is an offense.

children.text: api tu catvāri pātrāṇi suvarṇamayaṃ rūpyamayaṃ vaiḍūryamayaṃ sphaṭikamayam ||
children.translated_text: Moreover, there are four bowls: one made of gold, one made of silver, one made of beryl, and one made of crystal.

children.text: aparāṇyapi catvāri pātrāṇi rītimayaṃ tāmramayaṃ kaṃsamayam abhramayaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: There are also four other bowls: one made of brass, one made of copper, one made of bronze, and one made of mica.

children.text: tatra yāni pūrvakāṇi catvāri pātrāṇi etānyanupasthāpitāni nopasthāpayitavyāni upasthāpitāni visarjayitavyāni ||
children.translated_text: Of these, the former four bowls, if not acquired, must not be acquired; if acquired, they must be given up.

children.text: yāni paścimāni catvāri pātrāṇi etānyanupasthāpitāni nopasthāpayitavyāni upasthāpitāni tu bhaiṣajyaśarāvaparibhogena paribhoktavyāni ||
children.translated_text: The latter four bowls, if not acquired, must not be acquired; but if acquired, they may be used as medicine dishes.

children.text: api tvadhīṣṭāni te dve pātre āyasaṃ mṛṇmayam ||
children.translated_text: Only these two bowls are authorized: one of iron and one of clay."

children.text: yāvadapareṇa samayena jyotiṣkasya gṛhapaterdivyamānuṣī śrīḥ prādurbhūtā ||
children.translated_text: Then, at another time, divine and human splendor appeared for the householder <s>Jyotiṣka</s>.

children.text: antarā ca rājagṛhamantarā ca campāmatrāntare śulkaśālā ||
children.translated_text: Between <s>Rājagṛha</s> and <s>Campā</s>, midway between them, there was a toll house.

children.text: tasyāṃ śulkaśālikaḥ kālagataḥ ||
children.translated_text: The toll collector there died.

children.text: sa vyālayakṣeṣūpapannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was reborn among fierce <s>yakṣas</s>.

children.text: tena putrāṇāṃ svapnadarśanaṃ dattaṃ putrā yūyam etasmin sthāne yakṣasthānaṃ kārayata tatra ca ghaṇṭāṃ baddhvā lambayata yaḥ kaścit paṇyamaśulkayitvā gamiṣyati sā ghaṇṭā tāvadviraviṣyati yāvadasau nivartya śulkaṃ dāpayitavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: He gave his sons a dream-vision: "Sons, build a <s>yakṣa</s>-shrine in this place, and there tie up and hang a bell. Whoever passes by without paying duty on merchandise, that bell will ring until he is turned back and made to pay the duty."

children.text: taistaṃ svapnaṃ saṃbandhibāndhavānāṃ nivedya divasatithimuhūrtena tasmin pradeśe yakṣasthānaṃ kāritam ||
children.translated_text: After reporting that dream to their relatives and kinsmen, they had a <s>yakṣa</s>-shrine built in that place on an auspicious day, lunar date, and hour.

children.text: tatra ca ghaṇṭā baddhvā lambitā ||
children.translated_text: And there they tied up and hung a bell.

children.text: campāyāmanyatamo brāhmaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In <s>Campā</s> there was a certain brahmin.

children.text: tena sadṛśāt kulāt kalatramānītam ||
children.translated_text: He brought home a wife from a family equal to his own.

children.text: sā brāhmaṇī saṃlakṣayati ayaṃ brāhmaṇo yaistairupāyairdhanopārjanaṃ karoti ||
children.translated_text: That brahmin woman reflected, "This brahmin earns wealth by various means,

children.text: ahaṃ bhakṣayāmi ||
children.translated_text: and I consume it.

children.text: na mama pratirūpaṃ yad aham akarmikā tiṣṭheyamiti ||
children.translated_text: It is not proper for me to remain without work."

children.text: tayā vīthīṃ gatvā karpāsaḥ krītaḥ ||
children.translated_text: She went to the street and bought cotton.

children.text: taṃ parikarmayitvā ślakṣṇam sūtraṃ kartitam ||
children.translated_text: After preparing it, she spun smooth thread.

children.text: śobhanena kuvindena kārṣāpaṇasahasramūlyā yamalī vāyitā ||
children.translated_text: Through a good weaver she had a double cloth woven worth a thousand <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>.

children.text: tayā brāhmaṇa ukto brāhmaṇa asyā yamalyāḥ kārṣāpaṇasahasraṃ mūlyam ||
children.translated_text: She said to the brahmin, "Brahmin, this double cloth is worth a thousand <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>.

children.text: gṛhītvā vīthīṃ gaccha ||
children.translated_text: Take it and go to the street.

children.text: yadi kaścit yācati kārṣāpaṇasahasreṇa dātavyā no ced apattanaṃ ghoṣayitvā anyatra gantavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: If anyone asks for it, it is to be sold for a thousand <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>; but if not, then after proclaiming it through the market, you should go elsewhere."

children.text: sa tāṃ gṛhītvā vīthīṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He took it and went to the street.

children.text: na kaścit kārṣāpaṇasahasreṇa gṛhṇāti ||
children.translated_text: No one bought it for a thousand <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>.

children.text: so 'pattanaṃ ghoṣayitvā tām yamalīṃ chatradaṇḍe prakṣipya sārthena sārdhaṃ rājagṛhaṃ samprasthito yāvadanupūrveṇa śulkaśālāmanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After proclaiming it through the market, he placed that double cloth on his parasol-staff and set out with a caravan for <s>Rājagṛha</s>, until in due course he reached the toll house.

children.text: śulkaśālikena sārthaḥ śulkitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The toll collector assessed the caravan for duty.

children.text: sa śulkaṃ dattvā samprasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After paying the duty, he set out.

children.text: ghaṇṭā raṭitumārabdhā ||
children.translated_text: The bell began to ring.

children.text: śaulkikāḥ kathayanti bhavantaḥ yatheyaṃ ghaṇṭā raṇati nūnaṃ sārtho na nipuṇaṃ śulkitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The toll officers said, "Sirs, since this bell is ringing, surely the caravan has not been assessed carefully.

children.text: bhūyaḥ śulkayāma iti ||
children.translated_text: Let us assess it again."

children.text: tairasau sārthaḥ punaḥ pratinivartya śulkitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They turned that caravan back again and assessed it for duty.

children.text: nāsti kiṃcid aśulkitam ||
children.translated_text: There was nothing that had not been assessed.

children.text: ghaṇṭā raṭatyeva ||
children.translated_text: The bell kept ringing.

children.text: tairasau sārtho bhūyaḥ pratinivartya pratyavekṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They turned that caravan back again and inspected it.

children.text: nāstyevakiṃcit ||
children.translated_text: There was absolutely nothing.

children.text: sārthikā avadhyātumārabdhāḥ kim yūyamasmān mūṣitukāmā yena bhūyo bhūyaḥ pratinivartayadhvamiti tairasau dvidhā kṛtvā muktaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The caravan merchants began to reproach them: "Do you want to rob us, since you turn us back again and again?" Then they divided that caravan in two and released it.

children.text: yeṣāṃ madhye sa brāhmaṇo nāsti te 'tikrāntāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those among whom the brahmin was not present passed beyond.

children.text: anyeṣāṃ gacchatāṃ sā ghaṇṭā tathaiva raṭitumārabdhā ||
children.translated_text: As the others went on, that bell began to ring in the same way.

children.text: taiste punaḥ pratyavekṣitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They inspected them again.

children.text: evaṃ tāvat dvidhākṛtāḥ yāvat sa caiko brāhmaṇo 'vasthita iti ||
children.translated_text: In this way they were divided again and again, until that one brahmin remained standing.

children.text: sa tairgṛhītaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They seized him.

children.text: sa kathayati pratyavekṣata yadi mama kiṃcidastīti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Inspect me, if there is anything of mine."

children.text: taiḥ sarvataḥ pratyavekṣya muktaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After inspecting him everywhere, they released him.

children.text: sā ghaṇṭā raṭatyeva ||
children.translated_text: The bell kept ringing.

children.text: tairasau brāhmaṇaḥ pratinivartyokto bho brāhmaṇa kathaya naiva śulkaṃ dāpayāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They turned that brahmin back and said, "Ho, brahmin, tell us. We will certainly not make you pay the duty;

children.text: kiṃtu devasyaiva sānnidhyaṃ jñātaṃ bhavatīti ||
children.translated_text: rather, let the presence of the deity be known."

children.text: kathayati satyaṃ na dāpayatha na dāpayāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Is it true that you will not make me pay?" "We will not make you pay."

children.text: tena chatradaṇḍādapanīya sā yamalī darśitā ||
children.translated_text: Then he took that double cloth down from the parasol-staff and showed it.

children.text: te paraṃ vismayamāpannā bhavantaḥ īdṛśamapi devasya sānnidhyamiti ||
children.translated_text: They were filled with great amazement: "Sirs, even such is the deity's presence!"

children.text: taistat ekaṃ vastramudghāṭya devaḥ prāvṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Opening out one cloth, they covered the deity with it.

children.text: brāhmaṇaḥ kathayati yūyaṃ kathayatha śulkaṃ na dāpayāma iti ||
children.translated_text: The Brahmin said, "You say, 'We will not make you pay the fee.'

children.text: idānīṃ sarvasvamapaharatha iti ||
children.translated_text: Now you are taking away everything I own."

children.text: te kathayanti brāhmaṇa nāsmābhirgṛhītam ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Brahmin, we did not take it.

children.text: api devasyaitat sānnidhyamiti kṛtvā asmābhiḥ prāvṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thinking, 'This too is the deity's presence,' we covered him with it.

children.text: gṛhītvā gaccheti ||
children.translated_text: Take it and go."

children.text: sa taṃ punargṛhītvā punaśchatranāḍikāyāṃ prakṣipya prakrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He took it back again, put it once more into the tube of his umbrella, and departed.

children.text: anupūrveṇa rājagṛhamanuprāptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In due course he arrived at <s>Rājagṛha</s>.

children.text: sa vīthyāṃ prasāryāvasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He spread it out in the street and stood there.

children.text: tatrāpi tāṃ na kaścit kārṣāpaṇasahasreṇa yācate ||
children.translated_text: Even there no one asked for it at a thousand kārṣāpaṇas.

children.text: sa rājagṛhamapyapattanaṃ ghoṣayitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He began to proclaim that <s>Rājagṛha</s> too was no marketplace.

children.text: jyotiṣkaśca kumāro rājakulānniṣkramya hastiskandhābhirūḍho vīthīmadhyena svagṛhaṃ gacchati ||
children.translated_text: Then Prince <s>Jyotiṣka</s>, having left the royal palace and mounted on an elephant's back, was going home through the middle of the street.

children.text: tena śrutam ||
children.translated_text: He heard him.

children.text: sa taiḥ śabditaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was addressed by them.

children.text: jyotiṣkeṇokto bho brāhmaṇa kimarthaṃ tvam apattanaṃ ghoṣayasi gṛhapate asyā yamalyāḥ kārṣāpaṇasahasraṃ mūlyam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jyotiṣka</s> said, "Good Brahmin, why are you proclaiming that this is no marketplace?" "Householder, the price of this pair of cloths is a thousand kārṣāpaṇas.

children.text: na ca kaścidyācata iti ||
children.translated_text: And no one asks for it," he said.

children.text: sa kathayati ānaya paśyāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Bring it; let us see."

children.text: tenopadarśitā ||
children.translated_text: It was shown to him.

children.text: jyotiṣkaḥ kathayati astyetadeva ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jyotiṣka</s> said, "So it is.

children.text: kiṃtu atraikaṃ vastraṃ paribhuktakam ||
children.translated_text: But here one cloth has been used,

children.text: ekamaparibhuktakam ||
children.translated_text: and one has not been used.

children.text: yad aparibhuktam asya pañcakārṣāpaṇaśatāni mūlyam ||
children.translated_text: The one that has not been used is worth five hundred kārṣāpaṇas.

children.text: yattu paribhuktakam asyārdhatṛtīyāni ||
children.translated_text: But the one that has been used is worth two hundred and fifty."

children.text: brāhmaṇaḥ kathayati kimetadevaṃ bhaviṣyati jyotiṣkaḥ kathayati brāhmaṇa tava pratyakṣīkaromi ||
children.translated_text: The Brahmin said, "Will this really be so?" <s>Jyotiṣka</s> said, "Brahmin, I will make it evident before your eyes.

children.text: paśyeti ||
children.translated_text: Watch."

children.text: tenāsau aparibhukta uparivihāyasā kṣiptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He threw the unused cloth up into the air.

children.text: vitānaṃ kṛtvā avasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: It remained there, forming a canopy.

children.text: paribhuktaḥ kṣiptaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The used cloth was thrown.

children.text: kṣiptamātraka eva patitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The very moment it was thrown, it fell.

children.text: brāhmaṇo dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vismayamāpannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeing this, the Brahmin was filled with great amazement.

children.text: kathayati gṛhapate maharddhikastvam mahānubhāva iti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Householder, you possess great miraculous power and great majesty."

children.text: jyotiṣkaḥ kathayati brāhmaṇa punaḥ paśyainaṃ yo 'sau aparibhuktaka iti sa kaṇṭakavāṭasyopariṣṭāt kṣipto 'sajjamāno gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jyotiṣka</s> said, "Brahmin, look again. That one which is unused was thrown over a thorn fence and went across without catching.

children.text: so 'nyaḥ kṣiptaḥ kaṇṭake lagnaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The other one, when thrown, caught on the thorns."

children.text: sa brāhmaṇo bhūyasyā mātrayā abhiprasannaḥ kathayati gṛhapate maharddhikastvaṃ mahānubhāvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The Brahmin became still more deeply pleased and said, "Householder, you possess great miraculous power and great majesty.

children.text: yat tavābhipretaṃ tatprayaccheti ||
children.translated_text: Give whatever you wish."

children.text: sa kathayati brāhmaṇa atithistvam ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Brahmin, you are a guest.

children.text: tavaiva pūjā kṛtā bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The honor has been done to you yourself.

children.text: sahasrameva prayacchāmīti ||
children.translated_text: I will give the full thousand."

children.text: tena tasya kārṣāpaṇasahasraṃ dattam ||
children.translated_text: He gave him a thousand kārṣāpaṇas.

children.text: brāhmaṇastamādāya prakrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The Brahmin took it and departed.

children.text: jyotiṣkeṇa tato yaḥ paribhuktakaḥ sa dārakāya datto 'paribhuktakastu snānaśāṭakaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Jyotiṣka</s> gave the used cloth to a boy, while the unused one he made into a bathing garment.

children.text: yāvadapareṇa samayena rājā bimbisāra upariprāsādatalagato 'mātyagaṇaparivṛtastiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: At another time King <s>Bimbisāra</s> was standing on the upper terrace of the palace, surrounded by a group of ministers.

children.text: jyotiṣkasya sa snānaśāṭaka upari gṛhasyābhyavakāśe śoṣito vāyunā hriyamāṇo rājño bimbisārasyopari patitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jyotiṣka</s>'s bathing garment, which had been set out to dry in the open space above the house, was carried off by the wind and fell upon King <s>Bimbisāra</s>.

children.text: rājā kathayati bhavantaḥ rājārhamidaṃ vastram ||
children.translated_text: The king said, "Sirs, this cloth is worthy of a king.

children.text: kuta etaditi ||
children.translated_text: Where has it come from?"

children.text: te kathayanti deva śrūyate rājño māndhātuḥ saptāhaṃ hiraṇyavarṣaṃ patitam ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Your Majesty, it is heard that for King <s>Māndhātṛ</s> a rain of gold fell for seven days.

children.text: devasyāpi vastravarṣaḥ patitumārabdham ||
children.translated_text: For Your Majesty too a rain of cloth has begun to fall.

children.text: nacirāddhiraṇyavarṣaḥ patiṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: Before long a rain of gold will fall."

children.text: rājā kathayati bhavantaḥ jyotiṣko gṛhapatirbhagavatā vyākṛto divyamānuṣīṃ śriyaṃ pratyanubhaviṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: The king said, "Sirs, the householder <s>Jyotiṣka</s> was predicted by the Blessed One: 'He will experience divine and human splendor.'

children.text: idaṃ ca divyaṃ vastramākāśāt patitam ||
children.translated_text: And this divine cloth has fallen from the sky.

children.text: sthāpayata ||
children.translated_text: Put it aside.

children.text: tasyaivāgatasya dāsyāmīti ||
children.translated_text: I will give it to him when he comes."

children.text: te caivamālāpaṃ kurvanti jyotiṣkaścāgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Just as they were having this conversation, <s>Jyotiṣka</s> arrived.

children.text: rājā kathayati kumāra tvaṃ bhagavatā vyākṛto divyamānuṣīṃ śriyaṃ pratyanubhaviṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: The king said, "Prince, you were predicted by the Blessed One: 'He will experience divine and human splendor.'

children.text: mama cedaṃ divyaṃ vastramākāśāt patitam ||
children.translated_text: And this divine cloth has fallen upon me from the sky.

children.text: gṛhāṇeti ||
children.translated_text: Take it."

children.text: tena hastaḥ prasāritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He stretched out his hand.

children.text: deva ānaya paśyāmīti ||
children.translated_text: "Your Majesty, bring it; let me see," he said.

children.text: sa nirīkṣitumārabdho yāvat paśyatyātmīyaṃ snānaśāṭakam ||
children.translated_text: He began to inspect it, until he saw that it was his own bathing garment.

children.text: sa vismṛtya kathayati deva madīyo 'yaṃ snānaśāṭako vāyunopakṣipta ihāgata iti ||
children.translated_text: Forgetting himself, he said, "Your Majesty, this is my own bathing garment; carried up by the wind, it has come here."

children.text: kumāra tava divyamānuṣyakī śrīḥ prādurbhūtā deva prādurbhūtā ||
children.translated_text: "Prince, your divine and human splendor has appeared." "Your Majesty, it has appeared."

children.text: kumāra yadyevam kimarthaṃ na nimantrayasi deva nimantrito bhava ||
children.translated_text: "Prince, if that is so, why do you not invite me?" "Your Majesty, be invited."

children.text: gaccha bhaktaṃ sajjīkuru ||
children.translated_text: "Go, prepare the meal."

children.text: deva yasya divyamānuṣī śrīḥ prādurbhūtā kiṃ tena sajjīkartavyam nanu sajjīkṛtameva gaccheti ||
children.translated_text: "Your Majesty, what should be prepared by one whose divine and human splendor has appeared? Surely it is already prepared. Come."

children.text: sa jyotiṣkasya gṛhaṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He went to <s>Jyotiṣka</s>'s house.

children.text: rājā bāhyaṃ parijanaṃ dṛṣṭvā indriyāṇyutkṣipati ||
children.translated_text: Seeing the outer attendants, the king averted his eyes.

children.text: deva kimarthamindriyāṇyutkṣipasi ||
children.translated_text: "Your Majesty, why do you avert your eyes?"

children.text: sa kathayati kumāra vadhūjano 'yamiti kṛtvā ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Prince, because I thought, 'These are the women of the household.'"

children.text: deva nāyaṃ vadhūjanaḥ bāhyo 'yaṃ parijanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Your Majesty, these are not the women of the household; these are the outer attendants."

children.text: sa paraṃ vismayamāpannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was filled with great amazement.

children.text: punarmadhyaṃ janaṃ dṛṣṭvā indriyāṇyutkṣiptumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Again, seeing the middle attendants, he began to avert his eyes.

children.text: tathaiva pṛcchati ||
children.translated_text: In the same way he asked him.

children.text: rājā api tathaiva kathayati ||
children.translated_text: And the king answered in the same way.

children.text: jyotiṣkaḥ kathayati deva ayamapi na vadhūjanaḥ kiṃtu madhyo 'yaṃ janaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jyotiṣka</s> said, "Your Majesty, this too is not the women's quarters; rather, these are the middle attendants."

children.text: sa bhūyasyā mātrayā paraṃ vismayamāpannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He became exceedingly astonished.

children.text: tasya madhyamāyāṃ dvāraśālāyāṃ maṇibhūmiruparacitā ||
children.translated_text: In the middle gate-hall of his house a jeweled floor had been constructed.

children.text: tasyāṃ matsyā udakapūrṇāyāmiva yantrayogenoparibhramanto dṛśyante ||
children.translated_text: On it fish were seen moving about above, by means of a mechanism, as if it were filled with water.

children.text: rājā praveṣṭukāmo vāpīti kṛtvopānahau moktumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The king, wishing to enter and thinking it was a pond, began to take off his sandals.

children.text: jyotiṣkaḥ kathayati deva kasyārthe upānahau apanayasīti sa kathayati kumāra pānīyamuttartavyamiti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jyotiṣka</s> said, "Your Majesty, why are you removing your sandals?" He said, "Prince, the water must be crossed."

children.text: jyotiṣkaḥ kathayati deva nedaṃ pānīyaṃ maṇibhūmireṣā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jyotiṣka</s> said, "Your Majesty, this is not water; this is a jeweled floor."

children.text: sa kathayati kumāra ime matsyā upari bhramantaḥ paśyanti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Prince, look at these fish moving about above."

children.text: deva yantrayogenaite paribhramanti ||
children.translated_text: "Your Majesty, they are moving about by means of a mechanism."

children.text: sa na śraddhatte ||
children.translated_text: He did not believe it.

children.text: tenāṅgulimudrā kṣiptā ||
children.translated_text: He threw down his signet ring.

children.text: sā raṇaraṇāśabdena bhūmau patitā ||
children.translated_text: It fell on the floor with a rattling sound.

children.text: tato vismayamāpannaḥ praviśya siṃhāsane niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, astonished, he entered and sat down on the lion-throne.

children.text: vadhūjanaḥ pādābhivandana upasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The women came forward to bow at his feet.

children.text: tāsāmaśrupāto jātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Tears fell from their eyes.

children.text: rājā kathayati kumāra kasmādayaṃ vadhūjano roditi deva nāyaṃ roditi kiṃtu devasya kāṣṭhadhūmena vastrāṇi dhūpitāni tena āsāmaśrupato jāta iti ||
children.translated_text: The king said, "Prince, why are these women weeping?" "Your Majesty, they are not weeping. Your Majesty's clothes have been scented with wood smoke, and because of that their tears have fallen."

children.text: rājā tatra divyamānuṣyā śriyā upacaryamāṇaḥ pramatto na niṣkrāmati ||
children.translated_text: The king, being attended there with divine and human splendor, became absorbed and did not go out.

children.text: rājakṛtyāni rājakaraṇīyāni parihātumārabdhāni ||
children.translated_text: The royal business and the king's duties began to be neglected.

children.text: amātyairajātaśatruḥ kumāro 'bhibhūtaḥ kumāra devo jyotiṣkasya gṛhaṃ praviśya pramattaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The ministers urged Prince <s>Ajātaśatru</s>: "Prince, His Majesty has entered <s>Jyotiṣka</s>'s house and has become absorbed.

children.text: gaccha nivedayeti ||
children.translated_text: Go and inform him."

children.text: tena gatvā ukto deva kimatra praviśyāvasthito 'mātyāḥ kathayanti rājakṛtyāni rājakaraṇīyāni parihīyanta iti ||
children.translated_text: He went and said, "Your Majesty, why have you entered here and remained? The ministers say that the royal business and the king's duties are being neglected."

children.text: sa kathayati kumāra na śaknoṣi tvamekaṃ divasaṃ rājyaṃ kārayitum kiṃ devo jānīte mamaiko divasaḥ praviṣṭasya adya devasya saptamo divaso vartate ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Prince, can you not administer the kingdom for one day?" "Does Your Majesty know? Though I have been inside for one day, today is Your Majesty's seventh day."

children.text: rājā jyotiṣkasya mukhaṃ nirīkṣya kathayati kumāra satyam deva satyam ||
children.translated_text: The king looked at <s>Jyotiṣka</s>'s face and said, "Prince, is this true?" "Your Majesty, it is true.

children.text: saptama eva divaso vartate ||
children.translated_text: It is indeed the seventh day."

children.text: kumāra kathaṃ rātrirjñāyate divaso vā deva puṣpāṇāṃ saṃkocavikāsānmaṇīnāṃ jvalanājvalanayogācchakunīnāṃ ca kūjanākūjanāt ||
children.translated_text: "Prince, how is night or day known?" "Your Majesty, by the closing and opening of flowers, by the lighting and not lighting of gems, and by the singing and not singing of birds.

children.text: santi tāni puṣpāṇi yāni rātrau vikasanti divā mlāyanti santi yāni divā vikasanti rātrau mlāyanti santi te maṇayo ye rātrau jvalanti na divā santi ye divā jvalanti na rātrau santi te śakunayo ye rātrau kūjanti na divā santi ye divā kūjanti na rātrau rājā vismayamāpannaḥ kathayati kumāra avitathavādī bhagavān ||
children.translated_text: There are flowers that open at night and wither by day; there are others that open by day and wither at night. There are gems that shine at night but not by day; there are others that shine by day but not at night. There are birds that sing at night but not by day; there are others that sing by day but not at night." The king, astonished, said, "Prince, the Blessed One speaks no falsehood.

children.text: yathā tvaṃ bhagavatā vyākṛtastathaiva nānyathetyuktvā jyotiṣkagṛhāt niṣkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Just as you were predicted by the Blessed One, so it is, and not otherwise." Having said this, he departed from <s>Jyotiṣka</s>'s house.

children.text: ajātaśatrukumāreṇa jyotiṣkasantako maṇirapahṛtya dārakasya haste dattaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Prince <s>Ajātaśatru</s> stole a jewel belonging to <s>Jyotiṣka</s> and placed it in the hand of a boy.

children.text: tena yata eva gṛhītastatraiva gatvāvasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: It went back and remained in the very place from which it had been taken.

children.text: ajātaśatruḥ kathayati dāraka ānaya taṃ maṇiṃ paśyāmīti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ajātaśatru</s> said, "Boy, bring that jewel here; I will look at it."

children.text: sa muṣṭiṃ vighāṭya kathayati kumāra na jāne kutra gata iti ||
children.translated_text: Opening his fist, the boy said, "Prince, I do not know where it has gone."

children.text: sa taṃ tāḍayitumārabdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He began to beat him.

children.text: jyotiṣkaḥ kathayati kumāra kimarthamenaṃ tāḍayasi gṛhapate ahaṃ cauraḥ eṣa mahācauraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jyotiṣka</s> said, "Prince, why are you beating him?" "Householder, I am a thief, and he is a great thief.

children.text: mayā tvadīyo maṇirapahṛtaḥ so 'pyanenāpahṛta iti ||
children.translated_text: I stole your jewel, and it too was stolen by him."

children.text: sa kathayati kumāra na tvayā apahṛto nāpyanena api tu yata eva tvayā gṛhītastatraiva gatvā avasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Prince, it was not stolen by you, nor by him. Rather, it has gone back and remained in the very place from which you took it.

children.text: api tu kumāra svakaṃ te gṛham ||
children.translated_text: But, Prince, your own home is yours.

children.text: yāvadbhirmaṇibhiranyena vā prayojanaṃ tāvadgṛhāṇa yathāsukhamiti ||
children.translated_text: Take as many jewels, or whatever else, as you need, as you please."

children.text: sa pratibhinnakaḥ saṃlakṣayate yadā pituratyayādrājā bhaviṣyāmi tadā grahīṣyāmīti ||
children.translated_text: That malicious one thought, "When, after my father's death, I become king, then I will take them."

children.text: yadā ajātaśatruṇā devadattavigrāhitena pitā dhārmiko dharmarājo jīvitād vyaparopitaḥ svayameva ca paṭṭaṃ baddhvā pratiṣṭhitas tadā tena jyotiṣko 'bhihito gṛhapate tvaṃ mama bhrātā bhavasi ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Ajātaśatru</s>, stirred up by <s>Devadatta</s>, had deprived his righteous father, the dharma-king, of life, and had bound the diadem on himself and established himself, he said to <s>Jyotiṣka</s>, "Householder, you are my brother.

children.text: gṛhaṃ bhājayāma iti ||
children.translated_text: Let us divide the house."

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayati yena pitā dhārmiko dharmarājaḥ praghātitaḥ sa māṃ marṣayatīti kuta etan nūnamayaṃ madgṛhamāgacchatu kāmaṃ prayacchāmīti viditvā kathayati deva vibhaktameva kimatra vibhaktavyam madīyaṃ gṛhamāgaccha ahaṃ tvadīyaṃ gṛhamāgacchāmīti ||
children.translated_text: He reflected, "He who has had his righteous father, the dharma-king, killed, how could he show forbearance toward me? Surely he should come to my house; I will gladly give it." Understanding this, he said, "Your Majesty, it is already divided. What is there to divide? Come to my house, and I will come to your house."

children.text: ajātaśatruḥ kathayati śobhanam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ajātaśatru</s> said, "Good.

children.text: evaṃ kuru ||
children.translated_text: Do this."

children.text: sa tasya gṛhaṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He went to his house.

children.text: jyotiṣko 'pyajātaśatrorgṛhaṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jyotiṣka</s> also went to <s>Ajātaśatru</s>'s house.

children.text: sā śrīstasmādgṛhādantarhitā yatra jyotiṣkastatraiva gatā ||
children.translated_text: That splendor disappeared from that house and went to the very place where <s>Jyotiṣka</s> was.

children.text: evam yāvat saptavārānantarhitā prādurbhūtā ca ||
children.translated_text: In this way, up to seven times, it disappeared and appeared again.

children.text: ajātaśatruḥ saṃlakṣayate evamapi mayā na śakitaṃ jyotiṣkasya maṇīnapahartum ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ajātaśatru</s> thought, "Even in this way I have not been able to steal <s>Jyotiṣka</s>'s jewels.

children.text: anyadupāyaṃ karomi ||
children.translated_text: I will devise another means."

children.text: tena dhūrtapuruṣāḥ prayuktā gacchata jyotiṣkasya gṛhānmaṇīnapaharateti ||
children.translated_text: He employed rogues, saying, "Go, steal the jewels from <s>Jyotiṣka</s>'s house."

children.text: te hi śiṭākarkaṭakaprayogenābhiroḍhum ārabdhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They began to climb up by using a <s>śiṭākarkaṭaka</s> device.

children.text: te 'ntaḥpurikayā upariprāsādatalagatayā dṛṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They were seen by a woman of the inner apartments who had gone to the upper palace floor.

children.text: tayā dhūrtadhūrtakā iti nādo muktaḥ ||
children.translated_text: She cried out, "Rogues, rogues!"

children.text: jyotiṣkeṇa śrutam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jyotiṣka</s> heard it.

children.text: tenāśayato vāṅniścāritā tiṣṭhantu dhūrtakā iti ||
children.translated_text: From where he lay, he uttered the words, "Let the rogues stay."

children.text: teṣām yo yatrābhirūḍhaḥ sa tatraivāsthito yāvat prabhātā rajanī saṃvṛttā ||
children.translated_text: Each of them, wherever he had climbed up, remained fixed just there until the night turned to dawn.

children.text: mahājanakāyena dṛṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They were seen by the great crowd of people.

children.text: te kathayanti bhavantaḥ anena kalirājena pitā dhārmiko dharmarājo jīvitād vyaparopitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Sirs, by this wicked king his righteous father, the dharma-king, was deprived of life.

children.text: idānīṃ gṛhāṇyapi moṣayati ||
children.translated_text: Now he is even having houses robbed.

children.text: tatkiṃ na me moṣiṣyata iti purakṣobho jātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: What then will he not steal from me?" Thus an uproar arose in the city.

children.text: ajātaśatruṇā jyotiṣkasya dūto 'nupreṣito muñcata mamāyaṃ khalīkāra saṃlakṣayate yena nāma pitā jīvitād vyaparopitaḥ sa māṃ na praghātayiṣyatīti kuta etat sarvathā ahaṃ bhagavatā vyākṛto mama śāsane pravrajya sarvakleśaprahāṇādarhattvaṃ sākṣātkariṣyatīti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ajātaśatru</s> sent a messenger to <s>Jyotiṣka</s>: "Release them; this is understood as an insult to me." <s>Jyotiṣka</s> thought, "How could this be: that the man by whom his father was deprived of life will not kill me? In every way I was predicted by the Blessed One: 'Having gone forth in my teaching, he will realize <s>arhattva</s> (arhatship) through the abandonment of all defilements.'

children.text: gacchāmi pravrajāmīti ||
children.translated_text: I will go and take <s>pravrajyā</s> (renunciation)."

children.text: tena sarvaṃ ghanajātaṃ dīnānāthakṛpaṇebhyo dattam ||
children.translated_text: He gave all his amassed wealth to the poor, the helpless, and the destitute.

children.text: adhanāḥ sadhanā vyavasthāpitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those without wealth were established as people with wealth.

children.text: atha jyotiṣko gṛhapatiḥ suhṛtsambandhibāndhavānavalokya yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the householder <s>Jyotiṣka</s>, after looking upon his friends, relations, and kinsmen, approached the Blessed One.

children.text: upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having approached, he bowed with his head at the Blessed One's feet and sat down to one side.

children.text: ekāntaniṣaṇṇo jyotiṣko gṛhapatirbhagavantamidamavocal labheyāhaṃ bhadanta svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajyāmupasampadaṃ bhikṣubhāvam ||
children.translated_text: Sitting to one side, the householder <s>Jyotiṣka</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Venerable sir, may I obtain going forth, ordination, and the state of a monk in the well-proclaimed <s>dharmavinaya</s> (teaching and discipline).

children.text: careyamahaṃ bhagavato 'ntike brahmacaryamiti ||
children.translated_text: May I practice the holy life in the presence of the Blessed One."

children.text: sa bhagavatā ehibhikṣukayā ābhāṣita ehi bhikṣo cara brahmacaryamiti ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One addressed him with the formula of an "Come, monk" ordination: "Come, monk; practice the holy life."

children.text: bhagavato vācāvasānameva muṇḍaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At the very end of the Blessed One's utterance he became shaven-headed.

children.text: saṃghāṭīprāvṛtaḥ pātrakaravyagrahastaḥ saptāhāvaropitakeśaśmaśrurvarṣaśatopasaṃpannasya bhikṣurīryāpathenāvasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Clothed in a monastic robe, with his hands occupied by a bowl, with hair and beard as if seven days grown back, he stood in the deportment of a monk ordained for a hundred years.

children.text: ehīti coktaḥ sa tathāgatena muṇḍaśca saṃghāṭiparītadehaḥ
children.translated_text: And when the <s>Tathāgata</s> had said, "Come," he was shaven-headed, his body wrapped in the monastic robe,

children.text: sadyaḥ praśāntendriya eva tasthāvupasthito buddhamanorathena ||
children.translated_text: and at once he stood with tranquil senses, as if present there by the Buddha's own wish.

children.text: tasya bhagavatā avavādo dattaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One gave him instruction.

children.text: tenodyacchamānena vyāyacchamānena idameva pañcagaṇḍakaṃ saṃsāracakraṃ calācalaṃ viditvā sarvasaṃskāragatīḥ śatanapatanavikiraṇavidhvaṃsanadharmatayā parāhatya sarvakleśaprahāṇādarhattvaṃ sākṣātkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: As he strove and exerted himself, he understood this very wheel of <s>saṃsāra</s>, afflicted with five sores and unstable though seeming stable; having overcome all the courses of conditioned things as having the nature of breaking, falling, scattering, and destruction, he realized <s>arhattva</s> through the abandonment of all defilements.

children.text: arhan saṃvṛttastraidhātukavītarāgaḥ samaloṣṭakāñcana ākāśapāṇitalasamacitto vāsīcandanakalpo vidyāvidāritāṇḍakośo vidyābhijñāpratisaṃvitprāpto bhavalābhalobhasatkāraparāṅmukhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He became an arhat, free from passion for the three realms, regarding clod and gold alike, with a mind equal toward the sky and the palm of the hand, comparable toward axe and sandalwood, his eggshell split by knowledge, having attained knowledge, superknowledges, and analytical understandings, and turned away from gain, existence, greed, and honor.

children.text: sendropendrāṇāṃ devānāṃ pūjyo mānyo 'bhivādyaśca saṃvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He became worthy of worship, honor, and reverence from gods together with <s>Indra</s> and <s>Upendra</s>.

children.text: bhikṣavaḥ saṃśayajātāḥ sarvasaṃśayacchettāraṃ buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ papracchuḥ kiṃ bhadanta āyuṣmatā jyotiṣkeṇa karma kṛtam yena citāmāropitaḥ divyamānuṣī śrīḥ prādurbhūtā bhagavataḥ śāsane pravrajya sarvakleśaprahāṇādarhattvaṃ sākṣātkṛtamiti bhagavānāha jyotiṣkeṇaiva bhikṣavaḥ karmāṇi kṛtānyupacitāni labdhasaṃhārāṇi pariṇatapratyayānyoghavatpratyupasthitānyavaśyambhāvīni ||
children.translated_text: The monks, overcome by doubt, asked the Buddha, the Blessed One, the cutter-off of all doubts: "Venerable sir, what karma was done by the venerable <s>Jyotiṣka</s>, that he was placed on a funeral pyre, that divine and human splendor appeared for him, and that, having gone forth in the Blessed One's teaching, he realized <s>arhattva</s> through the abandonment of all defilements?" The Blessed One said, "Monks, deeds were done and accumulated by <s>Jyotiṣka</s>; they had gathered their necessary conditions, had ripened in their causes, had arisen like a flood, and were inevitable.

children.text: jyotiṣkeṇa karmāṇi kṛtānyupacitāni ||
children.translated_text: Deeds were done and accumulated by <s>Jyotiṣka</s>.

children.text: ko 'nyaḥ pratyanubhaviṣyati na bhikṣavaḥ karmāṇi kṛtānyupacitāni pṛthivīdhātau vipacyante nābdhātau na tejodhātau na vāyudhātau api tūpātteṣveva skandhadhātvāyataneṣu karmāṇi kṛtānyupacitāni vipacyante śubhānyaśubhāni ca ||
children.translated_text: Who else will experience them? Monks, deeds done and accumulated do not ripen in the earth element, nor in the water element, nor in the fire element, nor in the wind element; rather, deeds done and accumulated, both good and bad, ripen only in the appropriated aggregates, elements, and sense-bases.

children.text: na praṇaśyanti karmāṇi kalpakoṭiśatairapi
children.translated_text: Deeds do not perish, even in hundreds of crores of eons;

children.text: sāmagrīṃ prāpya kālaṃ ca phalanti khalu dehinām ||
children.translated_text: when they have obtained the conjunction and the time, they indeed bear fruit for embodied beings.

children.text: bhūtapūrvaṃ bhikṣava ekanavatikalpe vipaśyī nāma śāstā loka udapādi tathāgato 'rhan samyaksambuddho vidyācaraṇasampannaḥ sugato lokavidanuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā devamanuṣyāṇāṃ buddho bhagavān ||
children.translated_text: In the past, monks, ninety-one eons ago, a teacher named <s>Vipaśyī</s> arose in the world: a <s>Tathāgata</s>, arhat, perfectly awakened Buddha, endowed with knowledge and conduct, well-gone, knower of the world, unsurpassed guide of persons to be tamed, teacher of gods and humans, Buddha, Blessed One.

children.text: dvāṣaṣṭibhikṣusahasraparivāro janapadacārikāṃ caran bandhumatīṃ rājadhānīmanuprāpto bandhumatyāṃ viharati sma bandhumatīyake dāve ||
children.translated_text: Surrounded by sixty-two thousand monks, while wandering on a tour through the countryside, he arrived at the capital <s>Bandhumatī</s> and was dwelling at <s>Bandhumatī</s> in the <s>Bandhumatī</s> forest.

children.text: tena khalu samayena bandhumatyāṃ rājadhānyāṃ bandhumān nāma rājā rājyaṃ kārayati ṛddhaṃ ca sphītaṃ ca kṣemaṃ ca subhikṣaṃ ca ākīrṇabahujanamanuṣyaṃ ca praśāntakalikalahaḍimbaḍamaraṃ taskararogāpagataṃ śālīkṣugomahiṣīsampannam ||
children.translated_text: At that time, in the capital <s>Bandhumatī</s>, a king named <s>Bandhumān</s> was ruling a kingdom that was prosperous, flourishing, secure, well supplied with food, crowded with many people, quieted of strife, quarrel, turmoil, and disturbance, free from thieves and disease, and rich in rice, sugarcane, cows, and buffaloes.

children.text: dhārmiko dharmarājā dharmeṇa rājyaṃ kārayati ||
children.translated_text: He was righteous, a dharma-king, and ruled the kingdom according to <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: tasyānaṅgaṇo nāma gṛhapatirāḍhyo mahādhano mahābhogo vistīrṇaviśālaparigraho vaiśravaṇadhanasamudito vaiśravaṇadhanapratispardhī ||
children.translated_text: There was there a householder named <s>Anaṅgaṇa</s>, rich, possessing great wealth and great enjoyments, with extensive and vast possessions, endowed with wealth like that of <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s> and rivaling the wealth of <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s>.

children.text: sa saṃlakṣayate bahuśo mayā vipaśyī samyaksambuddho 'ntargṛhe upanimantrya bhojitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He reflected, "Many times I have invited <s>Vipaśyī</s>, the perfectly awakened Buddha, into my house and fed him.

children.text: na tu kadācit traimāsīṃ sarvopakaraṇaiḥ pravāritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: But never have I provided for him for three months with all the requisites.

children.text: yannvahaṃ vipaśyinaṃ samyaksambuddhaṃ traimāsīṃ sarvopakaraṇaiḥ pravārayeyam ||
children.translated_text: What if I were to provide for <s>Vipaśyī</s>, the perfectly awakened Buddha, for three months with all the requisites?"

children.text: iti viditvā yena vipaśyī samyaksambuddhastenopasaṃkrāntaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having understood this, he went to where <s>Vipaśyī</s>, the perfectly awakened Buddha, was.

children.text: upasaṃkramya vipaśyinaḥ samyaksambuddhasya pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte niṣaṇṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having gone there, he bowed with his head at the feet of <s>Vipaśyī</s>, the perfectly awakened Buddha, and sat down to one side.

children.text: ekāntaniṣaṇṇamanaṅgaṇaṃ gṛhapatiṃ vipaśyī samyaksambuddho dharmyayā kathayā saṃdarśayati samādāpayati samuttejayati saṃpraharṣayati ||
children.translated_text: As <s>Anaṅgaṇa</s> the householder was seated to one side, <s>Vipaśyī</s>, the perfectly awakened Buddha, instructed him, moved him to undertake, stirred him, and gladdened him with a discourse on <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: anekaparyāyeṇa dharmyayā kathayā saṃdarśya samādāpya samuttejya saṃpraharṣya tūṣṇīm ||
children.translated_text: After instructing him, moving him to undertake, stirring him, and gladdening him in many ways with a discourse on <s>dharma</s>, he became silent.

children.text: athānaṅgaṇo gṛhapatirutthāyāsanād ekāṃsamuttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā yena vipaśyī samyaksambuddhastenāñjaliṃ praṇamya vipaśyinaṃ samyaksambuddhamidamavocad adhivāsayatu me bhagavāṃs traimāsīṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātaśayanāsanaglānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkāraiḥ sārdhaṃ bhikṣusaṃgheneti ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Anaṅgaṇa</s> the householder rose from his seat, arranged his upper robe over one shoulder, bowed with joined palms toward <s>Vipaśyī</s>, the perfectly awakened Buddha, and said this to him: "May the Blessed One accept from me for three months robes, alms-food, beds and seats, and medicines and requisites for the sick, together with the community of monks."

children.text: adhivāsayati vipaśyī samyaksambuddho 'naṅgaṇasya gṛhapatestūṣṇīmbhāvena ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vipaśyī</s>, the perfectly awakened Buddha, accepted <s>Anaṅgaṇa</s> the householder's invitation by remaining silent.
